normal.ans: A FAMILIAR ENDING CAN STILL FEEL FRESH IN PERFORMANCE
normal.speak: a familiar ending can still feel fresh in performance
normal.vocabId: R6:A FAMILIAR ENDING CAN STILL FEEL FRESH IN PERFORMANCE
normal.explain: 口說表達「A FAMILIAR ENDING CAN STILL FEEL FRESH IN PERFORMANCE」(phr.)：熟悉結局演出時仍可新鮮。例句：A familiar ending can still feel fresh in performance.（熟悉結局演出時仍可新鮮。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：音樂蓋過開頭台詞
normal.ans: THE MUSIC DROWNED OUT THE OPENING WORDS
normal.speak: the music drowned out the opening words
normal.vocabId: R6:THE MUSIC DROWNED OUT THE OPENING WORDS
normal.explain: 口說表達「THE MUSIC DROWNED OUT THE OPENING WORDS」(phr.)：音樂蓋過開頭台詞。例句：The music drowned out the opening words.（音樂蓋過開頭台詞。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：為正式演出預先練習的排練（R 開頭，9 個字母）
normal.explain: REHEARSAL (n.)：為正式演出預先練習的排練。例句：The rehearsal focuses on scene changes.（排練重點是轉場。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：供觀眾觀看演出的大廳（A 開頭，10 個字母）
normal.explain: AUDITORIUM (n.)：供觀眾觀看演出的大廳。例句：The auditorium was quiet before the music began.（音樂前觀眾廳很安靜。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：集中照亮舞台一小區域的燈光（S 開頭，9 個字母）
normal.explain: SPOTLIGHT (n.)：集中照亮舞台一小區域的燈光。例句：A spotlight lit the empty chair.（聚光燈照亮空椅。）

normal.desc: 填空題：C U R _ A I N (舞台前可開合的布幕)
normal.explain: CURTAIN (n.)：舞台前可開合的布幕。填空答案為「T」。例句：The curtain remained closed.（布幕保持關閉。）

normal.desc: 填空題：P _ _ P (演出中使用的可移動道具)
normal.explain: PROP (n.)：演出中使用的可移動道具。填空答案為「RO」。例句：The letter is an important prop.（信是重要道具。）

normal.desc: 填空題：I N _ E _ V _ L (演出兩部分之間的休息時間)
normal.explain: INTERVAL (n.)：演出兩部分之間的休息時間。填空答案為「TRA」。例句：The talk takes place after the interval.（談話在中場後舉行。）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 替我把所有文件逐行抄好
B. 有空傳個短訊息給我
C. 把電線從樓上放下來
D. 在名單上把我的姓名刪除
normal.explain: drop a line 指簡短聯繫。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 只准用鉛筆寫任何信件
B. 把該事項永久劃掉不再討論
C. 先暫定排進行程
D. 把安排確認為永不可改
normal.explain: pencil in 表暫定，常仍可調整。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 把物品留著不要讓我碰
B. 等我回來前不准任何人決定
C. 正式宣布事情已處理完畢
D. 把這事交給我處理
normal.explain: 常用於承接調查或處理，未保證已完成。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Did you send the attachment? I thought I had, but I have just noticed it is still in my drafts.
options: A. 說話者從未想寄附件，只準備空白信。
B. 草稿已收回，附件則由別人轉寄。
C. 以為已寄附件，但剛發現還在草稿。
D. 附件已寄，剛發現收件者刪掉了。
normal.explain: thought vs just noticed 修正先前以為已完成的狀態。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I would rather hear that the date does not work than have you agree and struggle to make it.
options: A. 我希望你先答應，之後再處理無法出席的問題。
B. 只要你無法出席，就不必告訴我任何原因或日期。
C. 說話者認為所有人都應取消其他安排來配合。
D. 我寧願知道日期不合，也不想你答應後勉強趕來。
normal.explain: 鼓勵誠實回應而非勉強承諾，非禁止出席。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The message sounded urgent, although the deadline at the bottom is not until next month.
options: A. 訊息聽來急，但文末截止其實到下月。
B. 截止已過一個月，所以語氣不急也需立即處理。
C. 訊息已明說月底之前任何時間都不接受回覆。
D. 語氣與日期完全一致，沒有需要注意的落差。
normal.explain: 語氣急迫與實際時間資訊有反差，不判是否真緊急。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I did not mean to leave you out; I assumed the invitation had already reached you through Sam.
options: A. 我故意只邀山姆，並要求他不准告訴你。
B. 我確認你收到了，所以現在撤回邀請。
C. 山姆已承認拒絕轉交，說話者也同意。
D. 不是有意漏你，我以為山姆已把邀請給你。
normal.explain: 說明自身假設與意圖，未證明Sam實際做了什麼。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I appreciate the reminder, though I would have preferred it before I had made the arrangements rather than afterwards.
options: A. 謝謝提醒，但希望在我安排前而非之後告知。
B. 提醒來得太早，所以我還無法開始安排。
C. 我已因這次提醒取消所有安排，也不感謝對方。
D. 說話者認為提醒只在事情全部結束後才有用。
normal.explain: 肯定提醒功能但批評時機已晚。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The invitation is open-ended about when I visit, not about how long I stay once I arrive.
options: A. 說話者認為不能決定日期就等於沒有邀請。
B. 邀請對何時來沒限定，不代表停留多久也無限。
C. 何時來固定，來後停留則完全不受限制。
D. 邀請已保證可永久住下，不需再確認。
normal.explain: when versus how long，開放範圍不能外推。

normal.desc: 【文法】Would you mind ___ me know if the date changes?
options: A. having let to
B. letting
C. to let
D. let
normal.explain: mind 後用動名詞 letting，let me know 為告知。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Which verb means to accept that a message has been received?
options: A. enclose
B. redirect
C. acknowledge
D. postpone
normal.explain: acknowledge 在訊息語境可指確認收到，非一定贊同內容。

normal.desc: 【語意】The letter says, Please reply by Monday, even if your answer is no. What is requested?
options: A. A response only from people who accept the invitation.
B. An explanation of why Monday is an unsuitable date.
C. A decision to accept unless a reply arrives on Monday.
D. A response regardless of whether the invitation is accepted.
normal.explain: even if no 明示婉拒也需回覆。

normal.desc: 【指涉】I can lend you the blue folder, but I need the red one back tonight. What does one refer to?
options: A. A colour sample.
B. A loan application.
C. A folder.
D. A night.
normal.explain: one 代替前面的 folder，red one 為紅文件夾。

normal.desc: 【短文】A message reads, I am free on Tuesday after three, or on Thursday before noon. Which proposed meeting fits?
options: A. Tuesday at two in the afternoon.
B. Thursday at one in the afternoon.
C. Thursday at twelve thirty.
D. Tuesday at four in the afternoon.
normal.explain: after three / before noon 分別限定不同日，不能跨用時段。

normal.desc: 【文法】I would have replied sooner if your message ___ in the wrong folder.
options: A. had not ended up
B. has not ending
C. would not end
D. was not end
normal.explain: 過去未回覆的反事實條件，用 had not ended up。

normal.desc: 【短文】A friend writes, Bring anyone you like, but let me know how many are coming before I order food. What remains necessary?
options: A. Having every guest order food separately.
B. Asking permission for each guest’s individual identity.
C. Waiting until the food arrives to choose guests.
D. Providing the number of guests in advance.
normal.explain: 人選自由仍有先報人數條件。

normal.desc: 【語用】Thanks for checking rather than just assuming, a writer replies after being asked whether an old plan still applies. What is appreciated?
options: A. The decision to confirm a potentially outdated arrangement.
B. The other person’s promise never to change the old plan.
C. The absence of any need to discuss future arrangements.
D. The assumption that silence always means the plan is unchanged.
normal.explain: 肯定查證，不保證原安排確實未變。

normal.desc: 【短文】A message says, I can collect the parcel if it is still there at six. A recipient replies, Great, I will tell them you are definitely coming. What changed?
options: A. The recipient has withdrawn permission to collect the parcel.
B. A conditional offer has been reported as a firm commitment.
C. A promise to deliver a parcel has become a promise to collect one.
D. The collection time has moved from six to an earlier hour.
normal.explain: if still there 的條件被刪去，確定度擴大。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：隨信附上的文件或物品
normal.explain: 口說表達「ENCLOSURE」(n.)：隨信附上的文件或物品。例句：The letter refers to an enclosure.（信提到一份附件。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：收到信件物品或資訊的人
normal.explain: 口說表達「RECIPIENT」(n.)：收到信件物品或資訊的人。例句：The system indicated that the recipient had already read the message.（系統顯示收件人已經閱讀了該訊息。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：仍有待確認的試探性邀請
normal.explain: 口說表達「A TENTATIVE INVITATION」(phr.)：仍有待確認的試探性邀請。例句：The note contains a tentative invitation.（便條帶著試探邀請。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：比應有時間更晚的回覆
normal.explain: 口說表達「AN OVERDUE REPLY」(phr.)：比應有時間更晚的回覆。例句：He apologised for an overdue reply.（他為遲來回覆致歉。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：條件式提議不應變成無條件承諾
normal.ans: A CONDITIONAL OFFER SHOULD NOT BECOME AN UNCONDITIONAL PROMISE
normal.speak: a conditional offer should not become an unconditional promise
normal.vocabId: R6:A CONDITIONAL OFFER SHOULD NOT BECOME AN UNCONDITIONAL PROMISE
normal.explain: 口說表達「A CONDITIONAL OFFER SHOULD NOT BECOME AN UNCONDITIONAL PROMISE」(phr.)：條件式提議不應變成無條件承諾。例句：A conditional offer should not become an unconditional promise.（條件式提議不應變成無條件承諾。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：邀請讓到訪日期保持開放
normal.ans: THE INVITATION LEAVES THE ARRIVAL DATE OPEN
normal.speak: the invitation leaves the arrival date open
normal.vocabId: R6:THE INVITATION LEAVES THE ARRIVAL DATE OPEN
normal.explain: 口說表達「THE INVITATION LEAVES THE ARRIVAL DATE OPEN」(phr.)：邀請讓到訪日期保持開放。例句：The invitation leaves the arrival date open.（邀請讓到訪日期保持開放。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：確認已收到訊息或物品（A 開頭，11 個字母）
normal.explain: ACKNOWLEDGE (v.)：確認已收到訊息或物品。例句：If they had acknowledged the problem earlier, we wouldn't have lost the client.（如果他們早點承認這個問題，我們就不會失去那位客戶了。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：把收到的訊息轉寄他人（F 開頭，7 個字母）
normal.explain: FORWARD (v.)：把收到的訊息轉寄他人。例句：The email was forwarded to the correct department.（這封電子郵件已被轉發到正確的部門。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：以尊重他人的方式有禮貌的（C 開頭，9 個字母）
normal.explain: COURTEOUS (adj.)：以尊重他人的方式有禮貌的。例句：The reply was brief but courteous.（回覆簡短但有禮。）

normal.desc: 填空題：P O S T S _ R I P T (信件結尾署名後補加的文字)
normal.explain: POSTSCRIPT (n.)：信件結尾署名後補加的文字。填空答案為「C」。例句：The postscript changes the proposed date.（附言改了提議日期。）

normal.desc: 填空題：A D D _ E S _ E E (信封或訊息上被指定接收的人)
normal.explain: ADDRESSEE (n.)：信封或訊息上被指定接收的人。填空答案為「RS」。例句：Check the addressee before sending.（寄出前核對受信人。）

normal.desc: 填空題：R E _ C H _ D _ L E (把原訂事項另排時間)
normal.explain: RESCHEDULE (v.)：把原訂事項另排時間。填空答案為「SEU」。例句：We need to reschedule the meeting for tomorrow.（我們需要將會議重新安排到明天。）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 專為休息而設的山頂房間
B. 因看不到雲而取消行程
C. 雲層暫時出現空隙
D. 雲層變得完全不能分開
normal.explain: break 指中斷或開口，這裡為雲隙。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 必定沒有任何人的荒地
B. 只在地圖上標示的污點
C. 完全無遮蔽物的高地
D. 較不受風雨直接影響的地方
normal.explain: sheltered 有遮護，不等於保證任何天氣都安全。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 位於視野遠方的地平線上
B. 緊貼在觀察者腳邊
C. 藏在不透光物件內部
D. 正位於頭頂且無法看見
normal.explain: on horizon 此處空間義，也可比喻將發生。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: We could hear the river long before we could see it through the trees.
options: A. 先看見河很久後，才開始聽到聲音。
B. 河被樹遮住，因此完全無法發出聲音。
C. 說話者一直沒聽見也沒看見河。
D. 穿過樹間看見河之前很久，就聽到河聲。
normal.explain: 聲音先於視覺線索。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The light kept changing, so the same patch of hillside looked different every time I glanced back.
options: A. 光一直變，每次回看同片山坡都不同。
B. 山坡每次回看都已移到另一個位置。
C. 光線從未改變，只有山坡顏色真的變了。
D. 說話者只看山坡一次，所以無法比較。
normal.explain: 光照改變表觀，不是地理位置移動。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: It was not raining under the trees, exactly; the rain had stopped, but the branches were still letting it go.
options: A. 樹下完全沒水，所以不需區分來源。
B. 樹下不算正在下雨，是雨停後枝條仍落水。
C. 雨還持續，但樹枝已完全乾燥。
D. 說話者確認所有水都是河流濺上去的。
normal.explain: 修正下雨表象，擬人lettinggo指餘水滴落。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The view opens up after the bend; from here the wall hides most of it.
options: A. 彎後視野才開闊，此處牆擋了大部分。
B. 此處已看見全部，彎後反而完全被牆擋。
C. 彎後沒有路，所以視野與路線無關。
D. 牆剛被拆掉，從這裡現在能看見全部。
normal.explain: 現在/後續位置對比，opensup指視野展開。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The place was peaceful without feeling abandoned; someone had swept the step and left a mug beside the door.
options: A. 說話者認為寧靜必定表示從未有人居住。
B. 地方寧靜卻不像廢棄，掃過階梯和門邊杯子有生活痕跡。
C. 地方完全廢棄，因門邊杯子證明多年沒有人。
D. 階梯與杯子已被確認只是遊客中心的佈景。
normal.explain: 微小照料痕跡建立有人氣的平和印象。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I remember the smell of wet stone more clearly than the view we had walked all that way to see.
options: A. 說話者完全沒看到景，因而不可能記住任何畫面。
B. 氣味較清楚已證明整段行程沒有視覺經驗。
C. 我對濕石氣味的記憶，比走那麼遠要看的景更清楚。
D. 走那麼遠是為聞石頭，風景本來不是目的。
normal.explain: 實際記憶焦點與原定觀景目的不同，非否定看過。

normal.desc: 【文法】By the time we reached the ridge, the sun ___ behind the clouds.
options: A. will disappear
B. was disappear
C. had disappeared
D. has disappearing
normal.explain: 過去抵達前已不見，用過去完成式。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Which verb describes small drops of light rain falling?
options: A. glitter
B. ripple
C. rustle
D. drizzle
normal.explain: drizzle 下毛毛雨；其餘為閃爍、泛漣漪、沙沙作響。

normal.desc: 【空間】The path ran along the river, with the hill to our left and the water to our right. What was immediately to the walkers’ right?
options: A. The river.
B. The top of the hill.
C. The opposite side of the hill.
D. The path behind them.
normal.explain: water 與river同指，明示位於右側。

normal.desc: 【順序】The rain stopped before dawn, but the leaves were still dripping when the first light appeared. What persisted after the rain?
options: A. Heavy rain beginning before sunrise.
B. Complete darkness after daylight arrived.
C. Dry leaves blowing across the road.
D. Water falling from wet leaves.
normal.explain: 雨停後葉上餘水仍滴落，與雨繼續不同。

normal.desc: 【短文】The guide called the lake calm. A child pointed to small waves near the shore. The guide explained that calm did not mean perfectly still. What is distinguished?
options: A. A general condition from the complete absence of movement.
B. The lake’s depth from the height of the surrounding hills.
C. A child’s view from a photograph taken below the water.
D. The shore’s location from the direction of the path.
normal.explain: 相對平靜仍可有小波，不必絕對靜止。

normal.desc: 【文法】The further we walked from the road, ___ we heard.
options: A. so few traffic
B. the less traffic
C. less than traffic
D. the least of traffic
normal.explain: the further ..., the less ...；traffic 不可數。

normal.desc: 【短文】A cottage looked deserted from the path. As the travellers approached, smoke rose from its chimney and a dog barked inside. What happens to the first impression?
options: A. New details suggest that the cottage may be occupied.
B. The new details prove nobody has entered for years.
C. The travellers discover that they were looking at a photograph.
D. The chimney smoke shows that the path has changed direction.
normal.explain: 初看空無人後有生活線索，may避免確證誰在家。

normal.desc: 【氣氛】The road was familiar, but in the fading light every turning seemed to hesitate before revealing itself. What effect does the description create?
options: A. Every turning is clearly marked by newly installed signs.
B. A known place feels uncertain as visibility decreases.
C. The road is described as physically changing its route.
D. The narrator has forgotten that the walk took place in daylight.
normal.explain: 路口擬人化，暗光讓熟悉路也顯猶疑。

normal.desc: 【短文】We reached the viewpoint expecting a grand sunset. A cloud covered the sun, but its edge briefly shone like a silver thread. Why might the narrator mention the edge?
options: A. The narrator has abandoned visual description for a map.
B. The travellers can now see every place they visited earlier.
C. A small unexpected detail replaces the anticipated spectacle.
D. The edge proves that the sun has stopped setting.
normal.explain: 宏大期待被微小亮邊取代，關注轉移而非完全無景。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：細小而綿密的毛毛雨
normal.explain: 口說表達「DRIZZLE」(n.)：細小而綿密的毛毛雨。例句：A light drizzle softened the distant view.（毛毛雨使遠景柔化。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：微弱或短暫的一點亮光
normal.explain: 口說表達「GLIMMER」(n.)：微弱或短暫的一點亮光。例句：A glimmer appeared beyond the trees.（樹外出現微光。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：遠處低沉持續的聲響
normal.explain: 口說表達「A DISTANT RUMBLE」(phr.)：遠處低沉持續的聲響。例句：We heard a distant rumble across the valley.（我們聽到山谷遠方隆隆聲。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：蜿蜒曲折的人行小路
normal.explain: 口說表達「A WINDING FOOTPATH」(phr.)：蜿蜒曲折的人行小路。例句：A winding footpath led to the water.（曲折小路通往水邊。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：光線變化使同片山坡看來不同
normal.ans: THE CHANGING LIGHT MADE THE SAME HILLSIDE LOOK DIFFERENT
normal.speak: the changing light made the same hillside look different
normal.vocabId: R6:THE CHANGING LIGHT MADE THE SAME HILLSIDE LOOK DIFFERENT
normal.explain: 口說表達「THE CHANGING LIGHT MADE THE SAME HILLSIDE LOOK DIFFERENT」(phr.)：光線變化使同片山坡看來不同。例句：The changing light made the same hillside look different.（光線變化使同片山坡看來不同。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：看見河之前聲音已傳到
normal.ans: THE SOUND REACHED US BEFORE THE RIVER CAME INTO SIGHT
normal.speak: the sound reached us before the river came into sight
normal.vocabId: R6:THE SOUND REACHED US BEFORE THE RIVER CAME INTO SIGHT
normal.explain: 口說表達「THE SOUND REACHED US BEFORE THE RIVER CAME INTO SIGHT」(phr.)：看見河之前聲音已傳到。例句：The sound reached us before the river came into sight.（看見河之前聲音已傳到。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：因潮濕等而閃出柔亮光澤（G 開頭，7 個字母）
normal.explain: GLISTEN (v.)：因潮濕等而閃出柔亮光澤。例句：The wet leaves began to glisten.（濕葉開始閃光。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：天空與地面或海面看似相接的遠線（H 開頭，7 個字母）
normal.explain: HORIZON (n.)：天空與地面或海面看似相接的遠線。例句：A cloud rested on the horizon.（地平線上有朵雲。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：發出細碎沙沙聲（R 開頭，6 個字母）
normal.explain: RUSTLE (v.)：發出細碎沙沙聲。例句：The leaves rustle in the wind.（葉在風中沙沙響。）

normal.desc: 填空題：R I _ G E (山脈或山丘頂部狹長的高線)
normal.explain: RIDGE (n.)：山脈或山丘頂部狹長的高線。填空答案為「D」。例句：The path follows the ridge.（小路沿山脊走。）

normal.desc: 填空題：R I _ P _ E (水面細小的波紋)
normal.explain: RIPPLE (n.)：水面細小的波紋。填空答案為「PL」。例句：A ripple crossed the pond.（一道漣漪掠過池面。）

normal.desc: 填空題：T W _ L _ G _ T (日出前或日落後的微光時段)
normal.explain: TWILIGHT (n.)：日出前或日落後的微光時段。填空答案為「IIH」。例句：The village lights appeared in the twilight.（村燈在微光中出現。）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 在同一家店內繞行但不比較
B. 不經考慮就立即購買
C. 把商店搬到另一個地區
D. 比較不同賣家的選擇與價格
normal.explain: shop around 是購前比較，非必真的繞圈。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 目前沒有可供應的庫存
B. 永遠不會再生產的每件商品
C. 已購但尚未開箱的物品
D. 仍只在櫥窗裡展示而不標價
normal.explain: out of stock只說當下無庫存，不保證永停產。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 製作時增加的裝飾布條
B. 正常使用逐漸造成的磨損
C. 由一次蓄意破壞造成的所有損害
D. 商品標示的穿衣尺寸
normal.explain: wear and tear常指日常使用消耗痕跡。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The price is for the pair, not for each one, though the stand is sold separately.
options: A. 價格是一對，底座另售。
B. 每件都此價，底座已包含在內。
C. 一對只含其中一件，另一件必須借用。
D. 價格只給底座，成對物件完全不出售。
normal.explain: pair/eacheone/stand三個範圍需分清。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I would keep the receipt even if you are sure about the colour; it also records which version you bought.
options: A. 說話者確認留下收據即保證可依任何制度退貨。
B. 即使確定喜歡顏色也留收據，因它記載購買版本。
C. 收據只記顏色，並不包含任何版本資訊。
D. 顏色確定後，版本就不可能再成為問題。
normal.explain: 保留資訊用途，不推真實消費法規。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The replacement looks the same, but the handle is on the opposite side, which matters for how I use it.
options: A. 把手不同側已證明每位使用者都無法使用。
B. 說話者只比較照片大小，而未談實際用法。
C. 替代品外觀相似，但把手在反側，影響我的用法。
D. 替代品把手同側，所以使用差異只在顏色。
normal.explain: 外觀近似與功能適配可不同。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I borrowed it to see whether it would fit, not because I had already decided to keep it.
options: A. 說話者承認自己從未得到借用許可。
B. 我借來試是否合適，不是已決定留下。
C. 我已決定留下，所以不會再測是否合適。
D. 借用已被雙方明訂為完成購買。
normal.explain: 試用/檢查與確定持有不同。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The cheaper one would save space on the shelf, but it would not hold everything we need it to hold.
options: A. 容量足夠，但架子已被確認無法承重。
B. 說話者認為價格低就不可能有任何優點。
C. 較便宜那個省架上空間，卻裝不下所需物件。
D. 較便宜那個較大，所以一定更能滿足需求。
normal.explain: 優點省空間、限制容量並存，非承重事實。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I am not suggesting we replace something that works; I am asking whether it still works for the purpose we now have.
options: A. 我確認物件完全壞了，所以任何用途都不能再用。
B. 如今用途已明示未變，換新只為追求流行。
C. 說話者認為只要能開動就滿足任何目的。
D. 我不是說換掉能用的，而是問是否仍合如今用途。
normal.explain: 運作正常與當前用途適合不同。

normal.desc: 【文法】The size I need ___ currently out of stock.
options: A. are
B. have
C. being
D. is
normal.explain: 主詞 the size 單數，I need 是修飾子句。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Which noun means an extra supply kept available for later use?
options: A. reserve
B. sample
C. receipt
D. display
normal.explain: reserve 是儲備；其他為樣品、收據、展示。

normal.desc: 【數量】A box contains six cups. A customer needs eight cups and may buy individual cups as well as boxes. Which purchase supplies exactly eight?
options: A. Three boxes without any individual cups.
B. One box and two individual cups.
C. Two boxes and two individual cups.
D. One box and one individual cup.
normal.explain: 六加二等八；題內提供單購選項。

normal.desc: 【範圍】A sign says the offer applies to marked items only. Which condition matters?
options: A. The item must carry the relevant mark.
B. The customer must buy every item on the shelf.
C. The shop must close before the purchase is made.
D. The item must have the highest price in its category.
normal.explain: only限markeditems，題內未設價格高低門檻。

normal.desc: 【短文】A stall lends tools for a day and asks borrowers to return them before closing. A visitor assumes a day means the following morning. What should govern the return?
options: A. A general assumption that all stalls share the same policy.
B. The explicit closing-time condition.
C. The visitor’s usual waking time.
D. The time the tool was originally manufactured.
normal.explain: 題內明訂截止，不以抽象一天代替。

normal.desc: 【文法】I would rather ___ the one I already have than buy another.
options: A. to repair
B. repaired
C. repair
D. repairing
normal.explain: would rather 後原形repair，than buy平行。

normal.desc: 【短文】A customer borrows a display sample to check its colour at home. The assistant says the boxed item may have a different surface finish. What still needs checking?
options: A. Whether the customer has visited every shop selling similar items.
B. Whether the final item matches the desired finish as well as the colour.
C. Whether the sample can be counted as an additional boxed purchase.
D. Whether the shop’s walls are painted in the customer’s chosen colour.
normal.explain: 樣品能查色但未保證表面處理同款，須核第二面向。

normal.desc: 【語用】It is a bargain only if you were going to use it, says a friend about an unwanted discounted item. What is the point?
options: A. The friend has promised to buy the item instead.
B. An item is useful only when sold at its original price.
C. A low price alone does not establish value for this buyer.
D. Every discounted item must be defective.
normal.explain: 便宜與對個人有價值不同，不推瑕疵或原價必需。

normal.desc: 【短文】An exchange table lets visitors take one item for each item they leave. Jo leaves three objects, takes two, and asks whether she has used the whole allowance. What follows from the rule?
options: A. She must take three more items.
B. She has already exceeded the allowance.
C. She must retrieve one of her original objects.
D. She may take one more item.
normal.explain: 三換三上限，已取二還可一，未說必須取滿。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：預留以備未來使用的一批物資
normal.explain: 口說表達「STOCKPILE」(n.)：預留以備未來使用的一批物資。例句：The workshop keeps a small stockpile of paper.（工作坊留小批備紙。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：用來替代另一物的替代品
normal.explain: 口說表達「SUBSTITUTE」(n.)：用來替代另一物的替代品。例句：She said they had found a substitute for the missing ingredient.（她說他們已經找到了缺少食材的替代品。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：只涉及外觀的差異
normal.explain: 口說表達「A COSMETIC DIFFERENCE」(phr.)：只涉及外觀的差異。例句：The scratch is a cosmetic difference.（刮痕屬外觀差異。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：能配合原系統使用的替換品
normal.explain: 口說表達「A COMPATIBLE REPLACEMENT」(phr.)：能配合原系統使用的替換品。例句：We need a compatible replacement.（我們需要相容替換品。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：低價不證成對個人有用
normal.ans: A LOW PRICE DOES NOT ESTABLISH PERSONAL USEFULNESS
normal.speak: a low price does not establish personal usefulness
normal.vocabId: R6:A LOW PRICE DOES NOT ESTABLISH PERSONAL USEFULNESS
normal.explain: 口說表達「A LOW PRICE DOES NOT ESTABLISH PERSONAL USEFULNESS」(phr.)：低價不證成對個人有用。例句：A low price does not establish personal usefulness.（低價不證成對個人有用。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：把手位置對預定用途重要
normal.ans: THE HANDLE POSITION MATTERS FOR THE INTENDED USE
normal.speak: the handle position matters for the intended use
normal.vocabId: R6:THE HANDLE POSITION MATTERS FOR THE INTENDED USE
normal.explain: 口說表達「THE HANDLE POSITION MATTERS FOR THE INTENDED USE」(phr.)：把手位置對預定用途重要。例句：The handle position matters for the intended use.（把手位置對預定用途重要。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：超過所需的剩餘量（S 開頭，7 個字母）
normal.explain: SURPLUS (n.)：超過所需的剩餘量。例句：The stall offered its surplus for exchange.（攤位提供剩餘物交換。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：把耗去的存量補足（R 開頭，9 個字母）
normal.explain: REPLENISH (v.)：把耗去的存量補足。例句：They plan to replenish the paper supply.（他們計畫補足紙張。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：能與另一物共同適用而不衝突的（C 開頭，10 個字母）
normal.explain: COMPATIBLE (adj.)：能與另一物共同適用而不衝突的。例句：The replacement must be compatible with the base.（替換品須與底座相容。）

normal.desc: 填空題：B A _ C H (同次製作或處理的一批物品)
normal.explain: BATCH (n.)：同次製作或處理的一批物品。填空答案為「T」。例句：The next batch will have a different label.（下一批標籤不同。）

normal.desc: 填空題：S A _ P _ E (供檢查品質或特徵的樣品)
normal.explain: SAMPLE (n.)：供檢查品質或特徵的樣品。填空答案為「ML」。例句：Take the sample home to check the colour.（帶樣品回家核色。）

normal.desc: 填空題：D U _ A B _ L _ T Y (物品長期使用仍維持良好的耐用性)
normal.explain: DURABILITY (n.)：物品長期使用仍維持良好的耐用性。填空答案為「RII」。例句：The review mentioned that the product's durability had exceeded expectations.（評論提到該產品的耐用度超出了預期。）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 把線索連起來推知情況
B. 只做加法而不考慮情境
C. 把四件物平均分成兩袋
D. 要求兩人同時重做工作
normal.explain: 慣用指綜合資訊作推論，非一定算術。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 以跳躍動作參加比賽
B. 未充分考慮就急下結論
C. 將結論移到文章第一段
D. 因證據完整而結束查核
normal.explain: jump to conclusions 帶過早判斷的負評。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 故意不設置的提醒工具
B. 永遠不會發聲的每種鬧鐘
C. 以為出事而其實未出現該事的警報
D. 已確認且持續發生的事件
normal.explain: false alarm 可非故意，核心誤報。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The window was open when I arrived; I cannot tell you who opened it.
options: A. 窗一直沒有人開，所以不可能開著。
B. 我到時窗已開，不知誰開的。
C. 我親眼看見開窗者，但不願說姓名。
D. 我到時窗關著，後來才自己打開。
normal.explain: 觀察狀態與行動者知識分開。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I heard the door, not the footsteps, so I am sure someone came in but not sure it was Alex.
options: A. 我沒聽到任何聲音，只憑便條猜有人。
B. 我確定沒人進來，因為未聽見腳步。
C. 聽到門而非腳步，所以知道有人進，不能確定是艾力克斯。
D. 腳步已清楚證明艾力克斯進門。
normal.explain: 轉述說話者的確定範圍，非替聽者驗證誰進門。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The label tells us whose box it used to be, not necessarily who is using it now.
options: A. 標籤已確認現在使用者與舊主人相同。
B. 盒子無人使用，因標籤已被取下。
C. 現在使用者已把姓名直接寫在新標籤上。
D. 標籤說明舊主人，不一定是現使用者。
normal.explain: 曾持有與現使用兩種資訊不同。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: She knew the room had been changed, but that does not mean she knew where each object had been moved.
options: A. 她因不知物件位置而完全不知房間有改。
B. 每件物已回原位，所以問題不存在。
C. 她知房間改過，不代表知每件移去哪。
D. 知道房間改過已足以推知所有新位置。
normal.explain: 整體知情與具體細節知情不同。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The explanation accounts for the missing cup, but not for the extra one on the shelf.
options: A. 解釋已把少一杯與多一杯完整連起來。
B. 架上沒有多杯，因解釋已取消這項觀察。
C. 說話者認為只要有一部分說得通就不需其他。
D. 解釋能說明杯子少一個，卻未說明架上多的那個。
normal.explain: 解釋覆蓋範圍有限，未說整個解釋全錯。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Before we decide someone moved the sign, perhaps we should ask whether we approached it from the other side yesterday.
options: A. 認定有人移牌前，先問昨天是否從另一側接近。
B. 昨天方向已被證實相同，所以牌一定移過。
C. 只要接近方向不同，任何位置都永遠不可能比較。
D. 說話者確認自己昨晚親手移了標示。
normal.explain: 提出觀察視角替代解釋，perhaps非確知。

normal.desc: 【文法】Jo says she ___ away from home all week.
options: A. has been
B. has being
C. is been
D. have been
normal.explain: she單數，has been away 表本週持續不在。

normal.desc: 【字彙】To misplace an object is to ___.
options: A. discover that it was never made
B. put it somewhere and then be unable to find it
C. deliberately give it to a new owner
D. repair it without changing its position
normal.explain: misplace 是放錯/忘放哪，未必永久遺失。

normal.desc: 【順序】Ali saw the cup on the table before Beth entered. Beth then carried it to the shelf. Where was it immediately before Beth entered?
options: A. In Beth’s bag.
B. Outside the room.
C. On the table.
D. On the shelf.
normal.explain: before entered時點明確，後移動不能倒推。

normal.desc: 【範圍】Only Mina has the red key; both Mina and Tom have blue keys. Who definitely has a blue key?
options: A. Only a person other than Mina.
B. Tom.
C. Every visitor.
D. Nobody.
normal.explain: both明確含Mina/Tom；正答Tom但非只有Tom。

normal.desc: 【短文】A message says, The parcel arrived after lunch but before Eva left. Eva left at three. What is established?
options: A. Lunch ended exactly one minute before three.
B. Eva left before the parcel arrived.
C. The parcel arrived before three.
D. The parcel arrived exactly at three.
normal.explain: afterlunch/beforeleft限定抵達三點前，未定精時。

normal.desc: 【文法】If Sam had taken the umbrella, it ___ beside the door now.
options: A. will not been
B. had not being
C. would not to be
D. would not be
normal.explain: 過去假設影響現在結果，用had taken / would not be。

normal.desc: 【短文】Two identical envelopes lie on a desk. One contains a map; the other is empty. Jo picks one up but does not open it. What can she know from the stated facts alone?
options: A. The unopened envelope must be empty.
B. Both envelopes now contain a map.
C. The envelope she picked may contain the map.
D. The envelope she picked certainly contains the map.
normal.explain: 未給外觀辨識線索，只知可能一種內容。

normal.desc: 【短文】The room was quiet when the clock stopped. A visitor concludes that the clock had been making the only sound. Another visitor points out that they had not noticed the wind until the ticking ended. What changes?
options: A. The wind began only after the clock stopped, as independently confirmed.
B. The clock has been proved to control the weather outside.
C. The visitors have established that no sound was ever present.
D. A less noticeable sound became apparent when the louder one stopped.
normal.explain: 先前未注意與先前未存在不同；不補外部機制。

normal.desc: 【語用】I know where the spare key was yesterday; today is another question. What is the speaker limiting?
options: A. The time to which their knowledge applies.
B. The number of keys that can ever exist.
C. The right of another person to ask a question.
D. The meaning of yesterday as a calendar term.
normal.explain: 過去位置知識不能保證今日同處。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：協助理解或解開問題的線索
normal.explain: 口說表達「CLUE」(n.)：協助理解或解開問題的線索。例句：The note provides a clue.（便條提供線索。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：錯誤理解文字或情況的解讀
normal.explain: 口說表達「MISREADING」(n.)：錯誤理解文字或情況的解讀。例句：The confusion began with a misreading.（混亂始於誤讀。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：與已知資訊相容而合理的解釋
normal.explain: 口說表達「A PLAUSIBLE EXPLANATION」(phr.)：與已知資訊相容而合理的解釋。例句：That is a plausible explanation of the sound.（那是聲音的合理解釋。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：尚未查證的假設
normal.explain: 口說表達「AN UNTESTED ASSUMPTION」(phr.)：尚未查證的假設。例句：The conclusion rests on an untested assumption.（結論依未查證假設。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：知道舊位置不確定現在位置
normal.ans: KNOWING THE OLD POSITION DOES NOT ESTABLISH THE PRESENT ONE
normal.speak: knowing the old position does not establish the present one
normal.vocabId: R6:KNOWING THE OLD POSITION DOES NOT ESTABLISH THE PRESENT ONE
normal.explain: 口說表達「KNOWING THE OLD POSITION DOES NOT ESTABLISH THE PRESENT ONE」(phr.)：知道舊位置不確定現在位置。例句：Knowing the old position does not establish the present one.（知道舊位置不確定現在位置。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：解釋仍未交代多出那杯
normal.ans: THE EXPLANATION LEAVES THE EXTRA CUP UNACCOUNTED FOR
normal.speak: the explanation leaves the extra cup unaccounted for
normal.vocabId: R6:THE EXPLANATION LEAVES THE EXTRA CUP UNACCOUNTED FOR
normal.explain: 口說表達「THE EXPLANATION LEAVES THE EXTRA CUP UNACCOUNTED FOR」(phr.)：解釋仍未交代多出那杯。例句：The explanation leaves the extra cup unaccounted for.（解釋仍未交代多出那杯。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：把物放到某處後無法找到（M 開頭，8 個字母）
normal.explain: MISPLACE (v.)：把物放到某處後無法找到。例句：I sometimes misplace my keys.（我有時忘了鑰匙放哪。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：無意或偶然聽到他人談話（O 開頭，8 個字母）
normal.explain: OVERHEAR (v.)：無意或偶然聽到他人談話。例句：I did not mean to overhear your conversation.（我不是故意聽到你們談話的。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：手指接觸表面留下的紋路印記（F 開頭，11 個字母）
normal.explain: FINGERPRINT (n.)：手指接觸表面留下的紋路印記。例句：The story mentions a fingerprint on the glass.（故事提到玻璃指紋。）

normal.desc: 填空題：K E Y _ O L E (供鑰匙插入的鎖孔)
normal.explain: KEYHOLE (n.)：供鑰匙插入的鎖孔。填空答案為「H」。例句：The red key fits the keyhole.（紅鑰匙合鎖孔。）

normal.desc: 填空題：E N _ E L _ P E (盛放信件文件的封套)
normal.explain: ENVELOPE (n.)：盛放信件文件的封套。填空答案為「VO」。例句：I put the signed contract inside a white envelope yesterday.（我昨天把簽好的合約放進了一個白色信封裡。）

normal.desc: 填空題：M I _ C _ U _ T (計算數量時出錯)
normal.explain: MISCOUNT (v.)：計算數量時出錯。填空答案為「SON」。例句：It is easy to miscount identical cups.（相同杯子易數錯。）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 把所有格子合成同一個
B. 回到起點而得重新開始
C. 直接升到最後一格
D. 只有一人可用的方形棋盤
normal.explain: 慣用指進度歸原點，不必真有格盤。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 不讓任何其他人參與
B. 只在遊戲結束後作決定
C. 採較少風險的做法
D. 保證每次都能獲勝
normal.explain: play safe著重避險，不等於保證結果。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 把別人每次機會都取消
B. 依既定結果重複動作
C. 等到不確定性完全消失
D. 冒一次風險試試
normal.explain: take chance接受不確定而行動。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Are we counting the bonus now? No, at the end of the round, after everyone has played.
options: A. 只有還沒出過的人可以現在領獎。
B. 獎勵已取消，輪末只計基本分。
C. 獎勵輪末大家都出完後才算，不是現在。
D. 獎勵在輪首每人出牌前先算。
normal.explain: No修正計算時點，未改取消獎勵。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: You can trade with me if you like, though I would wait to see what the next card offers.
options: A. 說話者已正式拒絕任何交易。
B. 下一張必定更好，所以現在交換違規。
C. 只要對方喜歡，交易就已自動完成。
D. 可和我換，但我會先看下一張提供什麼。
normal.explain: 提供許可加策略建議，非規則要求或確知下卡。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I saved the token for later, which would have been sensible if there had been another round.
options: A. 我留代幣到後面用，若還有下一輪才算明智。
B. 代幣已在下一輪成功使用，所以決策有效。
C. 說話者確定每次留代幣都一定錯。
D. 下一輪已取消只因代幣被保留。
normal.explain: 反事實條件暗示沒下輪，保留資源未派用場。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The pieces look identical, but the symbol underneath tells you which team each belongs to.
options: A. 每隊外表不同，不需查看底部。
B. 棋子因看似同樣已被規定不分隊。
C. 符號只在盒上，棋子本身沒有辨識資訊。
D. 棋子外表相同，底下符號才示各屬哪隊。
normal.explain: 初看外形與隱藏標記不同，非完全無法分辨。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: We were cooperating until we realised the instructions said share information, not share the final score.
options: A. 原本合作，後來發現規則是分享資訊不是共享最終分數。
B. 規則已要求共享分數，資訊則禁止交流。
C. 兩人已證實合作無論何時都違反規則。
D. 說話者明說資訊與分數在遊戲中定義相同。
normal.explain: 可分享的對象範圍不同，不必合作本身非法。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I would not call it a bad move just because the next card made it fail; we did not know that card was coming.
options: A. 任何不知道下一卡的選擇都自動算最佳策略。
B. 不能只因下張卡讓它失敗就說壞決策，當時不知道會來哪張。
C. 事後失敗已充分證明當時選擇必定不合理。
D. 說話者在落卡前已確知卡面而仍故意選錯。
normal.explain: 依當時資訊與結果區分，不保證決策原本必最佳。

normal.desc: 【文法】Each player ___ two cards at the beginning of a round.
options: A. are receiving
B. receives
C. receive
D. have received
normal.explain: each player單數，用receives。

normal.desc: 【字彙】A move described as optional is one a player ___.
options: A. may make only after losing
B. has already made without noticing
C. may choose to make or omit
D. must make before every other move
normal.explain: optional可選，不指定勝負或必先做。

normal.desc: 【規則】A token moves one space forward unless the space ahead is occupied. It is occupied now. What follows?
options: A. The token must move two spaces forward instead.
B. The other token is automatically removed.
C. The token moves backwards to the starting space.
D. The stated condition for moving forward is not met.
normal.explain: unless被占據為例外，未另授跳格/擊退/倒退。

normal.desc: 【順序】Draw a card, reveal it, and then move your piece. Which action immediately precedes moving?
options: A. Returning the piece to the start.
B. Hiding the card again.
C. Revealing the card.
D. Drawing a second card.
normal.explain: 三步明示，move前一步reveal。

normal.desc: 【短文】A card lets its owner choose another player to draw one card. Lee chooses Jo and then draws the card himself. What has Lee misread?
options: A. The owner must give away the card permanently.
B. The choice must be made by the youngest player.
C. The card applies only after the game has ended.
D. The chosen player is the one who draws.
normal.explain: choose another player to draw指被選者執行draw。

normal.desc: 【文法】You cannot move the piece until the previous player ___ their turn.
options: A. has finished
B. will finishing
C. have finish
D. is finish
normal.explain: until未來時間子句現在完成式；previousplayer單數。

normal.desc: 【規則】A player may exchange two blue tokens for one red token. Jo has four blue tokens and no red tokens. She makes this exchange twice. What does she have from those exchanges?
options: A. Four red tokens and two blue tokens left.
B. One red token and two blue tokens left.
C. Two blue tokens and no red tokens.
D. Two red tokens and no blue tokens left.
normal.explain: 每次消二藍換一紅，兩次耗四藍得二紅。

normal.desc: 【語用】I can see why that move is tempting, but it leaves the gate unguarded. What is being raised?
options: A. A drawback of an otherwise attractive choice.
B. A claim that the move is prohibited by the written rules.
C. A guarantee that the opponent will choose a particular response.
D. A proposal to remove the gate from the board.
normal.explain: 承認吸引力並指出代價，不另造規則禁令。

normal.desc: 【短文】The winner is the player with the most points after five rounds, not the player who wins the most rounds. A player wins three rounds but has fewer total points. What follows?
options: A. The player receives an extra point for every round already won.
B. Winning more rounds does not make that player the overall winner.
C. Winning three rounds automatically replaces the total-points rule.
D. The remaining rounds must be replayed until totals are equal.
normal.explain: 依明示總分勝利條件，不加勝場紅利。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：可依規則代表其他牌或角色的萬用牌
normal.explain: 口說表達「WILDCARD」(n.)：可依規則代表其他牌或角色的萬用牌。例句：The wildcard can stand for either colour.（萬用牌可代表任一色。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：使進展受阻或倒退的挫折
normal.explain: 口說表達「SETBACK」(n.)：使進展受阻或倒退的挫折。例句：The team experienced a major setback when the funding was cut.（當資金被削減時，該團隊遭遇了重大挫折。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：可自行選擇的額外一步
normal.explain: 口說表達「AN OPTIONAL EXTRA MOVE」(phr.)：可自行選擇的額外一步。例句：The card grants an optional extra move.（卡給可選額外一步。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：有人或防禦物守住的入口
normal.explain: 口說表達「A GUARDED ENTRANCE」(phr.)：有人或防禦物守住的入口。例句：The blue piece protects a guarded entrance.（藍棋子保護有防守入口。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：合規一步未必有用
normal.ans: A LEGAL MOVE NEED NOT BE A USEFUL MOVE
normal.speak: a legal move need not be a useful move
normal.vocabId: R6:A LEGAL MOVE NEED NOT BE A USEFUL MOVE
normal.explain: 口說表達「A LEGAL MOVE NEED NOT BE A USEFUL MOVE」(phr.)：合規一步未必有用。例句：A legal move need not be a useful move.（合規一步未必有用。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：護盾消失前擋一次攻擊
normal.ans: THE SHIELD BLOCKS ONE ATTACK BEFORE DISAPPEARING
normal.speak: the shield blocks one attack before disappearing
normal.vocabId: R6:THE SHIELD BLOCKS ONE ATTACK BEFORE DISAPPEARING
normal.explain: 口說表達「THE SHIELD BLOCKS ONE ATTACK BEFORE DISAPPEARING」(phr.)：護盾消失前擋一次攻擊。例句：The shield blocks one attack before disappearing.（護盾消失前擋一次攻擊。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：為達成長期目標安排的行動方式（S 開頭，8 個字母）
normal.explain: STRATEGY (n.)：為達成長期目標安排的行動方式。例句：The strategy depends on saving tokens.（策略依賴保留代幣。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：遊戲中用以記數或標位置的小物件（C 開頭，7 個字母）
normal.explain: COUNTER (n.)：遊戲中用以記數或標位置的小物件。例句：Place a counter on the chosen square.（選定格放一枚標記。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：依規則失去某機會或權利（F 開頭，7 個字母）
normal.explain: FORFEIT (v.)：依規則失去某機會或權利。例句：You forfeit the bonus if you pass.（若選跳過便失去獎勵。）

normal.desc: 填空題：T O _ E N (遊戲中表示資源位置等的代幣或棋片)
normal.explain: TOKEN (n.)：遊戲中表示資源位置等的代幣或棋片。填空答案為「K」。例句：Exchange two blue tokens for one red token.（兩藍代幣換一紅。）

normal.desc: 填空題：D _ _ K (供遊戲使用的一副牌)
normal.explain: DECK (n.)：供遊戲使用的一副牌。填空答案為「EC」。例句：Return the card to the deck.（把牌放回牌堆。）

normal.desc: 填空題：O B _ E _ T _ V E (希望達成的目標)
normal.explain: OBJECTIVE (n.)：希望達成的目標。填空答案為「JCI」。例句：Our main objective is to satisfy our customers.（我們的主要目標是讓客戶滿意。）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 把所有舊紀錄正式刪除
B. 保證我回憶每項細節都正確
C. 幫我喚回一點記憶
D. 要求我跑步以代替回答
normal.explain: jog memory喚起記憶，不保證記得精確。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 逐字照讀別人的原文
B. 只准使用你發明的新詞
C. 把任何資料都改成第一人稱
D. 用你自己的說法表達
normal.explain: own words指換自己的措辭，不是自造詞。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 根據先前回答再作的追問
B. 與先前回答完全無關的新活動
C. 只在正式訪談前才問的問題
D. 由每位聽眾同時大聲重複的句子
normal.explain: supplementary question 是在原問題外補充的提問。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I remember the room, though the wallpaper in the photograph is not how I remember it.
options: A. 照片壁紙已證明說話者從未進過房。
B. 說話者確認照片與記憶每處完全相同。
C. 房間記憶全消失，只記得拍照者姓名。
D. 記得房間，但照片壁紙與記憶不同。
normal.explain: 局部不符與整體熟悉可共存。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Could you tell me what happened next before we go back to why you think it happened?
options: A. 能先說接著發生什麼，再回來談你認為的原因嗎？
B. 請先證明每項原因，才准提任何後續事件。
C. 下一件事已無關緊要，所以只談原因就好。
D. 說話者要求把事件時間線全部刪掉。
normal.explain: 區分事件敘述與事後解釋，先後議程明確。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I do not remember being afraid at the time, although it sounds frightening when I describe it now.
options: A. 說話者從未經歷此事，只因聽故事而怕。
B. 不記得當時害怕，現在敘述卻聽來可怕。
C. 現在覺得可怕已證當時一定害怕。
D. 當時已明白說出恐懼，現在只是逐字讀紀錄。
normal.explain: 當下感受記憶與現在敘事效果不同。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: She corrected herself without being prompted, which is worth keeping in the record rather than smoothing away.
options: A. 她沒被提醒就自我修正，值得記下而非潤飾刪掉。
B. 修正是訪談者直接教她說的，所以應改成他發言。
C. 自我修正已證原故事每句都不可信。
D. 說話者認為紀錄只可留下從不遲疑的句子。
normal.explain: 自發修正是回憶過程資訊，不自動全否定。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I would not turn every pause into uncertainty; sometimes she is choosing how much she wants to tell us.
options: A. 說話者認為停頓永遠不可能表示回想困難。
B. 別把每次停頓都當不確定，有時她在選要說多少。
C. 停頓已確證她不知道發生過什麼。
D. 每次停頓都被她明說是因錄音機故障。
normal.explain: 提出揭露範圍選擇的替代，不排除某些停頓為不確定。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The story has become funnier with retelling, though the speaker is quite clear that the event itself was not funny at the time.
options: A. 只要重述變有趣，就證明事件完全沒發生。
B. 說話者確認每次重述字詞都完全相同。
C. 故事重述後較好笑，但說話者清楚說當時事件不好笑。
D. 事件當時就像現在一樣好笑，沒有感受變化。
normal.explain: 現在敘述語氣與當時體驗分開。

normal.desc: 【文法】The interviewer asked me where I ___ when the old theatre closed.
options: A. did living
B. have live
C. was living
D. am live
normal.explain: 間接問句用陳述語序，過去時背景為was living。

normal.desc: 【字彙】To transcribe an interview is to ___.
options: A. replace the speaker with another person
B. decide which account must be true
C. ask the same question more loudly
D. write down what was said
normal.explain: transcribe將口語轉成書面，不必作真假判決。

normal.desc: 【語意】The speaker remembers the journey clearly but cannot recall the exact date. What is uncertain?
options: A. The calendar timing, rather than every detail of the journey.
B. Whether the speaker has any memory of travelling.
C. Whether the journey could have taken place at all.
D. The identity of every person who has heard the story.
normal.explain: 記事件與記精時不同，不能將局部忘記擴大全忘。

normal.desc: 【指涉】I showed the photograph to my uncle, and he recognised the woman beside the gate. Who recognised the woman?
options: A. The photographer, whose identity is not given.
B. The woman beside the gate.
C. Every person in the photograph.
D. The uncle.
normal.explain: he指myuncle，非自添拍攝者身分。

normal.desc: 【短文】An interviewer asks how difficult the move was. The speaker says she had found it exciting rather than difficult. What did the speaker correct?
options: A. An assumption built into the question.
B. The date when the interviewer arrived.
C. The number of homes visible in a photograph.
D. A mistake in the speaker’s own address.
normal.explain: how difficult預設困難，回答拒絕此框架。

normal.desc: 【文法】I remember ___ the door, but I cannot remember who opened it.
options: A. having knock on
B. knocking on
C. to knock on
D. knock on
normal.explain: remember doing回想已做事件，不是記得要做。

normal.desc: 【短文】A speaker pauses to look at a photograph, then corrects the colour of a car in her story. The interviewer keeps the correction. What does it show?
options: A. A detail was revised during the interview.
B. The entire story was withdrawn as invented.
C. The photograph proves every other detail is accurate.
D. The interviewer had supplied the car’s colour before the story.
normal.explain: 局部修正不能推出全假或全真。

normal.desc: 【語用】I can tell you what it felt like, though I cannot tell you exactly how long it lasted. What distinction is made?
options: A. A completed journey versus a future plan.
B. Personal experience versus precise duration.
C. A refusal to speak versus permission to record.
D. A written story versus a photograph.
normal.explain: feltlike主觀感受與howlong量化時間不同。

normal.desc: 【短文】A recording includes laughter after a speaker calls a disastrous picnic perfectly organised. A transcript prints only the words. What may be lost?
options: A. The location of every person who attended the picnic.
B. Proof that the picnic actually took place indoors.
C. A cue that the praise is humorous rather than straightforward.
D. The fact that the speaker has used complete words.
normal.explain: laughter可示反諷，刪口語線索可能改讀法。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：透過提問蒐集想法或經驗的訪談
normal.explain: 口說表達「INTERVIEW」(n.)：透過提問蒐集想法或經驗的訪談。例句：The interview includes a discussion of the journey.（訪談含旅程討論。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：再次敘述同一事件的版本或行為
normal.explain: 口說表達「RETELLING」(n.)：再次敘述同一事件的版本或行為。例句：The story changes emphasis in retelling.（故事重述時重點改變。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：未經提醒的自發修正
normal.explain: 口說表達「A SPONTANEOUS CORRECTION」(phr.)：未經提醒的自發修正。例句：The recording captures a spontaneous correction.（錄音捕捉自發修正。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：尊重對方的接續追問
normal.explain: 口說表達「A RESPECTFUL FOLLOW UP」(phr.)：尊重對方的接續追問。例句：A respectful follow-up invited more detail.（尊重的追問引出細節。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：停頓可能反映選擇透露什麼
normal.ans: A PAUSE MAY REFLECT A CHOICE ABOUT WHAT TO REVEAL
normal.speak: a pause may reflect a choice about what to reveal
normal.vocabId: R6:A PAUSE MAY REFLECT A CHOICE ABOUT WHAT TO REVEAL
normal.explain: 口說表達「A PAUSE MAY REFLECT A CHOICE ABOUT WHAT TO REVEAL」(phr.)：停頓可能反映選擇透露什麼。例句：A pause may reflect a choice about what to reveal.（停頓可能反映選擇透露什麼。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：現在敘述不同於原始體驗
normal.ans: THE PRESENT TELLING DIFFERS FROM THE ORIGINAL EXPERIENCE
normal.speak: the present telling differs from the original experience
normal.vocabId: R6:THE PRESENT TELLING DIFFERS FROM THE ORIGINAL EXPERIENCE
normal.explain: 口說表達「THE PRESENT TELLING DIFFERS FROM THE ORIGINAL EXPERIENCE」(phr.)：現在敘述不同於原始體驗。例句：The present telling differs from the original experience.（現在敘述不同於原始體驗。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：把口頭內容寫成文字（T 開頭，10 個字母）
normal.explain: TRANSCRIBE (v.)：把口頭內容寫成文字。例句：Please transcribe the final answer.（請把最後回答轉成文字。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：愉快地談起或回想往事（R 開頭，9 個字母）
normal.explain: REMINISCE (v.)：愉快地談起或回想往事。例句：They began to reminisce about the shop.（他們開始聊店裡往事。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：事件發生的時間先後次序（C 開頭，10 個字母）
normal.explain: CHRONOLOGY (n.)：事件發生的時間先後次序。例句：The chronology is clearer after the correction.（修正後時序更清楚。）

normal.desc: 填空題：P R O _ P T (引出回答或行動的提示)
normal.explain: PROMPT (n.)：引出回答或行動的提示。填空答案為「M」。例句：The photograph served as a prompt.（照片作提示。）

normal.desc: 填空題：N A _ R _ T E (以連貫方式講述事件)
normal.explain: NARRATE (v.)：以連貫方式講述事件。填空答案為「RA」。例句：He will narrate the journey in order.（他會依序講旅程。）

normal.desc: 填空題：R E _ P _ N _ E (對問題或刺激作出的回應)
normal.explain: RESPONSE (n.)：對問題或刺激作出的回應。填空答案為「SOS」。例句：We haven't received a response yet.（我們還沒有收到回覆。）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Please wait until they are out of earshot before we discuss the surprise.
options: A. 等他們回來一起決定如何取消驚喜。
B. 在他們看不見的地方放好禮物就行。
C. 先大聲說明驚喜，再請他們離開。
D. 等他們走到聽不見的地方再討論驚喜。
normal.explain: out of earshot指超出可聽見的距離，避免讓當事人聽見。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 說話小聲一些
B. 把你的想法記下來
C. 把聲音錄下保存
D. 慢慢把句子說完
normal.explain: keep your voice down是降低說話音量。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 刻意模仿他人的語氣
B. 被遮阻而低沉不清的聲音
C. 逐字清晰傳達的訊息
D. 突然升高的尖銳聲響
normal.explain: muffled表示聲音因遮阻而不清晰。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The music is fine; it is the conversation at the next table that I cannot ignore.
options: A. 困擾的是鄰桌談話，不是音樂。
B. 音樂太大，蓋住鄰桌所有談話。
C. 說話者想加入鄰桌的討論。
D. 說話者認為餐廳需要更多音樂。
normal.explain: it is…that強調真正干擾來源為鄰桌談話。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: You can leave the window open if you like. The traffic usually dies down after nine.
options: A. 說話者要求立即換一扇窗。
B. 可以開窗，九點後車流聲通常減弱。
C. 九點以前禁止任何人打開窗戶。
D. 九點後車流會開始變得更密集。
normal.explain: dies down逐漸減弱；usually表示通常而非保證。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I thought someone was knocking, but it turned out to be a loose branch against the glass.
options: A. 敲門者帶來一根鬆脫的樹枝。
B. 玻璃破裂後，說話者才聽見腳步。
C. 原以為有人敲門，後來發現是樹枝碰玻璃。
D. 明知樹枝敲玻璃，仍請來者進屋。
normal.explain: thought與turned out to be標示原判斷被修正。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The applause began before the final note had faded, which rather spoiled the ending for me.
options: A. 說話者認為鼓掌改善了結尾效果。
B. 最後音符未消退就鼓掌，影響了結尾感受。
C. 音符早已結束，觀眾卻遲遲不鼓掌。
D. 演奏者因掌聲太小而重奏結尾。
normal.explain: before與spoiled分別交代時序及負面感受。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: She was not refusing to answer. She was waiting for the translation to finish before speaking.
options: A. 她已搶先作答，翻譯還沒開始。
B. 她要求別人代替自己回答。
C. 她在等翻譯結束，並非拒答。
D. 她因不滿翻譯內容而拒絕回答。
normal.explain: 直接否定拒答，並提供等待原因。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I would not call it silent. You could hear the rain, but there was none of the usual machinery noise.
options: A. 雨聲和機械聲都比平常更大。
B. 機械仍運轉，只有雨聲消失。
C. 說話者把沉默當成不願交談。
D. 不算無聲：有雨聲，但沒有平常的機械聲。
normal.explain: 區分無機械噪音與絕對無聲。

normal.desc: 【語意】The announcement was audible, but I could not make out the words. What was the problem?
options: A. The speaker understood the words but disliked the message.
B. The announcement had not yet started.
C. The speaker could read the announcement clearly.
D. The speaker heard a voice without understanding its words.
normal.explain: audible指聽得到；make out the words指辨清字句，兩者不同。

normal.desc: 【文法】We closed the window so that the music ___ disturb the neighbours.
options: A. would not
B. not would
C. was not to being
D. did not to
normal.explain: 過去情境的目的子句用so that…would not，表示避免打擾。

normal.desc: 【字彙】If a sound fades away, it ___.
options: A. moves closer to the listener
B. gradually becomes quieter
C. suddenly changes into speech
D. continues at the same volume
normal.explain: fade away指逐漸消弱，不必涉及聲源移動。

normal.desc: 【指涉】The bell rang after the choir finished, and its sound filled the hall. What does its refer to?
options: A. The bell.
B. The choir’s conductor.
C. The audience.
D. The final song.
normal.explain: 主句the bell rang後的its sound承接鈴聲；並未提指揮。

normal.desc: 【文法】Hardly ___ the door when the alarm began to ring.
options: A. we did open
B. had we opened
C. we had opened
D. did we opened
normal.explain: Hardly置句首需倒裝；先開門後響鈴，用had we opened。

normal.desc: 【短文】The guide waited for a passing train to disappear before describing the painting. What is the most likely reason?
options: A. The guide wanted the group to board the train.
B. The painting had been removed from the room.
C. The train made it difficult to hear the guide.
D. The painting could only be seen from a train.
normal.explain: 等列車通過再說明，最合理的情境推論是避開干擾聲。

normal.desc: 【語用】A guest says, I can hear the television from my room. The host replies, Sorry, I will lower it. How did the host interpret the remark?
options: A. As an invitation to watch a programme together.
B. As an indirect request to reduce the volume.
C. As a request to move the television upstairs.
D. As praise for the television’s picture quality.
normal.explain: 主人道歉並調低音量，顯示將陳述理解為間接請求。

normal.desc: 【短文】A reviewer calls the concert intimate, despite its large audience, because the singer spoke as if addressing each listener personally. What explains intimate here?
options: A. A performance given only to invited relatives.
B. The limited number of available seats.
C. A sense of personal connection rather than a small crowd.
D. The absence of conversation between songs.
normal.explain: because明示親近感來自說話方式，而非觀眾人數。

normal.desc: 【語意】Silence followed the question, but the tutor waited rather than answering it herself. Which interpretation requires the fewest assumptions?
options: A. She knew that every student had misunderstood the question.
B. She had decided that the discussion was finished.
C. She was unable to remember her own question.
D. She allowed time for the students to formulate a response.
normal.explain: 等候而不代答支持給思考時間，不能由沉默斷定所有人誤解。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：能夠被聽見的
normal.explain: 口說表達「AUDIBLE」(adj.)：能夠被聽見的。例句：The announcement was barely audible.（廣播幾乎聽不見。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：紙張或樹葉摩擦的窸窣聲
normal.explain: 口說表達「RUSTLING」(n.)：紙張或樹葉摩擦的窸窣聲。例句：The rustling interrupted the interview.（窸窣聲打斷訪談。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：出乎意料的打斷
normal.explain: 口說表達「AN UNEXPECTED INTERRUPTION」(phr.)：出乎意料的打斷。例句：An unexpected interruption broke her concentration.（意外打斷使她分心。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：幾乎聽不見的回答
normal.explain: 口說表達「A BARELY AUDIBLE REPLY」(phr.)：幾乎聽不見的回答。例句：He gave a barely audible reply.（他輕聲作答，幾乎聽不見。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：聲音清楚但字詞不熟悉
normal.ans: THE SOUND WAS CLEAR BUT THE WORDS WERE UNFAMILIAR
normal.speak: the sound was clear but the words were unfamiliar
normal.vocabId: R6:THE SOUND WAS CLEAR BUT THE WORDS WERE UNFAMILIAR
normal.explain: 口說表達「THE SOUND WAS CLEAR BUT THE WORDS WERE UNFAMILIAR」(phr.)：聲音清楚但字詞不熟悉。例句：The sound was clear but the words were unfamiliar.（聲音清楚但字詞不熟悉。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：安靜房間不一定完全無聲
normal.ans: A QUIET ROOM IS NOT NECESSARILY A SILENT ROOM
normal.speak: a quiet room is not necessarily a silent room
normal.vocabId: R6:A QUIET ROOM IS NOT NECESSARILY A SILENT ROOM
normal.explain: 口說表達「A QUIET ROOM IS NOT NECESSARILY A SILENT ROOM」(phr.)：安靜房間不一定完全無聲。例句：A quiet room is not necessarily a silent room.（安靜房間不一定完全無聲。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：無意間聽到別人的談話（O 開頭，8 個字母）
normal.explain: OVERHEAR (v.)：無意間聽到別人的談話。例句：I did not mean to overhear your conversation.（我不是故意聽到你們談話的。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：帶有規律節奏的（R 開頭，8 個字母）
normal.explain: RHYTHMIC (adj.)：帶有規律節奏的。例句：We heard a rhythmic tapping at the window.（我們聽到窗邊有節奏的輕敲。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：使人分心的事物或干擾（D 開頭，11 個字母）
normal.explain: DISTRACTION (n.)：使人分心的事物或干擾。例句：The buzzing was a constant distraction.（嗡嗡聲持續讓人分心。）

normal.desc: 填空題：W H I _ P E R (刻意用很小的氣聲說話)
normal.explain: WHISPER (v.)：刻意用很小的氣聲說話。填空答案為「S」。例句：Please whisper while the baby is sleeping.（嬰兒睡覺時請小聲說話。）

normal.desc: 填空題：V I B _ A T _ O N (物體來回快速移動的振動)
normal.explain: VIBRATION (n.)：物體來回快速移動的振動。填空答案為「RI」。例句：I felt a vibration through the floor.（我感到地板傳來振動。）

normal.desc: 填空題：E _ H _ I _ G (充滿聲音反射回響的)
normal.explain: ECHOING (adj.)：充滿聲音反射回響的。填空答案為「CON」。例句：Footsteps filled the echoing corridor.（腳步聲在走廊回響。）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: We will have to play it by ear until we know how many people are coming.
options: A. 人數未明，得先視情況應變。
B. 人數已定，所以每個細節都不會改。
C. 得先學會用耳朵辨認每位來賓。
D. 不論有多少人，都決定取消活動。
normal.explain: play it by ear比喻不預先定死，依情況應變。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Can we leave that decision open for now?
options: A. 能把先前決定的紀錄刪掉嗎？
B. 能先暫不決定那件事嗎？
C. 能現在正式宣布最後決定嗎？
D. 能把門打開讓大家直接進來嗎？
normal.explain: leave a decision open暫不定案，不是宣告或刪紀錄。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: We need a fallback if the outdoor space is unavailable.
options: A. 戶外場地已確定永遠停止使用。
B. 現在需要有人往後退才能入場。
C. 戶外場地不能用時，需要備案。
D. 只要戶外場地能用，也必須改期。
normal.explain: fallback為第一方案不可行時的替代辦法。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: We are still going ahead; we are just moving the activity indoors.
options: A. 只准原本就在室內的人參加。
B. 活動照辦，只是改到室內。
C. 活動已取消，室內場地也不用了。
D. 室內活動結束後才決定是否照辦。
normal.explain: going ahead明示照辦，just限縮改動為地點。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Could we swap the two sessions? The person leading the first one is arriving late.
options: A. 能刪掉第二場，因第一場已開始嗎？
B. 能讓所有人各帶一場，不必等帶領者嗎？
C. 能把兩場順序對調，因第一場帶領者晚到嗎？
D. 能把兩場都延長，因帶領者會提早到嗎？
normal.explain: swap交換先後，不是增時或刪掉一場。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I had assumed you were bringing the equipment. No, I only said I could help carry it.
options: A. 雙方已同意各自提供一套相同器材。
B. 一方承諾提供器材，現在承認忘了帶。
C. 雙方都只談過搬運，從未出現不同理解。
D. 一方誤以為對方備器材；對方只說能幫忙搬。
normal.explain: 提供器材與協助搬運是不同承諾；had assumed標示原誤解。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: We can shorten the introduction, but I would not take time away from the practical exercise.
options: A. 兩部分都取消，改成自由討論。
B. 介紹已比實作短，所以不需調整。
C. 可縮短介紹，但不想壓縮實作。
D. 可縮短實作，介紹則完全不能動。
normal.explain: but對比兩部分的調整優先次序。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I am happy to try it once. That is not quite the same as agreeing to do it every week.
options: A. 同意每週做，只是不願第一次參加。
B. 曾試過一次，所以已承諾每週參加。
C. 只要不是每週做，就拒絕任何試行。
D. 願試一次，不等於同意每週做。
normal.explain: 一次嘗試與持續承諾範圍不同。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: We may have to make do with the smaller room, although it is not what we originally had in mind.
options: A. 或得將就小房間，雖非原先理想。
B. 小房間就是原先最想要的選擇。
C. 已決定不使用任何室內空間。
D. 小房間比原本預訂的大得多。
normal.explain: make do with在條件不足下將就，may保留未定性。

normal.desc: 【文法】If we had checked the opening hours, we ___ outside a locked door now.
options: A. would not be standing
B. will not have stood
C. had not stood
D. would not have been stand
normal.explain: 過去未查時間造成現在困境，混合條件句用would not be standing。

normal.desc: 【語意】We have kept the afternoon free in case the morning session runs over. What is the purpose?
options: A. To ensure that the morning session finishes early.
B. To allow for a possible delay.
C. To confirm that the morning session has been cancelled.
D. To arrange two sessions at exactly the same time.
normal.explain: in case為預先防備可能狀況；不保證會延誤或一定提早結束。

normal.desc: 【字彙】A makeshift shelter is one that is ___.
options: A. reserved for people who booked in advance
B. left empty until its official opening
C. put together temporarily from available materials
D. built according to a permanent design
normal.explain: makeshift指用現有材料權宜搭成，不等於永久設計。

normal.desc: 【指涉】We could use the hall or meet outside. The latter depends on the weather. Which option depends on the weather?
options: A. Choosing an appointment time.
B. Meeting outside.
C. Using the hall.
D. Cancelling both options.
normal.explain: the latter指剛列舉的後者meet outside。

normal.desc: 【文法】The room, ___ we had been assured would be available, was already occupied.
options: A. what
B. whose
C. which
D. where
normal.explain: 關係代詞which作would be available的主詞；we had been assured是插入的轉述結構。

normal.desc: 【語意】The replacement bus leaves at six, provided that enough passengers have booked. What is established?
options: A. A six o’clock departure is guaranteed.
B. All passengers must arrive six hours early.
C. The original bus will also leave at six.
D. The departure depends on sufficient bookings.
normal.explain: provided that引出條件；時間已給但未無條件保證發車。

normal.desc: 【語用】That should work, as long as we can get the keys beforehand. Which reply addresses the condition?
options: A. The room has a large window facing the garden.
B. I have never visited that part of town before.
C. I can collect them this evening and bring them with me.
D. Yes, I also think the plan sounds enjoyable.
normal.explain: 條件是事前取得鑰匙；只有承諾先領鑰匙直接處理此條件。

normal.desc: 【短文】A workshop leader brings extra paper but no spare projector. She explains that participants can draw their ideas if the slides fail. What does her preparation show?
options: A. She expects every participant to repair the projector.
B. She has cancelled the visual part of the workshop.
C. She believes the projector is certain to fail.
D. She has prepared an alternative way to carry out the activity.
normal.explain: if表示備案，改用畫圖仍保留視覺活動，不代表確信故障。

normal.desc: 【語意】We will review the arrangement after two weeks; that does not mean it ends automatically then. What is the distinction?
options: A. Reconsidering an arrangement versus bringing it to an end.
B. Starting an arrangement versus asking permission to discuss it.
C. Extending an arrangement versus refusing to evaluate it.
D. Changing the participants versus changing the location.
normal.explain: review是重新評估，不等於自動到期，題幹已明確區分。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：用現有材料權宜搭成的
normal.explain: 口說表達「MAKESHIFT」(adj.)：用現有材料權宜搭成的。例句：They built a makeshift table from two boxes.（他們用兩個箱子搭成臨時桌子。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：重新安排原定的時間
normal.explain: 口說表達「RESCHEDULE」(v.)：重新安排原定的時間。例句：We need to reschedule the meeting for tomorrow.（我們需要將會議重新安排到明天。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：實際可行的替代方案
normal.explain: 口說表達「A WORKABLE ALTERNATIVE」(phr.)：實際可行的替代方案。例句：The smaller room offers a workable alternative.（小房間提供可行替代方案。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：出乎意料的場地變更
normal.explain: 口說表達「AN UNEXPECTED CHANGE OF VENUE」(phr.)：出乎意料的場地變更。例句：We announced an unexpected change of venue.（我們宣布意外的場地變更。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：應先確認備選再取消原預約
normal.ans: WE SHOULD CONFIRM THE ALTERNATIVE BEFORE CANCELLING THE BOOKING
normal.speak: we should confirm the alternative before cancelling the booking
normal.vocabId: R6:WE SHOULD CONFIRM THE ALTERNATIVE BEFORE CANCELLING THE BOOKING
normal.explain: 口說表達「WE SHOULD CONFIRM THE ALTERNATIVE BEFORE CANCELLING THE BOOKING」(phr.)：應先確認備選再取消原預約。例句：We should confirm the alternative before cancelling the booking.（應先確認備選再取消原預約。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：願意試試與作固定承諾不同
normal.ans: BEING WILLING TO TRY IS DIFFERENT FROM MAKING A REGULAR COMMITMENT
normal.speak: being willing to try is different from making a regular commitment
normal.vocabId: R6:BEING WILLING TO TRY IS DIFFERENT FROM MAKING A REGULAR COMMITMENT
normal.explain: 口說表達「BEING WILLING TO TRY IS DIFFERENT FROM MAKING A REGULAR COMMITMENT」(phr.)：願意試試與作固定承諾不同。例句：Being willing to try is different from making a regular commitment.（願意試試與作固定承諾不同。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：可能發生而需要預作打算的狀況（C 開頭，11 個字母）
normal.explain: CONTINGENCY (n.)：可能發生而需要預作打算的狀況。例句：We discussed a contingency plan for heavy rain.（我們討論大雨備案。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：把原定事情延後舉行（P 開頭，12 個字母）
normal.explain: POSTPONEMENT (n.)：把原定事情延後舉行。例句：The postponement gives us another week to prepare.（延期使我們多一週準備。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：善用現有資源想辦法解決問題的（R 開頭，11 個字母）
normal.explain: RESOURCEFUL (adj.)：善用現有資源想辦法解決問題的。例句：The resourceful team found another place to meet.（足智多謀的團隊找到別處開會。）

normal.desc: 填空題：F L E X I _ I L I T Y (因情況不同而能調整的彈性)
normal.explain: FLEXIBILITY (n.)：因情況不同而能調整的彈性。填空答案為「B」。例句：The timetable allows some flexibility.（時間表容許一些彈性。）

normal.desc: 填空題：C O N _ I N _ E N T (取決於另一條件是否成立的)
normal.explain: CONTINGENT (adj.)：取決於另一條件是否成立的。填空答案為「TG」。例句：The visit is contingent on the room being available.（參訪取決於房間是否可用。）

normal.desc: 填空題：R E _ D _ U _ T (因新情況再次作調整)
normal.explain: READJUST (v.)：因新情況再次作調整。填空答案為「AJS」。例句：We can readjust the schedule tomorrow.（我們明天可再次調整行程。）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I am keeping the coat, but I am having the lining replaced.
options: A. 外套已經換好，現在不需處理。
B. 外套保留，內裡要更換。
C. 整件外套都退掉，內裡另行保留。
D. 只換外套顏色，內裡完全不動。
normal.explain: have something replaced表示請人更換該部分，keeping保留整體。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The label is at the back. I think you have put it on the wrong way round.
options: A. 標籤被剪掉，因此無法知道衣服材質。
B. 標籤要求把衣服倒掛而不是穿上。
C. 標籤應在後面，可能把前後穿反了。
D. 標籤在後面，所以肯定把衣服穿在外套外。
normal.explain: wrong way round在前後定位語境是方向穿反，非inside out裡外反。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: It is a loose fit by design; it is not meant to cling to you.
options: A. 衣服因洗壞而縮小，已無法穿。
B. 寬鬆只是標籤錯誤，應把它改緊。
C. 說話者要求所有衣服都穿同一尺寸。
D. 原本就設計成寬鬆，不是要貼身。
normal.explain: by design表有意設計；not meant to cling否定貼身目的。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I recognised the hat before I recognised the person wearing it.
options: A. 只認出帽子，始終沒認出戴者。
B. 認出的是帽子製作者，不是戴帽者。
C. 先認出帽子，才認出戴帽的人。
D. 先認出人，才知道帽子是誰的。
normal.explain: before提供認出兩者的先後，不是否定後來認出人。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: They are not identical costumes. The differences are just hard to see from the back of the hall.
options: A. 戲服完全相同，只有座位顏色不同。
B. 戲服太破舊，所以不准觀眾坐後排。
C. 坐後排的人比前排更容易辨識細節。
D. 戲服不同，只是坐廳後不易看出差別。
normal.explain: not identical否定相同，just解釋觀察距離造成難辨。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I would keep the original buttons. They are part of what makes the coat recognisable in the old photographs.
options: A. 想保留原鈕扣，因是舊照片中辨識外套的特徵。
B. 想把鈕扣全換掉，讓外套更像照片原貌。
C. 舊照片看不到外套，所以沒有可保留的特徵。
D. 鈕扣已全部遺失，只能根據照片重買。
normal.explain: keep與recognisable指出保留辨識特徵，未說鈕扣遺失。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The pockets are decorative. If you put your keys in there, they will fall straight through.
options: A. 口袋專為收鑰匙設計，比其他位置安全。
B. 鑰匙太重，應先把口袋拉鍊拉上。
C. 口袋內已有鑰匙，所以不能放別的。
D. 口袋只是裝飾，放鑰匙會直接掉下。
normal.explain: decorative與fall through否定實用收納功能。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: She said the dress was striking, which I took as a compliment, though she stopped short of saying she liked it.
options: A. 她說洋裝醒目，我當成讚美，但她沒明說喜歡。
B. 她明說喜歡，並要求買一件相同洋裝。
C. 她說洋裝不顯眼，所以我認為是在批評。
D. 她說話中斷，因有人拿走了洋裝。
normal.explain: striking醒目不自動等同喜歡；stopped short of在此是未進一步表示。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: We do not need to make the costume historically exact. We do need the audience to understand who the character is.
options: A. 說話者認為戲服對角色理解沒有幫助。
B. 不求戲服歷史細節全準，但要讓觀眾理解角色。
C. 角色辨識不重要，只求每個歷史細節都對。
D. 只要衣服昂貴，就能保證觀眾理解角色。
normal.explain: do not need與do need對照兩種優先條件。

normal.desc: 【語意】The jacket fits across the shoulders, but the sleeves need shortening. What is the problem?
options: A. The fabric has lost its colour.
B. The sleeves are too long.
C. The shoulders are too narrow.
D. The jacket cannot be fastened.
normal.explain: need shortening表示袖長過長，肩部尺寸合適已明說。

normal.desc: 【文法】I wish I ___ the coat on before buying it; it is much heavier than I expected.
options: A. have try
B. was try
C. had tried
D. would have trying
normal.explain: 對已完成購買的過去遺憾，用wish加過去完成式had tried。

normal.desc: 【字彙】A reversible jacket can be ___.
options: A. returned to the shop without a receipt
B. stretched to fit any size
C. washed only by hand
D. worn with either side facing out
normal.explain: reversible指正反兩面皆可穿，不涉及退貨權或洗法。

normal.desc: 【指涉】The scarf was tucked inside the collar so that it would not trail across the wet bench. What does it refer to?
options: A. The bench.
B. The weather.
C. The scarf.
D. The collar.
normal.explain: it承接被收進領口、可能拖到椅面的圍巾。

normal.desc: 【文法】The boots need ___ before they are comfortable enough for a long walk.
options: A. to breaking in
B. break in
C. to have break in
D. breaking in
normal.explain: need doing可表被動需要；break in鞋靴指穿到適腳。

normal.desc: 【語意】The notice says costumes are welcome but not compulsory. Which visitor meets the stated rule?
options: A. A visitor arriving in ordinary clothes.
B. Only a visitor wearing a complete costume.
C. Only a visitor who has hired a costume.
D. A visitor who refuses to enter without changing the rule.
normal.explain: welcome不等於必須，not compulsory明許一般衣著。

normal.desc: 【語用】Before you buy another size, have you checked whether the waist can be adjusted? What is suggested?
options: A. Buying another size is forbidden.
B. The garment has already been altered permanently.
C. The speaker knows the current size is unavailable.
D. An existing feature may solve the fit problem.
normal.explain: 問腰部能否調整，提供先查現有功能的替代步驟。

normal.desc: 【短文】A repair café advertises visible mending. Its organiser explains that repairs may become part of the design rather than being hidden. What should a participant expect?
options: A. The repair can be deliberately noticeable.
B. Every repair will be impossible to detect.
C. Only undamaged clothes will be accepted.
D. The original garment must be replaced entirely.
normal.explain: visible及rather than hidden明示可把修補痕跡當設計。

normal.desc: 【語意】The actor looked older in the costume, although nothing about his actual age had changed. What distinction is made?
options: A. A comfortable garment versus an expensive one.
B. An impression created by appearance versus a personal fact.
C. An actor’s identity versus the identity of the costume maker.
D. A planned costume versus a completed performance.
normal.explain: looked older是外觀印象，不是實際年齡改變。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：正反兩面皆可使用或穿著的
normal.explain: 口說表達「REVERSIBLE」(adj.)：正反兩面皆可使用或穿著的。例句：The jacket is reversible.（這件外套正反兩面都可穿。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：對衣物尺寸或樣式所作的修改
normal.explain: 口說表達「ALTERATIONS」(n.)：對衣物尺寸或樣式所作的修改。例句：The trousers need minor alterations.（這件長褲需稍作修改。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：刻意設計的寬鬆版型
normal.explain: 口說表達「A DELIBERATELY LOOSE FIT」(phr.)：刻意設計的寬鬆版型。例句：The coat has a deliberately loose fit.（外套刻意設計成寬鬆版型。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：適合實際活動的替換衣物
normal.explain: 口說表達「A PRACTICAL CHANGE OF CLOTHES」(phr.)：適合實際活動的替換衣物。例句：Bring a practical change of clothes for the workshop.（請為工作坊帶實用的替換衣物。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：修補可以成為設計的一部分
normal.ans: THE REPAIR CAN BECOME PART OF THE DESIGN
normal.speak: the repair can become part of the design
normal.vocabId: R6:THE REPAIR CAN BECOME PART OF THE DESIGN
normal.explain: 口說表達「THE REPAIR CAN BECOME PART OF THE DESIGN」(phr.)：修補可以成為設計的一部分。例句：The repair can become part of the design.（修補可以成為設計的一部分。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：看起來較老不等於實際年齡較大
normal.ans: LOOKING OLDER IS NOT THE SAME AS BEING OLDER
normal.speak: looking older is not the same as being older
normal.vocabId: R6:LOOKING OLDER IS NOT THE SAME AS BEING OLDER
normal.explain: 口說表達「LOOKING OLDER IS NOT THE SAME AS BEING OLDER」(phr.)：看起來較老不等於實際年齡較大。例句：Looking older is not the same as being older.（看起來較老不等於實際年齡較大。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：一個人擁有的全部衣物（W 開頭，8 個字母）
normal.explain: WARDROBE (n.)：一個人擁有的全部衣物。例句：She added a warm coat to her wardrobe.（她在自己的衣物中添了一件暖外套。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：能阻止水滲透的（W 開頭，10 個字母）
normal.explain: WATERPROOF (adj.)：能阻止水滲透的。例句：He wore a waterproof jacket in the rain.（他在雨中穿防水外套。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：可依需要改變位置或尺寸的（A 開頭，10 個字母）
normal.explain: ADJUSTABLE (adj.)：可依需要改變位置或尺寸的。例句：The bag has an adjustable strap.（袋子有可調整的背帶。）

normal.desc: 填空題：F A S T _ N I N G (把衣物或物品扣合的扣件)
normal.explain: FASTENING (n.)：把衣物或物品扣合的扣件。填空答案為「E」。例句：The fastening at the collar had broken.（領口扣件壞了。）

normal.desc: 填空題：E M B _ O I _ E R Y (在布料上用針線繡出的圖樣)
normal.explain: EMBROIDERY (n.)：在布料上用針線繡出的圖樣。填空答案為「RD」。例句：The embroidery was done by hand.（刺繡是手工完成的。）

normal.desc: 填空題：U N _ U I _ A _ L E (不適合某用途或場合的)
normal.explain: UNSUITABLE (adj.)：不適合某用途或場合的。填空答案為「STB」。例句：The shoes are unsuitable for a muddy path.（這雙鞋不適合泥濘小徑。）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Keep the river on your left until you reach the old mill.
options: A. 看到舊磨坊後，沿河走向左邊。
B. 走到河邊後，在第一個路口左轉。
C. 到舊磨坊之前，讓河一直在你的左邊。
D. 先到河左岸，再回到舊磨坊。
normal.explain: on your left說明行進時河的相對位置，until設定終點。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The gate is locked, but there is a public path around the edge of the garden.
options: A. 花園小路鎖著，必須由正門穿過。
B. 公共小路穿越花園中央，再通向鎖門。
C. 鎖門旁有人，可以請他帶路穿過花園。
D. 門鎖著，但可走花園邊緣的公共小路。
normal.explain: but給出可行替代，around the edge不是穿越中央，也沒提帶路者。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: We are on the right street, just at the wrong end of it.
options: A. 街道找對了，但目前在不對的那一端。
B. 街道走錯了，但目的地就在這個路口。
C. 已到正確街道盡頭，可以停止找路。
D. 街道兩端都能直接進入同一棟建築。
normal.explain: right street與wrong end同時成立，不能把right誤讀成右轉。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: If you pass the bakery, you have gone too far.
options: A. 先經過麵包店，才會到要找的位置。
B. 麵包店太遠，所以應改找其他目的地。
C. 過了麵包店之後，才需要開始看路牌。
D. 若走過麵包店，就表示已超過要找的位置。
normal.explain: gone too far表示越過目標位置；麵包店是確認走過頭的線索。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The shortcut saves distance, but with all those steps I doubt it saves effort.
options: A. 近路距離較短，但階梯多，未必省力。
B. 近路比較費時，因此距離應該也較長。
C. 近路雖有階梯，卻已確定更省力。
D. 近路階梯較少，所以較適合搬運行李。
normal.explain: distance與effort分開評估，doubt保留對省力的疑問。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I would check the street name before turning. These two corners look almost the same.
options: A. 應先轉彎，再確認街名是否相同。
B. 轉彎前先核對街名，因這兩個轉角很相似。
C. 街名已換過，所以只能憑轉角外觀找路。
D. 兩個轉角通向同條街，不必再核對。
normal.explain: before與look almost the same說明先確認文字線索的理由與順序。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: You can see the platform from here, but we still have to go through the underpass to get onto it.
options: A. 雖看得到月台，仍須經地下道才能上去。
B. 地下道能看見月台，但不能用來前往月台。
C. 月台在地下道內，沿目前通道直走即可。
D. 目前位置就是月台入口，不必再繞路。
normal.explain: see與get onto分別是看見與實際抵達，underpass仍是必要路線。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The map is not wrong about the distance. It just does not tell you that most of it is uphill.
options: A. 地圖的坡度標對了，距離卻仍待測量。
B. 距離本身沒錯，只是沒標大部分路段都上坡。
C. 距離標示有誤，因上坡會讓實際路程增加。
D. 地圖只畫上坡路段，所以漏掉其他距離。
normal.explain: not wrong about distance保留距離資訊正確，批評遺漏坡度。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I thought we were lost, but we had simply come out on the other side of the square.
options: A. 差點走錯，但在進入廣場前就察覺了。
B. 已走到另一座廣場，因此不認得出口。
C. 原以為迷路，其實只是從廣場另一側走出來。
D. 確實迷路，所以又回到了廣場原來那側。
normal.explain: had simply重新解釋原先lost的判斷，other side不是另一座廣場。

normal.desc: 【路線】The riverside path is shorter, but it closes at dusk. It is already dark, so we will take the road through the village. Why was that route chosen?
options: A. The riverside path leads to a different village.
B. The walkers want to reach the river before dusk.
C. The shorter route is no longer available.
D. The village road has recently been shortened.
normal.explain: 路徑黃昏關閉，現在已黑；選村內道路是可用性，不是距離改變。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The guide suggests using the clock tower as a landmark when walking back. What should visitors use it for?
options: A. Finding out when the tour ends.
B. Checking the height of nearby buildings.
C. Deciding which buildings they may enter.
D. Recognising where they are.
normal.explain: landmark在找路語境是可辨識位置的地標，未要求讀時間或進入塔內。

normal.desc: 【文法】By the time we reached the junction, the guide ___ the route twice already.
options: A. had checked
B. has checked
C. will have checked
D. is checking
normal.explain: reached為過去參照點，already與twice表示此前已完成兩次，用過去完成式。

normal.desc: 【語用】I would not rely on the blue line alone; the pavement markings have faded. What does the speaker recommend?
options: A. Choosing whichever pavement looks newest.
B. Avoiding every street marked in blue.
C. Waiting for the markings to be repainted.
D. Using another source to confirm the route.
normal.explain: not rely on ... alone是不要只靠單一線索，沒有要求等重畫或避開所有藍線。

normal.desc: 【指涉】The footbridge runs beside the railway bridge, but only the former is open to walkers. Which bridge may walkers use?
options: A. The footbridge.
B. The railway bridge.
C. Either bridge when no train is approaching.
D. The bridge closest to their starting point.
normal.explain: former指前述第一者footbridge，不能由火車是否接近自行增加通行條件。

normal.desc: 【路線】The app says the station is ten minutes away on foot. The notice beside us says the usual footpath is closed for repairs. What is the sensible conclusion?
options: A. The app has located a different station.
B. The estimate may not allow for the closure.
C. The station itself is closed for repairs.
D. The repairs will take about ten minutes.
normal.explain: 封閉可能使原步行估時不適用；不是證明車站關閉或定位錯誤。

normal.desc: 【短文】A map uses a dotted line for a steep path and a solid line for a flatter one. The key explains this distinction. What should a visitor check before choosing?
options: A. What the line styles mean.
B. Whether the dotted line is printed more recently.
C. Which line has the brighter colour.
D. Whether the solid line ends at a building.
normal.explain: 題內說明線型對應坡度，應讀圖例；沒有提供更新時間或終點差別。

normal.desc: 【推論】The campsite is visible from the road, but the entrance is on the far side of the field. What mistake might a visitor make?
options: A. Confusing the campsite with another place mentioned on the map.
B. Assuming that seeing the site means being near its entrance.
C. Thinking the road is hidden behind the campsite.
D. Using the field entrance despite being unable to see the site.
normal.explain: 可見營地與入口所在面不同，視線上的接近不等於接近可進入的位置。

normal.desc: 【語用】The sign is technically correct, but it appears after the turning it tells you to take. What is the criticism?
options: A. The instruction points in the opposite direction.
B. The sign should give distances rather than directions.
C. The information arrives too late to guide the decision.
D. The sign names a destination on a different road.
normal.explain: 批評資訊出現的時機，不否定文字方向本身或指定改為距離。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：用來辨識位置的地標
normal.explain: 口說表達「LANDMARK」(n.)：用來辨識位置的地標。例句：The chimney is a useful landmark when you return from the beach.（從海灘回來時，煙囪是實用的地標。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：道路交會的路口
normal.explain: 口說表達「JUNCTION」(n.)：道路交會的路口。例句：Turn left at the junction beyond the bridge.（過橋後在交會路口左轉。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：行程的目的地
normal.explain: 口說表達「DESTINATION」(n.)：行程的目的地。例句：Tainan was our favorite travel destination last summer.（台南是我們去年夏天最喜歡的旅遊目的地。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：循原路回走
normal.explain: 口說表達「RETRACE YOUR STEPS」(phr.)：循原路回走。例句：If the lane ends here, we should retrace our steps.（若巷道到這裡就沒了，我們應循原路回走。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：入口在庭院另一側。
normal.ans: THE ENTRANCE IS ACROSS THE COURTYARD
normal.speak: the entrance is across the courtyard
normal.vocabId: R6:THE ENTRANCE IS ACROSS THE COURTYARD
normal.explain: 口說表達「THE ENTRANCE IS ACROSS THE COURTYARD」(phr.)：入口在庭院另一側。。例句：The entrance is across the courtyard.（入口在庭院另一側。。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：看得見，不代表能直接到達。
normal.ans: VISIBLE DOES NOT MEAN DIRECTLY ACCESSIBLE
normal.speak: visible does not mean directly accessible
normal.vocabId: R6:VISIBLE DOES NOT MEAN DIRECTLY ACCESSIBLE
normal.explain: 口說表達「VISIBLE DOES NOT MEAN DIRECTLY ACCESSIBLE」(phr.)：看得見，不代表能直接到達。。例句：Visible does not mean directly accessible.（看得見，不代表能直接到達。。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：比一般路線更近的捷徑（S 開頭，8 個字母）
normal.explain: SHORTCUT (n.)：比一般路線更近的捷徑。例句：The shortcut crosses a field rather than following the road.（這條捷徑穿越田地，不沿道路走。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：大致的；非精確的（A 開頭，11 個字母）
normal.explain: APPROXIMATE (adj.)：大致的；非精確的。例句：The map gives an approximate walking time.（地圖提供大致的步行時間。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：因原路受阻而安排的改道路線（D 開頭，9 個字母）
normal.explain: DIVERSION (n.)：因原路受阻而安排的改道路線。例句：Follow the signed diversion while the bridge is being repaired.（橋梁維修期間，請循標示的改道路線走。）

normal.desc: 填空題：T H O R O U _ H F A R E (供車輛或行人穿行的主要道路)
normal.explain: THOROUGHFARE (n.)：供車輛或行人穿行的主要道路。填空答案為「G」。例句：The narrow lane leads onto a busy thoroughfare.（這條窄巷通向一條繁忙的主要道路。）

normal.desc: 填空題：B E _ R I _ G S (位置與方向感（常用複數）)
normal.explain: BEARINGS (n. pl.)：位置與方向感（常用複數）。填空答案為「AN」。例句：She paused at the crossing to get her bearings.（她在交叉口停下來，確認自己的位置與方向。）

normal.desc: 填空題：N A _ I _ A _ E (辨認方向並找路前進)
normal.explain: NAVIGATE (v.)：辨認方向並找路前進。填空答案為「VGT」。例句：She uses street names to navigate through the old town.（她利用街名在老城區辨認方向前進。）

normal.desc: 【時態】The committee ___ the proposed tax reforms for three hours without reaching a consensus.
options: A. discusses
B. has been discussing
C. is discussed
D. had discussed
normal.explain: 句中有「for three hours」強調動作持續進行且尚未結束，符合現在完成進行式的使用時機。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The controversial policy ___ by the board of directors during next month's meeting.
options: A. expects to review
B. is expecting to review
C. is expected to be reviewed
D. has expected to review
normal.explain: 政策是「被預期將被審查」，需使用「is expected to be + V-p.p.」的複雜被動語態。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The CEO's flight was delayed by a severe storm, so she ___ the opening speech.
options: A. must have missed
B. should miss
C. can be missing
D. ought to have missed
normal.explain: 基於班機延誤的事實，對過去發生的事情作肯定推測，應使用「must have + V-p.p.」，表示「一定已經錯過了」。

normal.desc: 【字彙】To ___ the financial burden on small businesses, the government introduced a new subsidy program.
options: A. aggravate
B. alleviate
C. allocate
D. alternate
normal.explain: alleviate 意為「減輕、緩和」。政府推動補助計畫是為了減輕小型企業的財務負擔。

normal.desc: 【時態】Scientists ___ this rare phenomenon since 2015, yet its true origin remains a mystery.
options: A. investigate
B. investigated
C. have been investigating
D. are investigating
normal.explain: 「since 2015」加上現在式「remains」，表示動作從過去持續到現在，應選現在完成進行式。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The latest software update ___ to have caused several system crashes across the network.
options: A. believes
B. is believing
C. is believed
D. has believed
normal.explain: 「被認為」造成了當機，主詞是軟體更新，應使用被動語態 is believed (to have + V-p.p.)。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】There was no forced entry, meaning the thief ___ a key to open the safe.
options: A. might use
B. must have used
C. will have used
D. could use
normal.explain: 沒有強行破壞的痕跡，代表小偷過去「一定使用了」鑰匙，這是有強烈依據的過去推測。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The board reached a ___ after hours of intense negotiation regarding the merger.
options: A. consensus
B. conflict
C. consequence
D. concept
normal.explain: consensus 意為「共識」。經過數小時談判後，董事會終於達成共識。

normal.desc: 【短文】Memo: The upcoming quarterly report is currently being drafted by the finance team. It is expected to be finalized by Friday. Since we have been experiencing a substantial deficit, all department heads must have prepared their cost-cutting strategies prior to the meeting. Q: What is implied about the company's financial status?
options: A. It is generating record-breaking profits.
B. It has been losing money recently.
C. It is expanding into new markets.
D. It has finalized its budget for next year.
normal.explain: 短文中提到「experiencing a substantial deficit」（經歷大幅虧損），因此暗示公司最近在賠錢。

normal.desc: 【短文】Science Daily: Researchers have been attempting to replicate the results of the groundbreaking study on renewable energy for months. However, the initial findings are now believed to have been skewed by equipment malfunction. Q: Why are the initial findings questionable?
options: A. The researchers lacked sufficient funding.
B. The data was deliberately falsified.
C. A flaw in the machinery likely affected the results.
D. The study was not published in a reputable journal.
normal.explain: 文章指出初步結果被認為是受到設備故障（equipment malfunction）的影響（skewed），故選 C。

normal.desc: 【時態】Our competitors ___ aggressively in artificial intelligence for the past few years to gain market share.
options: A. have been investing
B. are invested
C. invest
D. will invest
normal.explain: for the past few years 表示動作的持續性，需使用現在完成進行式。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The new regulations are rumored ___ next week, although official confirmation is still pending.
options: A. to announce
B. to be announced
C. announcing
D. announced
normal.explain: be rumored to be + V-p.p. 表示「據傳將被...」，法規是被公布的對象。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】You submitted the report without the financial attachments; you ___ them in your hurry.
options: A. must overlook
B. must have overlooked
C. should have overlooked
D. can overlook
normal.explain: 對於過去發生的失誤進行高度肯定的推測，「你當時一定是忽略了」，用 must have + V-p.p.。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The CEO's sudden resignation was completely ___; no one in the company saw it coming.
options: A. unprecedented
B. unresolved
C. undeniable
D. unexpected
normal.explain: unexpected 意為「出乎意料的」。沒有人預見這件事，代表它是未預期的。
