D. 球員們正在向裁判抗議這個不公的決定
normal.explain: 原句：The coach has been arguing with the referee over that penalty call. (教練一直在跟裁判爭論那個罰球判決。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The star player is rumored to be benched due to a minor injury.
options: A. 明星球員因為重傷將錯過整個賽季
B. 傳聞明星球員因為輕傷將坐冷板凳
C. 球隊決定將受傷的明星球員交易出去
D. 明星球員已經完全康復並準備上場
normal.explain: 原句：The star player is rumored to be benched due to a minor injury. (傳聞這位明星球員因為輕傷將坐冷板凳。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: They must have trained incredibly hard to reach the finals.
options: A. 他們拒絕參加決賽前的訓練
B. 訓練過度導致他們在決賽中表現不佳
C. 他們一定訓練得非常刻苦才能進入決賽
D. 教練對他們在決賽中的表現感到滿意
normal.explain: 原句：They must have trained incredibly hard to reach the finals. (他們一定訓練得非常刻苦才能進入決賽。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: We have been tracking the runner's lap times throughout the tournament.
options: A. His times must have been improving steadily.
B. The tournament was cancelled last week.
C. The runner refused to track his time.
D. I have been running every morning.
normal.explain: 原句：We have been tracking the runner's lap times throughout the tournament. (在整個錦標賽期間，我們一直在追蹤這位跑者的單圈時間。) 選項 A (他的成績一定在穩定進步中) 最合理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The tactical substitution is believed to be crucial for their victory.
options: A. 他們的勝利完全是因為運氣好
B. 教練拒絕在比賽中進行任何換人
C. 這次戰術性的換人被認為對他們的勝利至關重要
D. 換下主力球員導致了這場比賽的落敗
normal.explain: 原句：The tactical substitution is believed to be crucial for their victory. (這次戰術性的換人被認為對他們的勝利至關重要。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Professional credentials are required to be submitted before the seminar.
options: A. 研討會結束後將發放專業證書
B. 專業資格證明要求在研討會前提交
C. 參與者不需要任何專業背景即可報名
D. 研討會的主辦方遺失了大家的證件
normal.explain: 原句：Professional credentials are required to be submitted before the seminar. (專業資格證明要求在研討會前提交。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: She must have expanded her network significantly at the conference.
options: A. Yes, she exchanged cards with many executives.
B. The network is currently down.
C. We have been expanding the office space.
D. She must have forgotten to attend it.
normal.explain: 原句：She must have expanded her network significantly at the conference. (她一定在會議上大幅擴展了她的人脈。) 選項 A (是的，她跟許多高層交換了名片) 最合理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: We have been providing mentorship programs to assist mid-career transitions.
options: A. 我們一直在提供導師計畫以協助中年轉職
B. 中年轉職者拒絕參加任何導師計畫
C. 我們的導師計畫目前已經暫停招募
D. 轉職者對目前的導師計畫感到不滿
normal.explain: 原句：We have been providing mentorship programs to assist mid-career transitions. (我們一直在提供導師計畫以協助中年轉職。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The guest speaker is known to be an expert in climbing the corporate ladder.
options: A. 演講嘉賓以其在企業界晉升的專業知識而聞名
B. 嘉賓剛剛從公司的最高層職位退下來
C. 演講者拒絕透露他在企業成功的秘訣
D. 嘉賓認為在企業中晉升是一件困難的事
normal.explain: 原句：The guest speaker is known to be an expert in climbing the corporate ladder. (這位客座講者以其在企業界晉升的專業知識而聞名。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: He must have prepared extensively to answer those tough interview questions.
options: A. 面試官的問題讓他感到非常不知所措
B. 他面試時完全沒有回答出那些難題
C. 他一定做了廣泛的準備才能回答那些艱難的面試問題
D. 面試官一定已經提前把問題洩露給了他
normal.explain: 原句：He must have prepared extensively to answer those tough interview questions. (他一定做了廣泛的準備才能回答那些艱難的面試問題。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: I have been exploring alternative career paths since my department was downsized.
options: A. The department will be expanding soon.
B. It's a great opportunity to find what you really want.
C. You must have fired them all.
D. The paths in this park are quite narrow.
normal.explain: 原句：I have been exploring alternative career paths since my department was downsized. (自從我的部門縮編後，我一直在探索其他的職涯路徑。) 選項 B (這是一個尋找你真正想要什麼的好機會) 最合理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: A positive personal brand is considered to be indispensable in today's job market.
options: A. 求職者應該盡量隱藏自己的個人品牌
B. 正向的個人品牌在現今的就業市場被認為是不可或缺的
C. 大多數公司不在乎求職者的個人品牌
D. 建立個人品牌是一件浪費時間的事情
normal.explain: 原句：A positive personal brand is considered to be indispensable in today's job market. (正向的個人品牌在現今的就業市場被認為是不可或缺的。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The seminar attendees have been sharing their resumes for peer review.
options: A. 與會者拒絕讓別人看自己的履歷
B. 專家正在台上公開評論大家的履歷
C. 研討會的與會者一直在分享他們的履歷以進行同儕審查
D. 主辦方已經把所有與會者的履歷都銷毀了
normal.explain: 原句：The seminar attendees have been sharing their resumes for peer review. (研討會的與會者一直在分享他們的履歷以進行同儕審查。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: She must have secured a lucrative job offer after attending that workshop.
options: A. 她一定在參加那場工作坊後獲得了一份優渥的工作邀約
B. 工作坊的主辦方拒絕給她任何工作機會
C. 她在工作坊上表現不佳，錯失了工作機會
D. 她決定放棄那份薪水很高的工作
normal.explain: 原句：She must have secured a lucrative job offer after attending that workshop. (她一定在參加那場工作坊後獲得了一份優渥的工作邀約。)

normal.desc: 【時態】The human resources team ___ the staff's morale since the latest restructuring was announced.
options: A. has been assessing
B. assesses
C. is assessing
D. has assessed
normal.explain: 本題測驗現在完成進行式。句末的 since 表示動作從過去持續到現在，且強調持續進行的狀態，故選 has been assessing。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The anonymous survey results are reported ___ by the executive board behind closed doors yesterday.
options: A. to review
B. to have been reviewed
C. to be reviewing
D. to have reviewed
normal.explain: 本題測驗複雜被動語態。審查的動作發生在昨天（過去），因此不定詞需用完成式，且問卷結果是「被審查」，故選 to have been reviewed。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】Only half of the staff completed the questionnaire; the others ___ the due date notification.
options: A. should ignore
B. could ignore
C. must have ignored
D. might ignore
normal.explain: 本題測驗對過去事實的肯定推測。既然只有一半的人完成，其他人「一定忽略了」通知，應使用 must have + V-p.p.。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Why is the staff lounge closed?
B: The management ___ it for the past two weeks to create a better rest area.
options: A. renovate
B. has renovated
C. is renovated
D. has been renovating
normal.explain: 對話中提到 for the past two weeks，表示動作從過去兩週一直持續到現在還在進行中，需使用現在完成進行式。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The new remote work arrangement is widely considered ___ a major boost to overall staff well-being last year.
options: A. to have provided
B. to be provided
C. to provide
D. providing
normal.explain: 句中的 last year 點出提供幫助的時間點在過去，因此 consider 之後要接完成式不定詞 to have + V-p.p. 表達較早發生的動作。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】You didn't receive the wellness questionnaire? The automated mail server ___ it to your spam folder by mistake.
options: A. must route
B. must have routed
C. routes
D. has routed
normal.explain: 針對過去發生的情況（沒收到信）做出強烈推斷，「一定是分類到垃圾信件匣了」，須用 must have + V-p.p.。

normal.desc:
【短文】HR Notice: We have been gathering input from all departments regarding workplace stress. The long hours are suspected to have caused extreme burnout among the junior staff. Supervisors must have failed to recognize the early signs of exhaustion.
Q: What is identified as the root of the problem?
options: A. Low pay
B. Poor facilities
C. Excessive working hours
D. Lack of training
normal.explain: 短文中提到「The long hours are suspected to have caused extreme burnout」，可推知問題的根源是工時過長 (Excessive working hours)。

normal.desc:
【短文】Memo: The annual retreat has been undergoing major changes. The event is expected to be hosted locally this year to cut costs. The planning committee must have realized that international travel is no longer viable for our budget.
Q: What is true about the annual retreat?
options: A. It is canceled.
B. It is fully funded.
C. It will last longer.
D. It will take place nearby.
normal.explain: 短文中提到「hosted locally this year to cut costs」，表示今年的員工旅遊會在本地舉辦，因此地點會在附近 (nearby)。

normal.desc: 【時態】City planners ___ the traffic congestion at the main intersection for several months to find a solution.
options: A. have been observing
B. are observing
C. will observe
D. observe
normal.explain: for several months 表示動作持續了一段時間並延續至今，故選擇現在完成進行式。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The controversial toll tax is scheduled ___ by the municipal council next spring.
options: A. to enforce
B. to be enforced
C. enforcing
D. enforce
normal.explain: 稅收 (toll tax) 是被執行的，因此在 is scheduled 之後要接被動不定詞 to be + V-p.p.。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The train arrived forty minutes late; there ___ a severe malfunction on the tracks.
options: A. must be
B. can be
C. must have been
D. will be
normal.explain: 火車已經誤點了，這是對過去發生的事件進行強烈推測，「當時軌道一定發生了故障」，所以用 must have been。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Have they fixed the pothole on 5th Avenue?
B: No, the road crew ___ on the highway expansion instead.
options: A. focused
B. is focusing
C. focuses
D. has been focusing
normal.explain: 雖然沒有時間副詞，但語意上強調工程人員「這陣子一直專注於」高速公路擴建，用現在完成進行式最符合情境。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The expanded bicycle lanes are proven ___ commuting times for residents in the suburbs over the last year.
options: A. to have shortened
B. to shorten
C. shortening
D. to be shortened
normal.explain: over the last year 指向過去的成果，are proven 後方需搭配完成式不定詞 to have shortened 來表示已經發生的縮短效果。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The mayor skipped the transit ribbon-cutting ceremony. She ___ stuck in the very traffic she promised to eliminate.
options: A. is
B. must have gotten
C. will get
D. should get
normal.explain: 市長缺席了過去的典禮，推測她當時「一定被困在車陣中了」，對過去事實的推斷要用 must have + V-p.p.。

normal.desc:
【短文】Public Transit Update: The city has been testing electric buses on route 42. However, the battery capacity is rumored to have fallen short of initial projections. The manufacturer must have overestimated the mileage under heavy air conditioning use.
Q: What is the problem with the new buses?
options: A. They are too noisy.
B. They are too small.
C. Their batteries drain faster than expected.
D. Their air conditioners are broken.
normal.explain: 短文中指出電池容量「fallen short of initial projections (不如預期)」，代表電力消耗比預期的更快。

normal.desc: 【時態】Health inspectors ___ local restaurants continuously to ensure proper sanitation standards are met.
options: A. patrol
B. are patrolling
C. patrolled
D. have been patrolling
normal.explain: continuously 暗示動作從過去一直持續到現在，因此選現在完成進行式最能表達「持續不斷巡查」的語意。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The contaminated batch of frozen vegetables is ordered ___ from all retail stores nationwide immediately.
options: A. to be withdrawn
B. to withdraw
C. withdrawing
D. withdrawn
normal.explain: 蔬菜是「被撤下」，在 is ordered 之後應接被動的不定詞 to be withdrawn。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】Several consumers reported food poisoning; the restaurant ___ cross-contamination in the kitchen yesterday.
options: A. must allow
B. must have allowed
C. allowed
D. has allowed
normal.explain: 句末有 yesterday，推論昨天廚房裡「一定允許/發生了」交叉污染，用 must have + V-p.p.。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Why is the dairy aisle empty?
B: The supermarket chain ___ a massive recall on all milk products since this morning.
options: A. execute
B. is executing
C. has been executing
D. executes
normal.explain: since this morning 表示動作從早上持續到說話的當下，需用現在完成進行式。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The viral outbreak is strongly suspected ___ by imported seafood that bypassed border checks last week.
options: A. to be caused
B. causing
C. causes
D. to have been caused
normal.explain: 疾病爆發被強烈懷疑是上週的海鮮「所引起的」。時間發生在過去且是被動，需用完成式被動不定詞 to have been caused。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】You bought that expired meat on clearance? You ___ the label closely enough before paying.
options: A. must not have read
B. should read
C. must read
D. did not read
normal.explain: 對過去事實的強烈否定推測，「當時你一定沒有仔細看標籤」，使用 must not have + V-p.p.。

normal.desc:
【短文】News Report: The agricultural department has been tracking a new strain of bacteria in poultry farms. The infection is believed to have spread through contaminated feed. Farm owners must have skipped the mandatory sterilization procedures during the busy holiday season.
Q: How did the bacteria likely spread?
options: A. Through the air
B. Through polluted food sources
C. Through human contact
D. Through wild birds
normal.explain: 短文中提到「spread through contaminated feed (受到污染的飼料)」，因此與 polluted food sources 意思相符。

normal.desc:
【短文】Press Release: The beverage company has been recalling thousands of glass bottles. A manufacturing flaw is confirmed to have caused the glass to shatter easily. Consumers must have experienced injuries while opening the caps.
Q: What hazard is associated with the bottles?
options: A. Toxic ingredients
B. Expired contents
C. Breakable packaging
D. Leaking caps
normal.explain: 短文中提到「caused the glass to shatter easily (導致玻璃容易碎裂)」，因此危險在於易碎的包裝 (Breakable packaging)。

normal.desc: 【時態】Ethicists ___ the potential biases in machine learning algorithms for years without finding a perfect solution.
options: A. scrutinize
B. are scrutinizing
C. will scrutinize
D. have been scrutinizing
normal.explain: for years 點出持續多年的動作，並強調一直進行到現在的狀態，因此使用現在完成進行式。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The autonomous driving software is alleged ___ several traffic accidents due to sensor failure last month.
options: A. to have triggered
B. to trigger
C. triggering
D. to be triggered
normal.explain: 軟體被宣稱在「上個月」引發了事故。引發是主動動作且發生在過去，故用完成式不定詞 to have triggered。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The facial recognition system misidentified the suspect; its training data ___ diversity.
options: A. is lacking
B. must have lacked
C. lacks
D. will lack
normal.explain: 系統誤認了嫌犯（過去式），所以推測「當時的訓練資料一定缺乏多樣性」，選 must have + V-p.p.。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Is the new AI tool replacing human writers?
B: Critics ___ about that possibility, but creativity remains uniquely human.
options: A. warn
B. are warned
C. have been warning
D. will warn
normal.explain: 雖然沒有時間副詞，但語意上強調評論家「近期以來一直在警告」這件事，故用現在完成進行式最自然。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The new privacy legislation is widely acknowledged ___ tech companies to rewrite their data collection policies.
options: A. compel
B. compelling
C. to be compelled
D. to have compelled
normal.explain: 法規被廣泛承認「已經迫使」科技公司重寫政策。迫使是主動動作且已經發生，故接 to have compelled。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The chatbot generated highly offensive remarks. The developers ___ adequate content filters before the official launch.
options: A. must have omitted
B. omit
C. must omit
D. omitted
normal.explain: 因為機器人已經產生了冒犯言論，推斷開發者在發布前「一定遺漏了」過濾器。對過去事實的推測需用 must have + V-p.p.。

normal.desc:
【短文】Tech Commentary: Scholars have been questioning the transparency of AI decision-making. The algorithm is known to have favored resumes with specific keywords, creating an unfair advantage. The programmers must have trained the model on historically biased hiring records.
Q: Why did the algorithm favor certain resumes?
options: A. Because it was too slow
B. Because of the flawed historical data it learned from
C. Because the candidates paid money
D. Because it randomly selected them
normal.explain: 短文中提到「trained the model on historically biased hiring records (用有歷史偏見的招募紀錄來訓練模型)」，故選 B。

normal.desc: 【時態】The marketing agency ___ social media influencers to boost the new beverage's visibility since June.
options: A. sponsors
B. is sponsored
C. has been sponsoring
D. sponsored
normal.explain: since June 明確指出動作從六月持續至今，故選現在完成進行式 has been sponsoring。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The controversial advertisement is considered ___ the brand's reputation among younger consumers.
options: A. to tarnish
B. tarnishing
C. tarnished
D. to have tarnished
normal.explain: 這則廣告被認為「已經玷污了」品牌聲譽，破壞的動作已經發生，因此用 to have tarnished。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The pop-up store sold out of merchandise in two hours; the promotional campaign ___ highly successful.
options: A. must have been
B. must be
C. is
D. will be
normal.explain: 兩小時內就賣完是過去的事實，因此推測當時的宣傳活動「一定非常成功」，使用 must have + V-p.p.。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Why did they change the logo again?
B: The design team ___ the visual identity to appeal to a global audience.
options: A. revamp
B. has been revamping
C. is revamped
D. revamps
normal.explain: 對話表達設計團隊「一直以來都在進行」視覺形象的改造，用現在完成進行式最符合語氣。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The viral marketing stunt is estimated ___ over ten million impressions within the first 24 hours of its release.
options: A. generating
B. to generate
C. to have generated
D. generated
normal.explain: 這個行銷噱頭被估計「已經產生了」超過一千萬次曝光，動作已完成，故搭配 to have generated。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The competitor completely copied our promotional tactics. Someone internally ___ the campaign blueprint.
options: A. leaks
B. is leaking
C. to leak
D. must have leaked
normal.explain: 因為對手完全抄襲了，所以推測內部「一定有人洩漏了」企劃藍圖，使用 must have + V-p.p.。

normal.desc:
【短文】Case Study: The sportswear company has been struggling to connect with Gen Z buyers. Their recent partnership with e-sports athletes is reported to have revitalized their market share. The marketing director must have recognized the immense purchasing power of the gaming community.
Q: What action helped the company regain its market share?
options: A. Sponsoring gamers
B. Lowering prices
C. Changing the logo
D. Closing stores
normal.explain: 短文中提及「partnership with e-sports athletes (與電競選手合作)」，即指贊助遊戲玩家 (Sponsoring gamers)。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：投資組合
normal.explain: 口說表達「PORTFOLIO」(n.)：投資組合。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：股息
normal.explain: 口說表達「DIVIDEND」(n.)：股息。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：提款
normal.explain: 口說表達「WITHDRAWAL」(n.)：提款。例句：I made a withdrawal from my savings account.（我從儲蓄帳戶提款。）

C. have been assessing
D. will assess
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：句尾有 since 加上過去時間點，表示從過去一直持續到現在的動作，且強調持續性，應使用現在完成進行式 (have been V-ing)。選項 C 正確。A 為現在簡單式，B 為現在進行式，D 為未來式，皆不符合時間標記。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The unprecedented revenue growth is projected ___ by a new digital infrastructure.
options: A. to drive
B. to be driven
C. driving
D. to have driven
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：project (預計) 後方接不定詞 to V，而營收成長是「被」數位基礎設施所驅動，因此需要用不定詞的被動語態 to be p.p.。選項 B 正確。A 是主動，C 是動名詞，D 是主動的完成式，皆不合語意。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】We secured the dominant market share. Our competitors ___ our aggressive expansion plan.
options: A. should dismiss
B. must have dismissed
C. can dismiss
D. ought to dismiss
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：前句提到「我們取得了主導市佔率（已發生的事實）」，後句推測對手過去一定做錯了什麼決定，表示對過去事實的強烈推測用 must have + p.p.。選項 B (一定忽視了) 正確。A 和 D 表示「應該忽視(但沒做)」，C 為現在的能力或許可，皆不合理。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The CEO highlighted the company's ___ in navigating the unpredictable supply chain disruptions.
options: A. resilience
B. transparency
C. aesthetics
D. interpretation
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：resilience 意思是「韌性、適應力」，符合句意「CEO 強調公司在應對不可預測的供應鏈中斷時所展現的韌性」。B 為透明度，C 為美學，D 為解釋，皆不符合語境。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Did the shareholders approve the dividend payout?
B: Yes, a generous dividend is confirmed ___ to all investors next month.
options: A. to distribute
B. distributing
C. to be distributed
D. distributed
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：confirm 後方如接動作，常見為 is confirmed to V (被確認將會...)。股息 (dividend) 是「被分配」給投資人，所以要用被動語態 to be distributed。選項 C 正確。

normal.desc:
【短文】Shareholder Letter: We have been expanding our footprint in emerging markets. This strategic ___ is anticipated to yield substantial returns by 2028. Management must have foreseen the stagnation in domestic sales.
Q: Which word fits the blank best?
options: A. disruption
B. limitation
C. diversification
D. stagnation
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：短文提到公司一直在新興市場擴張版圖，這種「多元化/分散投資 (diversification)」預計將帶來回報。A 是中斷，B 是限制，D 是停滯，皆與擴張版圖的正面策略不符。

normal.desc:
【短文】Shareholder Letter: Our operational costs are reported to have spiked last quarter. The sudden surge in raw material prices must have caught the procurement team off guard. We have been restructuring the supplier contracts to mitigate this issue.
Q: What is the main cause of the increased costs?
options: A. The restructuring of supplier contracts
B. The drop in product quality
C. The sudden rise in raw material prices
D. The hiring of a new procurement team
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中提到「The sudden surge in raw material prices must have caught the procurement team off guard. (原物料價格突然飆升一定讓採購團隊措手不及)」，這正是營運成本飆升 (spiked) 的主因。選項 C 符合文章內容。

normal.desc: 【字彙】To ensure long-term stability, we plan to ___ our surplus capital into renewable energy ventures.
options: A. hinder
B. taint
C. channel
D. suppress
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：channel 在此作動詞，意為「引導、投入（資金等）」。句意為「我們計畫將剩餘資金投入再生能源事業」。A 為阻礙，B 為污染，D 為壓制，皆不符合語意。

normal.desc: 【時態】Astronomers ___ the irregular orbit of the newly discovered exoplanet for several months.
options: A. have been tracking
B. has tracked
C. track
D. are tracking
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：時間標記為 for several months，表示從過去持續到現在的動作，主詞 Astronomers 為複數，故選 have been tracking (現在完成進行式)。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The sudden mass extinction event is hypothesized ___ by a series of massive volcanic eruptions millions of years ago.
options: A. to trigger
B. to be triggering
C. to have been triggered
D. triggering
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：事件是「被」引發，故需用被動語態。又因為引發的動作發生在數百萬年前，比 is hypothesized (現在被假設) 更早發生，因此要用完成式的被動 to have been p.p.。選項 C 正確。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The fossil was found in a deep marine rock layer. The creature ___ in a shallow sea environment.
options: A. must not dwell
B. cannot have dwelled
C. should have dwelled
D. might dwell
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：化石是在「深海」岩層中發現的，因此推測該生物「不可能」棲息在淺海環境。對過去事實的強烈否定推測用 cannot (can't) have + p.p.。B 正確。A 是現在禁止，C 是過去應該做卻沒做，D 是現在或未來的弱推測。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The ability of certain bacteria to survive extreme radiation remains an intriguing ___ to modern biologists.
options: A. transparency
B. consolidation
C. enigma
D. motive
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：enigma 意指「謎、難以理解的事物」。句意為「某些細菌在極端輻射下存活的能力，對現代生物學家來說仍是個有趣的謎」。A 為透明度，B 為鞏固，D 為動機。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Why are they studying these deep-sea vents?
B: The unique ecosystem there is thought ___ crucial clues about the origins of life on Earth.
options: A. to hold
B. to be held
C. holding
D. to have been held
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：is thought 後方接 to V。深海熱泉的生態系統「主動擁有/包含 (hold)」了生命起源的線索，所以用主動語態 to hold 即可，不需被動。選項 A 正確。

normal.desc:
【短文】Cosmos Today: The rover has been drilling into the Martian surface to collect soil samples. Traces of ancient organic molecules are confirmed to have been detected in the latest batch. The planet must have harbored liquid water at some point in its history.
Q: What does the detection of organic molecules suggest?
options: A. The rover needs maintenance
B. The planet likely had liquid water in the past
C. The drilling process is complete
D. The soil samples are contaminated
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：短文最後一句指出「The planet must have harbored liquid water at some point in its history. (該行星歷史上某個時期一定曾擁有液態水)」，這是基於偵測到有機分子所作出的推論。選項 B 符合。

normal.desc: 【時態】The research institute ___ funding for its controversial cloning project since the ethical debate intensified.
options: A. has been losing
B. are losing
C. is lost
D. to lose
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：since 連接過去時間 (倫理辯論加劇之時)，主要子句應使用現在完成進行式表示動作持續至今。主詞為單數，故選 has been losing。

normal.desc: 【時態】Concerned citizens ___ outside the city hall to protest the proposed zoning laws for three consecutive days.
options: A. rally
B. are rallying
C. have been rallying
D. rallied
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：有 for three consecutive days (連續三天) 的時間區段，表示動作從過去持續到現在，應選現在完成進行式 have been rallying。A 為現在簡單式，B 為現在進行式，D 為過去簡單式。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The historic library in the town center is expected ___ into a commercial complex next year.
options: A. to transform
B. to be transformed
C. transforming
D. to have transformed
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：圖書館是「被改建」成商業綜合體，且預期發生在明年 (next year)，is expected 後接不定詞，故選擇 to be transformed (被動)。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The mayor approved the demolition of the park. He ___ the immense historical value of that green space.
options: A. must have disregarded
B. should disregard
C. can disregard
D. will disregard
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：市長已經批准了拆除案 (過去式 approved)，所以我們推論他當時「一定忽視了」那片綠地的歷史價值。對過去事實的肯定推測用 must have + p.p.。選項 A 正確。

normal.desc: 【字彙】It is utterly ___ that the municipal council decided to cut funding for public transportation while increasing parking fees.
options: A. immersive
B. preposterous
C. evocative
D. retrospective
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：preposterous 意為「荒謬的、乖戾的」。句意為「市議會決定削減大眾運輸資金，同時卻提高停車費，這絕對是荒謬的」。A 為沉浸式，C 為喚起情感的，D 為回顧的。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Did you read the editorial about the new stadium?
B: Yes, the construction costs are reported ___ the initial budget by millions of dollars.
options: A. to exceed
B. to have exceeded
C. exceeding
D. exceeded
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：are reported 後接 to V，但因為「超出預算」是已經發生的事實，比「被報導」(現在) 更早發生，因此要用完成不定詞 to have exceeded。主動語態即可，因為花費主動超出預算。

normal.desc:
【短文】Letter to the Editor: I have been living in this neighborhood for two decades. The recent surge in property taxes is alleged to have driven many long-term residents away. The local government must have forgotten that working-class families are the backbone of this community.
Q: What is the writer's main complaint?
options: A. Working-class families are causing traffic
B. The neighborhood has become too noisy
C. High property taxes are forcing long-term residents to move
D. The local government is building new houses
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：投書中提到「The recent surge in property taxes is alleged to have driven many long-term residents away (近期財產稅的飆升據稱已逼走許多長期居民)」，這是作者的主要抱怨。選項 C 符合。

normal.desc:
【短文】Reader's Voice: The sanitation department has been neglecting the waste collection schedule in the eastern district. The overflowing bins are widely recognized to be a severe public health hazard. The authorities must have diverted their resources to the wealthier neighborhoods.
Q: What does the writer suspect the authorities did?
options: A. They hired more sanitation workers
B. They redirected their resources to richer areas
C. They bought new waste bins
D. They increased the budget for the eastern district
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：作者寫道「The authorities must have diverted their resources to the wealthier neighborhoods (當局一定把資源轉移到較富裕的街區了)」。選項 B (redirected their resources to richer areas) 是 divert 的同義表達。

normal.desc: 【字彙】As a taxpayer, I demand greater ___ regarding how the infrastructure funds are being spent by the city council.
options: A. transparency
B. plumage
C. motive
D. exoplanet
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：transparency 意為「透明度」。句意：「作為納稅人，我要求市議會在如何花費基礎設施資金方面要有更高的透明度」。B 為羽毛，C 為動機，D 為系外行星。

normal.desc: 【時態】Legal experts ___ the implications of this landmark Supreme Court decision since it was announced yesterday morning.
options: A. are scrutinizing
B. have been scrutinizing
C. scrutinize
D. will scrutinize
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：句子有 since + 過去時間點，表示動作從過去持續到現在，應使用現在完成進行式。選項 B 正確。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The multinational corporation is ruled ___ antitrust laws by monopolizing the software distribution market.
options: A. to have violated
B. to be violated
C. violating
D. to violate
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：法庭裁決 (is ruled) 是現在式，但公司「違反」反托拉斯法是過去已發生的動作，所以用完成不定詞 to have violated。因為公司是主動違反法律，不需被動。選項 A 正確。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The defendant fled the country hours before the verdict. He ___ a tip-off from someone inside the courthouse.
options: A. will obtain
B. must have obtained
C. should obtain
D. could obtain
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：被告在判決前幾個小時逃離國家，所以推論他過去「一定已經獲得」了內部消息。對過去的強烈推測用 must have + p.p.。選項 B 正確。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The judge dismissed the case because the evidence presented by the prosecution was entirely ___ and lacked a solid factual basis.
options: A. circumstantial
B. immersive
C. resilient
D. transparent
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：circumstantial 意思是「依據情況的、間接的 (證據)」。circumstantial evidence 意指間接證據。句意為證據全是間接的且缺乏堅實的事實基礎，故法官駁回案件。B 沉浸式，C 有韌性的，D 透明的。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Why did the appellate court overturn the previous ruling?
B: The original trial is found ___ tainted by severe jury tampering.
options: A. to be
B. being
C. to have been
D. having been
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：is found 後接 to V。「原審被發現遭到陪審團干擾而受污染」，原審是過去的事，比 is found (現在) 更早發生，因此用 to have been p.p. (完成不定詞的被動形式)。選項 C 正確。

normal.desc:
【短文】Legal Times: The pharmaceutical company has been facing a massive class-action lawsuit. Their flagship painkiller is proven to have caused severe cardiac side effects. The executives must have suppressed the clinical trial data to secure FDA approval.
Q: What did the executives allegedly do?
options: A. They recalled the painkiller
B. They hid negative medical data from the trials
C. They increased the price of the drug
D. They sued the FDA
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中提到 executives (高管) must have suppressed the clinical trial data (一定壓下了臨床試驗數據)。suppress 意指隱瞞、壓制。選項 B (hid negative medical data) 為同義改寫，故正確。

normal.desc:
【短文】Court News Daily: The celebrity chef has been battling copyright infringement claims over his bestselling cookbook. Several recipes are deemed to have been blatantly plagiarized from a lesser-known blogger. The chef's legal team must have advised him to settle out of court to avoid further embarrassment.
Q: What is the celebrity chef accused of?
options: A. Using expired ingredients
B. Insulting a lesser-known blogger
C. Stealing recipes from someone else
D. Publishing his cookbook too late
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：短文指出「Several recipes are deemed to have been blatantly plagiarized (多個食譜被認為是公然抄襲)」，因此名廚被控訴的是竊取他人的食譜 (Stealing recipes)。選項 C 正確。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The defense attorney argued that his client had no ___ to commit the crime, as he stood to gain nothing from it.
options: A. interpretation
B. motive
C. retrospective
D. consolidation
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：motive 意思是「動機」。句意：「辯護律師主張他的委託人沒有犯罪動機，因為他無法從中獲利」。A 為解釋，C 為回顧，D 為鞏固。

normal.desc: 【時態】Art critics ___ the controversial installation piece since the gallery opened last Thursday.
options: A. have been praising
B. are praising
C. praised
D. praise
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：句尾的 since 加上過去時間點 (last Thursday) 是現在完成式或現在完成進行式的標誌。選項 A 符合，表示從上週四開始持續讚賞到現在。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The Renaissance masterpiece is rumored ___ to the national museum by an anonymous billionaire.
options: A. to donate
B. to be donating
C. to have been donated
D. to have donated
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：畫作是「被」捐贈，且由上下文得知捐贈動作應已發生，因此在 is rumored (被謠傳) 後方使用完成式被動 to have been donated。選項 C 正確。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The lighting in the exhibition hall is perfectly designed. The curator ___ a lot of time arranging the spotlights.
options: A. must invest
B. must have invested
C. should invest
D. might invest
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：展廳的燈光設計很完美 (現在的事實)，推論館長過去「一定投入了」許多時間。對過去的肯定推測用 must have + p.p.。選項 B 正確。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The contemporary sculpture exhibition offers a deeply ___ look into the devastating effects of climate change.
options: A. evocative
B. circumstantial
C. preposterous
D. controversial
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：evocative 意思是「喚起(情感/記憶)的、引起共鳴的」。句意為該展覽對氣候變遷的破壞性影響提供了深刻且發人深省/引起共鳴的視角。B 間接的，C 荒謬的，D 具爭議的 (此處理論上也可，但 evocative 更符合藝術評論的語境與 deeply 搭配)。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Did you see the new photography exhibit?
B: Yes, the vintage portraits are considered ___ the essence of post-war society beautifully.
options: A. to be captured
B. to capture
C. capturing
D. having captured
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：are considered 後方接 to V。肖像畫「捕捉」(capture) 社會本質是主動的動作，用 to capture 即可。選項 B 正確。

normal.desc:
【短文】Art Today: The local museum has been hosting a retrospective of the late painter's work. The early sketches are believed to have been heavily influenced by Japanese woodblock prints. The artist must have studied abroad during his formative years.
Q: What influenced the painter's early sketches?
options: A. The local museum
B. Japanese woodblock prints
C. His later paintings
D. European sculptures
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中提到「The early sketches are believed to have been heavily influenced by Japanese woodblock prints (早期素描被認為深受日本木版畫影響)」。選項 B 完全符合。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The exhibition successfully blends interactive media with traditional ___ to create a unique sensory experience.
options: A. aesthetics
B. consolidation
C. motives
D. exoplanets
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：aesthetics 意為「美學、審美觀」。句意為「展覽成功將互動媒體與傳統美學結合，創造獨特的感官體驗」。其他選項皆與藝術展覽語境不符。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：設施
normal.explain: 口說表達「AMENITY」(n.)：設施。例句：The hotel offers excellent amenities for business travelers.（這家飯店為商務旅客提供優質的設施。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：無法接受的
normal.explain: 口說表達「UNACCEPTABLE」(adj.)：無法接受的。例句：They declared that the sudden delay had been completely unacceptable.（他們宣稱那次突然的延誤是完全無法接受的。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：補償
normal.explain: 口說表達「COMPENSATE」(v.)：補償。例句：The company promised they would compensate us for the massive loss.（公司承諾他們會為這巨大的損失補償我們。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：延期
normal.explain: 口說表達「EXTENSION」(n.)：延期。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：替代
normal.explain: 口說表達「SUBSTITUTE」(n.)：替代。例句：She said they had found a substitute for the missing ingredient.（她說他們已經找到了缺少食材的替代品。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：變通方法
normal.explain: 口說表達「WORKAROUND」(n.)：變通方法。例句：The IT team provided a temporary workaround for the software bug.（IT團隊針對軟體漏洞提供了一個暫時的變通方法。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：認識的
normal.explain: 口說表達「ACQUAINTED」(adj.)：認識的。例句：I'm not fully acquainted with the new regulations yet.（我對新規定還不是很熟悉。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：交際
normal.explain: 口說表達「MINGLE」(v.)：交際。例句：The CEO encouraged everyone to mingle during the reception.（執行長鼓勵大家在招待會上互相交際。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：無瑕的
normal.explain: 口說表達「FLAWLESS」(adj.)：無瑕的。例句：The presentation went smoothly and was absolutely flawless.（簡報進行得很順利，絕對是完美無瑕的。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：離譜的
normal.explain: 口說表達「OUTRAGEOUS」(adj.)：離譜的。例句：The prices at that hotel minibar are completely outrageous.（那家飯店迷你吧的價格簡直離譜。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：補救
normal.explain: 口說表達「REMEDY」(n.)：補救。例句：We must find a remedy for this ongoing issue immediately.（我們必須立即找到補救這個持續存在問題的方法。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：重新安置
normal.explain: 口說表達「RELOCATE」(v.)：重新安置。例句：The company plans to relocate its headquarters to Tokyo.（公司計畫將總部搬遷至東京。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：無意中聽到
normal.explain: 口說表達「OVERHEAR」(v.)：無意中聽到。例句：I did not mean to overhear your conversation.（我不是故意聽到你們談話的。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：處理

normal.ans: IT MUST HAVE SLIPPED MY MIND
normal.speak: it must have slipped my mind

normal.desc: 請唸出：我們整個晚上都在交際
normal.ans: WE HAVE BEEN MINGLING ALL EVENING
normal.speak: we have been mingling all evening
normal.explain: 口說表達「WE HAVE BEEN MINGLING ALL EVENING」(phr.)：我們整個晚上都在交際。

normal.desc: 請唸出：客人們正在被重新安置
normal.explain: 口說表達「THE GUESTS ARE BEING RELOCATED」(phr.)：客人們正在被重新安置。

normal.desc: 請唸出：正在為您提出補償方案
normal.ans: COMPENSATION IS BEING PROPOSED FOR YOU
normal.speak: compensation is being proposed for you
normal.explain: 口說表達「COMPENSATION IS BEING PROPOSED FOR YOU」(phr.)：正在為您提出補償方案。

normal.desc: 請拼出：修訂；修改
normal.explain: REVISION (n.)：修訂；修改。例句：Extensive revisions are currently being made to the project proposal.（專案企劃書目前正進行大幅的修訂。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：能力；勝任
normal.explain: COMPETENCE (n.)：能有效完成任務的能力。例句：The assessment focuses on practical competence.（評量著重實際能力。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：適應力強的
normal.explain: ADAPTABLE (adj.)：適應力強的。例句：The new team members have been proving themselves to be highly adaptable.（新團隊成員一直證明自己適應力極強。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：接近；鄰近
normal.explain: PROXIMITY (n.)：接近；鄰近。例句：The hotel must have been chosen for its close proximity to the airport.（選擇這家飯店一定是因為它非常鄰近機場。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：設施；便利設施
normal.explain: AMENITY (n.)：設施。例句：The hotel offers excellent amenities for business travelers.（這家飯店為商務旅客提供優質的設施。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：結果；後果
normal.explain: CONSEQUENCE (n.)：後果。例句：He didn't consider the consequences of his actions.（他沒有考慮他行為的後果。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：資歷；憑證
normal.explain: CREDENTIAL (n.)：資歷；憑證。例句：She must have submitted her credentials already, as the interview is tomorrow.（她一定已經提交了資歷證明，因為明天就要面試了。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：背書；贊同
normal.explain: ENDORSEMENT (n.)：背書；贊同。例句：The proposal must have received the CEO's endorsement before being implemented.（這個提案在實施前一定已經獲得了執行長的背書。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：有禮貌的
normal.explain: COURTEOUS (adj.)：以尊重他人的方式有禮貌的。例句：The reply was brief but courteous.（回覆簡短但有禮。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：有說服力的
normal.explain: PERSUASIVE (adj.)：有說服力的。例句：He gave a very persuasive presentation to the clients.（他向客戶做了一次非常有說服力的簡報。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：清楚表達
normal.explain: ARTICULATE (v.)：明確表達原本隱含的想法或要求。例句：The author should articulate the missing condition.（作者應明說遺漏條件。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：綜合；合成
normal.explain: SYNTHESIZE (v.)：綜合；合成。例句：He must have synthesized data from various sources to write this conclusion.（他一定綜合了來自各種來源的數據才寫出這個結論。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：果斷的；自信的
normal.explain: ASSERTIVE (adj.)：有自信且不具攻擊性地表達立場的。例句：Her response was assertive without being rude.（她的回應有主見，卻不失禮。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：外交的；圓滑的
normal.explain: DIPLOMATIC (adj.)：外交的；圓滑的。例句：The sensitive issue is being handled in a diplomatic manner.（這個敏感問題正在以外交的、圓滑的方式處理中。）

normal.desc: 填空題：C R _ D E N T I A L (資歷；憑證)
normal.explain: CREDENTIAL (n.)：資歷；憑證。填空答案為「E」。例句：She must have submitted her credentials already, as the interview is tomorrow.（她一定已經提交了資歷證明，因為明天就要面試了。）

normal.explain: EVALUATE (n.)：評估。填空答案為「A」。

normal.desc: 填空題：V I _ B L E (可行的)

normal.explain: CONSENSUS (n.)：共識。填空答案為「S」。例句：Consensus emerged after the options were compared.（比較選項後形成了共識。）

normal.desc: 填空題：C O U R T E O U _ (有禮貌的)

normal.explain: ARTICULATE (v.)：清楚表達。填空答案為「IE」。例句：The author should articulate the missing condition.（作者應明說遺漏條件。）

normal.explain: AMENITY (n.)：設施；便利設施。填空答案為「EY」。例句：The hotel offers excellent amenities for business travelers.（這家飯店為商務旅客提供優質的設施。）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The updated pension scheme is expected to be finalized soon.
options: A. 更新後的退休金計畫預計很快就會定案。
B. 新的健康保險方案已經被取消了。
C. 員工的培訓計畫需要花費很長的時間。
D. 公司的年度預算即將被大幅度削減。
normal.explain: 英文：The updated pension scheme is expected to be finalized soon. 意思：更新後的退休金計畫預計很快就會定案。pension 為退休金，is expected to be 為被動預期句型。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Eligible staff members have been receiving generous maternity benefits.
options: A. 所有員工都在要求更高的加班費。
B. 符合資格的員工一直有收到豐厚的產假福利。
C. 只有少數主管能享有公司的配股分紅。
D. 表現優異的團隊獲得了額外的旅遊津貼。
normal.explain: 英文：Eligible staff members have been receiving generous maternity benefits. 意思：符合資格的員工一直有收到豐厚的產假福利。eligible 為符合資格的，使用現在完成進行式。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The wellness program must have boosted overall staff morale.
options: A. 健康檢查的費用將由公司全額負擔。
B. 員工的流失率因為工作壓力而上升了。
C. 這項健康計畫一定提升了全體員工的士氣。
D. 健身房的設施需要進行全面的升級。
normal.explain: 英文：The wellness program must have boosted overall staff morale. 意思：這項健康計畫一定提升了全體員工的士氣。morale 為士氣，must have boosted 表示對過去的強烈推測。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Your travel costs are currently being evaluated by the finance division.
options: A. 財務部門已經駁回了你的出差申請。
B. 你的旅遊計畫需要經理的特別批准。
C. 我們的差旅預算在今年被大幅削減了。
D. 你的差旅費用目前正在由財務部門評估中。
normal.explain: 英文：Your travel costs are currently being evaluated by the finance division. 意思：你的差旅費用目前正在由財務部門評估中。are being evaluated 為現在進行被動語態。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: We have been reviewing the annual leave entitlements for all regional branches.
options: A. 我們一直在審查所有各地分公司的特休假資格。
B. 總公司已經決定取消所有地區的年度獎金。
C. 各分部的主管正在討論如何減少加班時數。
D. 我們已經完成了所有員工的年度績效考核。
normal.explain: 英文：We have been reviewing the annual leave entitlements for all regional branches. 意思：我們一直在審查所有各地分公司的特休假資格（權益）。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: He must have misunderstood the new overtime compensation policy.
options: A. 他已經清楚了解了最新的排班規定。
B. 他一定是誤解了新的加班補償政策。
C. 公司正在修改關於遲到早退的懲罰機制。
D. 大家都同意這項關於薪資調整的提議。
normal.explain: 英文：He must have misunderstood the new overtime compensation policy. 意思：他一定是誤解了新的加班補償政策。must have misunderstood 表達對過去事件的推測。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The medical insurance premiums are going to be subsidized by the firm, right?
options: A. Yes, the hospital is located downtown.
B. No, the prescription is not ready yet.
C. Yes, they will cover sixty percent of the cost.
D. I have been feeling quite sick lately.
normal.explain: 英文：The medical insurance premiums are going to be subsidized by the firm, right? 意思：醫療保險費用將由公司補助，對嗎？選項 C「對，他們會涵蓋 60% 的費用」最合理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The defective transmission component is being replaced right now.
options: A. 技師正在檢查引擎的漏油問題。
B. 煞車系統需要更換全新的零件。
C. 汽車的儀表板上出現了故障燈號。
D. 有缺陷的變速箱零件現在正在被更換。
normal.explain: 英文：The defective transmission component is being replaced right now. 意思：有缺陷的變速箱零件現在正在被更換。defective 為有缺陷的，is being replaced 為現在進行被動式。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The mechanic has been inspecting the vehicle's exhaust system.
options: A. 技師一直在檢查這輛車的排氣系統。
B. 汽車的冷氣系統已經完全損壞了。
C. 車主抱怨引擎發出奇怪的噪音。
D. 我們正在為您的愛車進行外觀打蠟。
normal.explain: 英文：The mechanic has been inspecting the vehicle's exhaust system. 意思：技師一直在檢查這輛車的排氣系統。exhaust 指排氣，have/has been V-ing 為現在完成進行式。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: You must have ignored the dashboard warning lights for a while.
options: A. 你的車燈在夜晚時常常會閃爍。
B. 你一定已經忽視儀表板上的警告燈好一陣子了。
C. 汽車電池的壽命已經快要耗盡了。
D. 你應該盡快去修理破損的擋風玻璃。
normal.explain: 英文：You must have ignored the dashboard warning lights for a while. 意思：你一定已經忽視儀表板上的警告燈好一陣子了。dashboard 為儀表板。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The estimated repair cost is projected to be significantly higher than expected.
options: A. 最終的帳單比我們一開始預估的還要便宜。
B. 技師保證這次的維修不需要花費太多時間。
C. 預估的維修費用預計會比預期的還要高出許多。
D. 這次的車輛保養涵蓋在原廠的免費服務中。
normal.explain: 英文：The estimated repair cost is projected to be significantly higher than expected. 意思：預估的維修費用預計會比預期的還要高出許多。is projected to be 為被動語態的預測句型。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: We have been struggling to locate the source of the engine malfunction.
options: A. 引擎的啟動聲音聽起來非常正常。
B. 我們已經成功修復了所有的內部零件。
C. 我們發現問題是因為使用了劣質的機油。
D. 我們一直很努力在找出引擎故障的來源。
normal.explain: 英文：We have been struggling to locate the source of the engine malfunction. 意思：我們一直很努力在找出引擎故障的來源。malfunction 指故障。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The previous owner must have neglected the routine maintenance timeline.
options: A. 前任車主一定是疏忽了例行的保養時程。
B. 這台二手車的車況維持得非常完美。
C. 買家希望能看到過去所有的維修紀錄。
D. 汽車的保固期已經在兩個月前失效了。
normal.explain: 英文：The previous owner must have neglected the routine maintenance timeline. 意思：前任車主一定是疏忽了例行的保養時程。neglect 為疏忽。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: How long has this strange vibration been occurring while you drive?
options: A. I prefer to drive an automatic car.
B. Since I hit that deep pothole yesterday.
C. The traffic was extremely heavy this morning.
D. You should turn off the radio first.
normal.explain: 英文：How long has this strange vibration been occurring while you drive? 意思：你開車時出現這種奇怪的震動有多久了？回答 B「自從我昨天撞到那個深坑洞之後」最符合邏輯。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The protagonist of your new novel is said to be based on a real person.
options: A. 這本書的情節被認為過於曲折離奇。
B. 小說的背景設定在一個虛構的城市。
C. 據說你新小說的主角是根據真實人物改編的。
D. 讀者們非常喜歡這部作品的反派角色。
normal.explain: 英文：The protagonist of your new novel is said to be based on a real person. 意思：據說你新小說的主角是根據真實人物改編的。protagonist 為主角，is said to be 為複雜被動語態。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: I have been analyzing the compelling narrative structure of this book.
options: A. 我正在準備撰寫一篇關於文學的負面評論。

normal.explain: 英文：I have been analyzing the compelling narrative structure of this book. 意思：我一直在分析這本書引人入勝的敘事結構。compelling 形容極具吸引力的。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The original manuscript must have been edited heavily before publication.
options: A. 最初的手稿在出版前一定被大幅修改過。

D. 出版社遺失了這本書最重要的幾個章節。
normal.explain: 英文：The original manuscript must have been edited heavily before publication. 意思：最初的手稿在出版前一定被大幅修改過。manuscript 為手稿。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: This particular anecdote is meant to be interpreted as a subtle warning.
options: A. 這首詩歌描述了作者對童年時光的回憶。

C. 廣播節目主要討論了當代社會的經濟問題。
D. 書中的插圖是為了吸引年輕讀者的目光。
normal.explain: 英文：This particular anecdote is meant to be interpreted as a subtle warning. 意思：這個特定的軼事用意在於被解讀為一種隱含的警告。is meant to be 表達「用意是...」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Fans have been eagerly anticipating the sequel to your fantasy trilogy.
options: A. 許多人批評這部科幻小說的邏輯漏洞。
B. 讀者們覺得這部奇幻作品的節奏太慢。
C. 粉絲們一直熱切期待你奇幻三部曲的續集。
D. 作者決定不再撰寫任何相關的延伸故事。
normal.explain: 英文：Fans have been eagerly anticipating the sequel to your fantasy trilogy. 意思：粉絲們一直熱切期待你奇幻三部曲的續集。have been anticipating 為現在完成進行式。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The critics must have misinterpreted the tragic ending of your story.
options: A. 書評家給予這本書極高的文學評價。
B. 讀者們非常喜歡這個充滿希望的結局。
C. 這本書的結局被公認為是作家的顛峰之作。
D. 評論家們一定是誤解了你故事中悲慘的結局。
normal.explain: 英文：The critics must have misinterpreted the tragic ending of your story. 意思：評論家們一定是誤解了你故事中悲慘的結局。must have misinterpreted 為對過去動作的肯定推測。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Have you been incorporating more historical facts into your recent fiction?
options: A. Yes, intensive research has become a huge part of my process.
B. No, the radio station is broadcasting live right now.
C. I have always preferred watching documentaries on TV.
D. The bookstore will host a signing event tomorrow.
normal.explain: 英文：Have you been incorporating more historical facts into your recent fiction? 意思：你最近的小說裡有一直融入更多歷史史實嗎？回答 A「是的，密集的考究已經成為我寫作過程很大的一部分」最合適。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Prospective applicants are required to submit their academic transcripts.
options: A. 新進員工需要參加為期一週的職前訓練。
B. 有潛力的申請者（求職者）必須提交他們的在校成績單。
C. 所有面試者都必須穿著正式的商務服裝。
D. 公司鼓勵大學生來申請這個暑期實習計畫。
normal.explain: 英文：Prospective applicants are required to submit their academic transcripts. 意思：有潛力的申請者（求職者）必須提交他們的在校成績單。prospective 指潛在的、有希望的。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: We have been organizing placement tests for the upcoming graduating class.
options: A. 畢業典禮的場地布置已經全部完成了。
B. 教授們正在評分學生的期末專題報告。
C. 我們一直在為即將到來的畢業班籌辦分級（或分發）測驗。
D. 學校決定取消今年所有的企業參訪活動。
normal.explain: 英文：We have been organizing placement tests for the upcoming graduating class. 意思：我們一直在為即將到來的畢業班籌辦分級測驗。placement test 通常指分級或能力測驗。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: You must have exhibited exceptional leadership during the workshop.
options: A. 你在團隊合作中常常顯得過度強勢。
B. 我們希望你能帶領新團隊完成這個專案。
C. 研討會的講者分享了許多實用的管理技巧。
D. 你在工作坊期間一定展現了出色的領導能力。
normal.explain: 英文：You must have exhibited exceptional leadership during the workshop. 意思：你在工作坊期間一定展現了出色的領導能力。exhibit 指展現，must have exhibited 為對過去的推測。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The intensive training program is designed to be highly interactive.
options: A. 這個密集的培訓計畫被設計成具有高度互動性。
B. 線上課程的報名人數已經遠遠超過了預期。
C. 講師要求所有學員在上課時必須保持安靜。
D. 這份教材是專門為沒有經驗的新手編寫的。
normal.explain: 英文：The intensive training program is designed to be highly interactive. 意思：這個密集的培訓計畫被設計成具有高度互動性。is designed to be 為被動形式。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Our recruiters have been searching for individuals with strong analytical abilities.
options: A. 招募人員認為這次的應徵者缺乏實務經驗。
B. 我們的招募人員一直在尋找具備堅強分析能力的個人。
C. 公司正在縮減行銷部門的人事預算。
D. 這次校園徵才的重點是尋找有創意的設計師。
normal.explain: 英文：Our recruiters have been searching for individuals with strong analytical abilities. 意思：我們的招募人員一直在尋找具備堅強分析能力的個人。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The applicant must have fabricated some of the experiences listed on her profile.
options: A. 面試官對她的外語能力感到非常驚艷。
B. 她在履歷上列出的成就令人十分敬佩。
C. 這名求職者一定捏造了她個人檔案上列出的一些經歷。
D. 我們決定錄用她，因為她的背景非常吻合。
normal.explain: 英文：The applicant must have fabricated some of the experiences listed on her profile. 意思：這名求職者一定捏造了她個人檔案上列出的一些經歷。fabricate 為捏造。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: All initial screenings are slated to be conducted virtually this year.
options: A. The projection screen is broken in the meeting room.
B. I will get a new suit for the graduation party.
C. It is a relief that I don't have to travel far.
D. Have you watched that new movie at the cinema?
normal.explain: 英文：All initial screenings are slated to be conducted virtually this year. 意思：今年所有的初步篩選（面試）都預計在線上（虛擬）進行。回應 C「很欣慰我不用大老遠跑一趟」最合理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Have you been updating your profile to match the job requirements?
options: A. Yes, I am still putting the final touches on it.
B. No, the computer system is down today.
C. She has been working as a teacher for ten years.
D. The interview room is on the second floor.
normal.explain: 英文：Have you been updating your profile to match the job requirements? 意思：你有一直在更新你的個人檔案以符合工作要求嗎？回應 A「有，我還在做最後的潤飾」最合適。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The majestic cathedral is currently being restored by local artisans.
options: A. 當地的藝術家正在舉辦一場盛大的畫展。
B. 這座宏偉的大教堂目前正在由當地工匠修復中。
C. 遊客們被要求在進入寺廟時保持安靜。
D. 這個歷史悠久的廣場將被改建為購物中心。
normal.explain: 英文：The majestic cathedral is currently being restored by local artisans. 意思：這座宏偉的大教堂目前正在由當地工匠修復中。majestic 為宏偉的，is being restored 表現在進行被動。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: We have been admiring the picturesque scenery along the coastline.
options: A. 天氣預報說沿海地區今晚會有暴風雨。
B. 我們拍了很多關於野生動物的珍貴照片。
C. 我們一直很欣賞沿著海岸線如畫般美麗的風景。
D. 這個海灘因為嚴重的汙染已經被封閉了。
normal.explain: 英文：We have been admiring the picturesque scenery along the coastline. 意思：我們一直很欣賞沿著海岸線如畫般美麗的風景。picturesque 為如畫般美麗的。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The royal family must have fled the palace during the great uprising.
options: A. 國王在皇宮裡舉辦了一場非常豪華的宴會。
B. 皇室的珍貴珠寶在展覽期間被小偷偷走了。
C. 歷史學家對於這座城堡的建造年份有爭議。
D. 皇室家族在大起義期間一定是逃離了這座宮殿。
normal.explain: 英文：The royal family must have fled the palace during the great uprising. 意思：皇室家族在大起義期間一定是逃離了這座宮殿。must have fled 為逃離的推測語氣。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: This ancient sanctuary is considered to be one of the most sacred sites in the country.
options: A. 這個古老的聖所被認為是該國最神聖的地點之一。
B. 考古學家在遺跡中挖掘出大量古老的金幣。
C. 當地政府決定將這片廢墟列為國家級的保護區。
D. 導遊建議我們提早抵達以避開擁擠的人潮。
normal.explain: 英文：This ancient sanctuary is considered to be one of the most sacred sites in the country. 意思：這個古老的聖所被認為是該國最神聖的地點之一。sanctuary 為聖所，is considered to be 為複雜被動。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Historians have been piecing together the chronological events of that era.
options: A. 博物館的館長拒絕展出這批具有爭議的文物。
B. 歷史學家們一直試圖拼湊出那個時代按時間順序發生的事件。
C. 許多關於這個王朝的歷史文獻在戰火中被燒毀了。
D. 專家們對於這位傳奇將軍的死因依然沒有共識。
normal.explain: 英文：Historians have been piecing together the chronological events of that era. 意思：歷史學家們一直試圖拼湊出那個時代按時間順序發生的事件。chronological 為按時間順序的。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The hidden chamber must have remained undiscovered for centuries.
options: A. 這個地下墓穴的壁畫因為濕氣而嚴重受損。
B. 探險家們在洞穴深處發現了一條神秘的通道。
C. 這個隱藏的密室一定維持了幾個世紀都未被發現的狀態。
D. 導覽手冊上並沒有標示出這個景點的正確位置。
normal.explain: 英文：The hidden chamber must have remained undiscovered for centuries. 意思：這個隱藏的密室一定維持了幾個世紀都未被發現的狀態。must have remained 表達強烈推測。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The bronze statues are meant to commemorate the heroes of the revolution.
options: A. I will order a bronze medal for the winner.
B. They look incredible up close and hold so much meaning.
C. The revolution completely changed the tech industry.
D. Yes, the artist is still alive today.
normal.explain: 英文：The bronze statues are meant to commemorate the heroes of the revolution. 意思：這些銅像的用意是紀念革命英雄。回應 B「它們近看令人驚嘆，而且深具意義」最為適合。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Have you been following the audio guide's suggested walking route?
options: A. The music is a bit too loud for me.
B. I left my headphones at the hotel.
C. No, I prefer to wander around freely and explore.
D. The pedestrian crossing is just around the corner.
normal.explain: 英文：Have you been following the audio guide's suggested walking route? 意思：你有一直照著語音導覽建議的步行路線走嗎？回應 C「沒有，我偏好自由地漫步探索」最自然。

normal.desc: 【時態】The logistics team ___ alternative shipping routes for the past three weeks to avoid the port strike.
options: A. is exploring
B. has been exploring
C. explores
D. will explore
normal.explain: 本題測驗現在完成進行式，表示從過去持續到現在的動作（for the past three weeks）。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The sudden supply chain bottleneck is widely reported ___ by unexpected geopolitical tensions.
options: A. to have been caused
B. causing
C. to cause
D. causes
normal.explain: 測驗複雜被動語態「is reported to have been + V-en」，表示被報導過去發生的事。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】Our supplier missed the delivery deadline entirely; they ___ our urgent email last Friday.
options: A. should overlook
B. will overlook
C. can overlook
D. must have overlooked
normal.explain: 對過去事實的肯定推測，使用 must have + V-en。

normal.desc: 【字彙】To reduce costs, the manufacturer decided to ___ their customer service operations to a specialized firm.
options: A. outsource
B. surge
C. alleviate
D. venture
normal.explain: outsource 為外包。將業務交給專門公司以降低成本。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Why is the assembly line stopped?
B: The factory ___ extreme raw material shortages since the new tariff was announced.
options: A. experiences
B. was experiencing
C. has been experiencing
D. is experienced
normal.explain: 對話中提到 since，需使用現在完成進行式強調動作的持續性。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Did the regional manager approve the new contingency plan?
B: Yes, the proposed measures are expected ___ formally next Monday.
options: A. to be adopted
B. adopting
C. to adopt
D. adopted
normal.explain: are expected 後接 to V，而措施是被採用的，故用被動 to be adopted。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The unprecedented ___ in consumer demand is believed to have severely strained our delivery network.
options: A. bottleneck
B. surge
C. clause
D. heritage
normal.explain: surge 意為激增。消費者需求的激增對配送網路造成壓力。

normal.desc:
【短文】Supply Chain Brief: We have been seeking ways to mitigate the recent shipping delays. The global microchip shortage is acknowledged to have hindered our production goals. Management must have underestimated the long-term effects of the port closures.
Q: What is the main cause of the hindered production?
options: A. Poor management skills
B. Port closures
C. Global microchip shortage
D. Shipping delays
normal.explain: 短文中明確指出「The global microchip shortage is acknowledged to have hindered our production goals」。

normal.desc:
【短文】Industry Report: Analysts have been monitoring the sudden fluctuation in commodity prices. The erratic pricing is observed to have driven many small competitors out of business. Larger firms must have secured long-term contracts to survive the turmoil.
Q: How did larger firms likely survive according to the report?
options: A. By fluctuating prices
B. By securing long-term contracts
C. By driving out competitors
D. By monitoring the market
normal.explain: 文中提到「Larger firms must have secured long-term contracts to survive the turmoil」。

normal.desc: 【時態】Nutritionists ___ the effects of artificial sweeteners on our metabolism for the last decade.
options: A. have been studying
B. are studying
C. will study
D. studied
normal.explain: for the last decade 搭配現在完成進行式，表示持續至今的動作。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The new daily exercise guideline is considered ___ a significant milestone in preventive cardiology.
options: A. representing
B. to be represented
C. to represent
D. represents
normal.explain: is considered 後接 to V，代表「被認為代表了...」。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The patient's cholesterol levels dropped dramatically; he ___ strictly to the prescribed diet.
options: A. might adhere
B. must have adhered
C. can adhere
D. should adhere
normal.explain: 對過去事實的強烈推測，因為指數下降，推測他「一定有」遵守飲食規定。

normal.desc: 【字彙】A highly ___ lifestyle is strongly linked to an increased risk of cardiovascular diseases.
options: A. bustling
B. picturesque
C. scalable
D. sedentary
normal.explain: sedentary 意為久坐的。久坐的生活方式與心血管疾病風險有關。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Did the clinic send the trial results?
B: Yes, the experimental drug is proven ___ severe joint pain in elderly patients.
options: A. to have alleviated
B. to be alleviating
C. alleviated
D. alleviating
normal.explain: is proven 後接不定詞，表示對過去事實的證明用 to have + V-en。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: The control group reported feeling much better.
B: That's fascinating! They ___ the positive effects of the placebo.
options: A. will experience
B. must have experienced
C. are experiencing
D. experience
normal.explain: 對照組感覺變好，推測他們「一定經歷了」安慰劑效應（placebo）。

normal.desc:
【短文】Health Journal: Researchers have been tracking the cognitive functions of seniors. A lack of deep sleep is hypothesized to have accelerated memory loss in the subjects. The participants must have consumed excessive caffeine prior to bedtime, affecting their sleep cycles.
Q: What is suspected to accelerate memory loss?
options: A. Caffeine consumption
B. Cognitive functions
C. A lack of deep sleep
D. Sleep cycles
normal.explain: 短文中指明「A lack of deep sleep is hypothesized to have accelerated memory loss」。

normal.desc:
【短文】Medical News: The local hospital has been struggling with a sudden influx of patients. The community's poor sanitation is confirmed to have caused the bacterial outbreak. The health department must have ignored the early warning signs last month.
Q: What did the health department likely do?
options: A. Caused the bacterial outbreak
B. Ignored early warning signs
C. Struggled with patient influx
D. Improved community sanitation
normal.explain: 文中最後一句指出「must have ignored the early warning signs」。

normal.desc: 【時態】The property manager ___ the draft of the new lease agreement for the past few days.
options: A. modifies
B. is modifying
C. will modify
D. has been modifying
normal.explain: for the past few days 暗示動作持續進行，需用現在完成進行式。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The security deposit is strictly required ___ in full before the keys are handed over to the lessee.
options: A. to pay
B. to be paid
C. paying
D. paid
normal.explain: 押金「被支付」，require 後接不定詞的被動態 to be V-en。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】You brought a pet into the apartment? You ___ the strict no-pet policy in your contract.
options: A. must have misread
B. should misread
C. will misread
D. might be misreading
normal.explain: 已經把寵物帶進來了，推測對方「一定是看錯了」合約條款。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Both parties must sign the document in front of a witness to make it legally ___.
options: A. scalable
B. binding
C. bustling
D. sedentary
normal.explain: legally binding 意為具法律約束力的。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: What happens if I break the lease early?
B: According to the penalty ___, you will forfeit your entire security deposit.
options: A. clause
B. venture
C. heritage
D. surge
normal.explain: clause 指合約中的「條款」。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Are they still negotiating the rental terms?
B: Yes, the landlord ___ an extra background check on the prospective lessee since yesterday.
options: A. performs
B. has been performing
C. is performed
D. was performing
normal.explain: since yesterday 需搭配現在完成進行式。

normal.desc:
【短文】Legal Notice: We have been reviewing the commercial lease dispute. The lessee is alleged to have sublet the property without prior written consent. The original lessor must have failed to conduct routine inspections of the premises.
Q: What is the lessee accused of doing?
options: A. Conducting routine inspections
B. Subletting the property illegally
C. Reviewing the lease dispute
D. Failing to pay the deposit
normal.explain: 短文中指出承租人被指控「sublet the property without prior written consent」。

normal.desc:
【短文】Amendment Alert: The legal team has been drafting a new addendum regarding utility fees. The sudden increase in electricity rates is reported to have caught many tenants off guard. The building administration must have delayed the notification process.
Q: Why were the tenants caught off guard?
