normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: I have been experiencing a severe migraine since this morning.
options: A. You must have slept really well last night.
B. The doctor is being consulted right now.
C. You should have it checked; I can take notes for you.
D. Your headache must have been cured completely.
normal.explain: 原句：I have been experiencing a severe migraine since this morning.（我從今天早上就一直偏頭痛。）適合的回應是建議去看醫生，並表示可以幫忙做筆記。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: These chronic symptoms must have been alleviated by the new medication.
options: A. 這些慢性症狀一定是因為新藥而減輕了。
B. 新藥無法治癒這些慢性疾病。
C. 醫生強烈建議更換減輕痛苦的藥物。
D. 這些症狀一定是新藥所引起的副作用。
normal.explain: 原句：These chronic symptoms must have been alleviated by the new medication. 意思是「這些慢性症狀一定是被新藥給緩解了」。must have been alleviated 為情態動詞推測的被動語態。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: A customized nutrition plan is being formulated by our dietitians.
options: A. 我們的營養師正在制定專屬的營養計畫。
B. 營養師已經完成了所有的飲食評估。
C. 這個營養計畫即將被醫院強制推行。
D. 營養師一定是忘了制定飲食計畫。
normal.explain: 原句：A customized nutrition plan is being formulated by our dietitians. 意思是「我們的營養師正在制定一份客製化的營養計畫」。is being formulated 為現在進行式的被動語態。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: You must have misunderstood the recommended dosage on the prescription.
options: A. 你一定誤解了處方箋上的建議劑量。
B. 醫生一定開錯了藥物的劑量。
C. 這份處方箋的劑量正在被重新評估。
D. 你必須嚴格遵守處方箋上的用藥指示。
normal.explain: 原句：You must have misunderstood the recommended dosage on the prescription. 意思是「你一定誤解了處方箋上的建議劑量」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Why is the patient's metabolism rate still being monitored?
options: A. The monitoring equipment must have been turned off.
B. They have been trying to identify the underlying cause.
C. Metabolism is the chemical process in the body.
D. He must have eaten a large meal just now.
normal.explain: 原句：Why is the patient's metabolism rate still being monitored?（為什麼病患的新陳代謝率還在被監測？）回應「他們一直在試圖找出潛在原因 (They have been trying to identify...)」最合理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The lecture on holistic wellness has been going on for two hours.
options: A. 關於全人健康的講座已經進行了兩個小時。
B. 這場健康講座將在兩個小時後結束。
C. 講師一定是遲到了兩個小時。
D. 這場講座探討了兩個小時的醫學史。
normal.explain: 原句：The lecture on holistic wellness has been going on for two hours. 意思是「這場全人健康講座已經持續了兩個小時」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Our customer service hotline has been experiencing an unprecedented volume of calls.
options: A. 我們的客服專線一直面臨史無前例的龐大通話量。
B. 客服專線目前因為系統升級而無法使用。
C. 顧客一定對我們前所未有的服務感到滿意。
D. 我們已經關閉了客服專線以減少通話量。
normal.explain: 原句：Our customer service hotline has been experiencing an unprecedented volume of calls. 意思是「我們的客服專線一直面臨史無前例的龐大通話量」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The network outage must have been caused by the recent storm.
options: A. We have been waiting for the weather forecast.
B. The storm is expected to arrive tomorrow.
C. Yes, the technicians are restoring the connections now.
D. You must have caused the power failure.
normal.explain: 原句：The network outage must have been caused by the recent storm.（網路中斷一定是最近的暴風雨造成的。）回應「是的，技術人員現在正在恢復連線」最符合語境。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Your subscription is scheduled to be terminated at the end of the billing cycle.
options: A. 您的訂閱預計在計費週期結束時被終止。
B. 您必須在計費週期結束前繳清所有費用。
C. 您的合約已經在昨天被強制取消了。
D. 我們將延長您的訂閱直到下個計費週期。
normal.explain: 原句：Your subscription is scheduled to be terminated at the end of the billing cycle. 意思是「您的訂閱預計在計費週期結束時被終止」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The bandwidth allocation has been strictly regulated to prevent congestion.
options: A. 頻寬分配一直受到嚴格管制以防止網路擁塞。
B. 公司一定是為了省錢才限制頻寬使用。
C. 頻寬太小導致我們的網路持續塞車。
D. 我們正在放寬頻寬限制來提升速度。
normal.explain: 原句：The bandwidth allocation has been strictly regulated to prevent congestion. 意思是「頻寬分配一直受到嚴格管制以防止擁塞」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Have you been trying to reset the modem as instructed?
options: A. The instructions must have been lost in the mail.
B. Yes, but the error indicator is still blinking.
C. I will instruct him to buy a new modem.
D. The modem was successfully repaired last year.
normal.explain: 原句：Have you been trying to reset the modem as instructed?（你有一直照指示嘗試重設數據機嗎？）回應「有，但錯誤指示燈還是在閃爍」最符合情境。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The hidden fees must have been deducted from your account automatically.
options: A. 隱藏費用一定是被自動從你的帳戶中扣除了。
B. 系統錯誤導致你的帳戶被扣了兩次錢。
C. 你必須手動繳納這些隱藏的費用。
D. 我們已經把多扣的費用退還到你的帳戶。
normal.explain: 原句：The hidden fees must have been deducted from your account automatically. 意思是「隱藏費用一定是被自動從你的帳戶中扣除了」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: A new cellular tower is being constructed to enhance rural connectivity.
options: A. 正在建造一座新的基地台以加強偏鄉的連線品質。
B. 偏鄉的連線品質一定是因為新基地台而改善了。
C. 我們一直在尋找建造新基地台的最佳地點。
D. 舊的基地台已經被拆除，導致連線中斷。
normal.explain: 原句：A new cellular tower is being constructed to enhance rural connectivity. 意思是「正在建造一座新的行動通訊基地台，以加強鄉村地區的連線」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: I have been receiving promotional texts despite opting out.
options: A. You must have subscribed to our premium plan.
B. The promotional period has been extended.
C. I will ensure your number is removed from the database immediately.
D. The texts are being drafted by our marketing team.
normal.explain: 原句：I have been receiving promotional texts despite opting out.（儘管我已經選擇退出，我還是一直收到推銷簡訊。）客服最適合的回應是「我會確保您的號碼立刻從資料庫中移除」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The avant-garde aesthetic of this collection must have alienated some conservative buyers.
options: A. 這個系列前衛的美學一定疏遠了一些保守的買家。
B. 保守的買家一直非常欣賞這種前衛的設計。
C. 這種美學風格正在被主流市場廣泛接受。
D. 設計師必須為了保守買家改變他們的美學標準。
normal.explain: 原句：The avant-garde aesthetic of this collection must have alienated some conservative buyers. 意思是「這個系列前衛的美學一定疏遠（流失）了一些保守的買家」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Sustainable apparel is being prioritized by emerging fashion labels.
options: A. 永續服飾正被新興時尚品牌列為優先考量。
B. 新興時尚品牌一定放棄了傳統服飾的生產。
C. 顧客一直在尋找更便宜的環保服飾。
D. 這個品牌優先考慮降低服飾的製造成本。
normal.explain: 原句：Sustainable apparel is being prioritized by emerging fashion labels. 意思是「永續服飾正被新興時尚品牌列為優先考量」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The runway models have been rehearsing the choreography all afternoon.
options: A. They must be exhausted by now.
B. The runway was built securely yesterday.
C. I have been watching the fashion show.
D. The clothes are being manufactured quickly.
normal.explain: 原句：The runway models have been rehearsing the choreography all afternoon.（伸展台模特兒整個下午一直在排練走秀編排。）回應「她們現在一定很累了」最自然。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: We have been analyzing the shifts in consumer behavior towards versatile garments.
options: A. 我們一直在分析消費者對多功能服裝的行為轉變。
B. 消費者一定比較喜歡便宜且多功能的衣物。
C. 我們的分析報告即將被時尚雜誌刊登。
D. 多功能服裝正在被大規模地推廣到全球市場。
normal.explain: 原句：We have been analyzing the shifts in consumer behavior towards versatile garments. 意思是「我們一直在分析消費者行為朝向多功能服裝的轉變」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The renowned trendsetter must have worn that outfit to generate publicity.
options: A. 那位知名的潮流引領者穿那套衣服一定是要製造話題。
B. 我們必須請那位潮流引領者穿上這套服裝。
C. 那套服裝正被潮流引領者大力推薦。
D. 那位名人一直在設計引起大眾關注的衣服。
normal.explain: 原句：The renowned trendsetter must have worn that outfit to generate publicity. 意思是「那位知名的潮流引領者穿那套服裝一定是要製造知名度/話題」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Has the new luxury boutique been generating enough foot traffic?
options: A. The traffic jam must have delayed the opening.
B. The boutique is being relocated to a quieter street.
C. Surprisingly yes, they have been attracting a younger demographic.
D. You must have bought a lot of luxury goods.
normal.explain: 原句：Has the new luxury boutique been generating enough foot traffic?（這間新的奢華精品店有產生足夠的客流量嗎？）回應「令人驚訝的是，有，他們一直吸引著更年輕的客群」最合理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The vintage accessories are being showcased in the main exhibition hall.
options: A. 這些復古配件正被展示在主展覽廳裡。
B. 我們一直在主展覽廳尋找那些復古配件。
C. 復古配件一定是展覽中最受歡迎的項目。
D. 展覽廳裡必須展示所有最新的時尚單品。
normal.explain: 原句：The vintage accessories are being showcased in the main exhibition hall. 意思是「復古配件正被展示在主展覽廳中」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The proposed synergy between the two corporations has been heavily questioned by analysts.
options: A. 兩家公司提議的綜效一直受到分析師的強烈質疑。
B. 分析師一定高估了這兩家公司合併後的潛力。
C. 這兩家企業正在被分析師調查是否有不法行為。
D. 兩家公司一直試圖解答分析師提出的問題。
normal.explain: 原句：The proposed synergy between the two corporations has been heavily questioned by analysts. 意思是「這兩間公司所提議的綜效一直被分析師強烈質疑」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: They must have acquired a majority stake to force the hostile takeover.
options: A. The steaks are being grilled right now.
B. Yes, the board of directors had no choice but to comply.
C. We have been forcing them to sign the contract.
D. The acquisition was officially canceled.
normal.explain: 原句：They must have acquired a majority stake to force the hostile takeover.（他們一定取得了多數股權以強行進行惡意併購。）回應「對，董事會別無選擇只能順從」最適合。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Several prominent subsidiaries are going to be integrated into the parent company.
options: A. 幾家知名的子公司即將被整合進母公司中。
B. 母公司一直在剝離那些不賺錢的子公司。
C. 這些子公司一定拒絕了母公司的整合計畫。
D. 母公司必須在年底前收購更多的子公司。
normal.explain: 原句：Several prominent subsidiaries are going to be integrated into the parent company. 意思是「幾家知名的子公司即將被整合進母公司」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The multinational conglomerate has been expanding its influence in the tech sector.
options: A. 這個跨國集團一直在擴展其在科技領域的影響力。
B. 這個科技集團即將被一家跨國企業收購。
C. 跨國集團一定在科技領域遭遇了重大挫折。
D. 我們必須減少這個集團在市場上的影響力。
normal.explain: 原句：The multinational conglomerate has been expanding its influence in the tech sector. 意思是「這家跨國企業集團一直在擴展其於科技領域的影響力」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The merger agreement must have been scrutinized for potential antitrust violations.
options: A. 該合併協議一定因潛在的違反反托拉斯法而被仔細審查了。
B. 我們一直在審查合併協議以避免法律糾紛。
C. 這個協議正因為壟斷市場的嫌疑而被政府拒絕。
D. 他們必須修改協議以符合反壟斷法規。
normal.explain: 原句：The merger agreement must have been scrutinized for potential antitrust violations. 意思是「合併協議一定因潛在的反托拉斯（反壟斷）違規而被仔細審查過了」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: How long have the regulators been investigating this monopolistic behavior?
options: A. The behavior is being corrected immediately.
B. They must have discovered the monopoly yesterday.
C. For at least six months, and they are preparing a massive fine.
D. The investigation was undoubtedly successful.
normal.explain: 原句：How long have the regulators been investigating this monopolistic behavior?（監管機構調查這種壟斷行為多久了？）回應「至少六個月了，他們正在準備祭出鉅額罰款」符合邏輯。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The core curriculum is being redesigned to foster critical thinking skills.
options: A. 核心課綱正被重新設計以培養批判性思考能力。
B. 學校一直在尋找能教導批判性思考的老師。
C. 舊的課綱一定是阻礙了學生的思考發展。
D. 學生必須在核心課程中展現批判性思考。
normal.explain: 原句：The core curriculum is being redesigned to foster critical thinking skills. 意思是「核心課程正在被重新設計，以培養批判性思考技能」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The parents have been expressing concerns regarding the excessive extracurricular activities.
options: A. 家長們一直對過多的課外活動表達擔憂。
B. 課外活動即將因為家長的抗議而被取消。
C. 家長一定認為課外活動對學生的幫助不大。
D. 我們必須為學生安排更多有意義的活動。
normal.explain: 原句：The parents have been expressing concerns regarding the excessive extracurricular activities. 意思是「家長們一直對過度/過多的課外活動表達擔憂」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The disciplinary actions must have been implemented without consulting the student council.
options: A. 這些紀律處分一定是在沒有諮詢學生會的情況下實施的。
B. 學生會一直在要求學校撤銷這些懲處。
C. 學校即將實施一連串新的紀律處分方案。
D. 你必須在諮詢學生會之後才能採取懲處行動。
normal.explain: 原句：The disciplinary actions must have been implemented without consulting the student council. 意思是「這些懲處行動一定是在沒有諮詢學生會的情況下被執行的」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Has the school been addressing the cyberbullying issues effectively?
options: A. The bullies must have been expelled immediately.
B. Yes, a strict zero-tolerance policy is being enforced now.
C. The internet connection is being repaired.
D. They have been organizing the annual sports day.
normal.explain: 原句：Has the school been addressing the cyberbullying issues effectively?（學校有一直在有效處理網路霸凌問題嗎？）回應「有，現在正在執行嚴格的零容忍政策」最切題。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: A holistic approach to education is being promoted by the principal.
options: A. 校長正在推廣全人教育的理念。
B. 校長一定是改變了教育的方針。
C. 我們一直遵循校長提倡的教育方法。
D. 這種教育方式必須被全面推廣到所有學校。
normal.explain: 原句：A holistic approach to education is being promoted by the principal. 意思是「一種全人的教育方法正被校長推廣」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The fundraiser proceeds are going to be allocated to upgrade the science laboratory.
options: A. 募款活動的收益將被分配用來升級科學實驗室。
B. 我們一直在為了升級科學實驗室而進行募款。
C. 實驗室的設備一定是用上次的募款買的。
D. 學校必須舉辦募款活動才能維持實驗室運作。
normal.explain: 原句：The fundraiser proceeds are going to be allocated to upgrade the science laboratory. 意思是「募款收益將被分配用來升級科學實驗室」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: We have been advocating for a more inclusive learning environment for students with disabilities.
options: A. The environment must have been polluted recently.
B. That's great, equal access to education is crucial.
C. The disabled students are being expelled.
D. You must have forgotten to include the attachments.
normal.explain: 原句：We have been advocating for a more inclusive learning environment for students with disabilities.（我們一直在為身障學生倡導一個更具包容性的學習環境。）回應「太好了，平等的受教權至關重要」最得體。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The adolescent upbringing issues must have been discussed during the PTA meeting.
options: A. 青少年的教養問題一定在家長會上被討論過了。
B. 家長們一直在家長會上爭論教養問題。
C. 教養問題正被學校專家詳細分析中。
D. 你必須在家長會上提出關於青少年教養的疑問。
normal.explain: 原句：The adolescent upbringing issues must have been discussed during the PTA meeting. 意思是「青少年教養問題一定在這次的家長教師聯誼會 (PTA) 上被討論過了」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Specialized workshops are being organized to assist parents in guiding their children.
options: A. 專門的工作坊正在被組織起來，以協助家長引導孩子。
B. 學校一直定期舉辦工作坊來教育家長。
C. 家長們一定覺得這些工作坊非常有幫助。
D. 你必須參加這些專門的工作坊才能了解孩子。
normal.explain: 原句：Specialized workshops are being organized to assist parents in guiding their children. 意思是「專門的工作坊正被籌辦中，以協助父母引導他們的孩子」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The outdated grading system has been negatively impacting student motivation.
options: A. 過時的評分系統一直對學生的動機產生負面影響。
B. 學生的動機一定是因為評分不公而下降。
C. 評分系統即將被全新的機制所取代。
D. 我們必須改變這種會影響學生動機的評分方式。
normal.explain: 原句：The outdated grading system has been negatively impacting student motivation. 意思是「過時的評分系統一直對學生的動機產生負面影響」。

normal.desc: 【時態】The committee ___ the transition to renewable energy for several months.
options: A. is facilitating
B. has been facilitating
C. will facilitate
D. facilitates
normal.explain: 句末有 for several months，強調動作從過去一直持續到現在，必須使用現在完成進行式 (have/has been V-ing)。其他選項時態不符。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The solar farm project is expected ___ by a sudden drop in component prices.
options: A. to accelerate
B. to be accelerated
C. accelerating
D. accelerated
normal.explain: expect 後接不定詞 (to V)，而專案是被加速的，因此需要被動語態 (to be V-en)。選項 B 最符合文法與語意。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The power grid failed again. The engineering team ___ the maintenance warnings.
options: A. should overlook
B. will overlook
C. must have overlooked
D. can overlook
normal.explain: 對於過去發生的事實（電網故障）進行強烈推測，表示「當時必定是...」，應使用 must have V-en。選項 C 為正確答案。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Has the wind turbine installation finished?
B: No, they ___ the structural integrity since yesterday due to the severe storm.
options: A. assess
B. are assessing
C. have been assessing
D. will assess
normal.explain: 由 since yesterday 可知動作從昨天持續至今仍在進行，因此須使用現在完成進行式。選項 C 最合適。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Why did the offshore project fail?
B: The environmental impact is proven ___ severely underestimated by the developers.
options: A. to have been
B. to be
C. being
D. have been
normal.explain: 「被證實」是現在的狀態 (is proven)，而「被低估」是發生在過去的事情，不定詞需用完成式被動 (to have been V-en) 來表達時間的先後順序。

normal.desc: 【字彙】To achieve carbon neutrality, the nation must drastically reduce its ___ on fossil fuels.
options: A. reliance
B. resilient
C. relevant
D. reluctant
normal.explain: 空格處需要名詞作受詞。reliance 意為「依賴」，符合句意（減少對化石燃料的依賴）。其他選項均為形容詞或字義不合。

normal.desc:
【短文】Energy Report: The transition to green hydrogen has been gaining momentum. The initial extraction process is confirmed to have been optimized by a new catalyst. The leading scientists must have collaborated extensively with chemical engineers to achieve this breakthrough.
Q: What helped optimize the extraction process?
options: A. A new catalyst
B. Green hydrogen
C. The energy report
D. Fossil fuels
normal.explain: 短文中提到「The initial extraction process is confirmed to have been optimized by a new catalyst.」，直接指出是新的催化劑優化了萃取過程。

normal.desc: 【時態】Educational authorities ___ the national curriculum to better reflect modern technological skills.
options: A. have been overhauling
B. overhaul
C. are overhauled
D. overhauling
normal.explain: 句意表示教育當局一段時間以來持續在翻新課程，以反映現代技能，用現在完成進行式最符合語境。C為被動語意不對，D缺乏助動詞。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The traditional grading system is considered ___ obsolete by many progressive educators.
options: A. to have become
B. becoming
C. became
D. has become
normal.explain: is considered 後面接不定詞，表示「被認為已經變得過時」，強調整個轉變在過去已經發生，因此用 to have become 最自然。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The students struggled with the exam. The teacher ___ the complex theories too briefly.
options: A. could cover
B. must have covered
C. is covering
D. will cover
normal.explain: 學生考試考得很掙扎是過去的事實，據此強烈推斷老師當時一定講得太簡略，使用 must have V-en 最合適。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: How are the teachers reacting to the new pedagogical guidelines?
B: They ___ their lesson plans to align with the framework all week.
options: A. modify
B. have been modifying
C. modified
D. are modified
normal.explain: 關鍵字 all week 表示整個星期都在持續做某事，必須搭配現在完成進行式 (have been modifying)。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Did they abolish the standardized test?
B: Yes, the assessment method is determined ___ highly biased against marginalized groups.
options: A. to be
B. to have
C. being
D. is
normal.explain: is determined 後方接 to be + 形容詞 (highly biased)，表示「被判定為...」，符合英文句型習慣。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The university aims to foster an inclusive environment that promotes intellectual ___ among its diverse student body.
options: A. discourse
B. disease
C. disconnect
D. discard
normal.explain: intellectual discourse 意為「學術交流、知識對話」，符合大學促進多元學生交流的語境。其他選項皆不合理。

normal.desc:
【短文】Educational Insight: Schools in the district have been experimenting with flipped classrooms. The shift in teaching dynamics is shown to have improved student engagement significantly. The administration must have invested heavily in digital infrastructure to make this possible.
Q: What is the main benefit of the flipped classroom mentioned?
options: A. Reduced administrative workload
B. Improved student engagement
C. Cheaper digital infrastructure
D. Shorter teaching hours
normal.explain: 短文中明確指出「is shown to have improved student engagement significantly」，故 B 為正確答案。

normal.desc: 【時態】The hospitality group ___ guest complaints regarding the outdated plumbing for months.
options: A. monitors
B. has been monitoring
C. is monitored
D. will monitor
normal.explain: for months 點出時間的持續性，需使用現在完成進行式。句子為主動，飯店集團持續監控客訴。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The complimentary breakfast buffet is reported ___ drastically downgraded since the new management took over.
options: A. to downgrade
B. downgrading
C. to have been
D. has been
normal.explain: is reported 後接不定詞。因為自助餐是「被降級」，且動作從過去新管理層接手就已經發生，需用 to have been + V-en 結構。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The guest room was freezing upon arrival. The housekeeping staff ___ to turn on the heating system.
options: A. must have forgotten
B. should forget
C. will forget
D. can forget
normal.explain: 房間很冷是過去的事實，推測當時房務人員必定是忘記開暖氣，用 must have + V-en 表達過去的強烈推論。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Are they still investigating the data breach in the reservation system?
B: Yes, the IT team ___ the server logs non-stop since Sunday.
options: A. scan
B. scanned
C. is scanning
D. has been scanning
normal.explain: 關鍵字 since Sunday 加上 non-stop，表示動作從週日持續至今且不斷進行，必須使用現在完成進行式。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Why was the resort's rating penalized?
B: The poor hygiene standards in the spa area are found ___ multiple health code violations.
options: A. to have caused
B. to cause
C. causing
D. cause
normal.explain: 「被發現 (are found)」是現在，而「造成違規」是之前發生的事。因此要用 to have + V-en 表達先發生的主動動作。

normal.desc: 【字彙】To enhance guest satisfaction, the hotel decided to ___ its loyalty program with more personalized rewards.
options: A. revamp
B. revolve
C. revolt
D. reveal
normal.explain: revamp 意為「翻新、修改」，符合更新忠誠度計畫的語境。revolve 為旋轉，revolt 為反叛，reveal 為揭露。

normal.desc:
【短文】Guest Review: My family has been staying at this resort for a decade. Unfortunately, the quality of the room service is perceived to have plummeted this year. The chef must have drastically altered the menu without testing the new recipes.
Q: What issue did the guest experience?
options: A. The room was too small
B. A drop in room service quality
C. The resort was relocated
D. The menu was too expensive
normal.explain: 文章提到「the quality of the room service is perceived to have plummeted (直線下降)」，選項 B 與此意相符。

normal.desc: 【時態】The legal representatives ___ a potential compromise out of court for the past forty-eight hours.
options: A. have been seeking
B. seeks
C. are sought
D. has sought
normal.explain: for the past forty-eight hours 提示動作持續發生，主詞為複數 (representatives)，需用 have been seeking。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The core algorithm is alleged ___ from an open-source repository without proper attribution.
options: A. to copy
B. copying
C. to have been copied
D. copied
normal.explain: is alleged 後接不定詞。演算法是「被抄襲」，且抄襲發生在過去，因此使用完成式被動 to have been copied。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The competitor released an identical smartwatch. They ___ access to our confidential design schematics.
options: A. must have gained
B. should gain
C. will gain
D. have gained
normal.explain: 對手發布一模一樣的產品是已發生的事實，由此推斷對手「當時一定取得了」我們的機密設計圖，故用 must have V-en。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: How long has the litigation been going on?
B: The two software giants ___ over intellectual property rights for nearly three years.
options: A. are fighting
B. have been fighting
C. fought
D. fight
normal.explain: for nearly three years 表達持續了一段時間並延續至今的狀態，因此使用現在完成進行式。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Did the judge grant the injunction?
B: Yes, the defendant is ordered ___ the distribution of the disputed software immediately.
options: A. to halt
B. halting
C. halted
D. halt
normal.explain: be ordered to do something 是固定句型，表示「被命令去做某事」，halt 意為「停止」，此處為主動動作。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The startup filed a lawsuit claiming that the tech giant's new feature was a blatant ___ of their registered patent.
options: A. infringement
B. inflation
C. infection
D. influx
normal.explain: infringement 意為「侵犯、侵害」，常與專利 (patent) 或版權搭配使用。其他選項皆不符合語境。

normal.desc:
【短文】Tech Legal Brief: The semiconductor company has been fiercely defending its patents. The unauthorized use of their microarchitecture is proven to have inflicted massive financial damage. The rival manufacturer must have reverse-engineered the chip despite the strict non-disclosure agreements.
Q: What is the rival manufacturer accused of doing?
options: A. Signing new agreements
B. Reverse-engineering the chip
C. Selling the company
D. Fixing financial damage
normal.explain: 文中提到「The rival manufacturer must have reverse-engineered the chip (競爭對手必定是逆向工程了該晶片)」，故選 B。

normal.desc: 【時態】The city planners ___ the dilapidated waterfront district since the beginning of the mayor's term.
options: A. have been revitalizing
B. revitalize
C. are revitalized
D. will revitalize
normal.explain: 句中的 since 標示動作從過去市長上任之初開始，一直持續到現在，因此需用現在完成進行式。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The abandoned industrial complex is slated ___ into an eco-friendly residential hub by next spring.
options: A. to transform
B. to be transformed
C. transforming
D. transformed
normal.explain: be slated to do something 意指「預定要...」，而工業區是「被改造」，所以要使用不定詞的被動式 (to be transformed)。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The historic theater was demolished overnight. The municipal council ___ the preservation orders completely.
options: A. must have bypassed
B. could bypass
C. will bypass
D. should bypass
normal.explain: 歷史劇院在一夜之間被拆除，這是已發生的事實。推論市議會「必定是忽視/繞過了」保護令，應使用 must have V-en。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Why is the road construction taking so long?
B: They ___ the archaic underground sewage pipes for the past six months.
options: A. excavate
B. have been excavating
C. are excavated
D. excavated
normal.explain: for the past six months 表示這六個月以來持續不斷的動作，故以現在完成進行式表達最為準確。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Is the new zoning law finalized?
B: Yes, the commercial district is expected ___ by lush green spaces to improve air quality.
options: A. to surround
B. surrounding
C. to be surrounded
D. surrounds
normal.explain: 商業區是「被綠地環繞」，且在 is expected 後面，須使用不定詞的被動態 (to be surrounded)。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The rapid ___ of the downtown area has forced many low-income families to relocate due to soaring rents.
options: A. gentrification
B. generation
C. gesture
D. globalization
normal.explain: gentrification 指的是「士紳化、中產階級化」，通常伴隨租金上漲、低收入戶被迫搬遷的現象，完全符合句意。

normal.desc:
【短文】City Planning Gazette: The council has been promoting the creation of pedestrian-only zones. The reduction in vehicular traffic is observed to have significantly lowered local air pollution levels. The shop owners, who initially opposed the plan, must have realized that foot traffic actually boosts retail sales.
Q: What did shop owners realize?
options: A. Cars bring more customers
B. Foot traffic increases sales
C. Air pollution affects products
D. The council will raise taxes
normal.explain: 文末提到「must have realized that foot traffic actually boosts retail sales (必定是意識到步行人潮其實能提升零售業績)」，選 B。

normal.desc: 【字彙】To prevent flooding during the monsoon season, the city must improve the ___ of its drainage infrastructure.
options: A. capacity
B. captive
C. capsule
D. capital
normal.explain: capacity 在此指「容量、排水能力」。城市必須改善基礎設施的容量才能防範洪水。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The newly developed software offers a highly ___ solution for managing multiple patent portfolios simultaneously.
options: A. dynamic
B. static
C. toxic
D. panic
normal.explain: dynamic 意為「動態的、充滿活力的」，形容該解決方案靈活高效，適合用來管理專利組合。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：故障
normal.explain: 口說表達「MALFUNCTION」(n.)：故障。例句：The system suffered a major malfunction yesterday.（系統昨天發生了重大故障。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：過時的
normal.explain: 口說表達「OBSOLETE」(n.)：過時的。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：小故障
normal.explain: 口說表達「GLITCH」(n.)：小故障。例句：We experienced a minor software glitch.（我們遇到了一個軟體小故障。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：支出
normal.explain: 口說表達「EXPENDITURE」(n.)：支出。例句：If marketing expenditure had been controlled, we would have had a surplus.（如果行銷支出受到控制，我們就會有盈餘了。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：宣傳
normal.explain: 口說表達「PUBLICITY」(n.)：宣傳。例句：The event received little publicity.（活動宣傳不多。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：報導
normal.explain: 口說表達「COVERAGE」(n.)：報導。例句：The media coverage of our launch was extensive.（媒體對我們產品發布的報導非常廣泛。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：獨家的
normal.explain: 口說表達「EXCLUSIVE」(adj.)：獨家的。例句：We have an exclusive agreement with their firm.（我們與他們公司簽訂了獨家協議。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：提議
normal.explain: 口說表達「PROPOSITION」(n.)：提議。例句：They made an attractive business proposition.（他們提出了一個具吸引力的商業提議。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：懷疑的
normal.explain: 口說表達「SKEPTICAL」(adj.)：懷疑的。例句：The board remains skeptical about the new plan.（董事會對新計畫仍然持懷疑態度。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：猶豫的
normal.explain: 口說表達「HESITANT」(adj.)：猶豫的。例句：Clients are hesitant to sign the long-term contract.（客戶對簽署長期合約感到猶豫。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：赤字
normal.explain: 口說表達「DEFICIT」(n.)：赤字。例句：If they had cut costs earlier, the company wouldn't have fallen into a deficit.（如果他們早點削減成本，公司就不會陷入赤字了。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：不情願的
normal.explain: 口說表達「RELUCTANT」(adj.)：不情願的。例句：She was reluctant to open the letter.（她不太願意拆信。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：推薦函
normal.explain: 口說表達「TESTIMONIAL」(n.)：推薦函。例句：We received glowing testimonials from our clients.（我們收到了客戶熱情的推薦函。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：保留意見
normal.explain: 口說表達「RESERVATION」(n.)：保留意見。例句：Our reservation is for six thirty.（我們預訂六點半。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：正在被修理
normal.explain: 口說表達「IS BEING REPAIRED」(phr.)：正在被修理。

normal.desc: 請唸出：一直在故障
normal.explain: 口說表達「HAS BEEN MALFUNCTIONING」(phr.)：一直在故障。

normal.desc: 請唸出：一定已經故障了
normal.explain: 口說表達「MUST HAVE BROKEN DOWN」(phr.)：一定已經故障了。

normal.desc: 請唸出：正在被核准
normal.explain: 口說表達「IS BEING AUTHORIZED」(phr.)：正在被核准。

normal.desc: 請唸出：一定已經超過了
normal.explain: 口說表達「MUST HAVE EXCEEDED」(phr.)：一定已經超過了。

normal.desc: 請唸出：正在被錄音
normal.explain: 口說表達「ARE BEING RECORDED」(phr.)：正在被錄音。

normal.desc: 請唸出：一直在廣播
normal.explain: 口說表達「HAS BEEN BROADCASTING」(phr.)：一直在廣播。

normal.desc: 請唸出：一直在要求
normal.explain: 口說表達「HAVE BEEN DEMANDING」(phr.)：一直在要求。

normal.desc: 請唸出：一定已經說服了
normal.explain: 口說表達「MUST HAVE CONVINCED」(phr.)：一定已經說服了。

normal.desc: 請唸出：正在被挑戰
normal.explain: 口說表達「ARE BEING CHALLENGED」(phr.)：正在被挑戰。

normal.desc: 請唸出：一直在猶豫
normal.explain: 口說表達「HAVE BEEN HESITATING」(phr.)：一直在猶豫。

normal.desc: 請唸出：一定已經擔心了
normal.explain: 口說表達「MUST HAVE WORRIED」(phr.)：一定已經擔心了。

normal.desc: 請唸出：這台印表機一直發出奇怪的噪音
normal.ans: THE PRINTER HAS BEEN MAKING WEIRD NOISES
normal.speak: the printer has been making weird noises
normal.explain: 口說表達「THE PRINTER HAS BEEN MAKING WEIRD NOISES」(phr.)：這台印表機一直發出奇怪的噪音。

normal.desc: 請唸出：伺服器現在正在被重新啟動
normal.ans: THE SERVER IS BEING REBOOTED RIGHT NOW
normal.speak: the server is being rebooted right now
normal.explain: 口說表達「THE SERVER IS BEING REBOOTED RIGHT NOW」(phr.)：伺服器現在正在被重新啟動。

normal.desc: 請唸出：一定有人拔掉了主電纜
normal.ans: SOMEONE MUST HAVE UNPLUGGED THE MAIN CABLE
normal.speak: someone must have unplugged the main cable
normal.explain: 口說表達「SOMEONE MUST HAVE UNPLUGGED THE MAIN CABLE」(phr.)：一定有人拔掉了主電纜。

normal.desc: 請唸出：年度預算今天正在被審查
normal.ans: THE ANNUAL BUDGET IS BEING EXAMINED TODAY
normal.speak: the annual budget is being examined today
normal.explain: 口說表達「THE ANNUAL BUDGET IS BEING EXAMINED TODAY」(phr.)：年度預算今天正在被審查。

normal.desc: 請唸出：他們一定削減了我們部門的預算
normal.ans: THEY MUST HAVE CUT OUR DEPARTMENT BUDGET
normal.speak: they must have cut our department budget
normal.explain: 口說表達「THEY MUST HAVE CUT OUR DEPARTMENT BUDGET」(phr.)：他們一定削減了我們部門的預算。

normal.desc: 請唸出：執行長一直耐心地回答問題
normal.ans: THE CEO HAS BEEN ANSWERING QUESTIONS PATIENTLY
normal.speak: the ceo has been answering questions patiently
normal.explain: 口說表達「THE CEO HAS BEEN ANSWERING QUESTIONS PATIENTLY」(phr.)：執行長一直耐心地回答問題。

normal.desc: 請唸出：一份新聞稿正被立即起草
normal.ans: A PRESS RELEASE IS BEING DRAFTED IMMEDIATELY
normal.speak: a press release is being drafted immediately
normal.explain: 口說表達「A PRESS RELEASE IS BEING DRAFTED IMMEDIATELY」(phr.)：一份新聞稿正被立即起草。

normal.desc: 請唸出：我們一直在處理他們的主要疑慮
normal.ans: WE HAVE BEEN TACKLING THEIR MAIN CONCERNS
normal.speak: we have been tackling their main concerns
normal.explain: 口說表達「WE HAVE BEEN TACKLING THEIR MAIN CONCERNS」(phr.)：我們一直在處理他們的主要疑慮。

normal.desc: 請唸出：最終原型明天將會被展示
normal.ans: THE FINAL PROTOTYPE IS BEING SHOWN TOMORROW

normal.explain: 說話者詢問：「Are these promotional brochures going to be distributed at the main entrance?（這些宣傳手冊會在大門口發放嗎？）」最合理的回應是肯定並說明發放方式 (A)。（重點文法：複雜被動）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The competitors must have copied our booth layout from last year's convention.
options: A. 競爭對手一直在抄襲我們去年大會的攤位佈置。
B. 競爭對手一定抄襲了我們去年大會的攤位佈置。
C. 競爭對手去年大會的攤位佈置目前正在被調查。
D. 競爭對手必須在今年的大會抄襲我們的攤位佈置。
normal.explain: 「The competitors must have copied our booth layout from last year's convention.」意思是「競爭對手一定抄襲了我們去年大會的攤位佈置。」（重點文法：must have done）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: We have been gathering valuable feedback from attendees regarding the new interface.
options: A. 關於新介面，與會者一定已經提供了寶貴的意見。
B. 關於新介面，與會者的意見正在被嚴格地審查。
C. 關於新介面，我們一直在收集來自與會者的寶貴回饋。
D. 關於新介面，我們必須立刻回應與會者的意見。
normal.explain: 「We have been gathering valuable feedback from attendees regarding the new interface.」意思是「關於新介面，我們一直在收集來自與會者的寶貴回饋。」（重點文法：現在完成進行式）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: This interactive prototype is designed to be highly user-friendly.
options: A. We have been prototyping this device for months.
B. You must have used the older version before.
C. The designers are being replaced by the management.
D. Indeed, even a beginner can navigate it without any trouble.
normal.explain: 說話者表示：「This interactive prototype is designed to be highly user-friendly.（這個互動式原型的設計宗旨是高度重視使用者友善。）」最合理的回應是贊同並表示新手也能輕鬆操作 (D)。（重點文法：複雜被動）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The research team has been analyzing the preliminary data sets for several months.
options: A. 初步資料集預計在幾個月內被研究團隊分析完畢。
B. 研究團隊一定已經花了幾個月分析初步資料集。
C. 研究團隊幾個月來一直在分析初步資料集。
D. 研究團隊必須在幾個月內完成初步資料集的分析。
normal.explain: 「The research team has been analyzing the preliminary data sets for several months.」意思是「研究團隊幾個月來一直在分析初步資料集。」（重點文法：現在完成進行式）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The empirical findings are expected to be published in a peer-reviewed journal.
options: A. 這些實證結果一定已經發表在同儕審查的期刊上了。
B. 我們一直在同儕審查的期刊上發表這些實證結果。
C. 這些實證結果必須立刻投稿到同儕審查的期刊。
D. 這些實證結果預計將發表在同儕審查的期刊上。
normal.explain: 「The empirical findings are expected to be published in a peer-reviewed journal.」意思是「這些實證結果預計將發表在同儕審查的期刊上。」（重點文法：複雜被動）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: You must have isolated the independent variable incorrectly during the experiment.
options: A. Let me recheck the setup and run the trial again.
B. The laboratory is being thoroughly cleaned right now.
C. We have been waiting for the final results.
D. The variables are expected to be analyzed tomorrow.
normal.explain: 說話者推測：「You must have isolated the independent variable incorrectly during the experiment.（你在實驗過程中一定錯誤地分離了自變數。）」最合理的回應是打算重新檢查並再次實驗 (A)。（重點文法：must have done）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: We have been refining our central hypothesis based on the recent qualitative observations.
options: A. 我們的核心假說預計將根據近期的質性觀察進行修改。
B. 我們一直根據近期的質性觀察來完善我們的核心假說。
C. 我們的核心假說一定是因為近期的質性觀察而失敗了。
D. 我們必須立刻根據近期的質性觀察放棄核心假說。
normal.explain: 「We have been refining our central hypothesis based on the recent qualitative observations.」意思是「我們一直根據近期的質性觀察來完善我們的核心假說。」（重點文法：現在完成進行式）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Is the control group being monitored for any unexpected behavioral changes?
options: A. The control group must have completed the survey.
B. We have been studying their genetic makeup.
C. Yes, we are observing them around the clock.
D. The expected changes are not going to be recorded.
normal.explain: 說話者詢問：「Is the control group being monitored for any unexpected behavioral changes?（對照組是否正受到監控以觀察任何意外的行為變化？）」最合理的回應是肯定並表示24小時都在觀察 (C)。（重點文法：複雜被動）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The sudden temperature drop must have skewed the final chemical analysis.
options: A. 溫度的突然下降目前正在影響最終的化學分析。
B. 我們一直在調查溫度突然下降對化學分析的影響。
C. 化學分析預計會因為溫度的突然下降而延遲。
D. 溫度的突然下降一定使得最終的化學分析出現偏差。
normal.explain: 「The sudden temperature drop must have skewed the final chemical analysis.」意思是「溫度的突然下降一定使得最終的化學分析出現偏差。」（重點文法：must have done）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Our department has been collaborating with international scholars to broaden the scope.
options: A. 為了擴展領域，我們部門一直在與國際學者合作。
B. 我們的部門一定已經與國際學者完成了合作。
C. 為了擴展領域，我們的部門預計會被國際學者接管。
D. 我們的部門必須停止與國際學者的跨領域合作。
normal.explain: 「Our department has been collaborating with international scholars to broaden the scope.」意思是「為了擴展領域，我們部門一直在與國際學者合作。」（重點文法：現在完成進行式）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The theoretical models are currently being validated through rigorous empirical testing.
options: A. 理論模型一定已經通過了嚴格的實證測試。
B. 理論模型目前正透過嚴格的實證測試進行驗證。
C. 我們一直在理論模型中尋找實證測試的錯誤。
D. 理論模型預計將在沒有實證測試的情況下被發布。
normal.explain: 「The theoretical models are currently being validated through rigorous empirical testing.」意思是「理論模型目前正透過嚴格的實證測試進行驗證。」（重點文法：複雜被動）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The alarm system has been flashing continuously since the power outage began.
options: A. 自從停電開始，警報系統就一直在持續閃爍。
B. 警報系統一定是因為停電才被燒壞的。
C. 警報系統預計在停電結束後就會恢復閃爍。
D. 自從停電開始，我們必須手動關閉警報系統。
normal.explain: 「The alarm system has been flashing continuously since the power outage began.」意思是「自從停電開始，警報系統就一直在持續閃爍。」（重點文法：現在完成進行式）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: All personnel are strictly required to be escorted to the designated assembly area.
options: A. 所有人員一定已經在指定的集合地點會合了。
B. 嚴格要求所有人員必須被護送到指定的集合區域。
C. 救護人員一直在將傷者護送到指定的集合區域。
D. 所有人員都必須自行前往指定的集合區域報到。
normal.explain: 「All personnel are strictly required to be escorted to the designated assembly area.」意思是「嚴格要求所有人員必須被護送到指定的集合區域。」（重點文法：複雜被動）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Someone must have triggered the fire alarm accidentally on the third floor.
options: A. The fire alarm has been ringing all morning.
B. The evacuation protocol is being updated today.
C. I hope it's just a false alarm and no one is hurt.
D. You must have extinguished the fire yourself.
normal.explain: 說話者推測：「Someone must have triggered the fire alarm accidentally on the third floor.（一定有人在三樓不小心觸發了火災警報。）」最合理的回應是希望只是誤報且無人受傷 (C)。（重點文法：must have done）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: We have been clearing hazardous materials from the primary escape routes.
options: A. 主要逃生路線上的危險物質一定已經被清除了。
B. 這些危險物質預計將被放置在主要逃生路線上。
C. 我們必須立刻封鎖主要逃生路線上的危險物質。
D. 我們一直在清理主要逃生路線上的危險物質。
normal.explain: 「We have been clearing hazardous materials from the primary escape routes.」意思是「我們一直在清理主要逃生路線上的危險物質。」（重點文法：現在完成進行式）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Are the emergency doors being unlocked by the security personnel right now?
options: A. Yes, they are clearing all the main exits as we speak.
B. The security personnel have been waiting outside.
C. Someone must have locked the doors by mistake.
D. The doors are designed to be permanently locked.
normal.explain: 說話者詢問：「Are the emergency doors being unlocked by the security personnel right now?（保全人員現在正在解鎖緊急逃生門嗎？）」最合理的回應是肯定並說明他們正在淨空出口 (A)。（重點文法：複雜被動）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The ventilation system must have shut down automatically to contain the smoke.
options: A. 通風系統一直在自動運作以排出室內的濃煙。
B. 通風系統一定為了控制煙霧而自動關閉了。
C. 為了控制煙霧，通風系統預計會被遠端關閉。
D. 我們必須手動關閉通風系統來防止煙霧擴散。
normal.explain: 「The ventilation system must have shut down automatically to contain the smoke.」意思是「通風系統一定為了控制煙霧而自動關閉了。」（重點文法：must have done）

normal.desc: 【時態】The financial analysts ___ consumer behavior continuously since the new tariff was announced.
options: A. have been monitoring
B. will be monitoring
C. are monitored
D. had monitored
normal.explain: 本題測試現在完成進行式。句尾有 since 帶出的一段時間，且強調動作持續至今，故選 have been V-ing。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The recent surge in commodity prices is believed ___ by global supply chain disruptions.
options: A. trigger
B. to have been triggered
C. triggering
D. to trigger
normal.explain: 本題測試複雜被動語態。主詞是價格飆升，被認為「已經被」引發，故使用 is believed to have been + p.p.。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The rival brand launched an identical campaign overnight; they ___ our leaked marketing strategy.
options: A. should copy
B. can copy
C. must have copied
D. will have copied
normal.explain: 本題測試對過去事實的強烈推測。對手一夜之間推出相同活動，推測他們「必定已經」抄襲了我們的策略，用 must have + p.p.。

normal.desc: 【字彙】To boost online sales, the marketing team needs to offer a compelling ___ for first-time buyers.
options: A. deterrent
B. saturation
C. disparity
D. incentive
normal.explain: incentive (動機/誘因) 符合句意「提供強大的誘因給首次購買者」。deterrent (威懾物)、saturation (飽和)、disparity (差距) 皆不合。

normal.desc: 【時態】The HR department ___ the updated employee handbook to include the new remote work policies for weeks.
options: A. is revised
B. has been revising
C. will revise
D. having revised
normal.explain: for weeks 表示持續一段時間到現在的動作，使用現在完成進行式 has been revising。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】Attendance at the annual compliance training is considered ___ compulsory for all full-time staff.
options: A. to be
B. been
C. being
D. was
normal.explain: consider 的被動語法為 be considered to be + 補語（或直接加補語）。此處選 to be 最為完整合理。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The server crashed right after the new update was installed. The IT team ___ some incompatible codes.
options: A. must have deployed
B. would deploy
C. ought to deploy
D. can deploy
normal.explain: 對於過去發生的伺服器崩潰原因進行強烈推測，表示「必定已經部署了」不相容的程式碼，用 must have + p.p.。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The strict dress code policy has been heavily criticized for being a ___ to creative expression in the workplace.
options: A. leverage
B. deterrent
C. exemption
D. resilience
normal.explain: deterrent 意為「阻礙物/威懾物」，符合「對職場創意表現造成阻礙」的語意。

normal.desc: 【時態】The marine biologists ___ the migration patterns of these endangered whales for over a decade.
options: A. have been tracking
B. track
C. are tracked
D. will track
normal.explain: for over a decade 搭配現在完成進行式，表示動作從過去持續到現在。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The newly discovered fossil is hypothesized ___ to the late Jurassic period by leading paleontologists.
options: A. belonging
B. belong
C. to belong
D. belonged
normal.explain: be hypothesized to + 原形動詞，表示「被假定為...」。因此選 to belong。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The lab rats navigated the complex maze flawlessly. They ___ the route during the previous trials.
options: A. could memorize
B. must have memorized
C. will memorize
D. are memorizing
normal.explain: 完美走完迷宮是過去事實，推測其原因「必定是已經記住了路線」，故選 must have memorized。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The latest breakthrough in genome editing is expected to completely ___ the field of hereditary diseases.
options: A. deteriorate
B. alleviate
C. dismantle
D. revolutionize
normal.explain: revolutionize (徹底改變/使革命化) 符合重大科學突破對疾病領域的影響。alleviate 是減輕，不搭配 the field。

normal.desc: 【時態】The tourism board ___ a sustainable travel initiative to reduce the carbon footprint of foreign visitors.
options: A. has been promoting
B. is promoted
C. will be promoted
D. having promoted
normal.explain: 主動語態且表示近期持續進行的動作，選現在完成進行式 has been promoting。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The influx of tourists is observed ___ a disproportionate strain on the island's limited water resources.
options: A. placed
B. to have placed
C. place
D. placing
normal.explain: is observed to have + p.p. 表示「被觀察到已經...」，符合對已發生事實的被動描述。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The historic monument was severely defaced overnight. The vandals ___ the lax security patrols.
options: A. should exploit
B. might exploit
C. must have exploited
D. will have exploited
normal.explain: 古蹟被破壞是已發生的事，推論破壞者「必定利用了」鬆散的保全巡邏，用 must have + p.p.。

normal.desc: 【字彙】To prevent the local culture from being eroded, the government must impose strict ___ on commercial development.
options: A. incentives
B. disparities
C. exemptions
D. constraints
normal.explain: constraints 意為「限制/約束」，符合政府對商業開發實施嚴格限制以保護當地文化的語境。

normal.desc: 【時態】The non-profit organization ___ emergency relief supplies to the drought-stricken regions for three consecutive months.
options: A. has been dispatching
B. dispatched
C. is dispatched
D. to dispatch
normal.explain: for three consecutive months 強調動作持續至今，故選 has been dispatching。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The community outreach program is reported ___ successfully in bridging the wealth gap in urban areas.
options: A. implemented
B. to have been implemented
C. implement
D. is implementing
normal.explain: is reported to have been + p.p. 表示「據報導已經被實施」，符合複雜被動語態的結構。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The charity raised an unprecedented amount of funds. The celebrity endorsement ___ a significant impact.
options: A. must have made
B. ought to make
C. could make
D. will make
normal.explain: 推測名人代言必定在過去產生了重大影響，使用 must have + p.p.。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The NGO's primary ___ this year is to provide clean drinking water to over fifty remote villages.
options: A. saturation
B. endeavor
C. disparity
D. leverage
normal.explain: endeavor (努力/事業/目標) 符合句意「今年主要的努力目標是...」。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Have you reviewed the latest market saturation report?
B: Yes, our profit margins are proven ___ steadily by the fierce price wars since last quarter.
options: A. shrinking
B. to have been shrinking
C. shrink
D. shrunk
normal.explain: are proven to have been V-ing 表示「被證實一直都在...」，符合 since last quarter 強調持續狀態的語境。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Why didn't the marketing team launch the campaign on time?
B: They ___ a lot of internal resistance regarding the budget allocation.
options: A. must have faced
B. should face
C. can face
D. will have faced
normal.explain: 解釋過去沒有準時推出的原因，推測「必定是面臨了內部阻力」，用 must have + p.p.。

normal.desc: 【句子】The board of directors ___ the feasibility of expanding into the Southeast Asian market, but they remain skeptical about the infrastructure.
options: A. are evaluating
B. to evaluate
C. have been evaluating
D. evaluates
normal.explain: 強調這段時間以來持續評估的動作，使用現在完成進行式 have been evaluating。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Did the staff read the new remote work policy in the handbook?
B: Probably not. The HR department is alleged ___ the notification email to the wrong mailing list.
options: A. sent
B. sending
C. to be sent
D. to have sent
normal.explain: is alleged to have + p.p. 表示「據稱已經做了...」，符合句意「據稱人資把信寄錯了名單」。

normal.desc: 【句子】Many employees missed the mandatory compliance seminar. They ___ the reminder that was buried at the bottom of the weekly newsletter.
options: A. must have overlooked
B. will overlook
C. could overlook
D. should overlook
normal.explain: 推測員工「必定是忽略了」藏在電子報底部的提醒，用 must have + p.p.。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: What is the latest finding from the genome lab?
B: The researchers ___ a specific protein that can potentially reverse cellular aging.
options: A. are isolated
B. have been isolating
C. to isolate
D. isolate
normal.explain: 表示研究人員最近一直持續在分離特定蛋白質，用現在完成進行式 have been isolating 最適當。

normal.desc: 【句子】The sudden reduction in greenhouse gases during the lockdown is considered ___ a temporary phenomenon rather than a permanent climate shift.
options: A. be
B. to be
C. been
D. being
normal.explain: is considered to be... 為常見的被動語態結構，意指「被認為是...」。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Have local businesses complained about the new eco-tax on plastics?
B: Yes, the retail sector ___ fiercely against the regulations for the past two months.
options: A. lobby
B. lobbied
C. has been lobbying
D. is lobbied
normal.explain: for the past two months 表示持續進行到現在，故選現在完成進行式 has been lobbying。

normal.desc: 【句子】The government's ambitious attempt to build a massive artificial reef is thought ___ significant damage to the existing coral ecosystems.
options: A. causing
B. cause
C. to have caused
D. caused
normal.explain: is thought to have caused... 意為「被認為已經造成了...」，表達對過去已發生之事的被動看法。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Why did the NGO lose its primary corporate sponsor?
B: The board of directors ___ the charity's financial transparency reports during the recent audit.
options: A. can scrutinize
B. must have scrutinized
C. will scrutinize
D. are scrutinizing
normal.explain: 推測贊助商撤資的原因，必定是董事會在審計期間仔細審查了財務透明度報告，用 must have + p.p.。

normal.desc:
【短文】Market Analysis Brief: We have been tracking the consumer response to our newly launched vegan snack line. The initial sales figures are reported to have exceeded all quarterly projections by 40%. The marketing department must have leveraged the social media influencers exceptionally well. 
Q: What is true about the marketing department?
options: A. They ignored social media trends.
B. They failed to meet quarterly projections.
C. They are believed to have used influencers effectively.
D. They changed the product's vegan ingredients.
normal.explain: 文中提到 The marketing department must have leveraged the social media influencers exceptionally well，推論他們非常有效地利用了網紅行銷。

normal.desc:
【短文】HR Memo: The management has been reviewing the employee retention rates across all branches. The sudden spike in resignations in the IT department is hypothesized to have been caused by the mandatory overtime policy. The department heads must have underestimated the staff's burnout levels. 
Q: What did the department heads likely underestimate?
options: A. The company's profit margin.
B. The effectiveness of the new software.
C. The employees' exhaustion from overwork.
D. The number of new applicants.
normal.explain: 文中提到 must have underestimated the staff's burnout levels (必定低估了員工的倦怠程度)，選項 C 的 exhaustion from overwork 是同義替換。

normal.desc:
【短文】Science Journal Press Release: Researchers have been observing the impact of microplastics on marine life. The accumulation of toxins in local fish populations is confirmed to have reached unprecedented levels. Regulatory bodies must have ignored previous environmental warnings for years to let this happen. 
Q: Why did the toxins reach unprecedented levels according to the passage?
options: A. Regulatory bodies likely ignored past warnings.
B. The researchers fabricated the data.
C. Fish populations naturally evolved to absorb more toxins.
D. A new type of plastic was recently invented.
normal.explain: 文中提到 Regulatory bodies must have ignored previous environmental warnings for years，因此選 A。

normal.desc:
【短文】Tourism Policy Review: The city council has been attempting to limit the number of daily visitors to the historical district. The excessive foot traffic is proven to have accelerated the deterioration of the cobblestone streets. Local shop owners, seeing reduced sales, must have panicked and petitioned against the visitor cap. 
Q: What is a consequence of excessive foot traffic mentioned in the text?
options: A. An increase in local sales.
B. The destruction of the historical streets.
C. A surge in new shop openings.
D. Improved maintenance of the cobblestones.
normal.explain: 文中提到 excessive foot traffic is proven to have accelerated the deterioration of the cobblestone streets (加速了石板路的惡化)，即破壞歷史街道。

normal.desc:
【短文】NGO Annual Report: Over the past year, we have been vigorously advocating for refugee rights at the borders. The harsh immigration policies are known to have separated thousands of families unjustly. The international community must have turned a blind eye to these human rights violations until the recent media coverage. 
Q: What is implied about the international community?
options: A. They provided immediate assistance to the refugees.
B. They actively created the harsh immigration policies.
C. They ignored the violations before the media reported them.
D. They funded the NGO's advocacy campaigns.
normal.explain: 文中提到 must have turned a blind eye to these human rights violations until the recent media coverage (在近期媒體報導前必定是視而不見)，故選 C。

normal.desc:
【短文】Market Pulse: Startups in the electric vehicle sector have been struggling to secure capital. The recent withdrawal of several major investors is thought to have triggered a domino effect. The venture capitalists must have perceived the battery supply chain constraints as too risky. 
Q: What was a major concern for the venture capitalists?
options: A. The lack of consumer demand for electric vehicles.
B. The risks associated with the battery supply chain.
C. The excessive government regulations on startups.
D. The sudden resignation of key startup founders.
normal.explain: 文中指出 The venture capitalists must have perceived the battery supply chain constraints as too risky，故選 B。

normal.desc:
【短文】Employee Handbook Excerpt: The company has been updating its grievance procedures to ensure fairness. Any formal complaints filed are required to be handled with strict confidentiality by the HR ethics committee. Employees who felt marginalized in the past must have hesitated to report incidents due to fear of retaliation. 
Q: Why might some employees have not reported incidents previously?
options: A. They were unaware of the grievance procedures.
B. They resolved the issues informally.
C. They were afraid of negative consequences.
D. They trusted the HR ethics committee completely.
normal.explain: 文中提到 must have hesitated to report incidents due to fear of retaliation (必定是因害怕報復而猶豫)，選項 C 的 negative consequences 為同義替換。

normal.desc:
【短文】Scientific Update: Astrophysicists have been analyzing the unusual radio bursts from a distant galaxy. The signal anomalies are hypothesized to have originated from a collapsing neutron star. The initial observation team must have calibrated their telescopes incorrectly, as they missed the phenomenon completely last year. 
Q: What mistake is attributed to the initial observation team?
options: A. They published the data prematurely.
B. They misidentified a neutron star as a black hole.
C. They improperly set up their equipment.
D. They erased the recorded radio bursts by accident.
normal.explain: 文中提到 The initial observation team must have calibrated their telescopes incorrectly (必定是錯誤校準了望遠鏡)，即設備設定不當。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The replacement components are scheduled to be dispatched to your address.
options: A. 替換零件預計將被發送到您的地址。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: I have been trying to reach a human operator for over twenty minutes.

B. I apologize for the unusually long wait time.
C. We have been trying to contact you as well.

normal.explain: 正確答案是 B。句意：我已經嘗試聯絡人工客服超過二十分鐘了。原句：I have been trying to reach a human operator for over twenty minutes. 選項 B「對這異常漫長的等待時間感到抱歉」最適合。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思

B. 你必須在帳單到期前完成繳費。
C. 你一定撥錯了帳單部門的分機號碼。
D. 帳單部門目前無法接聽您的電話。
normal.explain: 正確答案是 C。句意：你一定撥錯了帳單部門的分機號碼。原句：You must have dialed the wrong extension for the billing department.

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？

C. 我們一直設計這個領導力課程來賦權初階主管。
D. 初階主管們負責籌劃這次的企業內部培訓。
normal.explain: 正確答案是 C。句意：我們一直設計這個領導力課程來賦予初階主管能力（賦權）。原句：We have been designing this leadership program to empower our junior managers.

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: You must have skipped the most important section of the safety manual.
options: A. The manual was written by an expert.
B. I will skip lunch today to finish the work.
C. Safety glasses are required in the lab.
D. I apologize, I will read it thoroughly right away.
normal.explain: 正確答案是 D。句意：你一定跳過了安全手冊裡最重要的部分。原句：You must have skipped the most important section of the safety manual. 選項 D「我道歉，我會立刻仔細閱讀它」最適合。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Dynamic workshops are reported to be preferred by most employees.
options: A. 據報導，充滿活力的工作坊較受多數員工青睞。
B. 大多數員工表示他們不想參加沉悶的工作坊。
C. 我們需要聘請更有活力的講師來帶領活動。
D. 員工問卷結果顯示，大家喜歡在戶外進行活動。
normal.explain: 正確答案是 A。句意：據報導，充滿活力的工作坊較受多數員工青睞（喜好）。原句：Dynamic workshops are reported to be preferred by most employees.

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: I have been reflecting on the insightful feedback given by my mentor.
options: A. The reflection in the mirror looks great.
B. It's always helpful to learn from their experience.
C. Your mentor is giving a presentation right now.
D. I will give you the feedback tomorrow.
normal.explain: 正確答案是 B。句意：我一直在反思導師給我的深刻回饋。原句：I have been reflecting on the insightful feedback given by my mentor. 選項 B「從他們的經驗中學習總是有幫助的」最適合。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The guest speaker must have noticed that the audience was losing focus.
options: A. 客座講者要求觀眾在演講過程中保持專注。
B. 觀眾抱怨客座講者的演講內容缺乏重點。
C. 客座講者一定注意到了觀眾正在失去注意力。
D. 因為麥克風故障，講者無法吸引觀眾的注意。
normal.explain: 正確答案是 C。句意：客座講者一定注意到了觀眾正在失去注意力。原句：The guest speaker must have noticed that the audience was losing focus.

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The revised onboarding materials are expected to be circulated by Friday.
options: A. The circle is perfectly drawn on the board.
B. Friday is my favorite day of the week.
C. We revised the budget constraints yesterday.
D. Excellent, I will prepare the newcomers for it.
normal.explain: 正確答案是 D。句意：修訂後的新人入職資料預計在週五前會傳閱發放。原句：The revised onboarding materials are expected to be circulated by Friday. 選項 D「太棒了，我會讓新進員工做好準備」最適合。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The curator has been collecting these rare artifacts for over two decades.
options: A. 館長收藏這些稀有文物已經超過二十年了。
B. 這座博物館展示了過去二十年來出土的文物。
C. 策展人將在未來二十年內修復這些古老的藝術品。
D. 這些珍貴文物是兩位收藏家畢生的心血。
normal.explain: 正確答案是 A。句意：館長（策展人）收藏這些稀有文物已經超過二十年了。原句：The curator has been collecting these rare artifacts for over two decades.

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: This abstract painting is believed to have been completed in his final years.
options: A. Yes, he painted the walls green.
B. That explains the profound sense of melancholy in it.
C. The final exam was completed yesterday.
D. It is hard to believe that the year is over.
normal.explain: 正確答案是 B。句意：這幅抽象畫被認為是在他晚年時完成的。原句：This abstract painting is believed to have been completed in his final years. 選項 B「那就能解釋畫中深沉的憂鬱感了」最適合。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The ancient civilization must have flourished along this fertile riverbank.
options: A. 這條肥沃的河岸曾經遭遇過嚴重的洪水氾濫。
B. 考古學家在這個河岸邊發現了許多古老的遺跡。
C. 這個古老文明一定曾沿著這條肥沃的河岸繁榮發展。
D. 古文明的衰亡與河岸土壤的枯竭有著密切關聯。
normal.explain: 正確答案是 C。句意：這個古老文明一定曾沿著這條肥沃的河岸繁榮發展。原句：The ancient civilization must have flourished along this fertile riverbank.

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: We have been marveling at this magnificent sculpture for ten minutes.
options: A. I know, the craftsmanship is simply breathtaking.
B. The sculptor hasn't arrived at the studio yet.
C. Ten minutes is not enough to walk there.
D. Marvel comics are very popular among teenagers.
normal.explain: 正確答案是 A。句意：我們驚嘆於這座宏偉的雕塑已經十分鐘了。原句：We have been marveling at this magnificent sculpture for ten minutes. 選項 A「我知道，其工藝簡直令人嘆為觀止」最適合。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The delicate ceramics are strictly forbidden to be photographed with a flash.
options: A. 這些精緻的陶瓷器嚴禁使用閃光燈拍照。
B. 博物館內禁止攜帶相機以保護脆弱的陶瓷。
C. 攝影師們必須獲得許可才能拍攝這些陶瓷。
D. 在強光照射下，這些陶瓷的顏色會逐漸褪去。
normal.explain: 正確答案是 A。句意：這些精緻的陶瓷器嚴禁被使用閃光燈拍照。原句：The delicate ceramics are strictly forbidden to be photographed with a flash.

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The sculptors must have spent countless hours perfecting these intricate details.
options: A. Time flies when you are having fun.
B. Exactly, the level of precision is absolutely stunning.
C. Details are often overlooked by modern artists.
D. They didn't spend any money on the materials.
normal.explain: 正確答案是 B。句意：雕塑家們一定花了無數個小時來完美這些複雜的細節。原句：The sculptors must have spent countless hours perfecting these intricate details. 選項 B「沒錯，這精準度絕對令人驚豔」最適合。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: A hidden doorway is rumored to be located behind this massive tapestry.
options: A. 巨大的掛毯後方藏著一條通往地下的通道。
B. 聽說這塊華麗的掛毯曾經掛在皇宮的大門前。
C. 謠傳在這幅巨大的掛毯後面有一扇隱藏的門。
D. 博物館的設計師將門票隱藏在掛毯的圖案中。
normal.explain: 正確答案是 C。句意：謠傳在這幅巨大的掛毯（壁毯）後面有一扇隱藏的門。原句：A hidden doorway is rumored to be located behind this massive tapestry.

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Our competitors have been offering much lower prices to attract our clients.
options: A. The price tag is missing from this item.
B. I am attracted to the beautiful scenery.
C. We are competing in a marathon next week.
D. We need to revise our promotional strategy then.
normal.explain: 正確答案是 D。句意：我們的競爭對手一直提供低得多的價格來吸引我們的客戶。原句：Our competitors have been offering much lower prices to attract our clients. 選項 D「那我們需要修改我們的促銷策略了」最適合。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The proposed deadline is considered to be unrealistic by our production team.
options: A. 我們的生產團隊認為提議的截止日期不切實際。
B. 生產團隊已經同意將截止日期延後一週。
C. 專案經理向生產團隊提出了新的時間表。
D. 生產團隊認為這個提案將無法如期完成。
normal.explain: 正確答案是 A。句意：我們的生產團隊認為提議的截止日期不切實際。原句：The proposed deadline is considered to be unrealistic by our production team.

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: They must have rejected our initial offer without even reading the terms.
options: A. Reading books is a great hobby.
B. I agree; it was dismissed far too quickly.
C. The initial phase is complete now.
D. We rejected the flawed products.
normal.explain: 正確答案是 B。句意：他們一定是連條款都沒看就拒絕了我們最初的報價。原句：They must have rejected our initial offer without even reading the terms. 選項 B「我同意；它被駁回得太快了」最適合。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: We have been trying to break this deadlock since the morning session.
options: A. 我們從早上就在試圖打破這扇鎖上的門。
B. 早上的會議已經成功解決了所有爭議。
C. 我們從上午的會議開始就一直試圖打破這個僵局。
D. 雙方的談判代表決定在上午暫停會談。
normal.explain: 正確答案是 C。句意：我們從上午的會議開始就一直試圖打破這個僵局。原句：We have been trying to break this deadlock since the morning session.

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Significant concessions are expected to be made by both parties today.
options: A. I bought some snacks from the concession stand.
B. Let's party until the sun comes up.
C. The significance of this event cannot be denied.
D. Yes, otherwise we won't reach an agreement.
normal.explain: 正確答案是 D。句意：預計今天雙方都會做出重大讓步。原句：Significant concessions are expected to be made by both parties today. 選項 D「對，否則我們將無法達成協議」最適合。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The foreign delegates must have been insulted by his aggressive tactics.
options: A. 外國代表一定對他咄咄逼人的策略感到被侮辱了。
B. 他強勢的手段成功說服了所有的外國代表。
C. 外國代表們拒絕使用如此具有攻擊性的戰術。
D. 他對於外國代表的無禮行為感到非常憤怒。
normal.explain: 正確答案是 A。句意：外國代表一定對他咄咄逼人的策略感到被侮辱了。原句：The foreign delegates must have been insulted by his aggressive tactics.

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Your legal team has been pushing for a more lucrative compensation package.
options: A. The package was delivered to the front door.
B. We believe our expertise justifies the higher rate.
C. Pushing heavy objects can cause back injuries.
D. The legal department is located on the third floor.
normal.explain: 正確答案是 B。句意：您的法務團隊一直在爭取更優渥（利潤豐厚）的薪酬方案。原句：Your legal team has been pushing for a more lucrative compensation package. 選項 B「我們相信我們的專業知識配得上更高的費率」最適合。

normal.desc: 【時態】The international trade commission ___ the impact of the new export tariffs on local agriculture for the past six months.
options: A. investigates
B. is investigated
C. has been investigating
D. will investigate
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：句尾有「for the past six months」表示從過去一直持續到現在的動作，應使用現在完成進行式 (has been V-ing)。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The psychological wellbeing of remote workers is proven ___ significantly by prolonged social isolation.
options: A. to have been damaged
B. has damaged
C. to damage
D. damaging
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：此處使用「is proven to + 不定詞」，且動作發生在過去並有被動意味，因此使用完成被動不定詞 (to have been + p.p.)。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The architectural firm won the prestigious award. They ___ an incredibly sustainable urban layout.
options: A. should design
B. must have designed
C. could design
D. will have designed
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：前句提到建築事務所贏得大獎，後句是對過去事實的強烈推測，應使用 must have + p.p.。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The newly passed healthcare policy aims to provide a comprehensive ___ to low-income families seeking medical assistance.
options: A. penalty
B. subsidy
C. hindrance
D. diagnosis
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：subsidy 意為「補貼、津貼」，符合提供低收入戶醫療援助的語境。penalty 是罰款，hindrance 是阻礙。

normal.desc: 【時態】E-commerce platforms ___ stricter anti-counterfeit measures since the consumer protection laws were updated.
options: A. enforces
B. had enforced
C. have been enforcing
D. will be enforced
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：自從法律更新(since)以來，平台「一直持續」執行更嚴格的措施，需用現在完成進行式。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The sudden increase in global shipping rates is generally considered ___ by severe port congestions.
options: A. to be caused
B. to have been caused
C. causing
D. having caused
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：「被認為是由於...所引起」，由於塞港是發生在運費上漲之前或同時的已經發生的事，用 to have been caused 最準確表達過去的被動原因。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The employee suddenly burst into tears during the performance review. The manager ___ some highly insensitive remarks.
options: A. must have made
B. should have made
C. might make
D. would make
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：對過去發生的事情（員工突然哭了）作強烈推測，經理「一定說了」不敏感的話，用 must have + p.p.。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The avant-garde building features a stunning glass ___, which maximizes natural light in the main lobby.
options: A. foundation
B. facade
C. basement
D. corridor
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：facade 指建築物的「正面、外牆」。玻璃外牆能最大化自然光，符合句意。

normal.desc: 【時態】Healthcare administrators ___ resources to emergency departments due to the unexpected flu outbreak.
options: A. redirect
B. have been redirecting
C. is redirected
D. redirects
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：表示從疫情爆發到現在「一直持續在重新分配」資源，用現在完成進行式最適當。

normal.desc: 【字彙】According to the updated terms of service, the e-commerce giant explicitly disclaims any ___ for third-party shipping delays.
options: A. liability
B. asset
C. prospect
D. momentum
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：disclaim liability 意為「免除責任」。電商巨頭聲明對第三方的運送延遲不承擔責任。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Have the two countries reached a trade agreement yet?
B: Not at all. They ___ over the import quotas for agricultural products for several consecutive weeks.
options: A. are bargaining
B. have been bargaining
C. had bargained
D. will be bargaining
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：B 回答「好幾個連續星期」，表示談判動作從過去持續到現在，應使用現在完成進行式。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Why did the lead designer resign so abruptly?
B: The excessive micromanagement from the board is widely believed ___ her creative autonomy.
options: A. to have stifled
B. to stifle
C. stifling
D. has stifled
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：is widely believed to... 後接不定詞。因為「扼殺自主權」是發生在離職之前的動作，需用完成式不定詞 to have stifled。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Did the clinic receive the extra funding from the government?
B: Yes, the administrative team ___ tirelessly to secure that grant since last autumn.
options: A. works
B. is working
C. has been working
D. will have worked
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：「since last autumn」表明動作從去年秋天延續至今，故選現在完成進行式。

normal.desc: 【句子】Many online sellers found their accounts suspended overnight. They ___ the newly updated anti-fraud provisions without realizing it.
options: A. ought to violate
B. must have violated
C. are violating
D. will violate
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：帳號被停權是已發生的事實，推測他們「一定是在不知不覺中違反了」新規定，用 must have + p.p.。

normal.desc: 【句子】The persistent supply chain disruptions are projected to severely ___ the delivery timelines of the major electronic components.
options: A. expedite
B. alleviate
C. hamper
D. subsidize
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：供應鏈中斷預期會「阻礙 (hamper)」交貨時程。expedite 是加速，alleviate 是減輕，皆不合語意。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Is it true that the entire department is suffering from severe burnout?
B: Unfortunately, yes. The continuous restructuring ___ a highly toxic atmosphere in the workplace.
options: A. to create
B. creates
C. is believed to have created
D. having created
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：句子缺乏主要動詞，C 選項是完整的被動語態與完成式不定詞組合「被認為已經造成了...」，符合句法與語意。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: The new library complex looks completely different from the initial blueprints.
B: The architects ___ the design to adhere to the strict environmental regulations.
options: A. must have altered
B. should alter
C. will have altered
D. might be altering
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：看到完工的建築與藍圖不同，推測建築師「一定更改了」設計，使用 must have + p.p. 表示強烈推測。

normal.desc: 【句子】Due to the drastic shift in global trade policies, multinational corporations ___ their overseas investments for the past few quarters.
options: A. are scaling back
B. scale back
C. have been scaling back
D. will scale back
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：關鍵字為「for the past few quarters」，表示過去幾季以來一直持續的動作，需用現在完成進行式。

normal.desc:
【短文】Trade Journal: The government has been imposing severe embargoes on specific raw materials to protect domestic industries. Consequently, the profit margins of several prominent exporters are proven to have shrunk drastically. The exporters must have relied too heavily on international markets instead of cultivating local demand.
Q: What is true about the prominent exporters according to the journal?
options: A. They have successfully shifted to the domestic market.
B. Their profit margins decreased because of the embargoes.
C. They requested the government to impose the embargoes.
D. They are proven to have avoided financial losses.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：短文提到因為禁運(embargoes)，導致出口商的利潤率(profit margins)大幅縮水(shrunk drastically)。故選 B。

normal.desc:
【短文】Workplace Wellness: Many organizations have been ignoring the early signs of chronic stress among their mid-level managers. This neglect is considered to have accelerated the alarming turnover rate in recent months. The HR executives must have assumed that offering generic wellness apps would be sufficient to prevent burnout.
Q: What mistake did the HR executives likely make?
options: A. They actively fired mid-level managers.
B. They thought simple wellness apps could solve the burnout issue.
C. They spent too much money on psychological counseling.
D. They ignored the turnover rate completely.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：短文最後一句指出，HR高層一定是假定(must have assumed)提供一般的健康應用程式就足以防止職業倦怠，這是他們的錯誤認知。

normal.desc:
【短文】Architectural Digest: The urban renewal project has been transforming the dilapidated waterfront. The massive steel structures are designed to be aesthetically pleasing while resisting coastal corrosion. However, the initial contractors must have utilized inferior alloys, as rust spots are already visible on the main pillars.
Q: Why are rust spots visible on the pillars?
options: A. The waterfront was too dilapidated to repair.
B. The design was aesthetically flawed from the beginning.
C. The initial contractors likely used low-quality metal mixtures.
D. The coastal corrosion was intentionally ignored by the mayor.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中推測 initial contractors must have utilized inferior alloys（一定使用了劣質合金），導致柱子上已經出現生鏽斑點。alloy 即為金屬混合物。

normal.desc:
【短文】Healthcare Bulletin: Public hospitals have been experiencing severe staffing shortages during the winter surge. The excessive patient load is widely acknowledged to have overwhelmed the emergency responders. The regional health board must have failed to anticipate the severity of this year's seasonal influenza.
Q: What is the regional health board criticized for?
options: A. Hiring too many inexperienced emergency responders.
B. Failing to predict how severe the flu season would be.
C. Closing down public hospitals during the winter.
D. Refusing to acknowledge the staffing shortages.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：短文最後指出 health board must have failed to anticipate the severity（一定未能預料到嚴重程度），因此 B 是他們受批評的原因。

normal.desc:
【短文】E-commerce Advisory: The platform has been revising its vendor penalty system to curb counterfeit goods. Accounts found selling fake items are immediately suspended, and the funds are held indefinitely. Honest sellers whose accounts were mistakenly blocked must have triggered the automated security algorithm by accident.
Q: What happens to the money of sellers caught selling fake items?
