D. 建立情感連結被預期能帶來長期的健康福祉
normal.explain: Building emotional resilience is considered to be crucial for long-term well-being. (建立情感韌性被認為對長期的幸福感至關重要。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The psychological assessments are required to be kept strictly confidential.
options: A. 心理評估的結果一直在被嚴密地保護著
B. 心理評估一定是被洩漏給了第三方
C. 心理評估被要求必須嚴格保密
D. 嚴格的保密協定預計會在心理評估後簽署
normal.explain: The psychological assessments are required to be kept strictly confidential. (心理評估被要求必須嚴格保密。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: We have been advocating for a healthier work-life balance.
options: A. 我們預期會有一個更健康的工作與生活平衡
B. 我們一直在提倡更健康的工作與生活平衡
C. 工作與生活的平衡一定已經被徹底打破了
D. 健康的生活方式正在被公司的高層推廣
normal.explain: We have been advocating for a healthier work-life balance. (我們一直在提倡更健康的工作與生活平衡。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The counselor has been providing remote support sessions all morning.
options: A. The counseling room is being renovated right now.
B. Remote support is expected to be canceled entirely.
C. She must be exhausted; let's offer her a coffee break.
D. He must have lost his counseling license.
normal.explain: The counselor has been providing remote support sessions all morning. (諮商師整個上午都在提供遠端支援輔導。) 最適合的回應是 C (她一定累壞了；我們讓她喝杯咖啡休息一下吧。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Early INTERVENTION is strongly recommended to prevent further emotional decline.
options: A. 強烈建議早期介入，以防情緒進一步惡化
B. 早期的介入治療一直被認為是無效的
C. 為了防止情緒惡化，早期干預正在被測試
D. 醫生一定已經建議了提早介入治療
normal.explain: Early intervention is strongly recommended to prevent further emotional decline. (強烈建議早期介入，以防情緒進一步惡化。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The PLUMBING issues in the master bathroom are being resolved.
options: A. 主臥浴室的管線問題正在被解決
B. 我們一直試圖修理主臥浴室的管線
C. 主臥浴室的管線一定是被住戶破壞了
D. 管線問題預期會在主臥浴室的裝修後改善
normal.explain: The plumbing issues in the master bathroom are being resolved. (主臥浴室的管線問題正在被解決。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: I have been trying to fix the leaking faucet since yesterday.
options: A. 漏水的水龍頭一定從昨天就開始出問題了
B. 從昨天開始我就一直試著修理漏水的水龍頭
C. 漏水的水龍頭預計會在昨天前被修好
D. 水龍頭的漏水問題正在被專業水電工處理
normal.explain: I have been trying to fix the leaking faucet since yesterday. (從昨天開始我就一直試著修理漏水的水龍頭。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The previous tenant must have damaged the hardwood floors.
options: A. The floors are being swept by the janitor.
B. I have been damaging the hardwood floors lately.
C. I'll document the scratches so you don't get charged for them.
D. The previous tenant is expected to move in tomorrow.
normal.explain: The previous tenant must have damaged the hardwood floors. (前一個房客一定損壞了木質地板。) 最適合的回應是 C (我會把刮痕記錄下來，這樣你就不會被扣錢。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: An EVICTION notice is slated to be issued if the rent remains unpaid.
options: A. 驅逐通知一定是因為房租未繳而被寄出了
B. 如果不付房租，我們一直都在發送驅逐通知
C. 租金未繳的問題正在透過驅逐程序處理
D. 如果租金仍未繳納，預定將發出驅逐通知
normal.explain: An eviction notice is slated to be issued if the rent remains unpaid. (如果租金仍未繳納，預定將發出驅逐通知。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The security deposit is expected to be returned within thirty days.
options: A. 押金預計會在三十天內退還
B. 押金一定在三十天前就被退還了
C. 我們一直在等押金在三十天內退回
D. 押金的退還程序目前正在被審核中
normal.explain: The security deposit is expected to be returned within thirty days. (押金預計會在三十天內退還。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The neighborhood association has been receiving complaints about the noise.
options: A. 社區管委會一定對這些噪音感到非常不滿
B. 關於噪音的投訴預定會由社區管委會處理
C. 關於噪音的投訴正在被社區管委會審查
D. 社區管委會一直收到關於噪音的投訴
normal.explain: The neighborhood association has been receiving complaints about the noise. (社區管委會一直收到關於噪音的投訴。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The broken window must have been shattered during the heavy storm.
options: A. We should contact maintenance to get it boarded up immediately.
B. The storm is expected to arrive later tonight.
C. I have been breaking the windows on purpose.
D. The window is being washed right now.
normal.explain: The broken window must have been shattered during the heavy storm. (破掉的窗戶一定是在暴風雨中被震碎的。) 最適合的回應是 A (我們應該聯絡維修人員立刻把它釘上木板。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The monthly UTILITIES are required to be paid separately from the rent.
options: A. 租金和水電費一定是一起繳納的
B. 每月的水電費按規定必須與租金分開支付
C. 我們一直將每月水電費與租金分開計算
D. 每月的水電費正在被併入租金的帳單中
normal.explain: The monthly utilities are required to be paid separately from the rent. (每月的水電費按規定必須與租金分開支付。)

normal.desc: 【時態】The humanitarian coalition ___ essential medical supplies to the conflict zone since the border reopened last week.
options: A. has been allocating
B. have allocated
C. allocates
D. will be allocating
normal.explain: 本題測試現在完成進行式。句尾的 since 加上過去時間點，強調從過去持續到現在且可能繼續進行的動作，因此選擇 has been allocating。其他選項時態不符。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The newly constructed refugee camp is anticipated ___ by several international watchdogs next month.
options: A. inspecting
B. to be inspected
C. to inspect
D. having inspected
normal.explain: 本題測試複雜被動語態。is anticipated 後接不定詞，而營地是被視察的對象，故使用被動不定詞 to be inspected。選項 C 為主動式，不符語意。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The relief convoy arrived three hours late. They ___ severe roadblocks along the primary route.
options: A. should have encountered
B. could encounter
C. must have encountered
D. might encounter
normal.explain: 本題測試對過去事實的強烈推測。車隊遲到三小時，推測「當時一定遇到了」嚴重的路障，故選 must have encountered。should have done 是「本應該做（卻未做）」。

normal.desc: 【字彙】To ensure long-term stability, the international committee must ___ more funds to rebuild the local infrastructure.
options: A. revoke
B. simulate
C. diagnose
D. allocate
normal.explain: allocate 意為「分配（資金、資源）」，符合句意。revoke（撤銷）、simulate（模擬）、diagnose（診斷）皆不符合語境。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Has the labor union accepted the new overtime policy?
B: Not at all. They ___ for fair compensation for the past three months.
options: A. campaigned
B. have been campaigning
C. had campaigned
D. will campaign
normal.explain: 對話中 B 回應「過去三個月來他們一直在爭取」，強調動作的持續性，使用現在完成進行式 have been campaigning 最為恰當。

normal.desc: 【句子】The revised labor regulations are expected ___ progressively to avoid disrupting the current manufacturing processes.
options: A. to be implemented
B. being implemented
C. to implement
D. have been implemented
normal.explain: are expected to V 是常見句型，因法規是被執行的，故用被動語態 to be implemented。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: The HR manager looked extremely frustrated after the board meeting.
B: She ___ a rejection regarding the proposed employee welfare program.
options: A. must have received
B. will have received
C. ought to receive
D. might receive
normal.explain: 根據 HR 經理沮喪的神情，強烈推測她「一定收到了」拒絕。must have + V-en 用於對過去事件的肯定推測。

normal.desc: 【句子】Many factory workers filed complaints because their employment contracts were ___ altered without prior consultation.
options: A. collectively
B. unilaterally
C. compassionately
D. sequentially
normal.explain: unilaterally 意為「單方面地」。句意指合約未經協商就被資方單方面更改，導致工人投訴。collectively（集體地）不合邏輯。

normal.desc:
【短文】Legal Advisory: The employment tribunal has been reviewing the mass dismissal case. The termination of over fifty staff members is confirmed to have been executed without adequate notice. The corporation must have violated the fundamental provisions of the Labor Standards Act.
Q: What did the corporation likely fail to do?
options: A. They failed to pay the yearly bonuses.
B. They failed to upgrade the machinery.
C. They failed to provide sufficient notice before firing staff.
D. They failed to hire enough legal advisors.
normal.explain: 短文中提到 The termination... is confirmed to have been executed without adequate notice（解僱在沒有充分通知的情況下執行），因此選項 C 正確。

normal.desc:
【短文】Design Thinking Case Study: Our UX team has been observing how seniors interact with the new health tracking app. The user interface is reported to have confused the majority of the test subjects. The developers must have overlooked the visual impairments common in this demographic when designing the fonts.
Q: What was the main flaw in the app's design process?
options: A. The app required too much storage space.
B. The designers ignored the physical limitations of elderly users.
C. The health tracking metrics were inaccurate.
D. The app was launched behind schedule.
normal.explain: 短文指出 The developers must have overlooked the visual impairments...（開發者一定忽略了該族群常見的視力退化），這屬於忽略了高齡用戶的身體限制（選項 B）。

normal.desc: 【時態】The product design team ___ numerous iterations of the smart glasses to optimize the user experience.
options: A. creates
B. have been creating
C. has been creating
D. is created
normal.explain: 主詞 The product design team 視為單數（或整體），用 has been creating 表示「一直不斷在創造（迭代版本）」。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The revolutionary ergonomic chair is said ___ entirely from recycled marine plastics.
options: A. to be manufactured
B. manufacturing
C. having manufactured
D. manufactures
normal.explain: is said to be + V-en 是一種常見的複雜被動語態句型，意為「據說被製造」。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The prototype failed the stress test spectacularly. The engineers ___ an error in their initial calculations.
options: A. must make
B. should have made
C. could make
D. must have made
normal.explain: 原型在壓力測試中徹底失敗，推測工程師「一定是在初步計算中犯了錯」。對過去的肯定推測用 must have + V-en。

normal.desc: 【字彙】During the brainstorming phase, team members are encouraged to share unconventional ideas without fear of ___.
options: A. ridicule
B. gratitude
C. synergy
D. protocol
normal.explain: ridicule 意為「嘲笑」。設計思考鼓勵分享想法而不必害怕被嘲笑。synergy（綜效）、protocol（草案/協議）皆不符。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: How is the climate summit progressing?
B: The delegates ___ the updated carbon emission thresholds for three consecutive days.
options: A. will debate
B. have been debating
C. are debated
D. debate
normal.explain: for three consecutive days 指出動作持續了三天且仍在進行，需用現在完成進行式 have been debating。

normal.desc: 【句子】The rapid melting of the permafrost is documented ___ an alarming amount of methane into the atmosphere.
options: A. to have released
B. releasing
C. releases
D. having released
normal.explain: is documented to have V-en 表示「有文獻記載已經發生了某事」。融化現象已經釋放了甲烷，故用完成被動不定詞結構。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: The coastal town was completely submerged after the unprecedented tidal surge.
B: The local authorities ___ the severe weather warnings issued last week.
options: A. could ignore
B. must have ignored
C. should ignore
D. would have ignored
normal.explain: 沿海城鎮被淹沒，因此強烈推測當局「一定忽略了」上週發布的警報。must have ignored 表對過去的強烈推測。

normal.desc: 【句子】To transition to a green economy, the government must foster cleaner alternatives and phase out ___ fossil fuels.
options: A. conventional
B. hypothetical
C. superficial
D. recreational
normal.explain: conventional 意為「傳統的、常規的」。phase out conventional fossil fuels 意為逐步淘汰傳統化石燃料，符合氣候科學語境。

normal.desc:
【短文】Climate Update: Meteorologists have been tracking a series of anomalous atmospheric pressure zones. The erratic rainfall pattern is hypothesized to have been driven by these invisible shifts. The agricultural sector must have suffered immense crop losses, as the drought was suddenly followed by torrential floods.
Q: What is believed to be the cause of the erratic rainfall?
options: A. The immense crop losses.
B. The sudden torrential floods.
C. Anomalous atmospheric pressure zones.
D. Over-farming by the agricultural sector.
normal.explain: 短文中提到 The erratic rainfall pattern is hypothesized to have been driven by these invisible shifts（也就是前一句的 anomalous atmospheric pressure zones），因此選 C。

normal.desc:
【短文】Retail Transformation Memo: We have been revamping our physical stores to offer a seamless omnichannel experience. The steep decline in foot traffic is considered to have been catalyzed by the aggressive discounts offered by e-commerce giants. Our legacy competitors must have reacted too slowly to this digital shift, leading to their recent bankruptcies.
Q: According to the memo, why did foot traffic decline?
options: A. E-commerce giants offered aggressive discounts.
B. The physical stores were poorly designed.
C. The competitors filed for bankruptcy.
D. The omnichannel experience was too confusing.
normal.explain: 文章指出 decline in foot traffic is considered to have been catalyzed by the aggressive discounts offered by e-commerce giants（因電商巨頭的激進折扣而加速），故選 A。

normal.desc: 【時態】The major retail chain ___ automated checkout kiosks in all its flagship stores to reduce wait times.
options: A. to install
B. has been installing
C. have been installing
D. installs
normal.explain: The major retail chain 是單數名詞，表示一個持續進行的動作（近期一直在安裝），用 has been installing 最適合。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The outdated inventory management software is scheduled ___ by a cloud-based AI system this weekend.
options: A. to replace
B. replacing
C. to be replaced
D. replaced
normal.explain: is scheduled to be + V-en，軟體「被取代」，故用被動不定詞 to be replaced。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The exclusive sneakers sold out within three minutes online. The marketing campaign ___ a massive success.
options: A. should have been
B. could be
C. must be
D. must have been
normal.explain: 鞋子在三分鐘內賣光（過去式），推測當時的行銷活動「一定是」巨大的成功，對過去的推測用 must have been。

normal.desc: 【字彙】By integrating augmented reality into the shopping app, the brand provides a highly ___ experience for its users.
options: A. immersive
B. passive
C. disruptive
D. deceptive
normal.explain: immersive 意為「沉浸式的」。AR（擴增實境）提供使用者高度沉浸式的體驗。disruptive（破壞性的）與語境不完全契合。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Has the aid organization finished rebuilding the local hospital?
B: Not quite. They ___ the structural integrity of the damaged wings for the last few weeks.
options: A. assessed
B. are assessing
C. have been assessing
D. will assess
normal.explain: for the last few weeks 表示從過去持續到現在的動作，使用現在完成進行式 have been assessing。

normal.desc: 【句子】The misappropriation of humanitarian funds is alleged ___ by several high-ranking officials who recently resigned.
options: A. orchestrating
B. to have been orchestrated
C. to orchestrate
D. having orchestrated
normal.explain: is alleged to have been V-en 是複雜被動語態，意為「據稱過去已被...策劃」。資金挪用是被策劃的，且動作發生在過去，故選 B。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: The labor inspector found multiple safety violations in the warehouse.
B: The site manager ___ the mandatory safety drills entirely.
options: A. must have bypassed
B. would bypass
C. can bypass
D. should have bypassed
normal.explain: 基於檢查員發現多處違規，強烈推測經理「一定略過了」強制性的安全演習，用 must have bypassed。

normal.desc: 【句子】To protect freelancers, the new legislation introduces stricter penalties for companies that deliberately delay ___.
options: A. compensation
B. correlation
C. segregation
D. ventilation
normal.explain: compensation 在此指「薪酬、報酬」。delay compensation 意為拖欠薪酬，符合勞動法規的主題。

normal.desc:
【短文】Workplace Safety Bulletin: The union has been negotiating for better protective gear since January. The recent chemical spill in Sector 4 is reported to have severely injured three operators. The factory owners must have ignored previous warnings regarding the deteriorating storage tanks.
Q: What did the factory owners likely do wrong?
options: A. They negotiated the contracts unfairly.
B. They intentionally spilled chemicals in Sector 4.
C. They dismissed prior warnings about the faulty tanks.
D. They provided the union with substandard gear.
normal.explain: 文中寫道 The factory owners must have ignored previous warnings regarding the deteriorating storage tanks，因此選項 C（dismissed = ignored）為正確答案。

normal.desc:
【短文】Innovation Review: Our design team has been experimenting with bio-degradable packaging materials. The traditional plastic wrap is proven to have contributed massively to landfill overflow. Earlier iterations of the eco-packaging must have lacked durability, as customers frequently complained about tears during shipping.
Q: Why did customers complain about the earlier eco-packaging?
options: A. It was too expensive to ship.
B. It was harmful to the environment.
C. It tore easily during transit.
D. It was difficult to open.
normal.explain: 文中提到 must have lacked durability, as customers frequently complained about tears during shipping（缺乏耐用度，運送中常破裂），對應選項 C。

normal.desc: 【時態】The lead architect ___ a novel blueprint that emphasizes both functionality and aesthetic appeal for months.
options: A. drafted
B. drafts
C. is drafting
D. has been drafting
normal.explain: 句尾有 for months，表示動作從過去持續到現在，因此選現在完成進行式 has been drafting。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The controversial aesthetic choices in the new app update are considered ___ by younger users.
options: A. to be embraced
B. embracing
C. to embrace
D. embraced
normal.explain: are considered to be V-en 表示「被認為被（某人）...」。設計選擇「被」年輕用戶擁抱（接受），故選被動態 to be embraced。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The user retention rate skyrocketed after the interface redesign. The UX team ___ a major pain point.
options: A. must solve
B. must have solved
C. should solve
D. ought to have solved
normal.explain: 留存率飆升，推測 UX 團隊「一定解決了」某個主要痛點。對過去事實的肯定推測用 must have + V-en。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The latest climate models predict a significant increase in the frequency of extreme weather ___ over the next decade.
options: A. phenomena
B. portfolios
C. prototypes
D. premises
normal.explain: phenomena 意為「現象（複數）」。extreme weather phenomena（極端氣候現象）符合語境。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Are the oceanographers still studying the coral bleaching?
B: Yes, they ___ the rising sea surface temperatures in the Pacific since early 2020.
options: A. monitor
B. monitored
C. have been monitoring
D. will be monitored
normal.explain: since early 2020 提示動作從過去持續至今，選用現在完成進行式 have been monitoring。

normal.desc: 【句子】The unprecedented depletion of the ozone layer was proven ___ by the widespread use of certain industrial chemicals.
options: A. triggering
B. to trigger
C. to have been triggered
D. having triggered
normal.explain: 消耗（depletion）是「被觸發」的，且觸發動作發生在「被證明」之前，故用完成被動不定詞 to have been triggered。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: The department store's profit margin dropped drastically this quarter.
B: The management ___ the impact of the new online shopping trend.
options: A. must have underestimated
B. should have underestimated
C. might underestimate
D. could underestimate
normal.explain: 利潤大幅下降，推測管理層「一定低估了」網購趨勢的影響。must have underestimated 表示對過去事實的強烈推斷。

normal.desc: 【句子】To remain competitive, brick-and-mortar stores must develop innovative strategies to enhance customer ___ and loyalty.
options: A. negligence
B. retention
C. obstruction
D. deterioration
normal.explain: retention 意為「保留、留存」。customer retention 即「顧客留存率」，為零售業重要指標。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The compensation policy is being thoroughly reviewed by the legal department.
options: A. 法務部門正在全面審查賠償政策。
B. 法律顧問已經批准了這項補償方案。
C. 賠償金正被法務部暫時扣留。
D. 政策部門要求法務部重新起草合約。

normal.explain: 原句：建築圖紙正在由城市的區劃委員會評估。選項A「我希望他們能趕快批准許可」最符合情境。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: I have been reviewing the manuscript, and the character arcs are fascinating.
options: A. 我一直在審閱這份手稿，而角色發展非常迷人。
B. 我拒絕了這份手稿，因為角色的設定太無聊了。
C. 這份手稿的角色設定正在被作者大幅修改。
D. 我覺得這本小說的手稿完全沒有任何亮點。
normal.explain: 英文原句意為「我一直在審閱這份手稿，而且角色曲線（發展）很迷人。」（have been reviewing：一直在審閱）。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The delay was beyond our control.
options: A. 我們故意拖延了進度。
B. 我們完全掌控了延誤時間。
C. 我們已取消整個計畫。
D. 延誤不是我們能控制的。
boss.explain: beyond our control 指超出控制範圍，沒有表示取消計畫。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: Unless we hear otherwise, we will proceed as planned.
options: A. 若未收到不同指示，我們會照原計畫進行。
B. 只有收到不同指示才會照原計畫進行。
C. 我們已決定無條件取消計畫。
D. 我們不會理會任何後續指示。
boss.explain: unless 是「除非」，otherwise 指不同消息或指示。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: We have been assured that no jobs will be lost, although the details of the restructuring have yet to be announced.
options: A. 公司已公布每個職位的調動細節。
B. 已獲不裁員的保證，但重組細節仍未公布。
C. 重組細節已公布，並確定裁掉所有員工。
D. 說話者保證重組永遠不會發生。
boss.explain: have been assured 是收到保證，have yet to be announced 是尚未公布。

boss.desc: 【語氣】Which reply accepts an invitation while making attendance conditional on finishing a report?
options: A. I would love to come, even if I never finish the report.
B. I cannot come because the report is already finished.
C. I will come instead of finishing the report.
D. I would love to come, provided I finish the report.
boss.explain: provided 表示「只要」，保留出席條件；其他選項取消條件、拒絕出席或選擇不寫報告。

boss.desc: 【推論】A supplier says the shipment is unlikely to arrive before Friday. Which statement preserves that degree of certainty?
options: A. Arrival before Friday is possible but not expected.
B. Arrival before Friday is completely impossible.
C. Arrival on Friday is guaranteed.
D. Arrival before Friday is more likely than not.
boss.explain: unlikely 是機率低而非不可能，也沒有保證週五到貨。

boss.desc: 【短文】An online course reports that its graduates earn more than non-graduates. Yet applicants already had above-average salaries before enrolling. Which concern most directly challenges the implied benefit?
options: A. Graduates necessarily worked fewer hours.
B. The salary difference may predate participation in the course.
C. The course must have lowered every graduate’s salary.
D. Non-graduates cannot learn online.
boss.explain: 入學前薪資差異可能造成結果，不能直接把較高薪資歸因於課程；其他敘述都沒有證據。

boss.desc: 請唸出：仔細檢視後
boss.speak: on closer inspection
boss.explain: 口說表達「ON CLOSER INSPECTION」(phr.)：仔細檢視後。例句：On closer inspection, the seal was damaged.（仔細檢視後，發現封條已破損。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：仍有很大的改善空間
boss.ans: THERE IS CONSIDERABLE ROOM FOR IMPROVEMENT
boss.speak: there is considerable room for improvement
boss.vocabId: R6:THERE IS CONSIDERABLE ROOM FOR IMPROVEMENT
boss.explain: 口說表達「THERE IS CONSIDERABLE ROOM FOR IMPROVEMENT」(phr.)：仍有很大的改善空間。例句：There is considerable room for improvement.（仍有很大的改善空間。）

boss.desc: 填空題：C O N T I _ G E N C Y (可能發生而須預作準備的意外情況)
boss.speak: contingency
boss.explain: CONTINGENCY (n.)：可能發生而須預作準備的意外情況。填空答案為「N」。例句：We discussed a contingency plan for heavy rain.（我們討論大雨備案。）

boss.desc: 填空題：R E P _ R C _ S S _ O N (事件帶來的間接負面後果)
boss.speak: repercussion
boss.explain: REPERCUSSION (n.)：事件帶來的間接負面後果。填空答案為「EUI」。例句：One unforeseen repercussion was a loss of trust.（一個未預見的負面後果是信任流失。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: We can hold the room for you until tomorrow afternoon.
options: A. 我們可以替你保留房間到明天下午。
B. 你必須在明天下午前搬出已入住的房間。
C. 房間要到下個月才會完工。
D. 你已經預付了全部房費。
boss.explain: hold the room 是暫時保留訂房機會，沒有說已付款或必須退房。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: I had been looking forward to the concert, so finding out it had been cancelled was a real letdown.
options: A. 演唱會只是延期，日期已經確定。
B. 因原本很期待演唱會，得知取消令說話者失望。
C. 說話者原本就不想參加，因此很高興取消。
D. 說話者直到演出結束才知道有演唱會。
boss.explain: look forward to 是期待，letdown 是令人失望的事；cancelled 不等於已確定延期。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: If we had booked the direct service, we would not be changing trains now, but at least we saved a fair amount.
options: A. 說話者正在討論明年才可能發生的行程。
B. 說話者認為轉乘和票價都與訂票選擇無關。
C. 選了較便宜的轉乘路線，現在得換車，但省了不少錢。
D. 訂了直達車，所以現在不用換車且費用較低。
boss.explain: 混合條件句把過去未選直達與現在轉乘連起來；at least 保留省錢這個好處。

boss.desc: 【搭配詞】The union and management finally reached a ___ after weeks of negotiation.
options: A. compromise
B. compression
C. comparison
D. composition
boss.explain: reach a compromise 是達成妥協；其餘分別是壓縮、比較及構成或作品。

boss.desc: 【文法】The museum opened ten years ago. By the time it closes for renovation next June, it ___ visitors for eleven years.
options: A. would have welcoming
B. will have welcomed
C. will welcome
D. has been welcomed
boss.explain: By...next June 設定未來完成的時間點，用 will have＋過去分詞；museum 是接待者，不是被接待者。

boss.desc: 【短文】A restaurant says its menu is seasonal. When a customer complains that a favourite dish has disappeared, the owner explains that its main ingredient is no longer locally available. Which response follows the restaurant’s stated approach?
options: A. Claiming that seasonal menus must contain only cold food.
B. Removing all local ingredients from future menus.
C. Offering a different dish made with ingredients currently available locally.
D. Promising to serve every dish unchanged throughout the year.
boss.explain: 隨季節與當地食材調整菜單，提供當季替代菜色符合原則；不是全年固定不變。

boss.desc: 請唸出：在你方便時儘早
boss.speak: at your earliest convenience
boss.explain: 口說表達「AT YOUR EARLIEST CONVENIENCE」(phr.)：在你方便時儘早。例句：Please return the form at your earliest convenience.（請在方便時儘早交回表格。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：保存這棟建物仍是我們最優先的事
boss.ans: PRESERVING THE BUILDING REMAINS OUR OVERRIDING PRIORITY
boss.speak: preserving the building remains our overriding priority
boss.vocabId: R6:PRESERVING THE BUILDING REMAINS OUR OVERRIDING PRIORITY
boss.explain: 口說表達「PRESERVING THE BUILDING REMAINS OUR OVERRIDING PRIORITY」(phr.)：保存這棟建物仍是我們最優先的事。例句：Preserving the building remains our overriding priority.（保存這棟建物仍是我們最優先的事。）

boss.desc: 填空題：R E C I P _ O C I T Y (相互給予或回應的互惠原則)
boss.speak: reciprocity
boss.explain: RECIPROCITY (n.)：相互給予或回應的互惠原則。填空答案為「R」。例句：The exchange programme operates on the principle of reciprocity.（這項交流計畫依互惠原則運作。）

boss.desc: 填空題：R E F _ R B _ S H _ E N T (建築或設備的翻新整修)
boss.speak: refurbishment
boss.explain: REFURBISHMENT (n.)：建築或設備的翻新整修。填空答案為「UIM」。例句：The theatre closed temporarily for refurbishment.（劇院因翻新整修而暫時關閉。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The update is designed to address the issue, not merely hide it.
options: A. 更新的唯一作用是隱藏使用者姓名。
B. 更新是為了解決問題，而不只是把它藏起來。
C. 更新只會把問題藏起來，而且沒有其他目的。
D. 問題已不存在，所以不需要更新。
boss.explain: address the issue 是處理問題；not merely 表示不只停留在掩蓋。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The new tool saves time on routine tasks, although checking the results still requires human judgement.
options: A. 人工檢查只會讓所有結果變錯。
B. 工具只能用來測量人類反應時間。
C. 工具能省下例行工作的時間，但檢查結果仍需人工判斷。
D. 工具已完全取代任何人工判斷。
boss.explain: although 保留人工驗證需求；save time 不等於免除責任或判斷。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The screenshot may be genuine, but without the surrounding conversation we cannot be sure what the message was responding to.
options: A. 截圖真實就能保證所有解讀都正確。
B. 缺少前後文足以證明截圖是偽造的。
C. 我們已經完整掌握對話中的每個細節。
D. 截圖可能是真的，但缺少前後文就難以確定訊息回應的是什麼。
boss.explain: 區分影像真實性與語境完整性；缺脈絡不直接證明造假。

boss.desc: 【搭配詞】Please ___ your sources before sharing a claim that could affect other people’s decisions.
options: A. amplify
B. verify
C. notify
D. satisfy
boss.explain: verify 是核實；notify 通知、satisfy 滿足、amplify 放大均不合此目的。

boss.desc: 【推測】The file was encrypted, and only Mara had the key. If someone read it without asking her, they ___ another way to access it.
options: A. will have been finding
B. are finding
C. must have found
D. must find
boss.explain: 已讀取是過去事件，根據線索推測應用 must have found；不表達現在或未來。

boss.desc: 【短文】An article links to an original study, but its headline replaces a possible association with a claim of proven cause. Why should the reader check the study itself?
options: A. Linking to a study guarantees that every headline is accurate.
B. A possible association always proves a direct cause.
C. The original study must reach the opposite conclusion to the headline.
D. The headline may overstate what the research supports.
boss.explain: possible association 與 proven cause 的證據強度不同；需要核對，不能先斷定原研究一定相反。

boss.desc: 請唸出：帶有若干保留地
boss.speak: with certain reservations
boss.explain: 口說表達「WITH CERTAIN RESERVATIONS」(phr.)：帶有若干保留地。例句：I recommend the service with certain reservations.（我帶著若干保留推薦這項服務。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：這項建議取決於你的具體需求
boss.ans: THE RECOMMENDATION DEPENDS ON YOUR PARTICULAR REQUIREMENTS
boss.speak: the recommendation depends on your particular requirements
boss.vocabId: R6:THE RECOMMENDATION DEPENDS ON YOUR PARTICULAR REQUIREMENTS
boss.explain: 口說表達「THE RECOMMENDATION DEPENDS ON YOUR PARTICULAR REQUIREMENTS」(phr.)：這項建議取決於你的具體需求。例句：The recommendation depends on your particular requirements.（這項建議取決於你的具體需求。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：容易受攻擊或傷害的弱點（V 開頭，13 個字母）
boss.speak: vulnerability
boss.explain: VULNERABILITY (n.)：容易受攻擊或傷害的弱點。例句：The update fixes a vulnerability in the software.（這次更新修補軟體中的一個漏洞。）

boss.desc: 填空題：V E R _ F I _ A T _ O N (核對說法或資料是否正確的過程)
boss.speak: verification
boss.explain: VERIFICATION (n.)：核對說法或資料是否正確的過程。填空答案為「ICI」。例句：Independent verification is needed before publication.（發表前需要獨立查證。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The plan is ambitious, but we need to be realistic about the resources available.
options: A. 資源已確定足以完成任何目標。
B. 說話者主張立即取消所有計畫。
C. 計畫有企圖心，但必須務實看待可用資源。
D. 只要計畫夠大，就不需要考慮資源。
boss.explain: ambitious 與 realistic 的對照保留目標，也提出資源限制。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The trees were planted to provide shade, although it will be years before they make a noticeable difference.
options: A. 樹木種下當天就已提供完整遮蔭。
B. 因為無法立即遮蔭，所有樹木已被移除。
C. 種樹的唯一目的是測量時間。
D. 種樹是為了遮蔭，但要多年後才有明顯效果。
boss.explain: 目的與見效時程分開表達，沒有說計畫已取消。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: I would welcome the improvement, but only if the households most affected by the work have a genuine say in how it is carried out.
options: A. 我願支持改善，但條件是受影響最大的住戶能實際參與執行方式的決定。
B. 只要宣布工程，住戶就不需要再表達意見。
C. 我反對讓任何住戶參與。
D. 受影響最大的住戶已獲准單獨決定一切。
boss.explain: only if 明示必要條件；genuine say 是實質發言權，非單獨掌控所有決策。

boss.desc: 【搭配詞】The housing proposal met with strong ___ from people concerned about traffic.
options: A. oppose
B. opposing it
C. opposition
D. oppositionally
boss.explain: met with strong opposition 是遭遇強烈反對，此處需名詞。

boss.desc: 【推測】The river was clear yesterday but muddy after the overnight storm. The rain ___ soil into it.
options: A. may wash tomorrow
B. is to wash
C. has washing
D. may have washed
boss.explain: 對過去原因作可能性推測用 may have＋過去分詞；沒有把可能原因說成確證。

boss.desc: 【短文】A refill shop counts every reused bottle as one disposable bottle avoided. Some customers previously used tap water and bought no bottles. What could make the reported saving too large?
options: A. Assuming all refills replace purchases that would otherwise have occurred.
B. Counting only customers who had previously bought bottled products.
C. Separating new customers from existing bottle users.
D. Checking what customers used before visiting the shop.
boss.explain: 未有原本購買行為就不能當成替代了購買；後三項反而有助釐清估計。

boss.desc: 請唸出：數量有限的資源
boss.speak: a finite resource
boss.explain: 口說表達「A FINITE RESOURCE」(phr.)：數量有限的資源。例句：Clean water is a finite resource in this region.（在這個地區，乾淨用水是有限資源。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：短期節省可能造成長期問題
boss.ans: SHORT TERM SAVINGS MAY CREATE LASTING PROBLEMS
boss.speak: short term savings may create lasting problems
boss.vocabId: R6:SHORT TERM SAVINGS MAY CREATE LASTING PROBLEMS
boss.explain: 口說表達「SHORT TERM SAVINGS MAY CREATE LASTING PROBLEMS」(phr.)：短期節省可能造成長期問題。例句：Short term savings may create lasting problems.（短期節省可能造成長期問題。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：價格在可負擔範圍內的程度（A 開頭，13 個字母）
boss.speak: affordability
boss.explain: AFFORDABILITY (n.)：價格在可負擔範圍內的程度。例句：Affordability matters alongside the quality of housing.（住房品質之外，可負擔程度也很重要。）

boss.desc: 填空題：I N F _ A S T _ U C _ U R E (交通供水等支撐社會運作的基礎設施)
boss.speak: infrastructure
boss.explain: INFRASTRUCTURE (n.)：交通供水等支撐社會運作的基礎設施。填空答案為「RRT」。例句：The town needs more resilient infrastructure.（城鎮需要更能承受衝擊的基礎設施。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: You do not have to understand every word to follow the main argument.
options: A. 不懂每個字就一定無法理解任何內容。
B. 只要懂一個字就必定掌握所有細節。
C. 課程不會提供任何字彙說明。
D. 掌握主要論點不一定需要懂每個字。
boss.explain: do not have to 是否定必要性，不保證完全不需字彙知識。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The deadline can be extended in exceptional circumstances, but you should not assume that an extension is automatic.
options: A. 特殊情況可延期，但不能當成自動獲准。
B. 所有人不必申請就一定能延期。
C. 任何特殊情況都不允許延期。
D. 延期已被批准且不需要再確認。
boss.explain: can 表可能獲准，not automatic 表仍有條件或程序。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: It is tempting to choose the familiar expression, but the question is testing whether it suits this particular relationship between the speakers.
options: A. 本題只測拼字，完全不涉及使用情境。
B. 熟悉表達容易讓人想選，但本題考的是它是否適合說話者關係。
C. 最熟悉的說法在每種關係中都最恰當。
D. 說話者之間的關係不會影響語氣。
boss.explain: familiarity 與 appropriateness 不同，語域取決於關係。

boss.desc: 【搭配詞】The course aims to bridge the ___ between theoretical knowledge and practical use.
options: A. gasp
B. grip
C. glimpse
D. gap
boss.explain: bridge the gap 是縮小差距；其餘詞不表理論與實務間的落差。

boss.desc: 【句意】The instructor distinguished memorising a rule from knowing when to apply it. What distinction is made?
options: A. Recalling information is different from using it appropriately.
B. Memorising always prevents any later application.
C. Rules can only be used by people unable to recall them.
D. Appropriate use never requires knowledge of a rule.
boss.explain: 記住規則與依情境使用不同；沒有主張兩者互斥。

boss.desc: 【短文】A school compares this year’s average score with last year’s, but this year’s test used shorter texts and allowed more time. What should be considered before attributing the rise to improved teaching?
options: A. A higher average guarantees that each student improved.
B. The changes to the assessment may have affected the scores.
C. Shorter texts always test a more advanced skill.
D. More time proves that students studied less.
boss.explain: 測驗條件同時改變，不能直接把平均提升單獨歸因於教學。

boss.desc: 請唸出：短期內需要學習很多內容的過程
boss.speak: a steep learning curve
boss.explain: 口說表達「A STEEP LEARNING CURVE」(phr.)：短期內需要學習很多內容的過程。例句：The new role involves a steep learning curve.（新職務需要在短期內學會很多內容。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：熟悉不應被誤當成精熟
boss.ans: FAMILIARITY SHOULD NOT BE MISTAKEN FOR MASTERY
boss.speak: familiarity should not be mistaken for mastery
boss.vocabId: R6:FAMILIARITY SHOULD NOT BE MISTAKEN FOR MASTERY
boss.explain: 口說表達「FAMILIARITY SHOULD NOT BE MISTAKEN FOR MASTERY」(phr.)：熟悉不應被誤當成精熟。例句：Familiarity should not be mistaken for mastery.（熟悉不應被誤當成精熟。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：對自己的思考與學習過程的覺察（M 開頭，13 個字母）
boss.speak: metacognition
boss.explain: METACOGNITION (n.)：對自己的思考與學習過程的覺察。例句：The activity encourages metacognition about study habits.（活動鼓勵覺察自己的學習習慣。）

boss.desc: 填空題：M I S _ O N _ E P _ I O N (對某事形成的錯誤理解)
boss.speak: misconception
boss.explain: MISCONCEPTION (n.)：對某事形成的錯誤理解。填空答案為「CCT」。例句：The discussion revealed a common misconception.（討論揭露了一項常見誤解。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The story works better when it trusts the audience to make the connection.
options: A. 故事讓觀眾自行建立關聯時效果更好。
B. 故事只有把每個暗示都直接解說才有效。
C. 觀眾不應試著理解故事中的關聯。
D. 故事必須先證明所有觀眾彼此認識。
boss.explain: trust the audience 表相信觀眾的理解能力。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The character is sympathetic without being particularly admirable.
options: A. 說話者認為同情和欽佩必定相同。
B. 角色讓人能同情，卻未必值得欽佩。
C. 角色受到欽佩，但完全無法引起同情。
D. 角色因沒有缺點而讓人同情。
boss.explain: sympathetic 與 admirable 是不同評價，不能混同。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The quotation is accurate, but removing the next sentence makes it sound like the author supports a view she immediately goes on to question.
options: A. 作者在下一句更強烈支持同一觀點。
B. 只要引文字面正確，前後文就永遠不影響意思。
C. 引文文字正確，但刪掉下一句後，作者被誤呈現為支持隨即遭她質疑的觀點。
D. 引文本身每個字都已被改寫。
boss.explain: 準確摘字不保證立場呈現準確，後句改變論述功能。

boss.desc: 【文法】By the end of the opening chapter, the narrator ___ three times without explaining why.
options: A. has disappeared
B. have disappeared
C. is disappeared by
D. has disappearing
boss.explain: 主詞單數 narrator 配 has＋過去分詞；題幹以閱讀進程中的現在觀點描述。

boss.desc: 【短文】A review praises the actors but says the dialogue repeatedly explains feelings the performances already convey. What is the criticism?
options: A. The reviewer objects to the presence of any dialogue.
B. The script supplies explanations that the acting has made unnecessary.
C. The actors fail to express the characters’ feelings.
D. The dialogue and acting communicate unrelated stories.
boss.explain: already convey 表演已傳達，重複說明可能多餘；未否定所有對白。

boss.desc: 【短文】A comedy repeatedly lets viewers know something the main character does not. When he confidently acts on his mistaken belief, the audience anticipates the problem. What creates the effect?
options: A. The story withholds every relevant fact from the audience.
B. The character accurately predicts every consequence.
C. The audience’s knowledge exceeds the character’s.
D. The audience and character are given identical information at every moment.
boss.explain: 觀眾知道而角色不知的資訊落差製造戲劇效果。

boss.desc: 請唸出：反覆出現的意象
boss.speak: a recurring image
boss.explain: 口說表達「A RECURRING IMAGE」(phr.)：反覆出現的意象。例句：The empty chair is a recurring image in the film.（空椅子是電影反覆出現的意象。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：引文需要放回前後文中閱讀
boss.ans: THE QUOTATION NEEDS TO BE READ IN CONTEXT
boss.speak: the quotation needs to be read in context
boss.vocabId: R6:THE QUOTATION NEEDS TO BE READ IN CONTEXT
boss.explain: 口說表達「THE QUOTATION NEEDS TO BE READ IN CONTEXT」(phr.)：引文需要放回前後文中閱讀。例句：The quotation needs to be read in context.（引文需要放回前後文中閱讀。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：以形象或事物表達更深意思的手法（S 開頭，9 個字母）
boss.speak: symbolism
boss.explain: SYMBOLISM (n.)：以形象或事物表達更深意思的手法。例句：The critic discusses the symbolism of the locked door.（評論者討論鎖門的象徵意義。）

boss.desc: 填空題：N A _ R _ T _ V E (將事件組織成故事的敘述)
boss.speak: narrative
boss.explain: NARRATIVE (n.)：將事件組織成故事的敘述。填空答案為「RAI」。例句：The narrative moves between past and present.（敘事在過去與現在之間移動。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: I can take that on, as long as we agree which of my current tasks can wait.
options: A. 我只在要求把新工作永久取消。
B. 只要先說定哪些現有工作能延後，我就能接下來。
C. 我已無條件答應同時完成所有工作。
D. 我拒絕討論任何現有工作的安排。
boss.explain: 接新任務以重新安排優先順序為條件。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The request sounds reasonable in isolation, but we need to consider what happens if every department asks for the same exception.
options: A. 所有部門目前都已提出完全相同申請。
B. 任何例外都被說話者視為不合理。
C. 單看要求似乎合理，但還得考量各部門都要求同一例外的影響。
D. 要求因來自單一部門就已自動獲准。
boss.explain: in isolation 對照全局與先例效果，沒有預設已普遍發生。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: It is not that I doubt your judgement; I need a record of the reasoning so that the decision can be explained to people who were not in the room.
options: A. 我要求紀錄是因已證明你的決定不誠實。
B. 只要有與會者就不必再對外說明。
C. 我只需要名單，不需要任何推理內容。
D. 我不是質疑你的判斷，而是需要理由紀錄，以便向未與會者解釋。
boss.explain: 明確區分信任個人與可說明、可追溯的決策需求。

boss.desc: 【語域】Which reply asks for clarification without rejecting the request?
options: A. You should not have asked me in the first place.
B. Could you clarify which part you would like me to prioritise?
C. I am refusing to do any part of this task.
D. There is nothing to clarify, and I have already finished.
boss.explain: clarify 與 prioritise 詢問工作範圍與順序，未直接拒絕。

boss.desc: 【句意】The approval applies to the trial period only. Which interpretation respects the limit?
options: A. The trial cannot take place under any circumstances.
B. Approval automatically applies to every future project.
C. Permission for the trial does not by itself authorise permanent use.
D. Permanent use has already been approved.
boss.explain: only 限定核准範圍，不可延伸為永久授權。

boss.desc: 【短文】Two suppliers offer the same price. One promises delivery in three days; the other gives a seven-day deadline with compensation if it is missed. The buyer values an enforceable commitment. What distinction matters?
options: A. The cheaper supplier has necessarily offered the stronger guarantee.
B. The three-day promise proves delivery will happen sooner.
C. Compensation removes every possible consequence of delay.
D. A target delivery time is different from a deadline backed by a stated remedy.
boss.explain: 買方關切承諾及未履行補救，不是僅比較較短天數。此為虛構合約語境。

boss.desc: 請唸出：在約定範圍之內
boss.speak: within the agreed scope
boss.explain: 口說表達「WITHIN THE AGREED SCOPE」(phr.)：在約定範圍之內。例句：The revision remains within the agreed scope.（修訂仍在約定範圍之內。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：彈性不會取消負責的必要
boss.ans: FLEXIBILITY DOES NOT REMOVE THE NEED FOR ACCOUNTABILITY
boss.speak: flexibility does not remove the need for accountability
boss.vocabId: R6:FLEXIBILITY DOES NOT REMOVE THE NEED FOR ACCOUNTABILITY
boss.explain: 口說表達「FLEXIBILITY DOES NOT REMOVE THE NEED FOR ACCOUNTABILITY」(phr.)：彈性不會取消負責的必要。例句：Flexibility does not remove the need for accountability.（彈性不會取消負責的必要。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：使不同人或活動互相配合的協調（C 開頭，12 個字母）
boss.speak: coordination
boss.explain: COORDINATION (n.)：使不同人或活動互相配合的協調。例句：The game develops coordination.（遊戲培養協調能力。）

boss.desc: 填空題：C O _ M I _ M _ N T (願意履行的承諾或投入)
boss.speak: commitment
boss.explain: COMMITMENT (n.)：願意履行的承諾或投入。填空答案為「MTE」。例句：They noticed that his commitment to the team had increased significantly.（他們注意到他對團隊的投入顯著增加了。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: I appreciate the invitation, but I would rather keep the weekend free.
options: A. 我要求你取消自己的週末安排。
B. 我認為邀請本身是不禮貌的。
C. 我感謝邀請，但比較想保留週末空檔。
D. 我已答應週末全程出席。
boss.explain: 感謝與婉拒可以並存，would rather 表偏好。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: She may have sounded abrupt, but I do not think she intended to be unkind.
options: A. 她已承認故意冒犯所有人。
B. 只要語氣生硬就能確定惡意。
C. 說話者沒有注意到任何語氣差異。
D. 她聽來可能生硬，但我不認為她有意不友善。
boss.explain: 區分可觀察語氣與對意圖的推論。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: What I need is not another assurance that you meant well, but a clearer agreement about what will happen differently next time.
options: A. 我需要的不是再次保證出於好意，而是說清楚下次會怎樣改變。
B. 我只想知道你是否有好意，不在乎後續做法。
C. 我已拒絕討論任何下一次安排。
D. 我認為說清楚具體做法就能保證永不出錯。
boss.explain: 要求由動機保證移向具體行動安排，未保證零失誤。

boss.desc: 【字彙】Which adjective means confident in expressing a view without being aggressive?
options: A. indecisive
B. submissive
C. assertive
D. secretive
boss.explain: assertive 指有自信清楚表達立場，與攻擊性不同。

boss.desc: 【短文】A neighbour says visitors are welcome, but asks that shared doors not be left open. Which action meets both parts of the message?
options: A. Treat the message as a ban on all visitors.
B. Leave every door open to show visitors are welcome.
C. Assume visitors may ignore all shared arrangements.
D. Invite visitors while keeping the shared doors closed when unattended.
boss.explain: 歡迎訪客不代表取消公共出入口的要求。

boss.desc: 【短文】A flatmate agrees to quiet hours after ten but uses headphones only for music, leaving loud calls on speaker. What needs to be clarified?
options: A. Whether quiet hours apply to the noise produced, not merely to one source of it.
B. Whether headphones can ever play music.
C. Whether the clock has been set to another time zone.
D. Whether quiet hours automatically end after one agreement.
boss.explain: 安靜要求應釐清涵蓋各類噪音，而非只針對音樂設備。

boss.desc: 請唸出：事先已有的承諾或安排
boss.speak: a prior commitment
boss.explain: 口說表達「A PRIOR COMMITMENT」(phr.)：事先已有的承諾或安排。例句：I cannot attend because of a prior commitment.（我因先前安排無法出席。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：清楚拒絕比不可靠的安慰更體貼
boss.ans: A CLEAR REFUSAL IS KINDER THAN UNRELIABLE REASSURANCE
boss.speak: a clear refusal is kinder than unreliable reassurance
boss.vocabId: R6:A CLEAR REFUSAL IS KINDER THAN UNRELIABLE REASSURANCE
boss.explain: 口說表達「A CLEAR REFUSAL IS KINDER THAN UNRELIABLE REASSURANCE」(phr.)：清楚拒絕比不可靠的安慰更體貼。例句：A clear refusal is kinder than unreliable reassurance.（清楚拒絕比不可靠的安慰更體貼。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：回應對方的感情善意或協助（R 開頭，11 個字母）
boss.speak: reciprocate
boss.explain: RECIPROCATE (v.)：回應對方的感情善意或協助。例句：He felt obliged to reciprocate the favour.（他覺得應回報人情。）

boss.desc: 填空題：R E _ O _ C _ L E (使衝突的人事或觀點重新相容)
boss.speak: reconcile
boss.explain: RECONCILE (v.)：使衝突的人事或觀點重新相容。填空答案為「CNI」。例句：They tried to reconcile their different expectations.（他們試著調和不同期待。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: We can change the booking, but the difference in fare will still apply.
options: A. 改訂已保證所有費用完全相同。
B. 票價差額會使改訂在任何情況都不可能。
C. 只有取消旅程才可保留原訂位。
D. 可以改訂，但仍須處理票價差額。
boss.explain: 能變更不代表免除差價。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The alternative is slightly longer on paper, but it avoids a transfer that often causes problems.
options: A. 替代路線表定稍長，但避開常出問題的轉乘。
B. 表定稍長就代表實際上必然更慢。
C. 替代路線增加了同一個麻煩轉乘。
D. 說話者已保證任一路線都不會延誤。
boss.explain: 表定時長與實際風險權衡不同，沒有確定總耗時結果。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The confirmation sounded reassuring until we noticed that it confirmed receipt of the request, rather than availability of the service.
options: A. 通知明確拒絕受理任何要求。
B. 確認通知令人安心，直到發現它只確認收到申請，並未確認服務可用。
C. 通知已同時確認申請和服務都完成。
D. 收到申請就必然保證服務有空位。
boss.explain: receipt 與 availability 是不同確認對象。

boss.desc: 【搭配詞】The route is closed, so drivers must take a ___.
options: A. departure
B. destination
C. duration
D. detour
boss.explain: detour 是繞道；其他詞是出發、目的地與時長。

boss.desc: 【短文】An airline offers meal vouchers during a delay. The notice says accepting a voucher does not settle any separate complaint about the journey. What does acceptance not imply?
options: A. That every other concern has been resolved.
B. That the passenger may receive the specified meal benefit.
C. That a delay has affected the service.
D. That the airline has issued a notice.
boss.explain: 餐券接受與其他爭議處理被明確分開，不應自行擴張。

boss.desc: 【短文】A route planner selects the quickest journey by adding scheduled travel times. It ignores the ten-minute walk between two different stations with similar names. What is missing?
options: A. A reason why scheduled travel time can never be useful.
B. A practical transfer requirement not included in the time calculation.
C. The distinction between morning and evening fares.
D. Proof that all station names refer to one building.
boss.explain: 步行轉乘是必要但未計入的時間，不能只相加行車分鐘。

boss.desc: 請唸出：另一條可採用的路線
boss.speak: an alternative route
boss.explain: 口說表達「AN ALTERNATIVE ROUTE」(phr.)：另一條可採用的路線。例句：An alternative route avoids the closed bridge.（替代路線避開了封閉橋梁。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：已說明的保證有範圍限制
boss.ans: THE STATED GUARANTEE HAS A LIMITED SCOPE
boss.speak: the stated guarantee has a limited scope
boss.vocabId: R6:THE STATED GUARANTEE HAS A LIMITED SCOPE
boss.explain: 口說表達「THE STATED GUARANTEE HAS A LIMITED SCOPE」(phr.)：已說明的保證有範圍限制。例句：The stated guarantee has a limited scope.（已說明的保證有範圍限制。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：是否發生取決於某項條件的（C 開頭，10 個字母）
boss.speak: contingent
boss.explain: CONTINGENT (adj.)：是否發生取決於某項條件的。例句：The visit is contingent on the room being available.（參訪取決於房間是否可用。）

boss.desc: 填空題：A C _ E S _ I _ L E (容易到達或適合不同需求者使用的)
boss.speak: accessible
boss.explain: ACCESSIBLE (adj.)：容易到達或適合不同需求者使用的。填空答案為「CSB」。例句：The station has an accessible route to every platform.（車站有通往各月台的無障礙動線。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The road is open, but that does not mean the danger has passed.
options: A. 道路開通不代表危險已消失。
B. 只要開通就能保證毫無風險。
C. 道路已因危險而永久封閉。
D. 說話者確認從來沒有危險。
boss.explain: 可通行與安全性是不同判斷。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: Her allegiance is to the people of the valley, not necessarily to whoever occupies the throne.
options: A. 她已宣布自己要立即登基。
B. 她忠於山谷人民，不一定忠於坐在王位上的任何人。
C. 她保證無論誰掌權都無條件服從。
D. 她對山谷居民完全沒有責任感。
boss.explain: 忠誠對象區分人民與掌權者。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The warning may be intended to protect us, but we should still ask whether it describes a danger or merely discourages a question.
options: A. 所有警告都只能是欺騙。
B. 只要有人問問題就能證明危險不存在。
C. 警告可能出於保護，但仍須問它在描述危險，還是在阻止提問。
D. 保護意圖已保證每項警告事實正確。
boss.explain: 善意可能性不免除內容與話語功能的檢驗。

boss.desc: 【字彙】Which verb means to give up a claim or possession, often reluctantly?
options: A. relinquish
B. replenish
C. reprimand
D. replicate
boss.explain: relinquish 是放棄交出；其他動詞分別補充、斥責、複製。

boss.desc: 【短文】The map marks a passage as hidden, not blocked. The group has not found its entrance. What conclusion is warranted?
options: A. A hidden passage must have an entrance visible from every direction.
B. The passage may exist even though its entrance has not been located.
C. The map explicitly states that no passage exists.
D. The group has already proved the route impassable.
boss.explain: 未發現不等於不存在；hidden 和 blocked 的資訊不同。

boss.desc: 【短文】The villagers call a tower cursed because everyone who entered returned frightened. The scout notes that none described what they saw. What should the group distinguish?
options: A. A description of events from a map of the village.
B. Proof of a curse from the villagers’ complete lack of concern.
C. Evidence of fear from evidence of a particular cause of that fear.
D. An absence of fear from certainty that the tower is safe.
boss.explain: 恐懼反應存在，不足以確定超自然原因。

boss.desc: 請唸出：不易被發現的通道
boss.speak: a hidden passage
boss.explain: 口說表達「A HIDDEN PASSAGE」(phr.)：不易被發現的通道。例句：The map suggests a hidden passage beneath the tower.（地圖暗示塔下有隱藏通道。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：我們應區分警告與解釋
boss.ans: WE SHOULD DISTINGUISH A WARNING FROM AN EXPLANATION
boss.speak: we should distinguish a warning from an explanation
boss.vocabId: R6:WE SHOULD DISTINGUISH A WARNING FROM AN EXPLANATION
boss.explain: 口說表達「WE SHOULD DISTINGUISH A WARNING FROM AN EXPLANATION」(phr.)：我們應區分警告與解釋。例句：We should distinguish a warning from an explanation.（我們應區分警告與解釋。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：恢復原本的職位權利或安排（R 開頭，9 個字母）
boss.speak: reinstate
boss.explain: REINSTATE (v.)：恢復原本的職位權利或安排。例句：The council agreed to reinstate the old route.（議會同意恢復舊路線。）

boss.desc: 填空題：V I _ I _ A _ C E (持續留意可能危險的警覺)
boss.speak: vigilance
boss.explain: VIGILANCE (n.)：持續留意可能危險的警覺。填空答案為「GLN」。例句：The quiet night did not remove the need for vigilance.（安靜夜晚沒有取消警覺的必要。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: good value for money
options: A. 品質完全不受價格影響
B. 以所付價格而言很划算
C. 價格必定是全市最低
D. 任何人都不用付錢
boss.explain: value for money 評估價格與所得價值，不保證最低價。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: We do have a quiet room, though it is upstairs and there is no lift.
options: A. 所有房間都一樣吵且無法選擇。
B. 說話者保證每位客人都能輕鬆進入。
C. 確實有安靜房間，但在樓上且沒有電梯。
D. 安靜房間位於有電梯的地面層。
boss.explain: 承認優點並指出可及性限制，不作個人能力推斷。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: Her review is enthusiastic about the cooking, less so about what she considers an unnecessarily formal atmosphere.
options: A. 她完全否定料理但喜歡正式氣氛。
B. 她宣稱所有客人都厭惡正式餐廳。
C. 料理與氣氛都被她同樣熱烈稱讚。
D. 她很欣賞料理，對自己認為過度正式的氣氛則較不熱衷。
boss.explain: less so 承接 enthusiastic，作程度較低的評價。

boss.desc: 【字彙】Which adjective describes food that tastes pleasantly of strong spices, rather than food with no noticeable flavour?
options: A. bland
B. flavourful
C. tasteless
D. unseasoned
boss.explain: flavourful 是有豐富滋味；其餘描述少味或未調味。

boss.desc: 【短文】A restaurant offers a cheaper set menu only before six. A guest arrives at six thirty with a photograph of the offer showing its time limit. Why may the advertised price not apply?
options: A. The restaurant has necessarily changed its menu.
B. The offer is restricted to customers without photographs.
C. The guest has arrived outside the stated period.
D. The photograph must have been altered.
boss.explain: 時間條件已明示；超過時段可解釋不適用，不推測造假。

boss.desc: 【短文】A menu describes a dish as traditional. The chef explains that the recipe varies between neighbouring villages. What does this suggest?
options: A. The dish has no connection with any established practice.
B. One village must have copied a recipe incorrectly.
C. The chef has proved that all versions taste identical.
D. A tradition can contain variation rather than a single fixed recipe.
boss.explain: traditional 不必等於唯一不變版本；地方差異不自動否定傳統。

boss.desc: 請唸出：取決於個人喜好的事
boss.speak: a matter of taste
boss.explain: 口說表達「A MATTER OF TASTE」(phr.)：取決於個人喜好的事。例句：The choice of sauce is a matter of taste.（醬料的選擇取決於個人喜好。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：服務慢但員工很友善
boss.ans: THE SERVICE WAS SLOW BUT THE STAFF WERE FRIENDLY
boss.speak: the service was slow but the staff were friendly
boss.vocabId: R6:THE SERVICE WAS SLOW BUT THE STAFF WERE FRIENDLY
boss.explain: 口說表達「THE SERVICE WAS SLOW BUT THE STAFF WERE FRIENDLY」(phr.)：服務慢但員工很友善。例句：The service was slow but the staff were friendly.（服務慢但員工很友善。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：與主菜一起供應的配菜或佐食（A 開頭，13 個字母）
boss.speak: accompaniment
boss.explain: ACCOMPANIMENT (n.)：與主菜一起供應的配菜或佐食。例句：The bread is an accompaniment to the soup.（麵包是配湯的佐食。）

boss.desc: 填空題：H O _ E _ A _ E (在家製作或依家庭方式製作的)
boss.speak: homemade
boss.explain: HOMEMADE (adj.)：在家製作或依家庭方式製作的。填空答案為「MMD」。例句：They served homemade bread.（他們供應自製麵包。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: a telltale sign
options: A. 禁止說話的標誌
B. 完全不能提供線索的記號
C. 能透露某事存在的跡象
D. 故意編造的故事標題
boss.explain: telltale 作形容詞指洩露情況的。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: We are unlikely to see much from here unless the fog clears.
options: A. 即使霧很濃也確定能看清一切。
B. 霧散後仍已確定不能看到任何東西。
C. 說話者要求大家立即停止觀察。
D. 除非霧散，否則從這裡大概看不到太多。
boss.explain: unless 提出能見度改善的必要條件，unlikely 留機率。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The guide described the walk as gentle, but that was before she knew how much of the path had been washed away.
options: A. 導遊先說路程輕鬆，當時還不知道步道有多少被沖毀。
B. 導遊是在充分了解損壞後保證輕鬆。
C. 步道損壞已被確認完全不影響路程。
D. 導遊只是在形容說話聲音柔和。
boss.explain: before she knew 限定最初評估的資訊狀態。

boss.desc: 【語用】You might want to bring a notebook, says the guide before a birdwatching walk. What is the likely function?
options: A. A prediction that notebooks will be sold out.
B. A statement that the listener already owns a notebook.
C. A suggestion to prepare for recording observations.
D. A demand to hand over all existing notes.
boss.explain: You might want to ... 在此是委婉建議，而非宣告對方欲望。

boss.desc: 【語意】The guide could identify the tree by its bark alone. What information was sufficient?
options: A. The sound made by a dog nearby.
B. The shape of every leaf and flower together.
C. The place where the guide had bought the tree.
D. The appearance of the tree’s outer covering.
boss.explain: bark 在樹木語境指樹皮，alone 表只靠這項特徵。

boss.desc: 【短文】The leaflet calls the route easy, but gives no distance or description of the ground. A walker who uses a stick asks for more detail. What is the issue?
options: A. A general label may not provide enough information for an individual’s needs.
B. The leaflet has explicitly forbidden walking sticks.
C. The walker has already completed the route without difficulty.
D. An easy route must be suitable for everyone in the same way.
boss.explain: easy 的相對評價不能代替距離、地面等可用資訊。

boss.desc: 請唸出：可供信賴的野外辨識手冊
boss.speak: a reliable field guide
boss.explain: 口說表達「A RELIABLE FIELD GUIDE」(phr.)：可供信賴的野外辨識手冊。例句：A reliable field guide helps us check the markings.（可靠的野外手冊幫我們核對斑紋。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：沒看見動物不證明牠不存在
boss.ans: NOT SEEING AN ANIMAL DOES NOT PROVE ITS ABSENCE
boss.speak: not seeing an animal does not prove its absence
boss.vocabId: R6:NOT SEEING AN ANIMAL DOES NOT PROVE ITS ABSENCE
boss.explain: 口說表達「NOT SEEING AN ANIMAL DOES NOT PROVE ITS ABSENCE」(phr.)：沒看見動物不證明牠不存在。例句：Not seeing an animal does not prove its absence.（沒看見動物不證明牠不存在。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：主要在夜間活動的（N 開頭，9 個字母）
boss.speak: nocturnal
boss.explain: NOCTURNAL (adj.)：主要在夜間活動的。例句：The guide described the animal as nocturnal.（導遊說那動物主要夜間活動。）

boss.desc: 填空題：W A _ E R _ R _ O F (能防止水穿透的)
boss.speak: waterproof
boss.explain: WATERPROOF (adj.)：能防止水穿透的。填空答案為「TPO」。例句：He wore a waterproof jacket in the rain.（他在雨中穿防水外套。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: a close call
options: A. 裁判已把比賽正式取消
B. 隔著近距離打電話
C. 提早結束且毫無懸念的比賽
D. 差一點出事或結果難分的驚險情況
boss.explain: close call 可指險些出事或難定的判斷，重點在接近界線。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: I would rather play a shorter match properly than rush through a full one.
options: A. 我寧可好好打一場較短比賽，也不願匆忙打完整場。
B. 我寧可匆忙打完規定全程也不縮短。
C. 我想取消比賽改成討論規則。
D. 我只願看短比賽而不想參與。
boss.explain: rather 比較兩個參與方式，不是拒絕打球。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The results matter to me, just not enough to make me give up enjoying the afternoon.
options: A. 我願意為了贏而放棄任何休閒活動。
B. 我在意結果，但不至於犧牲下午的樂趣。
C. 我只要輸就會認定下午毫無價值。
D. 我對結果完全不感興趣也不會查看。
boss.explain: just not enough 限制程度，非否定在意。

boss.desc: 【語用】Would you mind keeping the score while I play? What is requested?
options: A. Explaining how to improve technique.
B. Changing the number of points needed.
C. Playing in place of the speaker.
D. Recording points during the game.
boss.explain: keep the score 是記分，不是保存球具。

boss.desc: 【語意】The coach praised her effort, if not her accuracy. What is the assessment?
options: A. Her effort deserved praise, but her accuracy did not receive the same approval.
B. Her accuracy deserved praise, but her effort did not receive the same approval.
C. Her effort would deserve praise only if she first improved her accuracy.
D. Her accuracy was praised because the coach considered effort irrelevant.
boss.explain: if not 在此限制讚美範圍，努力受肯定而準確性有所保留。

boss.desc: 【短文】A player wins a match after her opponent slips. She says the result was welcome but not a fair measure of their usual abilities. What distinction does she make?
options: A. Her opponent’s footwear versus the condition of her own equipment.
B. Winning this match versus demonstrating greater skill overall.
C. Being pleased with a win versus wanting to play the match again.
D. Following the rules versus receiving permission to enter the event.
boss.explain: 單次結果可能受意外影響，不能直接代表平常實力。

boss.desc: 請唸出：穩定逐步的進步
boss.speak: a steady improvement
boss.explain: 口說表達「A STEADY IMPROVEMENT」(phr.)：穩定逐步的進步。例句：Practice brought a steady improvement.（練習帶來穩定進步。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：我重視結果但不讓它毀掉一天
boss.ans: I VALUE THE RESULT WITHOUT LETTING IT SPOIL THE DAY
boss.speak: i value the result without letting it spoil the day
boss.vocabId: R6:I VALUE THE RESULT WITHOUT LETTING IT SPOIL THE DAY
boss.explain: 口說表達「I VALUE THE RESULT WITHOUT LETTING IT SPOIL THE DAY」(phr.)：我重視結果但不讓它毀掉一天。例句：I value the result without letting it spoil the day.（我重視結果但不讓它毀掉一天。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：遇困難仍持續努力的毅力（P 開頭，12 個字母）
boss.speak: perseverance
boss.explain: PERSEVERANCE (n.)：遇困難仍持續努力的毅力。例句：Learning the technique took perseverance.（學會技巧需要毅力。）

boss.desc: 填空題：D _ _ _ (雙方得分相同的平手結果)
boss.speak: draw
boss.explain: DRAW (n.)：雙方得分相同的平手結果。填空答案為「RAW」。例句：The match ended in a draw.（比賽以平手結束。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: word of mouth
options: A. 透過人們口頭相傳
B. 按照書面逐字朗讀
C. 由新聞機構正式公告
D. 用嘴形而不發聲表達
boss.explain: word of mouth 指人際口頭傳播。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: Could you make clear which part is your opinion and which part you heard from someone else?
options: A. 請把所有人的名字換成相同的稱呼。
B. 請分清哪些是你的看法、哪些是聽別人說的。
C. 請把別人的看法改寫成自己的親身經歷。
D. 請只留下你贊成而刪除你不同意的部分。
boss.explain: 要求區分資訊來源與個人判斷，不是篩選立場。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The apology explains how the error happened, but it does not quite acknowledge the trouble it caused.
options: A. 道歉把全部原因歸給受影響的人。
B. 道歉確認錯誤並未帶來任何不便。
C. 道歉解釋錯誤如何發生，卻未充分承認造成的困擾。
D. 道歉承認造成困擾，但拒絕說明錯誤原因。
boss.explain: 原因說明與承認後果不同；not quite 是有保留的批評。

boss.desc: 【語用】Could you send me the original message rather than a screenshot of part of it? What does the speaker want?
options: A. Access to the complete message in its original form.
B. A clearer photograph of the same selected sentence.
C. Permission to forward the selected sentence publicly.
D. A summary replacing both the message and the screenshot.
boss.explain: original rather than screenshot of part 強調取得原文完整脈絡。

boss.desc: 【語意】The reply was polite but noncommittal. What remained unclear?
options: A. Whether the request had been written in a message.
B. Whether the sender was agreeing to the request.
C. Whether the sender had used courteous language.
D. Whether the message had been sent as a reply.
boss.explain: noncommittal 不明確承諾或表態；禮貌不等於同意。

boss.desc: 【短文】A newsletter corrects a false date but leaves an accusation that depended on that date unchanged. A reader asks whether the correction goes far enough. What should be reconsidered?
options: A. The need to preserve the newsletter’s original publication time.
B. The reader’s ability to remember the earlier date accurately.
C. The accusation’s basis once the date has changed.
D. The size of the font used to print the corrected date.
boss.explain: 若推論依錯誤日期而成立，改日期後須重評推論。

boss.desc: 請唸出：尚未獲證實的報導
boss.speak: an unconfirmed report
boss.explain: 口說表達「AN UNCONFIRMED REPORT」(phr.)：尚未獲證實的報導。例句：The message repeats an unconfirmed report.（訊息重述未證實報導。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：正確引文仍可能漏掉重要脈絡
boss.ans: AN ACCURATE QUOTATION CAN STILL OMIT IMPORTANT CONTEXT
boss.speak: an accurate quotation can still omit important context
boss.vocabId: R6:AN ACCURATE QUOTATION CAN STILL OMIT IMPORTANT CONTEXT
boss.explain: 口說表達「AN ACCURATE QUOTATION CAN STILL OMIT IMPORTANT CONTEXT」(phr.)：正確引文仍可能漏掉重要脈絡。例句：An accurate quotation can still omit important context.（正確引文仍可能漏掉重要脈絡。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：錯誤理解某事的意思（M 開頭，12 個字母）
boss.speak: misinterpret
boss.explain: MISINTERPRET (v.)：錯誤理解某事的意思。例句：It is easy to misinterpret a short message.（簡短訊息容易被誤解。）

boss.desc: 填空題：A T _ R I _ U T _ O N (交代言論或作品來源的做法)
boss.speak: attribution
boss.explain: ATTRIBUTION (n.)：交代言論或作品來源的做法。填空答案為「TBI」。例句：The quotation needs clear attribution.（引文需要清楚交代來源。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: clear the air
options: A. 把所有東西搬到戶外
B. 把誤會或緊張談開
C. 把窗戶玻璃擦乾淨
D. 正式宣布結束租約
boss.explain: clear the air 慣用指化解緊張誤會。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The spare room is available, provided you do not need it before the boxes have been collected.
options: A. 空房只能在箱子被取走前暫時使用。
B. 說話者已確認箱子今天一定會被取走。
C. 空房可用，前提是你不需要在箱子被取走前用。
D. 箱子留在空房多久都不會影響使用。
boss.explain: 條件限定可使用時間，未給取件確切日期。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: I appreciate the offer to help; I would just rather decide together what needs changing before anyone starts.
options: A. 我會接受幫忙，但只有你自行決定改動才有效率。
B. 我拒絕任何改動，也不願再討論是否幫忙。
C. 我希望你先做完，之後我再說哪些不該改。
D. 謝謝願意幫忙，只希望開始前先一起決定改什麼。
boss.explain: 接受善意並要求先共同決策，非全盤拒絕。

boss.desc: 【語用】Could we keep this shelf for things we both use? What is proposed?
options: A. Replacing both people’s belongings with new ones.
B. Reserving the shelf for shared items.
C. Dividing the shelf into two private sections.
D. Removing the shelf to make more floor space.
boss.explain: keep ... for things we both use 指保留作共同用途。

boss.desc: 【語意】The new layout makes better use of the available space. What is claimed?
options: A. The room now contains more space than any other room.
B. The furniture has been removed rather than rearranged.
C. The existing space is used more effectively.
D. The total floor area has been physically enlarged.
boss.explain: 更有效使用原空間，不必代表擴建或家具全移除。

boss.desc: 【短文】A resident labels a chair unused because nobody sat in it during his visit. Another resident says it is used on other evenings. What was the first resident assuming?
options: A. A chair must be occupied continuously to remain safe.
B. The other resident was responsible for buying the chair.
C. The visit had taken place on the same evening every week.
D. A short observation represented the chair’s usual use.
boss.explain: 單次未用被當成通常未用，觀察範圍不足。

boss.desc: 請唸出：實際可行的安排
boss.speak: a practical arrangement
boss.explain: 口說表達「A PRACTICAL ARRANGEMENT」(phr.)：實際可行的安排。例句：The rota is a practical arrangement.（輪值表是可行安排。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：地板面積未增但房間感覺更大
boss.ans: THE ROOM FEELS LARGER WITHOUT ANY EXTRA FLOOR SPACE
boss.speak: the room feels larger without any extra floor space
boss.vocabId: R6:THE ROOM FEELS LARGER WITHOUT ANY EXTRA FLOOR SPACE
boss.explain: 口說表達「THE ROOM FEELS LARGER WITHOUT ANY EXTRA FLOOR SPACE」(phr.)：地板面積未增但房間感覺更大。例句：The room feels larger without any extra floor space.（地板面積未增但房間感覺更大。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：改變物品原有排列位置（R 開頭，9 個字母）
boss.speak: rearrange
boss.explain: REARRANGE (v.)：改變物品原有排列位置。例句：They want to rearrange the furniture.（他們想重排家具。）

boss.desc: 填空題：S O _ N D _ R _ O F (能阻隔聲音傳入或傳出的)
boss.speak: soundproof
boss.explain: SOUNDPROOF (adj.)：能阻隔聲音傳入或傳出的。填空答案為「UPO」。例句：The studio is not completely soundproof.（工作室並非完全隔音。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: keep someone posted
options: A. 把某人的職位永久保留
B. 將同一張公告反覆張貼
C. 隨時告知某人最新進展
D. 要求某人留在郵局
boss.explain: keep posted 指持續提供近況。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: Please count the replies, not the number of people mentioned in each reply; we need both figures separately.
options: A. 每封回覆只代表一人，兩項數字必定相同。
B. 請把回覆提及人數刪掉，只留下郵件數。
C. 回覆數只能由參加者自己統計後提交。
D. 請統計回覆數而非每封提及人數，兩個數字要分開。
boss.explain: 要求分開兩種單位，不是永久忽略其中一項。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: We do not need everyone to stay late, but we do need to know in advance who can.
options: A. 不需要人人留晚，但需事先知道誰可以。
B. 每人都必須留晚，只是可自行決定何時告知。
C. 誰可留晚並不重要，人數足夠就不必記錄。
D. 留晚安排只能等活動結束後才開始詢問。
boss.explain: 全員要求與確定可用人力不同。

boss.desc: 【語用】I can help set up, though I will need to leave before the guests arrive. What is the speaker doing?
options: A. Asking the guests to arrive earlier than planned.
B. Declining to take part in any preparation.
C. Offering limited help with preparation.
D. Accepting responsibility for welcoming every guest.
boss.explain: 同意布置並限定離開時間，非全盤拒絕。

boss.desc: 【語意】The event is informal, but punctuality still matters. Which action best fits?
options: A. Choosing any arrival time because there is no dress code.
B. Waiting outside until someone puts on formal clothes.
C. Arriving after the event because it is not a meeting.
D. Arriving at the stated time in relaxed clothing.
boss.explain: informal 未取消準時要求；服裝較輕鬆與時間明確可並存。

boss.desc: 【短文】An organiser thanks the team for adapting to a late change but says it should not become the normal way of planning. What is distinguished?
options: A. Appreciating flexibility from accepting avoidable disruption as routine.
B. Praising the team from accepting that any change occurred.
C. Welcoming new ideas from allowing team members to speak.
D. Rewarding preparation from requiring people to attend.
boss.explain: 肯定應變不等於認可反覆臨時變動。

boss.desc: 請唸出：交代清楚的工作交接
boss.speak: a clear handover
boss.explain: 口說表達「A CLEAR HANDOVER」(phr.)：交代清楚的工作交接。例句：A clear handover prevents confusion.（清楚交接可免混亂。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：請把回覆數與出席人數分開
boss.ans: PLEASE KEEP THE REPLY COUNT SEPARATE FROM THE ATTENDANCE COUNT
boss.speak: please keep the reply count separate from the attendance count
boss.vocabId: R6:PLEASE KEEP THE REPLY COUNT SEPARATE FROM THE ATTENDANCE COUNT
boss.explain: 口說表達「PLEASE KEEP THE REPLY COUNT SEPARATE FROM THE ATTENDANCE COUNT」(phr.)：請把回覆數與出席人數分開。例句：Please keep the reply count separate from the attendance count.（請把回覆數與出席人數分開。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：活動所需人員物品移動與安排工作（L 開頭，9 個字母）
boss.speak: logistics
boss.explain: LOGISTICS (n.)：活動所需人員物品移動與安排工作。例句：She coordinates the logistics of the event.（她協調活動的後勤安排。）

boss.desc: 填空題：O V _ R _ I _ H T (因疏忽而遺漏或犯下的錯誤)
boss.speak: oversight
boss.explain: OVERSIGHT (n.)：因疏忽而遺漏或犯下的錯誤。填空答案為「ESG」。例句：If there hadn't been that serious oversight, we would have won the contract long ago.（如果沒有那個嚴重的疏忽，我們早就贏得合約了。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: It belonged to my aunt before it came to me, though I cannot remember where she got it.
options: A. 我知道阿姨買它的地點，卻不知現在屬於誰。
B. 這一直是我的，阿姨只曾暫時借用。
C. 我記得它曾屬阿姨，但確定不是她交給我的。
D. 這原屬阿姨後來給我，但我不記得她從哪取得。
boss.explain: 交代一段所有權沿革，對更早來源保留未知。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The collection began with one suitcase, and somehow the suitcase now takes up less room than everything we have added since.
options: A. 收藏始於一只行李箱，如今後來新增的東西占空間更多。
B. 所有收藏現在仍能裝進最初那只行李箱。
C. 行李箱因後來縮小，所以看來比藏品小。
D. 說話者決定丟掉新增藏品，只留下行李箱。
boss.explain: 幽默敘述收藏擴增，未說縮小物件或決定丟棄。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The letters are moving partly because they were never intended to explain a whole life to strangers.
options: A. 說話者覺得私人信件不應含有任何生活細節。
B. 信件感人，部分因為它們本無意向陌生人解釋整個人生。
C. 信件原本專為陌生人寫完整傳記，所以令人感動。
D. 信件因所有字都會移動而難以閱讀。
boss.explain: moving 在此感人；非公共完整自傳的片段感具有感染力。

boss.desc: 【語用】You are welcome to take photographs, but please leave the flash off. What is permitted?
options: A. Using the flash if no other visitor is nearby.
B. Taking pictures only of the written labels.
C. Borrowing a camera from any nearby visitor.
D. Taking pictures without using the flash.
boss.explain: 明示允許拍照，限制在閃光燈，不加其他條件。

boss.desc: 【文法】The guide showed us a drawer ___ with old tickets and letters.
options: A. filled
B. filling
C. had filled
D. was filling
boss.explain: drawer filled with ... 過去分詞作後置修飾，抽屜被裝滿。

boss.desc: 【短文】A postcard says, We arrived safely, though our luggage has chosen a different holiday. What happened to the luggage?
options: A. It was given to someone who wanted a holiday.
B. It did not arrive with the travellers.
C. It was deliberately sent ahead to the hotel.
D. It contained a second set of holiday tickets.
boss.explain: 擬人化 chosen different holiday 幽默描述行李去了別處。

boss.desc: 請唸出：家族代代相傳的物品
boss.speak: a family heirloom
boss.explain: 口說表達「A FAMILY HEIRLOOM」(phr.)：家族代代相傳的物品。例句：The bowl is a family heirloom.（碗是家傳物。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：原件留樓上而遊客觸摸複本
boss.ans: THE ORIGINAL REMAINS UPSTAIRS WHILE VISITORS HANDLE THE COPY
boss.speak: the original remains upstairs while visitors handle the copy
boss.vocabId: R6:THE ORIGINAL REMAINS UPSTAIRS WHILE VISITORS HANDLE THE COPY
boss.explain: 口說表達「THE ORIGINAL REMAINS UPSTAIRS WHILE VISITORS HANDLE THE COPY」(phr.)：原件留樓上而遊客觸摸複本。例句：The original remains upstairs while visitors handle the copy.（原件留樓上而遊客觸摸複本。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：因個人情感與回憶而珍重的（S 開頭，11 個字母）
boss.speak: sentimental
boss.explain: SENTIMENTAL (adj.)：因個人情感與回憶而珍重的。例句：The object has sentimental value.（物件有情感價值。）

boss.desc: 填空題：F _ A _ I _ E (容易破損而需小心處理的)
boss.speak: fragile
boss.explain: FRAGILE (adj.)：容易破損而需小心處理的。填空答案為「RGL」。例句：The paper is fragile after years in storage.（紙存放多年後脆弱易損。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: I thought you were waiting outside. No, I said I would wait by the window.
options: A. 一人以為對方在外面，對方澄清說的是窗邊。
B. 雙方都同意原先說好在室外窗邊等。
C. 一人取消等候，另一人要求把窗打開。
D. 對方已承認自己把外面誤說成窗邊。
boss.explain: 第二人修正等候位置的理解，未承認自己說錯。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: You found the note, then? Eventually. It was under the very book I had been looking through.
options: A. 便條先找到，書則後來才被人借走。
B. 終於找到便條，就在一直翻的那本書下面。
C. 便條在書裡，他翻到最後一頁才找到。
D. 他已看完書，卻仍不知道便條在哪。
boss.explain: under book 與 looking through book 對比搜尋焦點。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: We arrived too late for the beginning, but just in time to hear everyone arguing about how it had ended.
options: A. 爭論是在活動開始前，大家預測可能結局。
B. 我們完整看過活動，後來才參與爭論。
C. 我們錯過開頭，抵達時正好聽見大家爭論結局。
D. 我們及時看到開頭，卻在結局前離開。
boss.explain: late for beginning + arguing ended 暗示事件已結束但討論持續。

boss.desc: 【語用】A guest looks at the empty plate and says, I take it the cake was popular. What is inferred?
options: A. People have eaten the cake.
B. The cake has not yet been served.
C. The plate was too small to hold a cake.
D. The guests have asked for a different dessert.
boss.explain: 由空盤推蛋糕受歡迎的幽默推論；不是確證所有人喜歡。

boss.desc: 【語氣】You might have mentioned the stairs, said the visitor, looking at the suitcase she had carried up four floors. What is conveyed?
options: A. Gratitude for a detailed description of the stairs.
B. Mild reproach for not being warned.
C. Certainty that the stairs have just been installed.
D. A request to remove the suitcase from the building.
boss.explain: might have mentioned 在此責怪未提前提醒，以情境確定語氣。

boss.desc: 【短文】A stranger offered to carry Jo’s bag. She thanked him but kept her hand on the strap until they reached the crowded platform. What is the strongest supported reading?
options: A. She was unable to carry the bag without him.
B. She intended to give him the bag permanently.
C. She accepted the help with some caution.
D. She had known the stranger for many years.
boss.explain: 感謝配合不放手顯示有保留接受，不能據此確定有犯罪。

boss.desc: 請唸出：使人較安心的微笑
boss.speak: a reassuring smile
boss.explain: 口說表達「A REASSURING SMILE」(phr.)：使人較安心的微笑。例句：The stranger gave a reassuring smile.（陌生人露出安心微笑。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：不見的便條一直在書下
boss.ans: THE MISSING NOTE LAY BENEATH THE BOOK ALL ALONG
boss.speak: the missing note lay beneath the book all along
boss.vocabId: R6:THE MISSING NOTE LAY BENEATH THE BOOK ALL ALONG
boss.explain: 口說表達「THE MISSING NOTE LAY BENEATH THE BOOK ALL ALONG」(phr.)：不見的便條一直在書下。例句：The missing note lay beneath the book all along.（不見的便條一直在書下。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：看似相關而偶然同時發生的巧合（C 開頭，11 個字母）
boss.speak: coincidence
boss.explain: COINCIDENCE (n.)：看似相關而偶然同時發生的巧合。例句：Meeting there was a coincidence.（在那相遇是巧合。）

boss.desc: 填空題：B E _ I L _ E _ E D (因不理解發生何事而困惑的)
boss.speak: bewildered
boss.explain: BEWILDERED (adj.)：因不理解發生何事而困惑的。填空答案為「WDR」。例句：He looked bewildered by the sudden silence.（他對突然沉默顯得困惑。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: I said leave the top edge open, not leave the lid off.
options: A. 我已說好封住頂邊，再另做一個蓋子。
B. 我說留頂邊開口，不是不要蓋子。
C. 我要求移除整個蓋子而不是只留邊緣。
D. 頂邊與蓋子被明確定義成同一部分。
boss.explain: 否定範圍區分局部開口與整蓋移除。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: Try the arrangement without attaching anything first; it is much easier to change your mind at that stage.
options: A. 只要開始試擺，後來就不准再改。
B. 說話者認為排列方式不需要任何選擇。
C. 先試擺別固定，那時改主意較容易。
D. 先把每件都固定，才決定排列方式。
boss.explain: without attaching + first 設可逆試做階段。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: A close match is enough here; trying to make it exact would add work without changing whether the pieces fit.
options: A. 只有完全一致才可合上，近似一定無法使用。
B. 兩片是否合上與尺寸毫無關係。
C. 說話者認為應不比較就隨意拿兩片。
D. 此處近似就夠，追求完全一致只加工作而不改能否合上。
boss.explain: 本步驟精度需求有限，不泛化所有組件要求。

boss.desc: 【語用】Could you leave a little space between the labels so I can cut them apart? What is requested?
options: A. A second copy of the same sheet.
B. A gap separating adjacent labels.
C. A blank label before the first printed one.
D. A larger font on every label.
boss.explain: between labels 為裁開留間隔，非空白標籤或字體大小。

boss.desc: 【空間】Place the blue card between the red card and the green card, all in one row. Which order fits?
options: A. Red, green, blue.
B. Blue, green, red.
C. Red, blue, green.
D. Blue, red, green.
boss.explain: blue 須在 red/green 中間，正答為其中一個方向。

boss.desc: 【短文】An example uses a green ribbon. The note says any colour may be used as long as the ribbon is narrow enough to pass through the hole. What matters for this step?
options: A. Using the same colour as the example.
B. Matching the ribbon’s length to the hole’s width.
C. Choosing a ribbon before checking whether there is a hole.
D. The ribbon’s width rather than its colour.
boss.explain: any colour 排除色限制，narrow enough 指寬度適配。

boss.desc: 請唸出：緊密合適而不鬆動的配合
boss.speak: a snug fit
boss.explain: 口說表達「A SNUG FIT」(phr.)：緊密合適而不鬆動的配合。例句：The cover should be a snug fit.（蓋子應緊密合適。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：備件不表示漏做步驟
boss.ans: A SPARE PIECE DOES NOT IMPLY A MISSING STEP
boss.speak: a spare piece does not imply a missing step
boss.vocabId: R6:A SPARE PIECE DOES NOT IMPLY A MISSING STEP
boss.explain: 口說表達「A SPARE PIECE DOES NOT IMPLY A MISSING STEP」(phr.)：備件不表示漏做步驟。例句：A spare piece does not imply a missing step.（備件不表示漏做步驟。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：尺寸或數量收縮減少的現象（S 開頭，9 個字母）
boss.speak: shrinkage
boss.explain: SHRINKAGE (n.)：尺寸或數量收縮減少的現象。例句：The plan allows for slight shrinkage.（計畫預留輕微收縮。）

boss.desc: 填空題：D I _ E _ S _ O N (長寬高等可測量的尺寸方向)
boss.speak: dimension
boss.explain: DIMENSION (n.)：長寬高等可測量的尺寸方向。填空答案為「MNI」。例句：Width is one dimension of the card.（寬是卡片的一個尺寸方向。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: Go past the desk, then take the first door on your left, not the door beside the desk.
options: A. 走到櫃台旁門就進去，不需再往前。
B. 經過櫃台後改向右，再找唯一出口。
C. 經過櫃台後左側第一門，不是櫃台旁那道。
D. 在到櫃台之前先進左側第一門。
boss.explain: past/then/left 與 not 明確界定動線。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The queue on the right is for people who have already booked, even if they still need to collect a ticket.
options: A. 右隊只給手上已持票且不需領取者。
B. 還沒預約者應去右邊排隊先拿票。
C. 兩條隊伍都不接受需要領票的人。
D. 右隊給已預約者，即使還需要領票。
boss.explain: 分類依預約狀態，非是否拿到實體票。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: I would not describe the route as inaccessible, but I would explain the steep section before letting people assume it is an easy stroll.
options: A. 我不會稱路線無法到達，但會先說明陡坡，免得以為輕鬆散步。
B. 路線已被正式封閉，所以不應再提供任何說明。
C. 說話者確認陡坡對任何人都不構成困難。
D. 只要能走到，就已保證整段路對人人輕鬆。
boss.explain: 可到達與輕鬆程度不同，提前明示地形資訊。

boss.desc: 【語用】Could you point me towards the information desk? What help is requested?
options: A. A written complaint about the desk’s location.
B. Permission to move the desk nearer the door.
C. An indication of which way to go.
D. A reservation at the desk for a later visit.
boss.explain: point towards 是指引方向，不必親自帶路。

boss.desc: 【空間】The lift is opposite the reception desk, while the stairs are immediately behind the desk. Which statement follows?
options: A. The stairs are inside the lift.
B. The lift is behind the stairs and cannot be seen.
C. The reception desk is on a different floor from both.
D. The stairs and lift are on different sides of the desk.
boss.explain: opposite 與 behind 相對桌的位置不同，不能推能見度。

boss.desc: 【短文】The map marks a nearby exit, but a temporary notice says it is closed today and gives another route. Which information should govern today’s departure?
options: A. The current notice about the temporary closure.
B. The map alone because printed routes cannot change.
C. The shortest line on the map regardless of access.
D. The location of the exit used on a previous visit.
boss.explain: 暫時告示直接更新今日通行，非一般地圖永遠錯誤。

boss.desc: 請唸出：暫時改行的路線安排
boss.speak: a temporary diversion
boss.explain: 口說表達「A TEMPORARY DIVERSION」(phr.)：暫時改行的路線安排。例句：Follow the temporary diversion today.（今天依暫時改道走。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：作選擇前應能看見指引
boss.ans: DIRECTIONS SHOULD BE VISIBLE BEFORE A CHOICE IS MADE
boss.speak: directions should be visible before a choice is made
boss.vocabId: R6:DIRECTIONS SHOULD BE VISIBLE BEFORE A CHOICE IS MADE
boss.explain: 口說表達「DIRECTIONS SHOULD BE VISIBLE BEFORE A CHOICE IS MADE」(phr.)：作選擇前應能看見指引。例句：Directions should be visible before a choice is made.（作選擇前應能看見指引。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：道路或線路相交的位置（I 開頭，12 個字母）
boss.speak: intersection
boss.explain: INTERSECTION (n.)：道路或線路相交的位置。例句：The meeting point is beyond the intersection.（集合點在路口另一邊。）

boss.desc: 填空題：B _ L _ A _ D (路旁用以限制車輛通行的矮柱)
boss.speak: bollard
boss.explain: BOLLARD (n.)：路旁用以限制車輛通行的矮柱。填空答案為「OLR」。例句：A bollard marks the edge of the vehicle route.（矮柱標示車輛路線邊緣。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: Are we starting from the beginning? No, from the moment she opens the letter.
options: A. 從最初場景開始，一直演到她拆信。
B. 拆信場景已取消，所以由下一場開始。
C. 所有人先讀完信，再決定從哪開始。
D. 不是從頭，從她拆信那刻開始。
boss.explain: No 修正開始位置，不是設定結束位置。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The spare costume is ready, though we hope nobody will need it.
options: A. 備用服裝已備妥，但希望不會用到。
B. 因不希望用到，所以沒有準備任何備服。
C. 備用服已被要求每位演員輪流穿一次。
D. 說話者確認原服已全部不能使用。
boss.explain: 準備備案不等於預測必需使用。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: We should leave room for a laugh without making the audience feel that we are waiting for one.
options: A. 說話者認為只有完全不停頓才會自然。
B. 要留笑聲空間，但別讓觀眾覺得我們在等他們笑。
C. 要停到每位觀眾都笑才繼續，不論多久。
D. 觀眾若開始笑，就應立刻跳過剩下台詞。
boss.explain: 表演節奏兼顧反應與不強求反應，非機械指令。

boss.desc: 【語用】Could we try that line once more, a little less quickly? What is requested?
options: A. Removing the line from the script.
B. Making the line longer before speaking it.
C. Reading the next line without a pause.
D. Repeating the line at a slower pace.
boss.explain: once more 重複，less quickly 放慢。

boss.desc: 【語意】Her voice carried to the back of the room. What does carried mean here?
options: A. It could be heard at the back.
B. It was recorded only behind the room.
C. It became quieter whenever she moved.
D. It repeated words spoken by the audience.
boss.explain: voice carried 指聲音傳得到，不是實體搬運。

boss.desc: 【短文】A review calls a performance polished but not lifeless. What combination is praised?
options: A. An absence of emotion that keeps the technique hidden.
B. Technical control together with energy or feeling.
C. A lack of preparation disguised by loud speaking.
D. An unchanging pace that prevents any surprise.
boss.explain: polished 精熟流暢，not lifeless 保留活力與情感。

boss.desc: 請唸出：令人信服的表演
boss.speak: a convincing performance
boss.explain: 口說表達「A CONVINCING PERFORMANCE」(phr.)：令人信服的表演。例句：She gave a convincing performance.（她作出令人信服的表演。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：停頓應容納笑聲而非強求它
boss.ans: THE PAUSE SHOULD ALLOW A LAUGH WITHOUT DEMANDING ONE
boss.speak: the pause should allow a laugh without demanding one
boss.vocabId: R6:THE PAUSE SHOULD ALLOW A LAUGH WITHOUT DEMANDING ONE
boss.explain: 口說表達「THE PAUSE SHOULD ALLOW A LAUGH WITHOUT DEMANDING ONE」(phr.)：停頓應容納笑聲而非強求它。例句：The pause should allow a laugh without demanding one.（停頓應容納笑聲而非強求它。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：觀眾以拍手表示讚賞的掌聲（A 開頭，8 個字母）
boss.speak: applause
boss.explain: APPLAUSE (n.)：觀眾以拍手表示讚賞的掌聲。例句：The applause continued after the curtain fell.（落幕後掌聲繼續。）

boss.desc: 填空題：C H O _ E O _ R A _ H Y (舞蹈動作與順序的編排)
boss.speak: choreography
boss.explain: CHOREOGRAPHY (n.)：舞蹈動作與順序的編排。填空答案為「RGP」。例句：The choreography gives each dancer room to move.（舞蹈編排讓每位舞者有活動空間。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: I can come on Friday, but only if you mean the evening; I am working until four.
options: A. 週五可來，但只能晚上，四點前在工作。
B. 週五四點前有空，晚上則確定工作。
C. 說話者已確認週五整天都能參加。
D. 週五不能來，只願換到另一個工作日。
boss.explain: only if evening 限制 Friday 的可用時段。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: Please use the new address for the reply, not the old one from which this message was forwarded.
options: A. 新舊地址都已停用，必須改成電話回覆。
B. 請回新地址，不是轉寄此訊息的舊地址。
C. 請回轉寄來源的舊地址，新地址僅作副本。
D. 訊息尚未轉寄，所以現在無法使用任何地址。
boss.explain: 回覆目標與轉寄來源分開。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: I would not read too much into the short reply; she may have been answering between trains.
options: A. 她已明說在車上，所以我們確知所有來由。
B. 說話者認為短訊息從來不會帶有任何態度。
C. 別過度解讀簡短回覆，她可能在轉車空檔回的。
D. 短回覆已證實她生氣，不可能有其他原因。
boss.explain: may 提替代解釋，非證實行蹤或否定所有語氣。

boss.desc: 【語用】I hope this is not too short notice, says a friend inviting you tomorrow. What is being recognised?
options: A. The invitation gives little time to prepare.
B. The message may contain too few sentences.
C. The invitation has already been declined.
D. Tomorrow’s event will last only a few minutes.
boss.explain: short notice 指通知期短，非文字或活動長度。

boss.desc: 【語氣】That might be a little difficult is written in reply to a request for a favour. Which interpretation best fits the wording?
options: A. The writer denies having received any request.
B. The writer is expressing a reservation politely.
C. The writer guarantees the favour will be completed.
D. The writer asks for a more difficult favour instead.
boss.explain: might/a little 緩和負面回應；未必最後拒絕，故用 reservation。
