boss.desc: 【短文】An email ends, No need to reply until you know. The recipient has not yet confirmed travel dates. What response is most consistent?
options: A. Treat the lack of dates as a permanent refusal of the invitation.
B. Ask the sender to cancel the event before making any plans.
C. Wait for the dates to be confirmed before giving an answer.
D. Reply immediately with invented dates to avoid appearing impolite.
boss.explain: 允許等知道後再回，不需虛構或把未定當拒絕。

boss.desc: 請唸出：有禮貌的婉拒
boss.speak: a courteous refusal
boss.explain: 口說表達「A COURTEOUS REFUSAL」(phr.)：有禮貌的婉拒。例句：She sent a courteous refusal.（她寄出禮貌婉拒。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：短回覆可能反映時間不足而非惱怒
boss.ans: A SHORT REPLY MAY REFLECT LIMITED TIME RATHER THAN ANNOYANCE
boss.speak: a short reply may reflect limited time rather than annoyance
boss.vocabId: R6:A SHORT REPLY MAY REFLECT LIMITED TIME RATHER THAN ANNOYANCE
boss.explain: 口說表達「A SHORT REPLY MAY REFLECT LIMITED TIME RATHER THAN ANNOYANCE」(phr.)：短回覆可能反映時間不足而非惱怒。例句：A short reply may reflect limited time rather than annoyance.（短回覆可能反映時間不足而非惱怒。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：把某物放入同一信封或包裝（E 開頭，7 個字母）
boss.speak: enclose
boss.explain: ENCLOSE (v.)：把某物放入同一信封或包裝。例句：He said he had enclosed the receipt in the package.（他說他已經將收據隨信附在包裹裡了。）

boss.desc: 填空題：P _ O _ _ T (不拖延而及時的)
boss.speak: prompt
boss.explain: PROMPT (n.)：不拖延而及時的。填空答案為「RMP」。例句：The photograph served as a prompt.（照片作提示。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The hill is not much higher from here, though the last part of the path is steeper.
options: A. 山路已結束，所以不需再往上走。
B. 從這裡山頂沒高多少，但末段路較陡。
C. 山頂高出很多，末段路則完全平坦。
D. 說話者確認剩餘高度與坡度意思相同。
boss.explain: 剩餘高度與局部坡度不同。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: I had expected the road to feel empty at that hour, but the sound of a single cart seemed to fill the whole valley.
options: A. 說話者看見整個山谷都停滿相同車輛。
B. 馬車只有影子沒有聲音，所以山谷更安靜。
C. 原以為那時路上空寂，一輛車聲卻彷彿充滿山谷。
D. 路上有很多車，因此每輛聲音都無法聽清。
boss.explain: 單聲在寂靜地景顯著，seemed非量測保證。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The clearing felt bright after the woods, though a few minutes later I realised how little daylight was actually left.
options: A. 空地亮是因太陽剛升，天光只會越來越多。
B. 幾分鐘內空地被人蓋住，所以亮度突然無關日光。
C. 說話者確認林中比空地更亮，先前並無對比。
D. 出樹林覺得空地明亮，幾分鐘後才發現日光其實所剩不多。
boss.explain: 相對林中亮與絕對剩餘日光不同。

boss.desc: 【語意】The village came into sight as the mist thinned. What changed?
options: A. The walkers found that the village had been rebuilt.
B. The village became easier to see.
C. The village moved closer to the walkers.
D. The mist became thicker around the village.
boss.explain: 能見度改善，非村落移動或改建。

boss.desc: 【語意】The fields stretched as far as we could see. What is conveyed?
options: A. There were no boundaries anywhere beyond the view.
B. The fields physically lengthened as the walkers watched.
C. Their visible extent seemed very large.
D. The walkers had measured every field exactly.
boss.explain: as far as could see 限於視野印象，不證世界無界。

boss.desc: 【語意】The silence was broken only by a gate tapping in the wind. Which interpretation fits?
options: A. The place is filled with constant overlapping noise.
B. There is no sound of any kind, including the gate.
C. The wind has stopped and the gate is being repaired.
D. The isolated sound makes the surrounding quiet noticeable.
boss.explain: 一孤聲反襯大環境寂靜，不是絕對無聲。

boss.desc: 請唸出：一小片陽光照亮的地方
boss.speak: a patch of sunlight
boss.explain: 口說表達「A PATCH OF SUNLIGHT」(phr.)：一小片陽光照亮的地方。例句：The bench stood in a patch of sunlight.（長椅在一片陽光中。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：微小照料痕跡使地方顯得有人住
boss.ans: A SMALL SIGN OF CARE MADE THE PLACE FEEL INHABITED
boss.speak: a small sign of care made the place feel inhabited
boss.vocabId: R6:A SMALL SIGN OF CARE MADE THE PLACE FEEL INHABITED
boss.explain: 口說表達「A SMALL SIGN OF CARE MADE THE PLACE FEEL INHABITED」(phr.)：微小照料痕跡使地方顯得有人住。例句：A small sign of care made the place feel inhabited.（微小照料痕跡使地方顯得有人住。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：天空被雲層廣泛遮蔽的（O 開頭，8 個字母）
boss.speak: overcast
boss.explain: OVERCAST (adj.)：天空被雲層廣泛遮蔽的。例句：The morning was overcast.（早晨陰天。）

boss.desc: 填空題：S T _ L _ N _ S S (沒有明顯移動或聲響的寂靜狀態)
boss.speak: stillness
boss.explain: STILLNESS (n.)：沒有明顯移動或聲響的寂靜狀態。填空答案為「ILE」。例句：The gate’s tapping emphasised the stillness.（門輕敲聲反襯寂靜。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: I can reserve the colour, but I cannot promise the larger size will arrive before Saturday.
options: A. 說話者已取消所有尺寸的訂購。
B. 保留顏色就已等於保證大尺寸即時到貨。
C. 可保留顏色，但不能保證大尺寸週六前到。
D. 顏色不能選，但大尺寸已保證週六前到。
boss.explain: 不同規格/交期承諾不能合併外推。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: We have enough to make a set of four, provided you do not mind two slightly different shades.
options: A. 四件全是完全相同色調，沒有任何條件。
B. 只有兩件可用，另兩件已被確定損壞。
C. 只要接受色差，就能免費取得任何數量。
D. 有足夠湊四件，只要不介意有兩種略不同色調。
boss.explain: 數量足夠附色調差異，未明定各色各幾。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: It feels like getting something for nothing until I count the time I spend finding somewhere to put it.
options: A. 初覺白得，計入找地方收納時間才見代價。
B. 物品免費，所以存放確定不耗任何資源。
C. 說話者已付全價，只因忘帶收據才說免費。
D. 收納時間越多就已證明物品市場價越高。
boss.explain: 時間/空間可成非金錢成本，非購物建議。

boss.desc: 【語用】Could you put this aside until I check the measurements at home? What is requested?
options: A. Sending the item home before the customer makes a decision.
B. Changing the item’s measurements to fit an unknown space.
C. Keeping the item temporarily without selling it to someone else.
D. Removing the item permanently from the shop’s range.
boss.explain: put aside 在此請暫留，未要求購買或配送。

boss.desc: 【語意】The assistant described the difference as cosmetic rather than functional. What was meant?
options: A. It changes the item’s main purpose but leaves its appearance unchanged.
B. It proves the item contains beauty products.
C. It means the two items cannot be compared in any way.
D. It concerns appearance rather than how the item works.
boss.explain: cosmetic在物件差異指外觀，非必化妝品。

boss.desc: 【短文】A coat is described as hardly worn. A buyer later complains that it was not completely unused. Which distinction matters?
options: A. Very little use is different from no use.
B. Hardly worn guarantees that the coat has never been tried on.
C. The description refers only to the coat’s physical weight.
D. A used coat cannot be accurately described in any words.
boss.explain: hardly worn 接近未穿但非完全零使用。

boss.desc: 請唸出：略多於所需的小量剩餘
boss.speak: a modest surplus
boss.explain: 口說表達「A MODEST SURPLUS」(phr.)：略多於所需的小量剩餘。例句：The exchange left a modest surplus.（交換後有少量剩餘。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：極少磨損不同於毫無磨損
boss.ans: VERY LITTLE WEAR IS DIFFERENT FROM NO WEAR
boss.speak: very little wear is different from no wear
boss.vocabId: R6:VERY LITTLE WEAR IS DIFFERENT FROM NO WEAR
boss.explain: 口說表達「VERY LITTLE WEAR IS DIFFERENT FROM NO WEAR」(phr.)：極少磨損不同於毫無磨損。例句：Very little wear is different from no wear.（極少磨損不同於毫無磨損。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：已停止供應或生產的（D 開頭，12 個字母）
boss.speak: discontinued
boss.explain: DISCONTINUED (adj.)：已停止供應或生產的。例句：The leaflet identifies a discontinued version.（傳單指出停供版本。）

boss.desc: 填空題：R E _ I L _ A _ L E (內容用完後可再填充的)
boss.speak: refillable
boss.explain: REFILLABLE (adj.)：內容用完後可再填充的。填空答案為「FLB」。例句：The container is refillable.（容器可再填充。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: I found the bag, but not where you said it would be; it was under the seat, not beside it.
options: A. 包在座旁找到，所以你給的位置完全正確。
B. 包沒找到，只有座位下的一張便條。
C. 我把包從座旁移到座下後才開始找。
D. 包找到了，在座下而非你說的座旁。
boss.explain: 結果找到不等於預告位置正確。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: It could have fallen behind the drawer, though we should look before saying that is what happened.
options: A. 可能掉抽屜後，但要查看才說就是如此。
B. 已親眼看見掉落，所以不需再查。
C. 因尚未查就已證明不可能在後面。
D. 說話者要求把抽屜後所有物件都丟棄。
boss.explain: couldhave可能過去，後句要求查證而非定論。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: I am not saying the story is wrong; I am saying the detail you have just added was not in the story we were given.
options: A. 說話者要求只因新細節有趣就當既定事實。
B. 我沒說故事錯，只說你新加細節不在原故事。
C. 原故事已逐字包含新細節，所以不需區分。
D. 我確認故事每項資訊都假，因此所有細節都刪。
boss.explain: 來源界線與故事真偽分別，不能無證添設定。

boss.desc: 【語用】That is one mystery solved, says Lee after finding his glasses on his head. What is the tone?
options: A. A formal announcement of a police investigation.
B. Anger because someone has damaged the glasses.
C. Certainty that another person deliberately hid them.
D. Light amusement at an ordinary mistake.
boss.explain: 普通忘物自嘲用mystery，非外部刑案背景。

boss.desc: 【語意】The explanation is possible, but it is not the only one that fits the note. What follows?
options: A. The note does not uniquely establish that explanation.
B. The explanation has been proved false.
C. The note contains no words that can be read.
D. Every possible explanation is equally likely.
boss.explain: 非唯一支持不等於錯或等機率。

boss.desc: 【短文】A cake is missing from the kitchen. Pat has flour on a sleeve, but says she baked bread elsewhere. No other information is given. Which conclusion is warranted?
options: A. The missing cake must have been bread all along.
B. The flour alone does not establish that Pat took the cake.
C. The flour proves Pat ate the cake before anyone arrived.
D. Pat’s explanation proves she could not have entered the kitchen.
boss.explain: 麵粉有替代來源，不足以唯一定案，也未證Pat必無關。

boss.desc: 請唸出：未被提供或未被注意的細節
boss.speak: a missing detail
boss.explain: 口說表達「A MISSING DETAIL」(phr.)：未被提供或未被注意的細節。例句：One missing detail changes the sequence.（一個遺漏細節改變順序。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：應區分既給事實與新增猜測
boss.ans: WE SHOULD DISTINGUISH A SUPPLIED FACT FROM AN ADDED GUESS
boss.speak: we should distinguish a supplied fact from an added guess
boss.vocabId: R6:WE SHOULD DISTINGUISH A SUPPLIED FACT FROM AN ADDED GUESS
boss.explain: 口說表達「WE SHOULD DISTINGUISH A SUPPLIED FACT FROM AN ADDED GUESS」(phr.)：應區分既給事實與新增猜測。例句：We should distinguish a supplied fact from an added guess.（應區分既給事實與新增猜測。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：使人形成錯誤理解或判斷（M 開頭，7 個字母）
boss.speak: mislead
boss.explain: MISLEAD (v.)：使人形成錯誤理解或判斷。例句：An old label can mislead a reader.（舊標籤可能誤導讀者。）

boss.desc: 填空題：U N _ O _ I _ E D (沒有被察覺的)
boss.speak: unnoticed
boss.explain: UNNOTICED (adj.)：沒有被察覺的。填空答案為「NTC」。例句：The extra cup remained unnoticed.（多出杯子仍未被注意。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The card says you may move again, not that you have to.
options: A. 卡說可再移動，不是必須再移。
B. 卡要求立即再移，而且不能放棄。
C. 再移只在前一步非法時才適用。
D. 說話者要求取消卡片上的選擇。
boss.explain: may許可不同於義務。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The move is legal; I am only asking whether it gets you closer to the goal.
options: A. 說話者在要求改掉正式目標。
B. 這步合規，我只問是否更接近目標。
C. 這步已違規，所以不能討論策略。
D. 只要合規就已保證有助勝利。
boss.explain: 規則合法與策略有效分開。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The rules reward finishing quickly, but not so much that it is worth ignoring every side objective.
options: A. 規則完全不獎速度，只計支線完成數。
B. 說話者已確認每個玩家每回合都必選同路。
C. 規則獎快完，但未高到值得忽略所有支線目標。
D. 速度分已高到任何支線都必無用。
boss.explain: not so much限制速度收益，非否定其存在。

boss.desc: 【語用】Could we go through one practice round before keeping score? What is proposed?
options: A. Trying the rules before starting the scored game.
B. Counting the practice round as the final result.
C. Replacing the scoring rules with a different game.
D. Ending the game before anyone has taken a turn.
boss.explain: before keeping score設定先練不記正式分。

boss.desc: 【語意】The score carries over to the next round. What happens?
options: A. The round ends before any score can be recorded.
B. The next round begins with the existing score retained.
C. The next round begins with everyone’s score reset to zero.
D. The score is given to the player sitting next to its owner.
boss.explain: carry over延續保留，不是轉交鄰座。

boss.desc: 【規則】A shield prevents one attack and is then removed. A player with one shield faces two separate attacks in order. What does the shield itself do?
options: A. It blocks only the second attack after ignoring the first.
B. It remains in place until the player chooses to discard it.
C. It blocks the first attack but not the second.
D. It blocks both attacks because they occur in the same turn.
boss.explain: preventsoneandthenremoved，順序先擋一再失去。

boss.desc: 請唸出：大家共同要達成的目標
boss.speak: a shared objective
boss.explain: 口說表達「A SHARED OBJECTIVE」(phr.)：大家共同要達成的目標。例句：The team pursues a shared objective.（隊伍追共同目標。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：總分比贏輪數重要
boss.ans: THE FINAL SCORE MATTERS MORE THAN THE NUMBER OF ROUNDS WON
boss.speak: the final score matters more than the number of rounds won
boss.vocabId: R6:THE FINAL SCORE MATTERS MORE THAN THE NUMBER OF ROUNDS WON
boss.explain: 口說表達「THE FINAL SCORE MATTERS MORE THAN THE NUMBER OF ROUNDS WON」(phr.)：總分比贏輪數重要。例句：The final score matters more than the number of rounds won.（總分比贏輪數重要。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：逐漸收集而增加數量（A 開頭，10 個字母）
boss.speak: accumulate
boss.explain: ACCUMULATE (v.)：逐漸收集而增加數量。例句：Players accumulate points across rounds.（玩家跨輪累積分數。）

boss.desc: 填空題：C O _ P E _ A T _ V E (由各方互相協助達成共同目標的)
boss.speak: cooperative
boss.explain: COOPERATIVE (adj.)：由各方互相協助達成共同目標的。填空答案為「ORI」。例句：The game is cooperative rather than competitive.（遊戲屬合作而非競爭。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: Was it your first job? My first paid job, yes; I had helped in the family shop before that.
options: A. 說話者確認自己從未在家裡店幫忙。
B. 是第一份有薪工作，之前已幫家裡店。
C. 之前完全沒做過任何事，所以沒有區分。
D. 第一份工作在家裡店，而且已領同樣薪水。
boss.explain: paid限定firstjob的範圍。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The interview runs for an hour, but the extract we are using includes only the part about the journey.
options: A. 節錄比原訪談更長，因另加所有人的旅程。
B. 說話者已刪掉旅程，所以節錄不含它。
C. 訪談一小時，所用節錄只含旅程部分。
D. 整場訪談只有旅程主題，沒有任何其他部分。
boss.explain: 原件時長與選段範圍不同。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The question gave her two choices, and her answer began by explaining why neither described what she remembered.
options: A. 她從兩項中選了一項，並確認另一項完全相反。
B. 訪談者未提供任何選項，所以她拒絕回想。
C. 說話者認為回憶只能依既定選項分類。
D. 問題給兩選項，她先說明兩者都不合記憶。
boss.explain: 回答可拒絕題問框架，不必勉選其一。

boss.desc: 【語用】Take your time; we are not trying to fit the whole story into one minute. What is encouraged?
options: A. Repeating the same sentence for a minute.
B. Answering without feeling rushed.
C. Giving only a one-word response.
D. Ending the interview immediately.
boss.explain: take your time允許從容，不是限更短。

boss.desc: 【語意】The interviewer asks for an example rather than a general description. Which response fits?
options: A. It was the kind of place where everyone seemed to know everyone.
B. The community was probably similar to many other communities.
C. One evening, our neighbours brought chairs into the street and we all ate together.
D. People were generally friendly and the area was pleasant.
boss.explain: 具體一次場景為例子，其他仍概括描述。

boss.desc: 【短文】A speaker says a shop was always open, then explains that the owner closed it every Sunday. Which interpretation best reconciles the remarks?
options: A. The shop must have had a second owner who opened it on Sundays.
B. The speaker has proved the shop never existed.
C. Every Sunday refers to one particular Sunday only.
D. Always is being used loosely for regular availability, not literally every day.
boss.explain: 口語always常概括，後文明示例外限制字面。

boss.desc: 請唸出：鮮明的個人經驗敘述
boss.speak: a vivid personal account
boss.explain: 口說表達「A VIVID PERSONAL ACCOUNT」(phr.)：鮮明的個人經驗敘述。例句：She gave a vivid personal account.（她給出鮮明個人敘述。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：具體例子可說清概括描述
boss.ans: A SPECIFIC EXAMPLE CAN CLARIFY A GENERAL DESCRIPTION
boss.speak: a specific example can clarify a general description
boss.vocabId: R6:A SPECIFIC EXAMPLE CAN CLARIFY A GENERAL DESCRIPTION
boss.explain: 口說表達「A SPECIFIC EXAMPLE CAN CLARIFY A GENERAL DESCRIPTION」(phr.)：具體例子可說清概括描述。例句：A specific example can clarify a general description.（具體例子可說清概括描述。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：努力想起過去某事（R 開頭，9 個字母）
boss.speak: recollect
boss.explain: RECOLLECT (v.)：努力想起過去某事。例句：She could not recollect the exact date.（她想不起精確日期。）

boss.desc: 填空題：R E _ O _ D _ N G (把聲音影像保留下來的紀錄)
boss.speak: recording
boss.explain: RECORDING (n.)：把聲音影像保留下來的紀錄。填空答案為「CRI」。例句：The recording includes laughter.（錄音包含笑聲。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: I heard the doorbell, but by the time I reached the door, whoever rang it had gone.
options: A. 開門時來者仍在，於是一起走了。
B. 聽見的是電話，而不是門鈴。
C. 聽見門鈴，但開門前來者已離開。
D. 沒聽見門鈴，卻剛好在門外遇到來者。
boss.explain: by the time…had gone確定先離開、後到門口。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: Could you repeat the last part? I caught the date, just not the place.
options: A. 請重說日期；地點已記下。
B. 日期和地點都已聽清，不必再說。
C. 最後一段沒有提到任何地點。
D. 請重說地點；日期已聽清。
boss.explain: caught在此為聽懂；just not the place縮限未聽清部分。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The microphone picked up every rustle of paper, yet somehow missed half of what the speaker actually said.
options: A. 麥克風收進紙張窸窣，卻漏掉不少發言。
B. 發言收得完整，只有紙聲沒錄到。
C. 發言者故意以翻紙代替所有回答。
D. 錄音者事後加入紙聲遮掩發言。
boss.explain: yet表對比；half口語概指大量遺漏，無故意造假證據。

boss.desc: 【語用】Would you mind turning it down a little? The baby has just fallen asleep. What is requested?
options: A. An explanation of how the speaker works.
B. An immediate end to the visit.
C. A modest reduction in volume.
D. A change to a different song.
boss.explain: turn it down降低音量；a little並未要求完全關掉。

boss.desc: 【語意】The room was quieter after the carpet was laid, though voices from the corridor were still noticeable. Which claim is supported?
options: A. The carpet increased noise from the corridor.
B. The corridor had become empty.
C. The room could no longer be used for conversation.
D. The carpet reduced some noise without making the room silent.
boss.explain: quieter是比較，不等於完全無聲；後句明示仍可聽見走廊人聲。

boss.desc: 【短文】The recording captures the crowd more clearly than the person speaking. A listener says it conveys the atmosphere better than the argument. What is the limitation?
options: A. It preserves the setting more effectively than the speaker’s reasoning.
B. It contains no evidence that an audience was present.
C. It makes the speaker’s reasoning easier to follow than a transcript would.
D. It replaces the crowd’s reactions with invented sounds.
boss.explain: 聽清群眾而非發言，能感受氣氛卻較難追隨論證；無剪造證據。

boss.desc: 請唸出：彼此不感尷尬的一段沉默
boss.speak: a comfortable silence
boss.explain: 口說表達「A COMFORTABLE SILENCE」(phr.)：彼此不感尷尬的一段沉默。例句：They sat together in a comfortable silence.（他們自在而安靜地坐在一起。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：她等到掌聲漸漸平息
boss.ans: SHE WAITED UNTIL THE APPLAUSE HAD DIED DOWN
boss.speak: she waited until the applause had died down
boss.vocabId: R6:SHE WAITED UNTIL THE APPLAUSE HAD DIED DOWN
boss.explain: 口說表達「SHE WAITED UNTIL THE APPLAUSE HAD DIED DOWN」(phr.)：她等到掌聲漸漸平息。例句：She waited until the applause had died down.（她等到掌聲漸漸平息。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：讓人放心或安心的（R 開頭，10 個字母）
boss.speak: reassuring
boss.explain: REASSURING (adj.)：讓人放心或安心的。例句：Her reassuring voice helped him relax.（她讓人安心的聲音使他放鬆。）

boss.desc: 填空題：I N T _ R R _ P T _ O N (使原活動暫時中斷的事件)
boss.speak: interruption
boss.explain: INTERRUPTION (n.)：使原活動暫時中斷的事件。填空答案為「EUI」。例句：The interruption made her lose her place.（這次打斷使她忘了讀到哪裡。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: I can come on Friday, just not before four.
options: A. 週五四點之前能來，之後不行。
B. 只有週四能來，週五沒有空。
C. 週五無法出席，所以要取消。
D. 週五能來，但四點以前不行。
boss.explain: not before four限最早時間，不是否定週五出席。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: Let us keep the original booking until the alternative is confirmed. There is no point losing both.
options: A. 備選未確認前，先保留原預約，免得兩頭落空。
B. 立刻取消兩個預約，以免重複付款。
C. 備選一提出就算確定，可取消原預約。
D. 原預約已失效，所以無法保留。
boss.explain: until提供保留期限條件；理由是避免兩方案都失去。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: I do not mind a change of plan. I just need to know before I set off, rather than after I have arrived.
options: A. 已抵達現場，所以要求立刻開始。
B. 不介意改計畫，只希望出發前得知。
C. 反對任何改動，即使事先通知也一樣。
D. 希望抵達後才知道有哪些改動。
boss.explain: 主訴求為通知時間，不是拒絕改動。

boss.desc: 【語用】I could move my appointment, but I would rather not unless it is necessary. What is the speaker saying?
options: A. The appointment has already been moved.
B. A change is impossible under any circumstances.
C. The speaker wants someone else to cancel their appointment.
D. A change is possible but not preferred.
boss.explain: could表示可行，would rather not表示不偏好，unless保留必要時例外。

boss.desc: 【短文】A group agrees to meet at the east gate. One member suggests the café instead because the gate is exposed to rain. The others accept without changing the time. What has changed?
options: A. The meeting place, while the agreed time remains.
B. The meeting time, while the gate remains the venue.
C. The purpose of the meeting and everyone invited.
D. The route from the café to the east gate.
boss.explain: instead取代地點，without changing the time排除時間變更。

boss.desc: 【短文】The original route was shorter, but the revised one avoids a steep hill. A walker with a heavy bag prefers the revision. What is the most plausible trade-off?
options: A. A heavier bag in exchange for a more direct route.
B. A longer distance in exchange for an easier climb.
C. A steeper climb in exchange for a shorter distance.
D. An earlier departure in exchange for a cheaper ticket.
boss.explain: shorter屬原路，避陡坡屬新路；不添加票價或出發時間。

boss.desc: 請唸出：還可能調整的暫定安排
boss.speak: a provisional arrangement
boss.explain: 口說表達「A PROVISIONAL ARRANGEMENT」(phr.)：還可能調整的暫定安排。例句：This is a provisional arrangement for the first week.（這是第一週暫定安排。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：可以調整活動而不放棄目的
boss.ans: WE CAN ADAPT THE ACTIVITY WITHOUT ABANDONING ITS PURPOSE
boss.speak: we can adapt the activity without abandoning its purpose
boss.vocabId: R6:WE CAN ADAPT THE ACTIVITY WITHOUT ABANDONING ITS PURPOSE
boss.explain: 口說表達「WE CAN ADAPT THE ACTIVITY WITHOUT ABANDONING ITS PURPOSE」(phr.)：可以調整活動而不放棄目的。例句：We can adapt the activity without abandoning its purpose.（可以調整活動而不放棄目的。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：計畫在實際條件下能否辦到的可行性（F 開頭，11 個字母）
boss.speak: feasibility
boss.explain: FEASIBILITY (n.)：計畫在實際條件下能否辦到的可行性。例句：We checked the feasibility of an outdoor session.（我們確認戶外場次的可行性。）

boss.desc: 填空題：U N _ O R _ S _ E N (事前沒有預料到的)
boss.speak: unforeseen
boss.explain: UNFORESEEN (adj.)：事前沒有預料到的。填空答案為「FEE」。例句：Due to unforeseen circumstances, the event has been canceled.（由於無法預料的情況，活動已被取消。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: Do I need a tie? No, just something reasonably smart.
options: A. 不必領帶，穿得適度整齊即可。
B. 一定要領帶，而且只能選黑色。
C. 完全沒有衣著要求，任何穿著都可以。
D. 只有領帶需要整齊，其他衣服不重要。
boss.explain: 否定領帶必要性，但reasonably smart仍有整齊程度要求。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: It only looks black under this lighting. Take it by the window and you will see the green.
options: A. 燈光已證明這衣服完全沒有固定顏色。
B. 這種燈下才像黑色，到窗邊會看出綠色。
C. 到窗邊會把衣服永久染成綠色。
D. 衣服是黑色，綠色只是窗戶標籤。
boss.explain: looks與see區分光線下的色彩呈現，不是實際染色。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: I would not throw it away just because it is out of fashion. The question is whether you still enjoy wearing it.
options: A. 只要仍然流行，就代表穿起來一定舒適。
B. 說話者要求所有舊衣都必須永久留下。
C. 別只因過時丟掉，應問自己是否仍喜歡穿。
D. 既然過時就該丟，即使自己仍愛穿也一樣。
boss.explain: 質疑單以流行判斷取捨，不是無條件留每件舊衣。

boss.desc: 【語用】It is lovely, though I am not sure I would wear it to a muddy outdoor event. What is being questioned?
options: A. Its suitability for that occasion.
B. Its attractiveness in general.
C. Whether outdoor events can be enjoyable.
D. Whether the speaker owns any other clothes.
boss.explain: lovely認可好看，though後限制特定場合的適用性。

boss.desc: 【短文】A theatre uses the same grey coat for two characters. Each wears a different badge, allowing the audience to distinguish them. What identifies the characters?
options: A. The order in which audience members entered.
B. The badges rather than the coat alone.
C. The colour of two different coats.
D. The actors’ spoken explanations of the costume budget.
boss.explain: 同件灰外套不獨立區分角色，不同徽章才是指定線索。

boss.desc: 【短文】A walker packs two thin layers instead of one thick jumper because she wants to remove one when she warms up. What advantage matters to her?
options: A. Avoiding the need to carry any spare clothing.
B. Ensuring that the walk takes less time.
C. Being able to adjust how much warmth the clothing provides.
D. Keeping the same amount of clothing on throughout the walk.
boss.explain: 題內理由是可脫一層調節，不添加步行時間或零負重。

boss.desc: 請唸出：具有鮮明辨識特徵的衣物
boss.speak: a distinctive piece of clothing
boss.explain: 口說表達「A DISTINCTIVE PIECE OF CLOTHING」(phr.)：具有鮮明辨識特徵的衣物。例句：A distinctive piece of clothing helped identify the character.（有鮮明特徵的衣物幫助辨識角色。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：戲服應幫助觀眾辨識角色
boss.ans: THE COSTUME SHOULD HELP THE AUDIENCE RECOGNISE THE CHARACTER
boss.speak: the costume should help the audience recognise the character
boss.vocabId: R6:THE COSTUME SHOULD HELP THE AUDIENCE RECOGNISE THE CHARACTER
boss.explain: 口說表達「THE COSTUME SHOULD HELP THE AUDIENCE RECOGNISE THE CHARACTER」(phr.)：戲服應幫助觀眾辨識角色。例句：The costume should help the audience recognise the character.（戲服應幫助觀眾辨識角色。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：為隱藏身分而作的外表改裝（D 開頭，8 個字母）
boss.speak: disguise
boss.explain: DISGUISE (n.)：為隱藏身分而作的外表改裝。例句：The hat was part of her disguise.（帽子是她偽裝的一部分。）

boss.desc: 填空題：D I _ T I _ C T _ V E (特徵鮮明而容易辨認的)
boss.speak: distinctive
boss.explain: DISTINCTIVE (adj.)：特徵鮮明而容易辨認的。填空答案為「SNI」。例句：The distinctive collar appears in every portrait.（每幅肖像都能看到那個特別的衣領。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The arrow points to the car park, not to the building entrance.
options: A. 箭頭表示停車場和建築入口都在前方。
B. 箭頭指停車場，不是建築入口。
C. 箭頭指建築入口，停車場在旁邊。
D. 箭頭指停車場內的建築入口。
boss.explain: not to明確排除把箭頭當建築入口指示。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: It is marked as a through road, although the barrier suggests it no longer is one.
options: A. 障礙物只限制停車，不影響道路通行。
B. 圖上道路與眼前道路有不同名字，因此不是同一條。
C. 圖上標可穿越，但障礙物顯示現在可能已不能通行。
D. 圖上標道路封閉，障礙物卻表示已重新開放。
boss.explain: no longer is one承接through road；suggests是現場線索而非確定公告。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: Let us use the printed map for the overall route and the signs for the last few turns.
options: A. 先用路牌規畫全程，再以紙本圖找最後出口。
B. 紙本圖只用來估時間，路牌才提供全程方向。
C. 先比較兩種資訊，之後只選其中一種使用。
D. 全程方向參考紙本圖，最後幾個轉彎看路牌。
boss.explain: overall與last few turns分配不同尺度的資訊用途，非擇一。

boss.desc: 【路線】The museum entrance has moved to the courtyard. The map still shows it on the main street. Which information needs updating?
options: A. The opening time of the museum.
B. The location of the museum entrance.
C. The name of the main street.
D. The position of the museum courtyard.
boss.explain: 搬動的是入口；未說街名、庭院位置或開放時間改變。

boss.desc: 【語意】The route is straightforward once you have found the right entrance. What qualification is being made?
options: A. The entrance is marked more clearly than the route.
B. The route becomes shorter after the first visit.
C. Finding the entrance may be the tricky part.
D. Every entrance leads to the same route.
boss.explain: once條件限定容易的是找到正確入口之後，不保證入口本身好找。

boss.desc: 【短文】A walker retraces her steps to the last junction she recognises instead of following another unfamiliar lane. What is her strategy?
options: A. Continuing until an unfamiliar lane becomes recognisable.
B. Choosing a new route to avoid repeating any ground.
C. Checking whether the destination has moved since her last visit.
D. Returning to a known point before deciding again.
boss.explain: retrace回走，last junction she recognises提供重新定位的已知點。

boss.desc: 請唸出單字：朝上坡方向的
boss.speak: uphill
boss.explain: 口說表達「UPHILL」(adj.)：朝上坡方向的。例句：The uphill section starts just beyond the cottages.（上坡路段從小屋再過去一點開始。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：我們先回到那個熟悉的路口。
boss.ans: LET US RETURN TO THAT FAMILIAR JUNCTION
boss.speak: let us return to that familiar junction
boss.vocabId: R6:LET US RETURN TO THAT FAMILIAR JUNCTION
boss.explain: 口說表達「LET US RETURN TO THAT FAMILIAR JUNCTION」(phr.)：我們先回到那個熟悉的路口。。例句：Let us return to that familiar junction.（我們先回到那個熟悉的路口。。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：對自身位置與方向的辨識（O 開頭，11 個字母）
boss.speak: orientation
boss.explain: ORIENTATION (n.)：對自身位置與方向的辨識。例句：The first exercise helps visitors develop a sense of orientation.（第一個練習幫助訪客建立位置與方向感。）

boss.desc: 填空題：V I _ I B _ L _ T Y (能見度；可看清的程度)
boss.speak: visibility
boss.explain: VISIBILITY (n.)：能見度；可看清的程度。填空答案為「SII」。例句：Poor visibility made the distant tower hard to recognise.（能見度差，遠處的塔不容易辨認。）

boss.desc: 【綜合】Business Review: The retail giant's downfall is generally understood to have been triggered by its failure to adapt to e-commerce. For years, executives had been ignoring the digital shift, mistakenly believing their brick-and-mortar dominance was unassailable. They must have severely miscalculated consumer behavior. Now, large-scale layoffs are expected to be announced. Q: Which of the following best describes the executives' past mindset?
options: A. They were overly confident in their physical stores.
B. They were pioneering the transition to digital sales.
C. They have been constantly restructuring the company.
D. They expected the layoffs to boost their stock price.
boss.explain: 文中指出主管們誤以為他們的實體店優勢是無懈可擊的 (mistakenly believing their brick-and-mortar dominance was unassailable)，代表他們對實體店過度自信。

boss.desc: 【綜合】Science Journal: Anthropologists have been debating the purpose of the newly discovered ruins. The complex structure is hypothesized to have been utilized as a celestial observatory. Given the precision of the stonework, the builders must have possessed advanced mathematical knowledge. Q: What is the main conclusion drawn about the ancient builders?
options: A. They struggled with complex architectural designs.
B. They were highly skilled in mathematics.
C. They used the ruins primarily for religious rituals.
D. They have been living in the region for centuries.
boss.explain: 短文推論「the builders must have possessed advanced mathematical knowledge」（建造者一定具備先進的數學知識），故選 B。

boss.desc: 【綜合】Policy Paper Summary: The proposed carbon tax has been facing fierce opposition from industrial sectors. Proponents argue that the measure is essential and is proven to have reduced emissions in neighboring countries. The government's failure to consult industry leaders beforehand must have exacerbated the backlash. Q: Why did the policy face a severe backlash according to the passage?
options: A. It failed to reduce emissions in neighboring countries.
B. The government did not communicate with industry leaders in advance.
C. Industrial sectors have been demanding higher taxes.
D. Proponents did not believe the measure was essential.
boss.explain: 文中提到「The government's failure to consult industry leaders beforehand must have exacerbated the backlash」（政府事前未諮詢業界領袖一定加劇了反彈）。

boss.desc: 【綜合】Tech News: Developers have been working around the clock to patch a critical vulnerability. The security flaw is reported to have compromised the data of millions of users. The company's stock plummeted following the breach; investors must have panicked over the potential legal liabilities. Q: What was the consequence of the security flaw?
options: A. The developers were sued by the investors.
B. Millions of users lost their internet connection.
C. The company's stock value dropped sharply.
D. The vulnerability was patched before any data was lost.
boss.explain: 文章明確指出「The company's stock plummeted following the breach」（漏洞發生後公司股票暴跌）。

boss.desc: 【綜合】Editorial Opinion: The housing crisis is often said to have been caused solely by foreign investors. However, domestic policies have been restricting urban development for decades. The city council must have ignored the growing population metrics when zoning the residential areas. Q: What does the author believe is a major factor in the housing crisis?
options: A. An influx of foreign workers.
B. Restrictive domestic urban development policies.
C. Overdevelopment of residential areas.
D. Accurate tracking of population metrics.
boss.explain: 作者認為雖然常被說是外國投資者造成的，但國內政策數十年來一直在限制都市發展 (domestic policies have been restricting...)，這才是真正的關鍵因素。

boss.desc: 【語法結構】Not only ___ a profound impact on the local economy, but the new infrastructure is also expected to attract foreign investment.
options: A. the project has had
B. has the project had
C. the project is having
D. is the project had
boss.explain: 否定副詞 Not only 放句首時，後方需接倒裝句型（助動詞移至主詞前），故選 has the project had。

boss.desc: 【綜合】Medical Breakthrough: A new synthetic compound is purported to have cured several autoimmune diseases in clinical trials. Researchers have been refining its chemical structure to minimize side effects. The initial funding agency must have recognized its immense potential early on, given their continuous financial support. Q: What are researchers currently trying to achieve?
options: A. Secure more funding from the agency.
B. Reduce the side effects of the synthetic compound.
C. Prove that autoimmune diseases are incurable.
D. Patent the chemical structure globally.
boss.explain: 文中指出「Researchers have been refining its chemical structure to minimize side effects」（研究人員一直在改良其化學結構以將副作用降至最低）。

boss.desc: 【綜合】Corporate Memo: The merger with Apex Corp is anticipated to be finalized by the fourth quarter. Both legal teams have been scrutinizing the contractual obligations diligently. Any discrepancies found now must have been overlooked during the initial audit phase. Q: What is implied about the initial audit phase?
options: A. It was conducted flawlessly without errors.
B. It was handled exclusively by Apex Corp.
C. It might not have been thorough enough.
D. It was deliberately delayed by the legal teams.
boss.explain: 文中提到「現在發現的任何差異一定是在初步審計階段被忽略的」，暗示初步審計可能不夠徹底。

boss.desc: 【綜合】Travel Advisory: Travelers have been experiencing unprecedented delays at the international terminal due to a staff strike. The situation is estimated to be resolved within 48 hours. Passengers whose flights were cancelled must have been notified via email or text message. Q: What caused the delays at the international terminal?
options: A. Severe weather conditions.
B. A malfunction in the booking system.
C. A work stoppage by employees.
D. Unprecedented passenger volume.
boss.explain: 短文指出延誤是由於「staff strike」（員工罷工），即選項中的 work stoppage by employees。

boss.desc: 【語法結構】Scarcely ___ the press conference when a reporter asked a provocative question about the scandal.
options: A. had the CEO begun
B. the CEO had begun
C. has the CEO begun
D. the CEO began
boss.explain: 否定副詞 Scarcely 放句首時需倒裝，且配合 when 引導的過去式子句，主要子句應用過去完成式，故選 had the CEO begun。

boss.desc: 【綜合】Environmental Report: The shrinking of the ice caps is widely acknowledged to have accelerated over the last decade. Scientists have been urging policymakers to implement stringent regulations. The continuous dismissal of these warnings must have contributed significantly to the current ecological crisis. Q: What is the main point regarding policymakers?
options: A. They have successfully implemented stringent regulations.
B. Their disregard of scientific warnings worsened the crisis.
C. They are widely acknowledged to have accelerated the research.
D. They have been urging scientists to collect more data.
boss.explain: 文中提到「The continuous dismissal of these warnings must have contributed significantly...」（不斷忽視這些警告肯定大大促成了當前的危機），指出決策者的忽視使情況惡化。

boss.desc: 【綜合】Art History Analysis: The stolen masterpiece is now believed to have been smuggled out of the country in a freight container. Detectives have been tracking a notorious art syndicate connected to the heist. Security guards at the museum must have been bribed, as the alarm system was manually disabled. Q: How did the thieves likely manage to disable the alarm system?
options: A. By hacking into the main server.
B. By paying off the museum's security personnel.
C. By smuggling a device in a freight container.
D. By cutting the power supply to the building.
boss.explain: 文中明確推測「Security guards at the museum must have been bribed」（保全一定被收買了），對應選項 B (paying off security personnel)。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The true operational costs have been deliberately obscured by the accounting firm.
options: A. 會計師事務所大幅降低了實際的營運成本。
B. 真實的營運成本已經被清晰且透明地公開。
C. 真實的營運成本已被會計師事務所蓄意掩蓋。
D. 會計師事務所發現了營運成本中的重大錯誤。
boss.explain: The true operational costs have been deliberately obscured by the accounting firm. (真實的營運成本已被會計師事務所蓄意掩蓋。) obscure 作動詞指「掩蓋、使模糊」；deliberately 意為「蓄意地」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The domestic economy must have been more resilient to inflation than the experts predicted.
options: A. 國內經濟對通貨膨脹的反應非常脆弱且敏感。
B. 經濟專家極度準確地預測了經濟的反彈趨勢。
C. 國內經濟完全沒有受到任何通貨膨脹的影響。
D. 國內經濟對通膨的抵抗力一定比專家預測的更強。
boss.explain: The domestic economy must have been more resilient to inflation than the experts predicted. (國內經濟對通膨的抵抗力一定比專家預測的更強。) resilient 指「有韌性的、能迅速恢復的」；must have been 表強烈推測。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The consistently high interest rates have been deterring potential foreign investors.
options: A. 持續的高利率一直阻礙著潛在的外國投資者。
B. 持續的高利率成功吸引了大量的外國資金。
C. 潛在的投資者對目前的高利率狀態毫不在乎。
D. 外國投資者持續要求銀行提供更高的利率。
boss.explain: The consistently high interest rates have been deterring potential foreign investors. (持續的高利率一直阻礙著潛在的外國投資者。) deter 指「阻嚇、使打消念頭」；使用現在完成進行式強調此現象持續發生。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: An intricate network of environmental sensors is being installed across the metropolitan area.
options: A. 城市目前正在拆除原本極為複雜的感測器網路。
B. 一個複雜的環境感測器網路正在大都會區安裝中。
C. 一個簡易且基礎的感測器網路已經安裝完畢。
D. 大都會區嚴重缺乏用於監控環境的感測器硬體。
boss.explain: An intricate network of environmental sensors is being installed across the metropolitan area. (一個複雜的環境感測器網路正在大都會區安裝中。) intricate 指「錯綜複雜的」；is being installed 為現在進行被動語態。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: Several key financial details must have been omitted from the final quarterly report.
options: A. 最終的季度報告完整包含了所有的財務細節。
B. 季度報告中的一些細節被刻意過度強調了。
C. 最終的季報中一定遺漏了幾個關鍵的財務細節。
D. 公司的最終財務報告尚未編寫完成。
boss.explain: Several key financial details must have been omitted from the final quarterly report. (最終的季報中一定遺漏了幾個關鍵的財務細節。) omit 指「遺漏、省略」；must have been omitted 結合了情態動詞與被動語態。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: She has been taking a significantly more prominent role in the international trade negotiations.
options: A. I heard she recently resigned from her corporate role.
B. International trade volumes are unfortunately declining.
C. The negotiations have been stalled for weeks anyway.
D. Her leadership has really helped push things forward.
boss.explain: She has been taking a significantly more prominent role in the international trade negotiations. (她在國際貿易談判中一直扮演著更為突出的角色。) prominent 指「突出的、顯著的」；回應讚賞她的領導能力推動了進展最合適。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: A rapid shift towards renewable energy sources is being strongly advocated by policy makers.
options: A. 政策制定者正強烈主張迅速轉向再生能源。
B. 政策制定者極力反對在近期內使用再生能源。
C. 轉向再生能源的全球性政策轉型已經徹底完成。
D. 目前沒有任何政府官員支持再生能源的發展計畫。
boss.explain: A rapid shift towards renewable energy sources is being strongly advocated by policy makers. (政策制定者正強烈主張迅速轉向再生能源。) advocate 作動詞指「提倡、主張」；is being strongly advocated 為被動語態。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The emergency rescue efforts must have been severely hampered by the unexpected snowstorm.
options: A. Luckily, the snowstorm cleared up very quickly.
B. Yes, it made reaching the remote site almost impossible.
C. The rescue operation was declared a complete success.
D. We unfortunately don't have enough rescue teams right now.
boss.explain: The emergency rescue efforts must have been severely hampered by the unexpected snowstorm. (緊急救援行動一定受到了意外暴風雪的嚴重阻礙。) hamper 指「妨礙、阻礙」；回答「是的，這讓抵達偏遠現場幾乎成為不可能」符合因果關係。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: We have been comprehensively analyzing the long-term implications of this major policy shift.
options: A. 我們刻意忽略了這項重大政策轉變可能帶來的長期影響。
B. 專家認為這項重大政策轉變並不會帶來任何實際影響。
C. 我們一直在全面分析這項重大政策轉變的長期影響。
D. 公司高層認為短期的營利影響遠比長期的政策影響重要。
boss.explain: We have been comprehensively analyzing the long-term implications of this major policy shift. (我們一直在全面分析這項重大政策轉變的長期影響。) implication 在此指「可能引發的後果、影響」；comprehensively 意為「全面地」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: A significant portion of the generated revenue is expected to be reinvested into research and development.
options: A. We are actually losing a lot of money this fiscal year.
B. R&D has been entirely defunded by the new management.
C. The revenue was strictly set aside for paying off old debt.
D. That should really help us innovate faster for next year.
boss.explain: A significant portion of the generated revenue is expected to be reinvested into research and development. (產生的一大部分營收預計將重新投資於研發。) revenue 指「營收」；投資研發的回應「那應該能幫助我們明年加速創新」最恰當。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The engineering team must have worked for three consecutive weekends to meet that impossible deadline.
options: A. 工程團隊一定連續工作了三個週末才趕上那個不可能的期限。
B. 即使工程團隊努力了，他們依然錯過了那個最後期限。
C. 為了保持效率，工程團隊在過去的幾個週末都在休息。
D. 工程團隊只花了一個週末的時間就完成了那項困難的工作。
boss.explain: The engineering team must have worked for three consecutive weekends to meet that impossible deadline. (工程團隊一定連續工作了三個週末才趕上那個不可能的期限。) consecutive 指「連續的」；must have worked 推測過去已發生的努力。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The current foreign exchange market situation is considered to be highly volatile at this particular moment.
options: A. The market is completely stable right now, don't worry.
B. Perhaps we should delay our large currency conversion then.
C. Exchange rates basically never change in this region.
D. Volatility is just a myth invented by stock brokers.
boss.explain: The current foreign exchange market situation is considered to be highly volatile at this particular moment. (目前的匯市情況在此刻被認為是高度波動的。) volatile 指「易變的、波動大的」；回應「或許我們該延後大額外幣兌換」是明智的對策。

boss.desc: 請唸出：列入考量
boss.speak: take into consideration
boss.explain: 口說表達「TAKE INTO CONSIDERATION」(phr.)：列入考量。

boss.desc: 請唸出：一直在談判
boss.speak: have been negotiating
boss.explain: 口說表達「HAVE BEEN NEGOTIATING」(phr.)：一直在談判。

boss.desc: 請唸出：為不便道歉
boss.speak: apologize for the inconvenience
boss.explain: 口說表達「APOLOGIZE FOR THE INCONVENIENCE」(phr.)：為不便道歉。

boss.desc: 請唸出：他們一定是送錯物品了
boss.ans: THEY MUST HAVE SENT THE WRONG ITEM
boss.speak: they must have sent the wrong item
boss.explain: 口說表達「THEY MUST HAVE SENT THE WRONG ITEM」(phr.)：他們一定是送錯物品了。

boss.desc: 請唸出：專案一直進行得很順利
boss.ans: THE PROJECT HAS BEEN GOING WELL
boss.speak: the project has been going well
boss.explain: 口說表達「THE PROJECT HAS BEEN GOING WELL」(phr.)：專案一直進行得很順利。

boss.desc: 請唸出：你等了多久了
boss.ans: HOW LONG HAVE YOU BEEN WAITING
boss.speak: how long have you been waiting
boss.explain: 口說表達「HOW LONG HAVE YOU BEEN WAITING」(phr.)：你等了多久了。

boss.desc: 請唸出：他可能錯過了航班
boss.ans: HE MIGHT HAVE MISSED THE FLIGHT
boss.speak: he might have missed the flight
boss.explain: 口說表達「HE MIGHT HAVE MISSED THE FLIGHT」(phr.)：他可能錯過了航班。

boss.desc: 請唸出：我們需要找到妥協的方法
boss.ans: WE NEED TO FIND A COMPROMISE
boss.speak: we need to find a compromise
boss.explain: 口說表達「WE NEED TO FIND A COMPROMISE」(phr.)：我們需要找到妥協的方法。

boss.desc: 請唸出：問題現在正在解決中
boss.ans: THE ISSUE IS BEING RESOLVED NOW
boss.speak: the issue is being resolved now
boss.explain: 口說表達「THE ISSUE IS BEING RESOLVED NOW」(phr.)：問題現在正在解決中。

boss.desc: 請唸出：我一直在審查這些資料
boss.ans: I HAVE BEEN REVIEWING THE DATA
boss.speak: i have been reviewing the data
boss.explain: 口說表達「I HAVE BEEN REVIEWING THE DATA」(phr.)：我一直在審查這些資料。

boss.desc: 請唸出：你一定一直非常忙碌
boss.ans: YOU MUST HAVE BEEN VERY BUSY
boss.speak: you must have been very busy
boss.explain: 口說表達「YOU MUST HAVE BEEN VERY BUSY」(phr.)：你一定一直非常忙碌。

boss.desc: 請唸出：我們可以討論一下預算嗎
boss.speak: could we discuss the budget
boss.explain: 口說表達「COULD WE DISCUSS THE BUDGET」(phr.)：我們可以討論一下預算嗎。

boss.desc: 請唸出：這個提案一定已經被批准了
boss.ans: THIS PROPOSAL MUST HAVE BEEN APPROVED
boss.speak: this proposal must have been approved
boss.explain: 口說表達「THIS PROPOSAL MUST HAVE BEEN APPROVED」(phr.)：這個提案一定已經被批准了。

boss.desc: 請拼出：倡議；新計畫
boss.speak: initiative
boss.explain: INITIATIVE (n.)：未待指示而主動採取行動的能力。例句：The role requires initiative as well as cooperation.（職務需要主動性，也需要合作。）

boss.desc: 填空題：F E _ S I B _ L _ T Y (可行性)
boss.speak: feasibility
boss.explain: FEASIBILITY (n.)：可行性。填空答案為「AII」。例句：We checked the feasibility of an outdoor session.（我們確認戶外場次的可行性。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：全面的；詳盡的
boss.speak: comprehensive
boss.explain: COMPREHENSIVE (n.)：請拼出：全面的；詳盡的。

boss.desc: 填空題：C O M P R _ H _ N S _ V E (全面的；詳盡的)
boss.speak: comprehensive
boss.explain: COMPREHENSIVE (n.)：全面的；詳盡的。填空答案為「EEI」。

boss.desc: 請拼出：正當理由
boss.speak: justification
boss.explain: JUSTIFICATION (n.)：正當理由。例句：There must have been some strong justification for terminating the contract so abruptly.（如此突然終止合約一定有某些強而有力的正當理由。）

boss.desc: 填空題：J U S T _ F _ C _ T I O N (正當理由)
boss.speak: justification
boss.explain: JUSTIFICATION (n.)：正當理由。填空答案為「IIA」。例句：There must have been some strong justification for terminating the contract so abruptly.（如此突然終止合約一定有某些強而有力的正當理由。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：不滿
boss.speak: dissatisfaction
boss.explain: DISSATISFACTION (n.)：不滿。例句：Public dissatisfaction is widely believed to have been fueled by poor communication.（大眾的不滿被普遍認為是由於溝通不良所激起的。）

boss.desc: 填空題：D _ S S A T _ S F _ C T I O N (不滿)
boss.speak: dissatisfaction
boss.explain: DISSATISFACTION (n.)：不滿。填空答案為「IIA」。例句：Public dissatisfaction is widely believed to have been fueled by poor communication.（大眾的不滿被普遍認為是由於溝通不良所激起的。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：獲利能力
boss.speak: profitability
boss.explain: PROFITABILITY (n.)：獲利能力。例句：The profitability of the new product line is estimated to have exceeded expectations.（新產品線的獲利能力估計已超出了預期。）

boss.desc: 填空題：P R O F _ T _ B _ L I T Y (獲利能力)
boss.speak: profitability
boss.explain: PROFITABILITY (n.)：獲利能力。填空答案為「IAI」。例句：The profitability of the new product line is estimated to have exceeded expectations.（新產品線的獲利能力估計已超出了預期。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: Substantial discrepancies in the financial statements must have been overlooked during the initial audit.
options: A. 財務報表中的重大差異一定是在初步審計時被忽略了。
B. 我們必須在初步審計時找出財務報表中的重大差異。
C. 初步審計時，財務報表中的重大差異並沒有被忽略。
D. 財務報表中的重大差異導致了初步審計的失敗。
boss.explain: 原句：Substantial discrepancies in the financial statements must have been overlooked during the initial audit. 意思：財務報表中的重大差異一定是在初步審計時被忽略了。discrepancy (差異)、overlook (忽略)。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The proposed merger has been facing mounting opposition from key shareholders.
options: A. Key shareholders must have proposed a new merger.
B. Are they planning to restructure the deal to appease them?
C. The opposition was mounted on the wall.
D. Mergers are always very agreeable to everyone.
boss.explain: 原句：The proposed merger has been facing mounting opposition from key shareholders.（提議的合併案一直面臨來自主要股東日益增加的反對。）回應 B「他們打算重組交易來安撫他們嗎？」展現對商業困境的理解。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The outdated machinery is slated to be dismantled and replaced by automated robotics.
options: A. 過時的機械預計將被拆除，並由自動化機器人取代。
B. 自動化機器人正在拆除過時的機械。
C. 我們不打算拆除過時的機械，而是直接引入機器人。
D. 過時的機械已經被自動化機器人完全取代了。
boss.explain: 原句：The outdated machinery is slated to be dismantled and replaced by automated robotics. 意思：過時的機械預計將被拆除，並由自動化機器人取代。is slated to be 預計將被...

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The sudden dip in our quarterly earnings must have been triggered by the global supply chain disruptions.
options: A. 季度收益的突然下滑一定是全球供應鏈中斷所引發的。
B. 全球供應鏈中斷必須由季度收益的下滑來觸發。
C. 季度收益的下滑並沒有受到全球供應鏈中斷的影響。
D. 為了防止供應鏈中斷，我們必須接受季度收益下滑。
boss.explain: 原句：The sudden dip in our quarterly earnings must have been triggered by the global supply chain disruptions. 意思：季度收益的突然下滑一定是全球供應鏈中斷所引發的。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The research and development department has been spearheading the initiative to utilize biodegradable materials.
options: A. Have they encountered any structural integrity issues with those materials?
B. The department must have thrown a spear at the materials.
C. Biodegradable materials are not biodegradable at all.
D. They will initiate the department soon.
boss.explain: 原句：The R&D department has been spearheading the initiative to utilize biodegradable materials.（研發部門一直主導使用可生物降解材料的倡議。）回應 A「他們使用這些材料有遇到任何結構完整性的問題嗎？」邏輯最通順。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The strict environmental regulations are expected to be enforced rigorously by the newly appointed committee.
options: A. 嚴格的環境法規已經被新成立的委員會廢除了。
B. 預計新成立的委員會將嚴格執行這些環境法規。
C. 新成立的委員會預計將放寬嚴格的環境法規。
D. 新成立的委員會無法嚴格執行環境法規。
boss.explain: 原句：The strict environmental regulations are expected to be enforced rigorously by the newly appointed committee. 意思：預計新成立的委員會將嚴格執行這些環境法規。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The subtle nuances in his speech must have been misinterpreted by the international press.
options: A. 國際媒體一定誤解了他演講中微妙的言外之意。
B. 他必須在演講中向國際媒體解釋微妙的言外之意。
C. 國際媒體完美地詮釋了他演講中微妙的言外之意。
D. 他的演講沒有任何微妙的言外之意讓國際媒體誤解。
boss.explain: 原句：The subtle nuances in his speech must have been misinterpreted by the international press. 意思：國際媒體一定誤解了他演講中微妙的言外之意。nuance 指細微差別、言外之意。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: We have been revamping the entire user interface to enhance the overall customer experience.
options: A. The customer experience must have been revamped.
B. When is the rollout date for the new design?
C. We should user interface the entire customer.
D. The overall experience is very entire.
boss.explain: 原句：We have been revamping the entire user interface to enhance the overall customer experience.（我們一直在改版整個使用者介面以提升整體客戶體驗。）回應 B「新設計的推出日期是什麼時候？」最合理。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The controversial policy is presumed to be abandoned following the massive public outcry.
options: A. 在大規模的公眾強烈抗議之後，這項具爭議的政策預計將被放棄。
B. 這項具爭議的政策引發了公眾強烈抗議，但政府堅持執行。
C. 儘管有大規模的公眾抗議，這項政策仍然預計會被實施。
D. 這項具爭議的政策是為了平息公眾的強烈抗議而制定的。
boss.explain: 原句：The controversial policy is presumed to be abandoned following the massive public outcry. 意思：在大規模的公眾強烈抗議之後，這項具爭議的政策預計將被放棄。is presumed to be (推測將被)。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The sudden resignation of the chief financial officer must have exacerbated the investors' panic.
options: A. 財務長的突然辭職一定加劇了投資者的恐慌。
B. 財務長必須辭職以平息投資者的恐慌。
C. 財務長的突然辭職減輕了投資者的恐慌。
D. 投資者的恐慌一定導致了財務長的突然辭職。
boss.explain: 原句：The sudden resignation of the chief financial officer must have exacerbated the investors' panic. 意思：財務長的突然辭職一定加劇了投資者的恐慌。exacerbate 加劇、惡化。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The city council has been subsidizing public transportation to alleviate traffic congestion.
options: A. The traffic congestion must have subsidized the city.
B. Has there been a noticeable decrease in rush-hour traffic?
C. We should alleviate the public transportation.
D. City councils are usually located in the city center.
boss.explain: 原句：The city council has been subsidizing public transportation to alleviate traffic congestion.（市議會一直在補貼大眾運輸以緩解交通擁塞。）回應 B「尖峰時段的交通量有明顯減少嗎？」最符合邏輯。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The initial patent application is deemed to be invalid due to prior art references.
options: A. 最初的專利申請因先前的技術參考文獻被視為無效。
B. 最初的專利申請被視為有效，並將成為技術參考。
C. 我們必須使最初的專利申請失效以引用先前的技術。
D. 先前的技術參考文獻因最初的專利申請而無效。
boss.explain: 原句：The initial patent application is deemed to be invalid due to prior art references. 意思：最初的專利申請因先前的技術參考文獻被視為無效。is deemed to be (被視為)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Legal Brief: Section 4 of the employment contract has been undergoing major revisions. The termination clause is considered to have been too ambiguous in the previous version. The drafting committee must have realized that a clearer definition of gross misconduct was necessary to protect the company from wrongful dismissal lawsuits. Q: Why was Section 4 revised?
options: A. To provide more vacation days for employees.
B. Because the previous termination rules lacked clarity.
C. To prevent the drafting committee from resigning.
D. Because lawsuits have bankrupted the company.
boss.explain: 文中提到 termination clause is considered to have been too ambiguous (解雇條款被認為太過模稜兩可)，且需要 clearer definition (更清晰的定義)，故選 B。

boss.desc: 【短文】Notice of Liability: The contractor has been ignoring our repeated warnings regarding the use of substandard materials. Consequently, the structural damage is determined to be solely their responsibility. They must have intentionally bypassed the rigorous quality checks to cut costs. Legal proceedings will commence shortly. Q: What is the contractor accused of doing?
options: A. Delaying the project timeline on purpose.
B. Skipping required quality inspections to save money.
C. Suing the company for unreasonable demands.
D. Overcharging for the standard materials used.
boss.explain: 文中提到 They must have intentionally bypassed the rigorous quality checks to cut costs (他們一定為了省成本而故意繞過嚴格的品質檢驗)，對應選項 B。

boss.desc: 【短文】HR Announcement: We have been evaluating our current health benefits package for the past six months. The updated dental plan is slated to be launched in January. Employees who missed the open enrollment period must have overlooked the multiple reminder emails sent last week. Q: What is true about the updated dental plan?
options: A. It has already been implemented.
B. It will be introduced at the beginning of the year.
C. It was rejected by the employees.
D. It replaces the mandatory health checkup.
boss.explain: 文中指出 The updated dental plan is slated to be launched in January (預計於一月推出)，故選 B。

boss.desc: 【短文】Policy Update: The travel reimbursement process has been causing frustration among staff members. The finance team is reported to have overhauled the entire system to ensure faster payouts. Staff members who submitted claims last month must have noticed the significantly reduced processing time. Q: What was the main issue with the previous reimbursement process?
options: A. It required too many physical receipts.
B. It paid out in the wrong currency.
C. It was too slow and frustrated the employees.
D. It was only available to senior management.
boss.explain: 文中提到 causing frustration，並說財務團隊徹底改革系統 to ensure faster payouts (以確保更快的撥款)，代表以前的問題是太慢，故選 C。

boss.desc: 【短文】Abstract: Our team has been conducting longitudinal surveys on sleep deprivation among teenagers. The cognitive decline observed in the subjects is hypothesized to have been exacerbated by excessive screen time before bed. Previous studies must have failed to account for the blue light emission from modern smartphones. Q: What factor did previous studies likely miss according to the abstract?
options: A. The average sleep duration of adults.
B. The impact of blue light from modern phones.
C. The dietary habits of the subjects.
D. The academic pressure teenagers face.
boss.explain: 短文最後一句明確指出 Previous studies must have failed to account for the blue light emission from modern smartphones (之前的研究一定沒將現代手機的藍光輻射納入考量)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Abstract Snippet: Scientists have been attempting to synthesize a room-temperature superconductor for decades. The recent breakthrough is widely considered to be a pivotal moment in electrical engineering. The lead researcher must have utilized a completely novel crystalline structure, as traditional models consistently failed. Q: How does the recent breakthrough differ from past attempts?
options: A. It took less time to achieve.
B. It relied on traditional, proven models.
C. It likely used a new structural approach.
D. It was accidental and unplanned.
boss.explain: 文中提到 lead researcher must have utilized a completely novel crystalline structure (一定使用了一種全新的晶體結構)，故選 C。

boss.desc: 【短文】Travel Insight: The hospitality industry has been adapting to the rise of "bleisure" travel—combining business with leisure. Many luxury resorts are reported to have upgraded their business centers to accommodate remote workers. Hotel managers must have realized that free Wi-Fi is no longer sufficient to attract this new demographic. Q: What is the main reason luxury resorts are upgrading their facilities?
options: A. To comply with new safety regulations.
B. To meet the needs of travelers mixing work and vacation.
C. To host international political summits.
D. To reduce their overall energy consumption.
boss.explain: 文章首句定義 bleisure 為 combining business with leisure，並提到度假村升級商務中心以 accommodate remote workers (容納遠端工作者)，故選 B。

boss.desc: 【短文】Industry Report: Sustainable tourism has been gaining immense traction among millennials. The carbon footprint of commercial flights is acknowledged to be a major concern for these environmentally conscious travelers. Airlines must have noticed this trend, as many are now offering carbon offset programs at checkout. Q: How are airlines responding to the new trend among millennial travelers?
options: A. By stopping all international flights.
B. By offering cheaper tickets to millennials.
C. By providing options to neutralize travel emissions.
D. By forcing passengers to plant trees.
boss.explain: 文中提到 airlines ... are now offering carbon offset programs (航空公司現在提供碳補償計畫)，即提供中和碳排的選項 (neutralize travel emissions)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Book Review: The author has been weaving intricate political allegories into her fantasy worlds for years. Her latest work is said to have been inspired by the European industrial revolution. Readers familiar with her style must have quickly identified the parallels between the fictional empire and 19th-century Britain. Q: What is the primary inspiration for the author's latest book?
options: A. The author's personal childhood memories.
B. The industrial revolution in Europe.
C. A recent political scandal in modern Britain.
D. Classical Greek mythology.
boss.explain: 文中直接說明 Her latest work is said to have been inspired by the European industrial revolution (據說靈感來自歐洲工業革命)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Critique: Throughout the memoir, the writer has been attempting to justify his controversial political decisions. However, his account is proven to have omitted several key events that contradict his narrative. He must have assumed that his audience would not fact-check his highly biased timeline. Q: What is the main criticism of the memoir?
options: A. It deliberately leaves out information that goes against the writer's views.
B. It is too long and difficult to understand.
C. It focuses too much on the writer's personal life.
D. It was published without the publisher's consent.
boss.explain: 文中批評 omitted several key events that contradict his narrative (遺漏了數個與其敘述矛盾的關鍵事件)，即故意略過不利資訊，故選 A。

boss.desc: 【綜合】The ancient manuscript, which ___ in a forgotten monastery, is currently being authenticated. The monks who preserved it ___ extraordinary measures to protect it from moisture.
options: A. is believed to be found / should take
B. is believed to have been found / must have taken
C. believes to find / must take
D. believed to have found / should have taken
boss.explain: 第一格：手稿「被發現」發生在過去，用 is believed to have been found。第二格：推測過去僧侶「一定採取了」保護措施，用 must have taken。

boss.desc: 請唸出：已經被重新安排
boss.speak: has been rescheduled
boss.explain: 口說表達「HAS BEEN RESCHEDULED」(phr.)：已經被重新安排。

boss.desc: 請唸出：分析趨勢
boss.speak: analyze the trends
boss.explain: 口說表達「ANALYZE THE TRENDS」(phr.)：分析趨勢。

boss.desc: 請唸出：結束簡報
boss.speak: conclude the presentation
boss.explain: 口說表達「CONCLUDE THE PRESENTATION」(phr.)：結束簡報。

boss.desc: 請唸出：將您的注意力轉移到
boss.speak: draw your attention to
boss.explain: 口說表達「DRAW YOUR ATTENTION TO」(phr.)：將您的注意力轉移到。

boss.desc: 請唸出：一直在推測
boss.speak: have been speculating
boss.explain: 口說表達「HAVE BEEN SPECULATING」(phr.)：一直在推測。

boss.desc: 請唸出：利潤最近一直在波動
boss.speak: profits have been fluctuating recently
boss.explain: 口說表達「PROFITS HAVE BEEN FLUCTUATING RECENTLY」(phr.)：利潤最近一直在波動。

boss.desc: 請唸出：我現在將結束會議
boss.ans: I WILL CONCLUDE THE SESSION NOW
boss.speak: i will conclude the session now
boss.explain: 口說表達「I WILL CONCLUDE THE SESSION NOW」(phr.)：我現在將結束會議。

boss.desc: 請唸出：數字一定改變了
boss.speak: the figures must have changed
boss.explain: 口說表達「THE FIGURES MUST HAVE CHANGED」(phr.)：數字一定改變了。

boss.desc: 請唸出：這是一次富有成效的討論
boss.ans: IT HAS BEEN A FRUITFUL DISCUSSION
boss.speak: it has been a fruitful discussion
boss.explain: 口說表達「IT HAS BEEN A FRUITFUL DISCUSSION」(phr.)：這是一次富有成效的討論。

boss.desc: 請唸出：觀察到急劇下降
boss.speak: a sharp decline was observed
boss.explain: 口說表達「A SHARP DECLINE WAS OBSERVED」(phr.)：觀察到急劇下降。

boss.desc: 請唸出：我們一定忽略了這個
boss.speak: we must have overlooked this
boss.explain: 口說表達「WE MUST HAVE OVERLOOKED THIS」(phr.)：我們一定忽略了這個。

boss.desc: 請唸出：趨勢正在受到監控
boss.speak: the trend is being monitored
boss.explain: 口說表達「THE TREND IS BEING MONITORED」(phr.)：趨勢正在受到監控。

boss.desc: 請唸出：感謝您的聆聽
boss.speak: thank you for your attention
boss.explain: 口說表達「THANK YOU FOR YOUR ATTENTION」(phr.)：感謝您的聆聽。

boss.desc: 請拼出：隨後
boss.speak: subsequently
boss.explain: SUBSEQUENTLY (adv.)：隨後。例句：She must have missed the deadline and subsequently lost the client.（她一定是錯過了最後期限，隨後失去了這位客戶。）

boss.desc: 填空題：S U B S _ Q U _ N T L _ (隨後)
boss.speak: subsequently
boss.explain: SUBSEQUENTLY (adv.)：隨後。填空答案為「EEY」。例句：She must have missed the deadline and subsequently lost the client.（她一定是錯過了最後期限，隨後失去了這位客戶。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：儘管如此
boss.speak: nevertheless
boss.explain: NEVERTHELESS (adv.)：然而；不過。例句：He said the project had been difficult; nevertheless, they had completed it on time.（他說這個專案很困難；然而，他們還是準時完成了。）

boss.desc: 填空題：N _ V _ R T H _ L _ S S (儘管如此)
boss.speak: nevertheless
boss.explain: NEVERTHELESS (adv.)：儘管如此。填空答案為「EEEE」。例句：He said the project had been difficult; nevertheless, they had completed it on time.（他說這個專案很困難；然而，他們還是準時完成了。）

boss.desc: 填空題：C O R R _ S P O N D _ N C _ (通信；信件)
boss.speak: correspondence
boss.explain: CORRESPONDENCE (n.)：通信；信件。填空答案為「EEE」。例句：The lawyer stated that all official correspondence had been securely archived.（律師表示，所有正式通信均已安全歸檔。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：加快；促進
boss.speak: expedite
boss.explain: EXPEDITE (v.)：加快；促進。例句：The approval must have been expedited due to the urgent request.（由於請求緊急，批准程序一定已被加快了。）

boss.desc: 填空題：E X P _ D _ T _ (加快；促進)
boss.speak: expedite
boss.explain: EXPEDITE (v.)：加快；促進。填空答案為「EIE」。例句：The approval must have been expedited due to the urgent request.（由於請求緊急，批准程序一定已被加快了。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：應急準備；意外事件
boss.speak: contingency
boss.explain: CONTINGENCY (n.)：可能發生而需要預作打算的狀況。例句：We discussed a contingency plan for heavy rain.（我們討論大雨備案。）

boss.desc: 填空題：C _ N T _ N G _ N C Y (應急準備；意外事件)
boss.speak: contingency
boss.explain: CONTINGENCY (n.)：應急準備；意外事件。填空答案為「OIE」。例句：We discussed a contingency plan for heavy rain.（我們討論大雨備案。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：明確地
boss.speak: explicitly
boss.explain: EXPLICITLY (adv.)：明確地。例句：The instructions must have been explicitly stated in the manual.（手冊中一定已經明確地說明了這些指示。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：總是；不變地
boss.speak: invariably
boss.explain: INVARIABLY (adv.)：總是；不變地。例句：He invariably arrives late, which must have annoyed the director.（他總是遲到，這肯定惹惱了總監。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：模稜兩可的
boss.speak: ambiguous
boss.explain: AMBIGUOUS (adj.)：容許不只一種解讀的。例句：The instruction is ambiguous about which entrance to use.（指示沒有清楚交代該使用哪個入口。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：收購；獲得
boss.speak: acquisition
boss.explain: ACQUISITION (n.)：請拼出：收購；獲得。

boss.desc: 填空題：A C Q U _ S _ T _ O N (收購；獲得)
boss.speak: acquisition
boss.explain: ACQUISITION (n.)：收購；獲得。填空答案為「III」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: Experts have been predicting a remarkably sharp downturn in the automotive manufacturing sector.
options: A. 專家們必須立刻預防汽車製造業的急劇衰退。
B. 汽車製造業的衰退一定是被專家們準確預測到了。
C. 專家們一直在預測汽車製造業將出現顯著的急劇衰退。
D. 汽車製造業預期將經歷一場前所未見的增長。
boss.explain: 英文原句：Experts have been predicting a remarkably sharp downturn in the automotive manufacturing sector. (專家們一直在預測汽車製造業將出現顯著的急劇衰退。) downturn 指經濟衰退、下降趨勢。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The sudden political turmoil must have destabilized the regional currency significantly.
options: A. 政治動盪一直在破壞區域貨幣的穩定性。
B. 突如其來的政治動盪一定嚴重破壞了區域貨幣的穩定。
C. 區域貨幣的貶值預期將引發政治動盪。
D. 必須有政治動盪才能促成貨幣的重大改革。
boss.explain: 英文原句：The sudden political turmoil must have destabilized the regional currency significantly. (突如其來的政治動盪一定嚴重破壞了區域貨幣的穩定。) destabilize 使動搖、破壞穩定。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The unprecedented inflation rate is widely believed to have been fueled by irresponsible speculative trading.
options: A. 史無前例的通貨膨脹一直在助長投機交易的發生。
B. 投機交易必須對這場史無前例的通貨膨脹負責。
C. 普遍認為這場史無前例的通膨率是由不負責任的投機交易推波助瀾所致。
D. 廣大的民眾預期投機交易將導致更嚴重的通貨膨脹。
boss.explain: 英文原句：The unprecedented inflation rate is widely believed to have been fueled by irresponsible speculative trading. (普遍認為這場史無前例的通膨率是由不負責任的投機交易推波助瀾所致。) is believed to have been fueled by 為進階複雜被動句型。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The diplomatic ties between the two rival nations must have deteriorated substantially over the winter.
options: A. 兩大敵對國家的外交關係在整個冬天一定已經大幅惡化了。
B. 兩國的外交關係一直在冬天期間不斷惡化。
C. 這兩個國家必須在冬天前修復他們的外交關係。
D. 兩國預期會在冬季期間展開實質的外交談判。
boss.explain: 英文原句：The diplomatic ties between the two rival nations must have deteriorated substantially over the winter. (兩大敵對國家的外交關係在整個冬天一定已經大幅惡化了。) deteriorate 惡化、變壞。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The highly controversial legislation has been facing fierce resistance from numerous grassroots organizations.
options: A. 充滿爭議的法案一定是被基層組織給強烈抵制了。
B. 充滿爭議的法案預期將被基層組織強烈反對。
C. 基層組織必須對這項充滿爭議的法案展開抵制。
D. 這項極具爭議的法案一直面臨來自眾多基層組織的強烈抵抗。
boss.explain: 英文原句：The highly controversial legislation has been facing fierce resistance from numerous grassroots organizations. (這項極具爭議的法案一直面臨來自眾多基層組織的強烈抵抗。) legislation 法規、法案；grassroots 基層的。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The mayor's ambitious urban renewal plan is highly likely to be scrutinized by the opposition party.
options: A. 廣受反對黨審查的都市更新計畫一定是市長提議的。
B. 市長野心勃勃的都市更新計畫極有可能會受到反對黨的嚴格審查。
C. 反對黨一直在嚴厲審查市長的都市更新計畫。
D. 市長必須親自審查反對黨提出的都市更新計畫。
boss.explain: 英文原句：The mayor's ambitious urban renewal plan is highly likely to be scrutinized by the opposition party. (市長野心勃勃的都市更新計畫極有可能會受到反對黨的嚴格審查。) scrutinize 仔細審查。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: We have been trying to decipher the underlying economic implications of the newly announced tariffs.
options: A. 新宣布的關稅一定隱藏了某些經濟意圖。
B. 我們必須解讀新關稅所帶來的潛在影響。
C. 我們一直在試圖解讀新宣布的關稅背後隱含的經濟影響。
D. 新關稅的經濟影響預計將由我們來進行解讀。
boss.explain: 英文原句：We have been trying to decipher the underlying economic implications of the newly announced tariffs. (我們一直在試圖解讀新宣布的關稅背後隱含的經濟影響。) decipher 解讀、破譯；implication 影響、暗指。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The whistle-blower's explosive allegations must have triggered an immediate federal probe.
options: A. 聯邦調查局一直在針對吹哨者的指控進行調查。
B. 吹哨者的爆炸性指控一定觸發了立即的聯邦調查。
C. 吹哨者必須提出指控才能觸發聯邦調查。
D. 聯邦調查預計會揭露吹哨者的爆炸性指控。
boss.explain: 英文原句：The whistle-blower's explosive allegations must have triggered an immediate federal probe. (吹哨者的爆炸性指控一定觸發了立即的聯邦調查。) allegation 指控；probe 調查。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: A substantial financial rescue package is anticipated to be unveiled to prevent a total market collapse.
options: A. 為了防止市場全面崩潰，預計將會公布一項大規模的金融救援方案。
B. 一項大規模的救援方案一定已經為了防止市場崩潰而公布了。
C. 政府必須公布金融救援方案，因為市場一直在崩潰。
D. 救援方案的公布預計將會導致金融市場的全面崩潰。
boss.explain: 英文原句：A substantial financial rescue package is anticipated to be unveiled to prevent a total market collapse. (為了防止市場全面崩潰，預計將會公布一項大規模的金融救援方案。) unveil 揭幕、公布。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The investigative journalists have been uncovering a complex web of corporate espionage all year.
options: A. 調查記者一定是在今年揭露了商業間諜的網路。
B. 企業間諜活動預期將被調查記者全面揭露。
C. 商業間諜網路必須由調查記者來進行揭發。
D. 調查記者一整年來一直在揭露錯綜複雜的企業間諜網。
boss.explain: 英文原句：The investigative journalists have been uncovering a complex web of corporate espionage all year. (調查記者一整年來一直在揭露錯綜複雜的企業間諜網。) espionage 間諜活動。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The sudden collapse of the banking giant must have sent shockwaves through the global economy.
options: A. 銀行巨頭的突然倒閉一定在世界經濟中引發了震盪。
B. 全球經濟的震盪一直在導致銀行巨頭的倒閉。
C. 銀行巨頭必須倒閉才能對全球經濟產生影響。
D. 銀行巨頭的倒閉預計將對全球經濟造成衝擊。
boss.explain: 英文原句：The sudden collapse of the banking giant must have sent shockwaves through the global economy. (銀行巨頭的突然倒閉一定在世界經濟中引發了震盪。) send shockwaves 引起震動、震撼。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The fragile ceasefire agreement is widely reported to have been violated multiple times by both factions.
options: A. 雙方派系一直在違反那份脆弱的停火協議。
B. 停火協議必須被雙方嚴格遵守，否則會被違反。
C. 據廣泛報導，那份脆弱的停火協議已被雙方派系多次違反。
D. 雙方派系一定已經違反了那份脆弱的停火協議。
boss.explain: 英文原句：The fragile ceasefire agreement is widely reported to have been violated multiple times by both factions. (據廣泛報導，那份脆弱的停火協議已被雙方派系多次違反。) is reported to have been V-p.p. 為進階被動型態，表示據報導過去已被...

boss.desc: 【綜合語法】The commodity prices ___ wildly this month. Speculators are thought ___ artificial shortages to drive up the value.
options: A. fluctuate / to create
B. have been fluctuating / to have created
C. are fluctuating / creating
D. fluctuated / created
boss.explain: 前半句強調這個月以來持續的波動，用 have been fluctuating；後半句表示投機客被認為「已經製造了」人為短缺，用 to have created。

boss.desc: 【短文】Market Analysis: Tech stocks have been taking a hit lately. The sudden crash of Apex Inc. is alleged to have been orchestrated by massive institutional sell-offs. Retail investors, caught off guard, must have lost millions overnight. The market volatility highlights the need for a diversified ___ to absorb such sudden shocks. Q: Which word best completes the text?
options: A. mandate
B. portfolio
C. allegation
D. backlash
boss.explain: 投資人需要一個多樣化的「投資組合 (portfolio)」來吸收市場衝擊。mandate 為命令，allegation 為指控。

boss.desc: 【綜合語法】Local authorities ___ the factory's wastewater discharge for weeks. The toxic chemicals are confirmed ___ heavy damage to the nearby wetlands.
options: A. have been tracking / to have caused
B. tracked / to cause
C. are tracking / causing
D. had tracked / to have been caused
boss.explain: 第一格表示持續數週的追蹤 (have been tracking)。第二格表示化學物質被確認「已經造成」損害，主動語態完成式不定詞 (to have caused)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Ecological Update: Activists have been protesting the new mining mandate for over a month. The excavation process is argued to have irreparably depleted the underground aquifers. The local government must have prioritized short-term economic gains over long-term sustainability. Q: What is the main criticism against the local government?
options: A. They failed to pay the activists.
B. They valued quick money over the environment.
C. They ordered the aquifers to be filled.
D. They stopped the mining mandate.
boss.explain: 文中提到政府一定把短期經濟利益看得比長期永續性更重要 (prioritized short-term economic gains over long-term sustainability)，選項 B 最符合。

boss.desc: 【短文】Compliance Memo: All manufacturing branches have been struggling to meet the new emission targets. The old ventilation systems are known to have continuously leaked hazardous gases. The facility managers must have delayed the necessary upgrades to avoid budget overruns. Now, they must immediately ___ the old systems and install compliant ones. Q: Which word fits the blank best?
options: A. dismantle
B. liquidate
C. speculate
D. fluctuate
boss.explain: 為了升級，必須「拆除 (dismantle)」舊系統並安裝合規的新系統。liquidate 為清算資產，speculate 為投機。

boss.desc: 【綜合語法】Customers ___ of faulty wiring in the blenders since May. The severe overheating is suspected ___ several kitchen fires last week.
options: A. complain / to cause
B. have been complaining / to have caused
C. complained / causing
D. had complained / to be caused
boss.explain: 第一格用現在完成進行式表示自五月以來持續的抱怨；第二格用 to have caused 表示「過去被懷疑造成了火災」。

boss.desc: 【短文】Automotive Recall: We have been investigating the spontaneous airbag deployments in our 2025 sedans. The sensors are discovered to have been compromised by a substandard microchip. The chip supplier must have skipped the rigorous extreme-temperature testing phase. Vehicle owners are advised to avoid driving until the repair is completed. Q: What is the root cause of the airbag issue?
options: A. Extreme temperatures
B. A low-quality microchip
C. Aggressive driving
D. Expired sensors
boss.explain: 文中指出感測器因為一個劣質微晶片 (substandard microchip) 而出現問題。

boss.desc: 【綜合語法】Researchers ___ the monkeys' reactions to mirror reflections. The cognitive breakthrough is reported ___ earlier than initially predicted.
options: A. have been observing / to have occurred
B. observe / to occur
C. are observing / occurring
D. observed / to have been occurred
boss.explain: 研究員一直持續觀察 (have been observing)；認知突破據報導發生得比預期早，用 to have occurred (occur 不用被動)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Behavioral Study: We have been analyzing the correlation between sleep deprivation and risk-taking. Subjects lacking sleep are shown to have deviated significantly from logical decision-making models. They must have relied heavily on emotional impulses rather than rational thought. Q: How did sleep-deprived subjects make decisions?
options: A. Through careful logical deduction.
B. By following strict rational models.
C. Based mostly on emotional impulses.
D. By avoiding any risk-taking behavior.
boss.explain: 文章提到他們一定非常依賴情緒衝動 (relied heavily on emotional impulses)。

boss.desc: 【綜合語法】The CEO's questionable tax records ___ intense public scrutiny. The missing documents are assumed ___ deliberately destroyed before the audit.
options: A. draw / to be
B. have been drawing / to have been
C. are drawing / having been
D. drew / to have
boss.explain: 一直在引來公眾審視用 have been drawing；文件被假設「已經被銷毀」，用完成式被動不定詞 to have been destroyed。

boss.desc: 【短文】Corporate Crisis Press Release: Our legal team has been addressing the recent allegations of corporate espionage. The stolen data is confirmed to have been sold to a rival firm on the dark web. The former head of IT must have orchestrated the breach, as he had the highest level of clearance. We are working closely with cyber authorities. Q: Who is believed to be responsible for the data breach?
options: A. The cyber authorities
B. The legal team
C. A rival firm
D. The former head of IT
boss.explain: 文中明確指出「The former head of IT must have orchestrated the breach」(前IT主管一定策劃了這起外洩)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Internal Leak: Employees have been expressing outrage over the hidden executive bonuses. The board's attempt to cover up the payments is proven to have worsened the public ___. They must have underestimated the staff's demand for transparency and accountability. Q: Which word fits the blank best?
options: A. backlash
B. compliance
C. dividend
D. portfolio
boss.explain: 董事會掩蓋獎金的行為加劇了公眾的「強烈反彈 (backlash)」。

boss.desc: 請唸出單字：反響
boss.speak: repercussion
boss.explain: 口說表達「REPERCUSSION」(n.)：反響。例句：One unforeseen repercussion was a loss of trust.（一個未預見的負面後果是信任流失。）

boss.desc: 請唸出單字：當責
boss.speak: accountability
boss.explain: 口說表達「ACCOUNTABILITY」(n.)：當責。例句：The new rules strengthen public accountability.（新規則加強了對公眾負責的義務。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：晉升機會
boss.speak: opportunities for advancement
boss.explain: 口說表達「OPPORTUNITIES FOR ADVANCEMENT」(phr.)：晉升機會。

boss.desc: 請唸出：一直在...上發生衝突
boss.speak: have been clashing over
boss.explain: 口說表達「HAVE BEEN CLASHING OVER」(phr.)：一直在...上發生衝突。

boss.desc: 請唸出：找到共同點
boss.speak: find common ground
boss.explain: 口說表達「FIND COMMON GROUND」(phr.)：找到共同點。

boss.desc: 請唸出：押金一直被不公正地扣留
boss.ans: THE DEPOSIT HAS BEEN WITHHELD UNJUSTLY
boss.speak: the deposit has been withheld unjustly
boss.explain: 口說表達「THE DEPOSIT HAS BEEN WITHHELD UNJUSTLY」(phr.)：押金一直被不公正地扣留。

boss.desc: 請唸出：他們一定忽略了維修請求
boss.ans: THEY MUST HAVE IGNORED THE MAINTENANCE REQUESTS
boss.speak: they must have ignored the maintenance requests
boss.explain: 口說表達「THEY MUST HAVE IGNORED THE MAINTENANCE REQUESTS」(phr.)：他們一定忽略了維修請求。

boss.desc: 請唸出：我一定誤解了職位描述
boss.ans: I MUST HAVE MISINTERPRETED THE JOB DESCRIPTION
boss.speak: i must have misinterpreted the job description
boss.explain: 口說表達「I MUST HAVE MISINTERPRETED THE JOB DESCRIPTION」(phr.)：我一定誤解了職位描述。

boss.desc: 請唸出：哪些指標正被用來評估績效
boss.ans: WHAT METRICS ARE BEING USED TO EVALUATE PERFORMANCE
boss.speak: what metrics are being used to evaluate performance
boss.explain: 口說表達「WHAT METRICS ARE BEING USED TO EVALUATE PERFORMANCE」(phr.)：哪些指標正被用來評估績效。

boss.desc: 請唸出：他們之間的緊張局勢一直在升級
boss.ans: THE TENSION BETWEEN THEM HAS BEEN ESCALATING
boss.speak: the tension between them has been escalating
boss.explain: 口說表達「THE TENSION BETWEEN THEM HAS BEEN ESCALATING」(phr.)：他們之間的緊張局勢一直在升級。

boss.desc: 請唸出：數據當時正被仔細審查
boss.ans: THE DATA WAS BEING REVIEWED CAREFULLY
boss.speak: the data was being reviewed carefully
boss.explain: 口說表達「THE DATA WAS BEING REVIEWED CAREFULLY」(phr.)：數據當時正被仔細審查。

boss.desc: 請唸出：我們一定低估了所需的時間
boss.ans: WE MUST HAVE UNDERESTIMATED THE REQUIRED TIME
boss.speak: we must have underestimated the required time
boss.explain: 口說表達「WE MUST HAVE UNDERESTIMATED THE REQUIRED TIME」(phr.)：我們一定低估了所需的時間。

boss.desc: 請拼出：質性的
boss.speak: qualitative
boss.explain: QUALITATIVE (adj.)：質性的。例句：We have been conducting qualitative research to understand consumer behavior.（我們一直在進行質性研究以了解消費者行為。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：量化的
boss.speak: quantitative
boss.explain: QUANTITATIVE (adj.)：量化的。例句：Quantitative data must have been gathered to support the proposal.（一定已經收集了量化數據來支持這項提案。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：努力；盡力
boss.speak: endeavor
boss.explain: ENDEAVOR (n.)：努力；盡力。例句：We have been endeavoring to expand our market share in Asia.（我們一直努力在亞洲擴大市佔率。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：階層；等級制度
boss.speak: hierarchy
boss.explain: HIERARCHY (n.)：階層；等級制度。例句：The corporate hierarchy has been undergoing massive restructuring lately.（企業階層最近一直在進行大規模的重組。）

boss.desc: 填空題：I _ P L _ C _ T I O N (意涵；可能影響)
boss.speak: implication
boss.explain: IMPLICATION (n.)：意涵；可能影響。填空答案為「MIA」。例句：We need to consider the financial implications of this choice.（我們需要考慮這個選擇帶來的財務影響。）

boss.desc: 填空題：P _ R _ M E T _ R (參數；界限)
boss.speak: parameter
boss.explain: PARAMETER (n.)：參數；界限。填空答案為「AAE」。例句：The budget parameters must have been set by the board of directors.（預算界限一定是董事會設定的。）

boss.desc: 填空題：Q U _ N T _ T _ T I V E (量化的)
boss.speak: quantitative
boss.explain: QUANTITATIVE (adj.)：量化的。填空答案為「AIA」。例句：Quantitative data must have been gathered to support the proposal.（一定已經收集了量化數據來支持這項提案。）

boss.desc: 填空題：A C C _ R D _ N G L _ (相應地)
boss.speak: accordingly
boss.explain: ACCORDINGLY (adv.)：相應地。填空答案為「OIY」。例句：The team has been updating the schedule and notifying clients accordingly.（團隊一直在更新時程表並相應地通知客戶。）

boss.desc: 填空題：E N D _ _ V _ R (努力；盡力)
boss.speak: endeavor
boss.explain: ENDEAVOR (n.)：努力；盡力。填空答案為「EAO」。例句：We have been endeavoring to expand our market share in Asia.（我們一直努力在亞洲擴大市佔率。）

boss.desc: 填空題：E L _ B _ R _ T E (詳細說明)
boss.speak: elaborate
boss.explain: ELABORATE (v.)：詳細說明。填空答案為「AOA」。例句：The CEO must have elaborated on the new strategy during the private session.（執行長一定在閉門會議中詳細說明了新策略。）

boss.desc: 填空題：A C C _ M M _ D _ T I O N (住宿)
boss.speak: accommodation
boss.explain: ACCOMMODATION (n.)：住宿。填空答案為「OOA」。例句：Our accommodation has been booked for the trip.（我們這趟旅行的住宿已經預訂好了。）

boss.desc: 填空題：H I _ R _ R C H _ (階層；等級制度)
boss.speak: hierarchy
boss.explain: HIERARCHY (n.)：階層；等級制度。填空答案為「EAY」。例句：The corporate hierarchy has been undergoing massive restructuring lately.（企業階層最近一直在進行大規模的重組。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The liability clauses are anticipated to be strictly enforced by the claims department.
options: A. Then we must have misunderstood the terms.
B. We have been claiming the rewards today.
C. The department was built last month.
D. She must have strictly enforced the rules.
boss.explain: 原句：The liability clauses are anticipated to be strictly enforced by the claims department. (預計理賠部門將嚴格執行責任條款。) 選項 A (那我們一定是誤解了條款) 最合理。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The structural integrity of the roof has been deteriorating despite our repairs.
options: A. 儘管我們進行了維修，屋頂的結構完整性仍在惡化
B. 屋頂已經完全修復，不再有結構問題
C. 我們決定放棄維修，直接拆除整個屋頂
D. 結構工程師保證屋頂絕對安全無虞
boss.explain: 原句：The structural integrity of the roof has been deteriorating despite our repairs. (儘管我們進行了維修，屋頂的結構完整性仍在惡化。)

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The safety inspector must have noticed the frayed cables near the generator.
options: A. 檢查員認為發電機附近的電纜非常安全
B. 安全檢查員一定是注意到了發電機附近磨損的電纜
C. 檢查員要求工人立刻更換所有的發電機
D. 工人們故意隱瞞了電纜磨損的事實
boss.explain: 原句：The safety inspector must have noticed the frayed cables near the generator. (安全檢查員一定是注意到了發電機附近磨損的電纜。)

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The retrospective exhibition is intended to be a tribute to his entire career.
options: A. He has been painting the tribute for weeks.
B. It must have drawn crowds of his admirers.
C. I will exhibit my own work tomorrow.
D. The career center is open on Mondays.
boss.explain: 原句：The retrospective exhibition is intended to be a tribute to his entire career. (這場回顧展旨在向他的整個職業生涯致敬。) 選項 B (這一定吸引了大批他的仰慕者) 最合理。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: Several prominent critics have been analyzing the symbolic motifs in this collection.
options: A. 評論家們認為這個系列的作品缺乏象徵意義
B. 幾位著名的評論家一直在分析這個系列中的象徵性主題
C. 藝術家拒絕向評論家解釋作品中的主題
D. 觀眾對於作品中複雜的象徵感到非常困惑
boss.explain: 原句：Several prominent critics have been analyzing the symbolic motifs in this collection. (幾位著名的評論家一直在分析這個系列中的象徵性主題。)

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The auctioneer must have overlooked her bid in the heat of the moment.
options: A. 拍賣官拒絕接受她過低的報價
B. 她在最後一刻決定撤回自己的出價
C. 拍賣官在激烈的競標中一定忽略了她的出價
D. 拍賣官成功幫她標下了這件藝術品
boss.explain: 原句：The auctioneer must have overlooked her bid in the heat of the moment. (拍賣官在激烈的競標中一定忽略了她的出價。)

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The reigning champion is perceived to be unbeatable on this specific terrain.
options: A. They must have lost the previous game.
B. Yes, his agility here is truly unmatched.
C. The terrain is flat and very easy.
D. I have been championing this cause for years.
boss.explain: 原句：The reigning champion is perceived to be unbeatable on this specific terrain. (這位衛冕冠軍在這種特定的地形上被認為是不可戰勝的。) 選項 B (是的，他在這裡的敏捷度真的無人能及) 最合理。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: We have been scrutinizing the opponent's defensive formations for days.
options: A. 我們這幾天一直在仔細審視對手的防守陣型
B. 對手的防守陣型幾乎完美無瑕
C. 我們決定放棄研究對手，專注於自身的進攻
D. 教練對於球隊糟糕的防守感到非常憤怒
