boss.explain: 原句：We have been scrutinizing the opponent's defensive formations for days. (我們這幾天一直在仔細審視對手的防守陣型。)

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The underdog must have capitalized on that rare unforced error.
options: A. 處於劣勢的一方在比賽中犯下了一個嚴重的失誤
B. 劣勢方一定利用了那個罕見的非受迫性失誤
C. 強隊故意製造失誤來讓對手得分
D. 裁判判斷這是一個合理的技術性犯規
boss.explain: 原句：The underdog must have capitalized on that rare unforced error. (劣勢方一定利用了那個罕見的非受迫性失誤。)

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The executive coaching sessions are purported to be highly transformative.
options: A. I have been transforming the raw data.
B. Indeed, several managers spoke highly of them.
C. The coach must have missed the bus.
D. The sessions were unfortunately cancelled.
boss.explain: 原句：The executive coaching sessions are purported to be highly transformative. (高階主管教練課程據說非常具有變革性。) 選項 B (的確，有幾位經理對此評價很高) 最合理。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: They have been advocating for more inclusive hiring practices within the sector.
options: A. 他們拒絕在業界內推行任何新的招聘政策
B. 這個產業的招聘標準變得越來越嚴格
C. 他們一直在提倡業界內採取更具包容性的招聘實務
D. 公司決定解雇所有不符合包容性標準的員工
boss.explain: 原句：They have been advocating for more inclusive hiring practices within the sector. (他們一直在提倡業界內採取更具包容性的招聘實務。)

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: Her exceptional portfolio must have distinguished her from the other candidates.
options: A. 她的作品集太過普通，未能吸引面試官的注意
B. 她出色的作品集一定讓她在其他候選人中脫穎而出
C. 其他候選人的作品集比她的更加優秀
D. 面試官根本沒有看她的作品集
boss.explain: 原句：Her exceptional portfolio must have distinguished her from the other candidates. (她出色的作品集一定讓她在其他候選人中脫穎而出。)

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: A comprehensive skills assessment is required to be completed by all attendees.
options: A. I will assess the damages immediately.
B. I have been looking for the test link. Where is it?
C. We must have assessed the wrong property.
D. The skills were acquired long ago.
boss.explain: 原句：A comprehensive skills assessment is required to be completed by all attendees. (所有與會者都必須完成一項全面的技能評估。) 選項 B (我一直在找測驗的連結。它在哪裡？) 最合理。

boss.desc:
【短文】HR Memo: The management has been reviewing the turnover metrics for the past quarter. The rigid office hours are suspected to have alienated our top performers. We must have ignored their requests for a better work-life balance for far too long.
Q: What is considered the main reason for losing top performers?
options: A. Low salaries
B. Inflexible schedules
C. Poor management
D. Lack of training
boss.explain: 文中提到「rigid office hours (僵化的辦公時間)」，也就是缺乏彈性的行程 (Inflexible schedules) 導致留不住優秀人才。

boss.desc: 【被動語態】The department head's abrupt departure is presumed ___ by the crushing workload and insufficient administrative support.
options: A. to trigger
B. to be triggering
C. to have been triggered
D. triggering
boss.explain: 部門主管的離職被假定是「由龐大的工作量所引起的」。事情已發生且為被動，因此使用完成式被動不定詞 to have been triggered。

boss.desc: 【時態】The retention rate ___ gradually since the executives introduced a hybrid work model.
options: A. climbs
B. climbed
C. is climbing
D. has been climbing
boss.explain: 句中有 since 帶出的過去時間點，主句需用現在完成進行式，表示留任率從那時起持續在攀升中。

boss.desc:
【短文】Editorial: The proposed congestion pricing is said to have disproportionately affected low-income drivers. The policy makers must have prioritized municipal revenue over social equity when drafting the bill.
Q: What is the author's criticism of the policy makers?
options: A. They cared more about making money than fairness.
B. They built too many roads.
C. They ignored the environment.
D. They lowered taxes too much.
boss.explain: 社論批評政策制定者「prioritized municipal revenue over social equity (把市政收入置於社會公平之上)」，即只顧賺錢不顧公平。

boss.desc: 【推測語氣】The subway station was completely flooded during the storm. The city engineers ___ the drainage capacity accurately.
options: A. calculate
B. must not have calculated
C. should calculate
D. calculated
boss.explain: 地鐵站被淹沒了，可以強烈推斷工程師當時「一定沒有」準確計算好排水量，需用 must not have + V-p.p.。

boss.desc: 【時態】The local government ___ the subway fares continuously, causing widespread public outrage among daily commuters.
options: A. is hiked
B. hikes
C. has been hiking
D. hike
boss.explain: continuously 強調動作一直延續至今，政府不斷調漲票價，因此使用現在完成進行式 has been hiking。

boss.desc:
【短文】Investigative Report: The local dairy farm has been operating without a valid license. Their raw milk products are alleged to have caused a regional outbreak of listeria. The facility managers must have bribed the inspectors to ignore the gross health code violations.
Q: What did the factory managers allegedly do?
options: A. They improved sanitation.
B. They sold the farm.
C. They stopped production.
D. They paid off officials.
boss.explain: 文中指出經理「bribed the inspectors (賄賂檢查員)」，與 paid off officials 意思一致。

boss.desc: 【被動語態】The sudden closure of the popular bakery chain is rumored ___ by a severe pest infestation in their central kitchen.
options: A. to have been prompted
B. to prompt
C. prompting
D. to be prompted
boss.explain: 關店謠傳是「被」嚴重的蟲害所引起的。因為動作發生在過去且是被動，需用 to have been prompted。

boss.desc:
【短文】Article: Security experts have been monitoring the new smart home devices. The built-in microphones are proven to have recorded private conversations without consent. The manufacturer must have intentionally hidden this tracking feature deep within the terms of service.
Q: What is the main concern regarding the smart devices?
options: A. They are too expensive.
B. They secretly record users.
C. They break down easily.
D. They consume too much power.
boss.explain: 文章指出麥克風在未經同意下錄下私人對話 (recorded private conversations without consent)，即暗中錄音。

boss.desc: 【被動語態】The deployment of unregulated surveillance drones is feared ___ a chilling effect on public gatherings and free speech.
options: A. casting
B. to be cast
C. to have cast
D. cast
boss.explain: 無人機的部署被恐懼「已經產生了 (cast)」寒蟬效應，因是主動發出的動作且強調已造成影響，故選 to have cast。

boss.desc: 【推測語氣】The AI system completely failed to recognize the regional accents. The developers ___ it exclusively on standard dialects.
options: A. train
B. are training
C. should train
D. must have trained
boss.explain: 系統完全無法辨識地方口音，可推斷開發者當時「一定只用了」標準方言來訓練它，用 must have + V-p.p. 表過去的肯定推測。

boss.desc:
【短文】Marketing Review: Our rival brand has been dominating the digital space. Their latest interactive billboard is recognized to have captivated millions of pedestrians. Their creative team must have spent months studying foot traffic patterns to maximize visual impact.
Q: Why was the rival's billboard successful?
options: A. It was placed strategically based on data.
B. It was cheaper to produce.
C. It offered free samples.
D. It was endorsed by a celebrity.
boss.explain: 評論提到團隊「spent months studying foot traffic patterns (花了數月研究人潮模式)」，這代表廣告的成功是因為基於數據的策略性放置。

boss.desc: 【被動語態】The sudden rebranding effort is widely believed ___ by the new CEO's desire to distance the company from past scandals.
options: A. to drive
B. to have been driven
C. driving
D. driven
boss.explain: 品牌重塑被認為是「被新任CEO的渴望所驅動的」。已發生且為被動語態，需用 to have been driven。

boss.desc: 請唸出單字：使多樣化
boss.speak: diversify
boss.explain: 口說表達「DIVERSIFY」(n.)：使多樣化。

boss.desc: 請唸出單字：考核
boss.speak: appraisal
boss.explain: 口說表達「APPRAISAL」(n.)：考核。例句：We conduct a performance appraisal every year.（我們每年進行一次績效評價。）

boss.desc: 請唸出單字：據稱
boss.speak: allegedly
boss.explain: 口說表達「ALLEGEDLY」(adv.)：據稱。例句：He allegedly stole confidential files from the office.（據稱他從辦公室偷走了機密文件。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：一直在多樣化
boss.speak: have been diversifying
boss.explain: 口說表達「HAVE BEEN DIVERSIFYING」(phr.)：一直在多樣化。

boss.desc: 請唸出：一定暴跌了
boss.speak: must have plummeted
boss.explain: 口說表達「MUST HAVE PLUMMETED」(phr.)：一定暴跌了。

boss.desc: 請唸出：正在被定案
boss.speak: is being finalized
boss.explain: 口說表達「IS BEING FINALIZED」(phr.)：正在被定案。

boss.desc: 請唸出：正在被考核
boss.speak: are being appraised
boss.explain: 口說表達「ARE BEING APPRAISED」(phr.)：正在被考核。

boss.desc: 請唸出：我一直在多樣化我的投資組合
boss.ans: I HAVE BEEN DIVERSIFYING MY PORTFOLIO
boss.speak: i have been diversifying my portfolio
boss.explain: 口說表達「I HAVE BEEN DIVERSIFYING MY PORTFOLIO」(phr.)：我一直在多樣化我的投資組合。

boss.desc: 請唸出：這支股票昨天一定暴跌了
boss.ans: THE STOCK MUST HAVE PLUMMETED YESTERDAY
boss.speak: the stock must have plummeted yesterday
boss.explain: 口說表達「THE STOCK MUST HAVE PLUMMETED YESTERDAY」(phr.)：這支股票昨天一定暴跌了。

boss.desc: 請唸出：員工們本週正在被考核
boss.ans: EMPLOYEES ARE BEING APPRAISED THIS WEEK
boss.speak: employees are being appraised this week
boss.explain: 口說表達「EMPLOYEES ARE BEING APPRAISED THIS WEEK」(phr.)：員工們本週正在被考核。

boss.desc: 請唸出：一項合併案現在正在被定案
boss.ans: A MERGER IS BEING FINALIZED NOW
boss.speak: a merger is being finalized now
boss.explain: 口說表達「A MERGER IS BEING FINALIZED NOW」(phr.)：一項合併案現在正在被定案。

boss.desc: 請唸出：一定有人偷了我的隨身物品
boss.ans: SOMEONE MUST HAVE STOLEN MY BELONGINGS
boss.speak: someone must have stolen my belongings
boss.explain: 口說表達「SOMEONE MUST HAVE STOLEN MY BELONGINGS」(phr.)：一定有人偷了我的隨身物品。

boss.desc: 請拼出：優先事項；優先權
boss.speak: priority
boss.explain: PRIORITY (n.)：在時間或重要性上居先的地位。例句：The question here is temporal priority.（此問題在時間先後。）

boss.desc: 填空題：P R I O R _ T _ (優先事項；優先權)
boss.speak: priority
boss.explain: PRIORITY (n.)：優先事項；優先權。填空答案為「IY」。例句：The question here is temporal priority.（此問題在時間先後。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：多樣性；多種經營
boss.speak: diversify
boss.explain: DIVERSIFY (n.)：請拼出：多樣性；多種經營。

boss.desc: 填空題：D I V E R S _ F _ (多樣性；多種經營)
boss.speak: diversify
boss.explain: DIVERSIFY (n.)：多樣性；多種經營。填空答案為「IY」。

boss.desc: 請拼出：基準；評金標準
boss.speak: benchmark
boss.explain: BENCHMARK (n.)：請拼出：基準；評金標準。

boss.desc: 填空題：B E N C H M _ R _ (基準；評金標準)
boss.speak: benchmark
boss.explain: BENCHMARK (n.)：基準；評金標準。填空答案為「AK」。

boss.desc: 請拼出：漏洞；漏洞百出
boss.speak: loophole
boss.explain: LOOPHOLE (n.)：漏洞。例句：Lawyers found a legal loophole in the tax regulations.（律師在稅務法規中發現了一個法律漏洞。）

boss.desc: 填空題：L O O P H _ L _ (漏洞；漏洞百出)
boss.speak: loophole
boss.explain: LOOPHOLE (n.)：漏洞；漏洞百出。填空答案為「OE」。例句：Lawyers found a legal loophole in the tax regulations.（律師在稅務法規中發現了一個法律漏洞。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：基準；基本水準
boss.speak: baseline
boss.explain: BASELINE (n.)：基準；基本水準。例句：We established a performance baseline before implementing the new system.（我们在實施新系統前建立了一個績效基準。）

boss.desc: 填空題：B A S E L _ N _ (基準；基本水準)
boss.speak: baseline
boss.explain: BASELINE (n.)：基準；基本水準。填空答案為「IE」。例句：We established a performance baseline before implementing the new system.（我们在實施新系統前建立了一個績效基準。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：重組；改組
boss.speak: restructure
boss.explain: RESTRUCTURE (v.)：重組；改組。例句：The corporation plans to restructure its debt to improve cash flow.（該企業計畫重組其債務以改善現金流。）

boss.desc: 填空題：R E S T R U C T _ R _ (重組；改組)
boss.speak: restructure
boss.explain: RESTRUCTURE (v.)：重組；改組。填空答案為「UE」。例句：The corporation plans to restructure its debt to improve cash flow.（該企業計畫重組其債務以改善現金流。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：相互的；共同的
boss.speak: mutual
boss.explain: MUTUAL (adj.)：相互的；共同的。例句：Both companies agreed on a partnership based on mutual trust and respect.（兩家公司達成了一項基於互信與尊重的夥伴關係協議。）

boss.desc: 填空題：M U T U _ _ (相互的；共同的)
boss.speak: mutual
boss.explain: MUTUAL (adj.)：相互的；共同的。填空答案為「AL」。例句：Both companies agreed on a partnership based on mutual trust and respect.（兩家公司達成了一項基於互信與尊重的夥伴關係協議。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：漏洞；缺陷
boss.speak: vulnerability
boss.explain: VULNERABILITY (n.)：容易受攻擊或傷害的弱點。例句：The update fixes a vulnerability in the software.（這次更新修補軟體中的一個漏洞。）

boss.desc: 填空題：V U L N E R _ B I L _ T Y (漏洞；缺陷)
boss.speak: vulnerability
boss.explain: VULNERABILITY (n.)：漏洞；缺陷。填空答案為「AI」。例句：The update fixes a vulnerability in the software.（這次更新修補軟體中的一個漏洞。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：基準；指標
boss.speak: indicator
boss.explain: INDICATOR (n.)：指標；跡象。例句：Economic growth is a key indicator of consumer spending trends.（經濟成長是消費者支出趨勢的關鍵指標。）

boss.desc: 填空題：I N D _ C A T _ R (基準；指標)
boss.speak: indicator
boss.explain: INDICATOR (n.)：基準；指標。填空答案為「IO」。例句：Economic growth is a key indicator of consumer spending trends.（經濟成長是消費者支出趨勢的關鍵指標。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：特權；優免
boss.speak: privilege
boss.explain: PRIVILEGE (n.)：特權；優免。例句：Access to confidential business reports is a privilege reserved for senior executives.（查閱機密商業報告是高級主管才有的特權。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：精簡；裁員
boss.speak: streamline
boss.explain: STREAMLINE (n.)：請拼出：精簡；裁員。

boss.desc: 填空題：S T R E A M L _ N _ (精簡；裁員)
boss.speak: streamline
boss.explain: STREAMLINE (n.)：精簡；裁員。填空答案為「IE」。

boss.desc: 請拼出：策略規劃
boss.speak: blueprint
boss.explain: BLUEPRINT (n.)：藍圖；計畫。例句：The executive team developed a clear blueprint for business expansion.（執行團隊為業務擴展制定了清晰的藍圖。）

boss.desc: 填空題：B L U E P R _ N _ (策略規劃)
boss.speak: blueprint
boss.explain: BLUEPRINT (n.)：策略規劃。填空答案為「IT」。例句：The executive team developed a clear blueprint for business expansion.（執行團隊為業務擴展制定了清晰的藍圖。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The regional manager must have been anticipating this logistical nightmare when he requested the contingency plan.
options: A. Yes, his foresight really saved us from total paralysis today.
B. We have been ignoring the contingency plan completely.
C. The nightmare is predicted to be wonderful.
D. He must have slept through the entire crisis.
boss.explain: The regional manager must have been anticipating this logistical nightmare when he requested the contingency plan. (區域經理要求制定應急計畫時，一定早就預料到這場物流噩夢了。) 回應 A (是的，他的遠見確實拯救了我們今天免於全面癱瘓) 最契合語境。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The entire freight network is purported to be operating at maximum capacity to clear the backlog.
options: A. 整個貨運網絡正在減班以節省成本
B. 據稱整個貨運網絡正以最大產能運作以清理積壓的貨物
C. 貨運網絡已經完全癱瘓
D. 積壓的貨物已經全數被銷毀
boss.explain: The entire freight network is purported to be operating at maximum capacity to clear the backlog. (據稱，整個貨運網絡正以最大負載運作，以清除積壓的貨物。)

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The exorbitant prices on the menu must have deterred a significant portion of their target demographic.
options: A. I have been eating there every day.
B. Exactly, many locals feel priced out and no longer visit.
C. The menu is expected to be incredibly cheap.
D. They must have deterred the chef from cooking.
boss.explain: The exorbitant prices on the menu must have deterred a significant portion of their target demographic. (菜單上高昂的價格一定嚇退了他們很大一部分的目標客群。) 回應 B (沒錯，許多當地人覺得價格太高而不再光顧) 是最精準的回應。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The complex flavor profile of this dish is intended to be unraveled slowly on the palate.
options: A. 這道菜的口味非常單調且無趣
B. 這道菜複雜的風味層次旨在讓味蕾慢慢去解析感受
C. 廚師希望客人快速吃完這道菜
D. 這道菜的味道過於強烈，難以下嚥
boss.explain: The complex flavor profile of this dish is intended to be unraveled slowly on the palate. (這道菜複雜的風味特徵是為了讓味蕾細細品味、慢慢解開而設計的。)

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The underlying premise of your research must have been challenged vigorously during the defense.
options: A. Yes, the committee grilled me on my theoretical framework for hours.
B. We have been accepting the premise without question.
C. The research is scheduled to be canceled.
D. I must have defended the committee.
boss.explain: The underlying premise of your research must have been challenged vigorously during the defense. (你研究的潛在前提在口試辯護時一定受到了強烈的質疑。) 回應 A (是的，委員會對我的理論框架盤問了好幾個小時) 正確對應。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: These statistical anomalies are generally presumed to be caused by flaws in the sampling methodology.
options: A. 這些統計異常被證明是完美的結果
B. 這些統計上的異常狀況通常被推定為是抽樣方法上的瑕疵所致
C. 抽樣方法完全沒有任何缺陷
D. 統計異常是人為刻意捏造的
boss.explain: These statistical anomalies are generally presumed to be caused by flaws in the sampling methodology. (這些統計上的異常現象通常被推斷是由抽樣方法中的瑕疵引起的。)

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The incumbent governor must have deliberately evaded the reporter's question about the corruption scandal.
options: A. He has been answering every question transparently.
B. Absolutely, his pivot to infrastructure was a classic deflection tactic.
C. The corruption scandal is expected to be promoted.
D. The reporter must have evaded the press conference.
boss.explain: The incumbent governor must have deliberately evaded the reporter's question about the corruption scandal. (現任州長一定是故意迴避了記者關於貪污醜聞的提問。) 回應 B (絕對是，他轉移話題到基礎設施是經典的閃避策略) 語意相符。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The ambitious housing initiative is slated to be entirely subsidized by federal grants.
options: A. 這個雄心勃勃的住宅計畫預計將完全由聯邦政府補助
B. 住宅計畫將由市民自行籌資
C. 聯邦政府拒絕資助這項住宅計畫
D. 這項倡議已經被全盤否決
boss.explain: The ambitious housing initiative is slated to be entirely subsidized by federal grants. (這項雄心勃勃的住房倡議預定將完全由聯邦補助款提供資金。)

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The malicious ransomware must have circumvented our firewalls during the scheduled maintenance window.
options: A. We have been turning off the servers permanently.
B. It appears so; the logs show an intrusion at precisely 3 AM.
C. The firewalls are considered to be invulnerable.
D. They must have maintained the ransomware.
boss.explain: The malicious ransomware must have circumvented our firewalls during the scheduled maintenance window. (惡意勒索軟體一定是在預定的維護時段繞過了我們的防火牆。) 回應 B (看來是這樣；日誌顯示正好在凌晨三點有入侵跡象) 完全符合資安情境。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: Routine system diagnostics are strictly required to be logged in the centralized repository.
options: A. 系統診斷結果不需要被保留下來
B. 嚴格要求例行的系統診斷記錄必須存入集中式資料庫
C. 只有嚴重的錯誤才需要被記錄
D. 集中式資料庫目前無法使用
boss.explain: Routine system diagnostics are strictly required to be logged in the centralized repository. (嚴格規定例行的系統診斷結果必須被記錄在集中的儲存庫中。)

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The sudden data loss must have severely compromised our operational integrity.
options: A. The operational integrity is flawless.
B. Indeed, several client accounts are currently unrecoverable.
C. We have been compromising the data deliberately.
D. The loss must have been a great benefit.
boss.explain: The sudden data loss must have severely compromised our operational integrity. (突如其來的數據遺失一定嚴重損害了我們的營運完整性。) 回應 B (確實，好幾個客戶帳戶目前無法恢復) 反映了嚴重性。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: Redundancy protocols are strategically designed to be triggered upon primary server failure.
options: A. 備援協定被設計在主伺服器正常運作時關閉
B. 備援協定經策略性設計，會在主伺服器故障時觸發
C. 主伺服器故障時會導致所有資料被刪除
D. 這些協定完全沒有備份的作用
boss.explain: Redundancy protocols are strategically designed to be triggered upon primary server failure. (備援協定經過策略性設計，以便在主伺服器故障時被觸發。)

boss.desc: 【綜合文法】Not only ___ our market share, but we have also been outperforming industry benchmarks consistently.
options: A. the new product boosted
B. has the new product boosted
C. the new product has boosted
D. did the new product boosted
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：Not only 置於句首時，其後的子句需倒裝 (助動詞移至主詞前)。後半句用現在完成進行式，前半句配合語意用現在完成式倒裝，has the new product boosted。選項 B 正確；D 助動詞 did 後面動詞未還原，為語法錯誤。

boss.desc:
【短文】Letter to Shareholders: Over the past year, we have been revamping our core software architecture. The legacy system is widely acknowledged to have hindered our agility. Our early investors must have worried about the technological debt we accumulated. Fortunately, the transition is now complete.
Q: What was the problem with the legacy system?
options: A. It was too expensive to maintain
B. It slowed down the company's responsiveness
C. It caused massive data leaks
D. It was not accessible to early investors
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中指出舊系統 (legacy system)「hindered our agility (阻礙了我們的敏捷度)」。agility 指敏捷度、反應速度，選項 B (slowed down responsiveness) 為其同義改寫，故為正解。

boss.desc: 【字彙】The sudden mutation in the virus strain is highly ___ to the development of our new vaccine, rendering it less effective.
options: A. resilient
B. evocative
C. detrimental
D. immersive
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：detrimental 意為「有害的、不利的」。句意為病毒株的突變對疫苗開發「極為不利」，導致其效果降低。其他選項 (A 韌性的，B 喚起情感的，D 沉浸式的) 完全不合邏輯。

boss.desc:
【短文】Neuro-Science: Neuroscientists have been mapping the brain's neural pathways during deep sleep. Memory consolidation is proven to be facilitated by these slow-wave patterns. Individuals who sleep poorly must have experienced a significant disruption in this critical restorative phase.
Q: What happens during slow-wave sleep?
options: A. Neural pathways are permanently destroyed
B. Memories are strengthened and organized
C. The brain stops all internal activity
D. Individuals experience vivid nightmares
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文章提到 Memory consolidation (記憶鞏固/強化) 是由慢波模式 (slow-wave patterns) 促進的。選項 B「記憶被強化與組織」正是 consolidation 的意義。

boss.desc: 【綜合文法】Scarcely ___ the new recycling initiative when they realized they lacked the facilities to process the collected materials.
options: A. the city had launched
B. did the city launch
C. had the city launched
D. the city launched
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：否定副詞 Scarcely (幾乎不/一...就...) 置於句首時，主要子句需倒裝，通常搭配過去完成式 (had + S + p.p.)，後面跟 when 加上過去式子句。選項 C (had the city launched) 完全符合倒裝與時態規則。

boss.desc:
【短文】Opinion Page: We have been enduring endless traffic jams since the bridge repair began. The detour routes are proven to have been poorly planned. The urban planners must have relied on outdated traffic models, as they completely failed to account for rush-hour volume.
Q: Why are the detour routes ineffective?
options: A. They are too narrow for commercial trucks
B. The planners used old and inaccurate traffic data
C. Rush-hour volume has decreased recently
D. The bridge repair was unexpectedly canceled
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：投書中提到都市計畫者「must have relied on outdated traffic models (一定依賴了過時的交通模型)」，導致無法應付尖峰時段車流。選項 B (使用舊且不準確的數據) 為正解。

boss.desc: 【綜合文法】Only after the whistleblower leaked the internal memos ___ the true extent of the corporate fraud.
options: A. the public realized
B. did the public realize
C. the public has realized
D. has the public realized
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：Only after 帶領的副詞子句置於句首時，後面的主要子句必須倒裝 (助動詞 + 主詞 + 動詞)。又因為 leak 是過去式，主要子句也應為過去式倒裝，選項 B (did the public realize) 為正解。

boss.desc:
【短文】Judicial Review: The tech giant has been appealing the heavy fines imposed by the European Union. Their data collection practices are alleged to have infringed upon user privacy rights. The company's compliance officers must have deliberately bypassed the regional regulations.
Q: Why was the tech giant fined?
options: A. For failing to pay corporate taxes
B. For allegedly violating user privacy laws
C. For appealing the European Union's decision
D. For firing their compliance officers
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中提及「Their data collection practices are alleged to have infringed upon user privacy rights (他們的資料收集行為據稱侵犯了用戶隱私權)」。infringe upon 意為侵犯，選項 B (violating user privacy laws) 符合。

boss.desc: 【字彙】The artist's refusal to provide any description for his abstract paintings leaves their meaning completely open to ___.
options: A. transparency
B. consolidation
C. interpretation
D. plumage
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：open to interpretation 是一個常見片語，意為「開放給人自由詮釋」。藝術家不提供文字說明，使得抽象畫的意義完全開放給觀眾各自解讀。選項 C 正確。

boss.desc:
【短文】Gallery Review: The historical society has been showcasing a collection of rare medieval artifacts. A magnificent jewel-encrusted sword is purported to have belonged to a legendary king. The craftsmen who forged it must have possessed unparalleled metallurgical skills.
Q: What is said about the sword's creators?
options: A. They were members of the royal family
B. They were highly skilled in metalworking
C. They stole the jewels from a legendary king
D. They left detailed blueprints for the historical society
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中稱讚鍛造這把劍的工匠 (craftsmen)「must have possessed unparalleled metallurgical skills (一定擁有無與倫比的冶金/金屬加工技巧)」。選項 B (highly skilled in metalworking) 是準確的改寫。

boss.desc:
【短文】Science Weekly: Researchers have been observing the peculiar mating rituals of the bird of paradise. The vibrant plumage is considered to have evolved specifically to attract mates in dense jungles. The ancestors of these birds must have faced intense sexual selection pressures.
Q: Why did the vibrant plumage evolve?
options: A. To camouflage the birds in dense jungles
B. To attract potential mating partners
C. To frighten away dangerous predators
D. To help the birds fly faster
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文章明確指出鮮豔的羽毛 (vibrant plumage) 被認為是為了「attract mates (吸引配偶)」而演化出來的。選項 B (attract potential mating partners) 完全相符。

boss.desc:
【短文】Exhibition Critique: We have been waiting in line for hours to see the immersive digital art show. The visual projections are reported to have crashed twice during the morning session. The technical team must have overlooked a fatal bug in the rendering software.
Q: What issue occurred during the morning session?
options: A. The gallery was closed due to a power outage
B. The visual projections failed to operate correctly
C. The technical team resigned unexpectedly
D. The audience refused to wait in line
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中提及「The visual projections are reported to have crashed twice (視覺投影據報崩潰了兩次)」，意即系統無法正常運作。選項 B 準確描述了投影失敗的問題。

boss.desc: 請唸出單字：精疲力竭的
boss.speak: exhausted
boss.explain: 口說表達「EXHAUSTED」(adj.)：精疲力竭的。例句：I was completely exhausted after the long flight from London.（在從倫敦長途飛行之後，我已經完全精疲力竭了。）

boss.desc: 請唸出單字：無法預見的
boss.speak: unforeseen
boss.explain: 口說表達「UNFORESEEN」(adj.)：無法預見的。例句：Due to unforeseen circumstances, the event has been canceled.（由於無法預料的情況，活動已被取消。）

boss.desc: 請唸出單字：瓶頸
boss.speak: bottleneck
boss.explain: 口說表達「BOTTLENECK」(n.)：瓶頸。例句：The narrow doorway creates a bottleneck.（狹窄門口形成瓶頸。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：一定遇到了
boss.speak: must have encountered
boss.explain: 口說表達「MUST HAVE ENCOUNTERED」(phr.)：一定遇到了。

boss.desc: 請唸出：無法預見的延誤
boss.speak: unforeseen delays
boss.explain: 口說表達「UNFORESEEN DELAYS」(phr.)：無法預見的延誤。

boss.desc: 請唸出：你一定已經精疲力竭了
boss.speak: you must have been exhausted
boss.explain: 口說表達「YOU MUST HAVE BEEN EXHAUSTED」(phr.)：你一定已經精疲力竭了。

boss.desc: 請唸出：問題目前正在被處理中
boss.ans: THE ISSUE IS BEING ADDRESSED CURRENTLY
boss.speak: the issue is being addressed currently
boss.explain: 口說表達「THE ISSUE IS BEING ADDRESSED CURRENTLY」(phr.)：問題目前正在被處理中。

boss.desc: 請唸出：我們一直在探索可行的替代方案
boss.ans: WE HAVE BEEN EXPLORING VIABLE ALTERNATIVES
boss.speak: we have been exploring viable alternatives
boss.explain: 口說表達「WE HAVE BEEN EXPLORING VIABLE ALTERNATIVES」(phr.)：我們一直在探索可行的替代方案。

boss.desc: 請唸出：一個變通方法正在被開發中
boss.speak: a workaround is being developed
boss.explain: 口說表達「A WORKAROUND IS BEING DEVELOPED」(phr.)：一個變通方法正在被開發中。

boss.desc: 請唸出：她一定遇到了嚴重的塞車
boss.ans: SHE MUST HAVE ENCOUNTERED HEAVY TRAFFIC
boss.speak: she must have encountered heavy traffic
boss.explain: 口說表達「SHE MUST HAVE ENCOUNTERED HEAVY TRAFFIC」(phr.)：她一定遇到了嚴重的塞車。

boss.desc: 請唸出：他們一直面臨無法預見的挫折
boss.ans: THEY HAVE BEEN FACING UNFORESEEN SETBACKS
boss.speak: they have been facing unforeseen setbacks
boss.explain: 口說表達「THEY HAVE BEEN FACING UNFORESEEN SETBACKS」(phr.)：他們一直面臨無法預見的挫折。

boss.desc: 請拼出：精通；熟練
boss.speak: proficiency
boss.explain: PROFICIENCY (n.)：熟練運用某項技能的程度。例句：The test provides evidence of language proficiency.（測驗提供語言熟練程度的證據。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：差異；不一致
boss.speak: discrepancy
boss.explain: DISCREPANCY (n.)：資料或說法之間的出入。例句：There was a discrepancy between the two reports.（兩份報告之間有出入。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：核銷；退款
boss.speak: reimbursement
boss.explain: REIMBURSEMENT (n.)：償還他人先行支出費用的款項或過程。例句：The form is used to request reimbursement of agreed expenses.（表格用來申請償還約定費用。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：改寫；釋義
boss.speak: paraphrase
boss.explain: PARAPHRASE (v.)：改寫；釋義。例句：The original text is being paraphrased to avoid plagiarism.（原始文本正被改寫以避免抄襲。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：等同的；等價物
boss.speak: equivalent
boss.explain: EQUIVALENT (adj.)：相等的；等值的。例句：If I had the equivalent amount of money, I would invest it in tech stocks.（如果我有等值的錢，我會將其投資於科技股。）

boss.desc: 填空題：D _ S C R _ P A N C _ (差異；不一致)
boss.speak: discrepancy
boss.explain: DISCREPANCY (n.)：差異；不一致。填空答案為「IEY」。例句：There was a discrepancy between the two reports.（兩份報告之間有出入。）

boss.desc: 填空題：A S S _ R T _ V _ (果斷的；自信的)
boss.speak: assertive
boss.explain: ASSERTIVE (adj.)：果斷的；自信的。填空答案為「EIE」。例句：Her response was assertive without being rude.（她的回應有主見，卻不失禮。）

boss.desc: 填空題：D _ P L _ M A T _ C (外交的；圓滑的)
boss.speak: diplomatic
boss.explain: DIPLOMATIC (adj.)：外交的；圓滑的。填空答案為「IOI」。例句：The sensitive issue is being handled in a diplomatic manner.（這個敏感問題正在以外交的、圓滑的方式處理中。）

boss.desc: 填空題：R E _ M B _ R S E M E N _ (核銷；退款)
boss.speak: reimbursement
boss.explain: REIMBURSEMENT (n.)：核銷；退款。填空答案為「IUT」。例句：The form is used to request reimbursement of agreed expenses.（表格用來申請償還約定費用。）

boss.desc: 填空題：P _ R _ P H R A S _ (改寫；釋義)
boss.speak: paraphrase
boss.explain: PARAPHRASE (v.)：改寫；釋義。填空答案為「AAE」。例句：The original text is being paraphrased to avoid plagiarism.（原始文本正被改寫以避免抄襲。）

boss.desc: 填空題：R _ V _ S I _ N (修訂；修改)
boss.speak: revision
boss.explain: REVISION (n.)：修訂；修改。填空答案為「EIO」。例句：Extensive revisions are currently being made to the project proposal.（專案企劃書目前正進行大幅的修訂。）

boss.desc: 填空題：E Q U _ V _ L E N _ (等同的；等價物)
boss.speak: equivalent
boss.explain: EQUIVALENT (adj.)：等同的；等價物。填空答案為「IAT」。例句：If I had the equivalent amount of money, I would invest it in tech stocks.（如果我有等值的錢，我會將其投資於科技股。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Have you been going to the mandatory retirement planning workshops?
options: A. No, I actually missed the first session due to a meeting.
B. I plan to buy a new suit for the party.
C. The construction workshop is located outside.
D. Yes, he is retiring next month.
boss.explain: 英文：Have you been going to the mandatory retirement planning workshops? 意思：你有一直去參加強制性的退休規劃工作坊嗎？A「沒有，其實我因為開會錯過了第一堂課」最為連貫。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The performance-based bonuses are slated to be disbursed at the end of this quarter.
options: A. 由於業績下滑，今年的年終獎金將被取消。
B. 基於績效的獎金預計將在本季末發放。
C. 表現不佳的員工將被要求參加額外的培訓。
D. 公司的整體利潤在上個月創下了歷史新高。
boss.explain: 英文：The performance-based bonuses are slated to be disbursed at the end of this quarter. 意思：基於績效的獎金預計將在本季末發放。disburse 為發放（款項），slated to be 為預定被...

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: They must have deliberately concealed the recent cuts to our dental coverage.
options: A. The dentist is available on Friday morning.
B. I need to buy a new cover for my smartphone.
C. That explains the sudden outrage from the staff.
D. We should conceal our identities for safety.
boss.explain: 英文：They must have deliberately concealed the recent cuts to our dental coverage. 意思：他們一定是刻意隱瞞了最近對我們牙科保險的削減。C「那解釋了為何員工會突然感到憤怒」最合理。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The windshield wipers are supposed to be included in the basic warranty, correct?
options: A. Yes, the weather is quite stormy today.
B. I wiped the windows clean this morning.
C. The mechanic is busy fixing another car.
D. Actually, they are considered normal wear and tear.
boss.explain: 英文：The windshield wipers are supposed to be included in the basic warranty, correct? 意思：雨刷應該包含在基本保固裡，對嗎？D「其實，它們被視為正常的耗損」最符合汽車保固常理。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The internal computer system must have bypassed the minor electrical fault.
options: A. 內部的電腦系統一定是繞過了這個輕微的電力故障。
B. 維修人員不小心扯斷了引擎室裡的電線。
C. 汽車的電池因為過度充電而發生了爆炸。
D. 這台車的導航系統經常在偏遠地區失去訊號。
boss.explain: 英文：The internal computer system must have bypassed the minor electrical fault. 意思：內部的電腦系統一定是繞過了這個輕微的電力故障。bypass 意為繞過、避開。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The brake pads have been wearing out unevenly due to a misaligned suspension.
options: A. I will pad the box with some extra foam.
B. Should I authorize a complete suspension replacement then?
C. The road has been very smooth lately.
D. Please wear a helmet while riding the motorcycle.
boss.explain: 英文：The brake pads have been wearing out unevenly due to a misaligned suspension. 意思：因為懸吊系統未對齊，煞車來令片一直磨損得很不平均。B「那麼我應該授權進行懸吊系統的全面更換嗎？」為最佳回應。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The autobiography is expected to be released globally next Tuesday.
options: A. The global economy is recovering slowly.
B. I can't wait to grab a copy from the bookstore.
C. She drives an automatic car to work.
D. Yes, Tuesday is a holiday.
boss.explain: 英文：The autobiography is expected to be released globally next Tuesday. 意思：這本自傳預計下週二在全球發行。B「我等不及要去書店買一本了」最合適。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The central conflict of the plot must have been inspired by your childhood trauma.
options: A. 許多讀者對小說中暴力的情節感到反感。
B. 這本童書的插畫充滿了生動鮮明的色彩。
C. 作者拒絕在訪談中透露任何個人的隱私。
D. 劇情的中心衝突一定是被你童年的創傷所啟發的。
boss.explain: 英文：The central conflict of the plot must have been inspired by your childhood trauma. 意思：劇情的中心衝突一定是被你童年的創傷所啟發的。trauma 指創傷。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Certain chapters are known to have been rewritten to appease the publishers.
options: A. It is a shame they sacrificed artistic integrity for sales.
B. The printer is out of paper again.
C. I have not read the latest newspaper yet.
D. He knows how to write a good email.
boss.explain: 英文：Certain chapters are known to have been rewritten to appease the publishers. 意思：某些章節據悉為了安撫出版商而被重寫了。A「很遺憾他們為了銷量犧牲了藝術的完整性」最為契合。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The essential prerequisites for this internship are supposed to be strictly enforced.
options: A. 公司決定放寬實習生的招募條件以吸引更多人。
B. 這個實習計畫的必要先決條件理應被嚴格執行。
C. 所有實習生都會獲得一份全職工作的錄取通知。
D. 面試過程非常輕鬆，沒有任何嚴格的規定。
boss.explain: 英文：The essential prerequisites for this internship are supposed to be strictly enforced. 意思：這個實習計畫的必要先決條件理應被嚴格執行。prerequisite 為先決條件。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The selection committee must have been overwhelmed by the sheer volume of outstanding applications.
options: A. The volume of the speaker is too loud.
B. I downloaded a new application on my phone.
C. That definitely explains the long delay in announcing the results.
D. They selected a new chairman yesterday.
boss.explain: 英文：The selection committee must have been overwhelmed by the sheer volume of outstanding applications. 意思：評選委員會一定是被數量龐大的優秀申請件給淹沒了。C「這絕對解釋了為何公佈結果會拖延這麼久」最為適當。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The spectacular architecture on the ceiling must have taken decades to construct.
options: A. 博物館的屋頂因為年久失修而開始漏水。
B. 這座城市的摩天大樓都是在近年完工的。
C. 這裡的建築風格受到了現代藝術的強烈影響。
D. 天花板上壯觀的建築結構一定花了幾十年才建造完成。
boss.explain: 英文：The spectacular architecture on the ceiling must have taken decades to construct. 意思：天花板上壯觀的建築結構一定花了幾十年才建造完成。architecture 指建築結構，must have taken 表達推測花費的時間。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The archaeological excavations have been uncovering remnants of a forgotten civilization.
options: A. It is absolutely fascinating how much history is buried here.
B. I need to cover my car before it rains.
C. The construction workers forgot their tools.
D. This museum is closed on Mondays.
boss.explain: 英文：The archaeological excavations have been uncovering remnants of a forgotten civilization. 意思：這些考古挖掘工作一直不斷出土一個被遺忘文明的遺跡。A「這裡埋藏了多少歷史，真是令人極度著迷」最切題。

boss.desc:
【綜合】Supply Chain Insight: The sudden collapse of the major shipping firm is heavily rumored to have been orchestrated by a rival conglomerate. Smaller vendors have been suffering from extreme inventory shortages ever since. They must have relied entirely on a single logistics provider, ignoring the basic principle of diversification.
Q: What mistake did the smaller vendors make?
options: A. They orchestrated the firm's collapse.
B. They relied on a single logistics provider.
C. They diversified their inventory too much.
D. They ignored the rival conglomerate.
boss.explain: 文中指責較小的供應商「must have relied entirely on a single logistics provider」，犯了未分散風險的錯誤。

boss.desc: 【語法結構】Not only ___ alternative raw materials, but the procurement team is also expected to secure lower import tariffs next quarter.
options: A. they have been sourcing
B. have they been sourcing
C. do they source
D. they source
boss.explain: Not only 置於句首時，後面的子句需要倒裝（助動詞移到主詞前），故選 have they been sourcing。

boss.desc:
【綜合】Health Abstract: Long-term dietary studies have been analyzing the correlation between sugar intake and early-onset diabetes. The metabolic disruption is firmly believed to have been triggered by highly processed ingredients. The food industry must have deliberately obscured the nutritional labels to maintain high sales volumes.
Q: What is the food industry accused of doing?
options: A. Analyzing dietary studies
B. Lowering sugar intake
C. Obscuring nutritional labels
D. Triggering early-onset diabetes directly
boss.explain: 短文中提到「must have deliberately obscured the nutritional labels」，指控食品業故意模糊營養標示。

boss.desc:
【綜合】Lease Dispute Summary: The commercial tenant has been demanding compensation for the water damage. The faulty plumbing is proven to have caused severe structural decay prior to the move-in date. The property inspector must have conducted a superficial evaluation during the initial handover.
Q: Why is the property inspector criticized?
options: A. For causing the water damage
B. For conducting a superficial evaluation
C. For demanding compensation
D. For moving in early
boss.explain: 短文中提到「must have conducted a superficial evaluation」，意即檢驗員只做了草率的檢查。

boss.desc: 【語法結構】Scarcely ___ the new binding clause when the lessee realized it heavily favored the landlord's interests.
options: A. had the lawyer drafted
B. the lawyer had drafted
C. has the lawyer drafted
D. the lawyer has drafted
boss.explain: Scarcely 置於句首需倒裝，搭配 when，且主要子句為過去式（realized），故前方需用過去完成式倒裝 had + S + V-en。

boss.desc:
【綜合】Startup Analysis: The highly anticipated app is reported to have crashed completely during its live demonstration. Developers have been frantically releasing patches to contain the damage. The QA department must have bypassed the server load tests to meet the aggressive launch schedule set by the investors.
Q: What caused the live demonstration to fail?
options: A. The investors cancelled the launch.
B. The app crashed due to bypassed server load tests.
C. The developers released too many patches.
D. The live demonstration was poorly attended.
boss.explain: 文中說明應用程式崩潰，且推測是 QA 部門為了趕進度而跳過伺服器負載測試（bypassed the server load tests）。

boss.desc: 【字彙】To attract venture capital, a startup's business model must be highly ___, allowing it to grow exponentially without a proportional increase in costs.
options: A. bustling
B. sedentary
C. scalable
D. picturesque
boss.explain: scalable 意為「可擴展的」。新創的商業模式必須能擴大規模而成本不致於暴增。

boss.desc:
【綜合】Culture Column: The local government has been pouring funds into restoring the colonial-era architecture. The historical district is widely considered to have lost its authentic charm due to over-commercialization. The city planners must have prioritized lucrative tourist traps over genuine cultural preservation.
Q: What is the main criticism against the city planners?
options: A. They destroyed the colonial-era architecture.
B. They prioritized commercial tourist traps over cultural preservation.
C. They ran out of funds for the restoration.
D. They ignored the historical district entirely.
boss.explain: 文中批評「must have prioritized lucrative tourist traps over genuine cultural preservation」（將賺錢的觀光陷阱置於真正的文化保存之上）。

boss.desc: 【字彙】The region's unique ___, featuring a blend of indigenous spices and modern culinary techniques, has drawn food critics from all over the world.
options: A. traction
B. valuation
C. gastronomy
D. clause
boss.explain: gastronomy 意為「美食學、烹飪法」。結合當地香料與現代技術的美食吸引了全球評論家。

boss.desc: 【語法結構】Only after the audit was fully completed ___ that the startup's inflated valuation was entirely fabricated by the founders.
options: A. it was discovered
B. did they discover
C. they discovered
D. they have discovered
boss.explain: Only after 位於句首時，主要子句需倒裝。過去式倒裝為 did + S + V。

boss.desc:
【綜合】City Travel Guide: Tourists have been crowding the northern coastal town to witness its famed sunset. The iconic lighthouse is said to have guided countless lost sailors during the 19th century. Early settlers must have endured incredibly harsh winters without modern heating.
Q: What is true about the iconic lighthouse?
options: A. It was built to attract tourists.
B. It is currently being rebuilt.
C. It is said to have guided lost sailors in the past.
D. It was destroyed in the 19th century.
boss.explain: 文中提及「The iconic lighthouse is said to have guided countless lost sailors during the 19th century」。

boss.desc: 【字彙】The village is so ___, with its cobblestone streets and vibrant gardens, that it looks like a scene straight out of a fairy tale.
options: A. scalable
B. binding
C. picturesque
D. sedentary
boss.explain: picturesque 意為「如畫的、美麗的」，用來形容風景如童話般美麗。

boss.desc: 請唸出：正在被組裝
boss.speak: are being assembled
boss.explain: 口說表達「ARE BEING ASSEMBLED」(phr.)：正在被組裝。

boss.desc: 請唸出：一定遺漏了
boss.speak: must have omitted
boss.explain: 口說表達「MUST HAVE OMITTED」(phr.)：一定遺漏了。

boss.desc: 請唸出：一直排練
boss.speak: have been rehearsing
boss.explain: 口說表達「HAVE BEEN REHEARSING」(phr.)：一直排練。

boss.desc: 請唸出：正在退款中
boss.speak: is being refunded
boss.explain: 口說表達「IS BEING REFUNDED」(phr.)：正在退款中。

boss.desc: 請唸出：一定延遲了
boss.speak: must have delayed it
boss.explain: 口說表達「MUST HAVE DELAYED IT」(phr.)：一定延遲了。

boss.desc: 請唸出：你一定忽略了那個特定條款
boss.ans: YOU MUST HAVE OVERLOOKED THAT SPECIFIC CLAUSE
boss.speak: you must have overlooked that specific clause
boss.explain: 口說表達「YOU MUST HAVE OVERLOOKED THAT SPECIFIC CLAUSE」(phr.)：你一定忽略了那個特定條款。

boss.desc: 請唸出：一個有趣的軼事現在正被分享
boss.ans: AN AMUSING ANECDOTE IS BEING SHARED NOW
boss.speak: an amusing anecdote is being shared now
boss.explain: 口說表達「AN AMUSING ANECDOTE IS BEING SHARED NOW」(phr.)：一個有趣的軼事現在正被分享。

boss.desc: 請唸出：後勤工作正由他們處理
boss.ans: THE LOGISTICS ARE BEING HANDLED BY THEM
boss.speak: the logistics are being handled by them
boss.explain: 口說表達「THE LOGISTICS ARE BEING HANDLED BY THEM」(phr.)：後勤工作正由他們處理。

boss.desc: 請唸出：她一直在分享一個有趣的軼事
boss.ans: SHE HAS BEEN SHARING AN INTERESTING ANECDOTE
boss.speak: she has been sharing an interesting anecdote
boss.explain: 口說表達「SHE HAS BEEN SHARING AN INTERESTING ANECDOTE」(phr.)：她一直在分享一個有趣的軼事。

boss.desc: 請唸出：他們一定把這兩個地址搞混了
boss.ans: THEY MUST HAVE CONFUSED THE DIFFERENT ADDRESSES
boss.speak: they must have confused the different addresses
boss.explain: 口說表達「THEY MUST HAVE CONFUSED THE DIFFERENT ADDRESSES」(phr.)：他們一定把這兩個地址搞混了。

boss.desc: 請唸出：資金的分配正在被討論
boss.ans: THE ALLOCATION OF FUNDS IS BEING DISCUSSED
boss.speak: the allocation of funds is being discussed
boss.explain: 口說表達「THE ALLOCATION OF FUNDS IS BEING DISCUSSED」(phr.)：資金的分配正在被討論。

boss.desc: 請唸出：我們一直在表達我們深深的感激
boss.ans: WE HAVE BEEN EXPRESSING OUR DEEP GRATITUDE
boss.speak: we have been expressing our deep gratitude
boss.explain: 口說表達「WE HAVE BEEN EXPRESSING OUR DEEP GRATITUDE」(phr.)：我們一直在表達我們深深的感激。

boss.desc: 填空題：I N _ E G R _ T I _ N (整合)
boss.speak: integration
boss.explain: INTEGRATION (n.)：整合。填空答案為「TAO」。例句：System integration is currently being tested by the IT team.（系統整合目前正由資訊團隊進行測試。）

boss.desc: 填空題：C L _ R I F I C _ T I _ N (澄清；說明)
boss.speak: clarification
boss.explain: CLARIFICATION (n.)：澄清；說明。填空答案為「AAO」。例句：The customer asked for a clarification of the company policy.（顧客要求對公司政策進行說明。）

boss.desc: 填空題：C O N S _ L _ D A T _ (鞏固；合併)
boss.speak: consolidate
boss.explain: CONSOLIDATE (v.)：鞏固；合併。填空答案為「OIE」。例句：Review helps consolidate new knowledge.（複習有助鞏固新知。）

boss.desc: 填空題：T _ N T _ T I V _ (暫定的)
boss.speak: tentative
boss.explain: TENTATIVE (adj.)：暫定的。填空答案為「EAE」。例句：We have made a tentative schedule for next week.（我們已經為下週制定了暫定的行程表。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：相關的；恰當的
boss.speak: pertinent
boss.explain: PERTINENT (adj.)：與問題直接相關而切題的。例句：That distinction is pertinent to the complaint.（那個區分與申訴直接相關。）

boss.desc: 填空題：P _ R T _ N E N _ (相關的；恰當的)
boss.speak: pertinent
boss.explain: PERTINENT (adj.)：相關的；恰當的。填空答案為「EIT」。例句：That distinction is pertinent to the complaint.（那個區分與申訴直接相關。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：規定；明確要求
boss.speak: stipulate
boss.explain: STIPULATE (v.)：明確約定各項義務。例句：Environmental accords stipulate stringent limits on carbon sulfur emissions.（國際環境公約明確約定了對各國硫碳化合物排放總量的嚴格限制。）

boss.desc: 填空題：S T _ P U L _ T _ (規定；明確要求)
boss.speak: stipulate
boss.explain: STIPULATE (v.)：規定；明確要求。填空答案為「IAE」。例句：Environmental accords stipulate stringent limits on carbon sulfur emissions.（國際環境公約明確約定了對各國硫碳化合物排放總量的嚴格限制。）

boss.desc: 填空題：M _ T _ G A T _ (減輕；緩和)
boss.speak: mitigate
boss.explain: MITIGATE (n.)：減輕；緩和。填空答案為「IIE」。

boss.desc: 請拼出：潛在的；預期的
boss.speak: prospective
boss.explain: PROSPECTIVE (adj.)：潛在的；預期的。例句：Prospective buyers are being shown around the property this afternoon.（今天下午正在帶領潛在買家參觀該物業。）

boss.desc: 填空題：P R _ S P _ C T I V _ (潛在的；預期的)
boss.speak: prospective
boss.explain: PROSPECTIVE (adj.)：潛在的；預期的。填空答案為「OEE」。例句：Prospective buyers are being shown around the property this afternoon.（今天下午正在帶領潛在買家參觀該物業。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The correlation between sleep deprivation and cognitive decline has been rigorously documented by researchers.
options: A. 研究人員一直嚴格記錄睡眠不足與認知衰退之間的關聯性。
B. 睡眠不足一定導致了受試者嚴重的認知功能下降。
C. 關於睡眠與認知的研究正被學術界廣泛討論。
D. 研究人員必須證明睡眠不足會造成認知衰退。
boss.explain: 原句：The correlation between sleep deprivation and cognitive decline has been rigorously documented by researchers. 意思是「睡眠不足與認知衰退之間的關聯，已經被研究人員嚴格地記錄下來」。使用現在完成式的被動語態 (has been documented)。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The erroneous billing charges must have been generated by a glitch in the automated system.
options: A. The system is being shut down permanently tomorrow.
B. Yes, our engineers have been trying to isolate the exact bug since Monday.
C. You must have intentionally overcharged the customers.
D. The billing statement has been mailed to your address.
boss.explain: 原句：The erroneous billing charges must have been generated by a glitch in the automated system.（錯誤的帳單費用一定是自動化系統中的小故障所產生的。）回應「是的，我們的工程師從週一就一直在試圖找出確切的錯誤」符合語境與複雜時態。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The intricate embroidery on this haute couture gown is being meticulously crafted by artisans.
options: A. 這件高級訂製禮服上精美的刺繡正由工匠們一絲不苟地製作中。
B. 工匠們一直努力在期限前完成這件高級禮服的刺繡。
C. 這件禮服的刺繡一定花了工匠們好幾個月的時間。
D. 我們必須請最頂尖的工匠來完成這種精美的刺繡。
boss.explain: 原句：The intricate embroidery on this haute couture gown is being meticulously crafted by artisans. 意思是「這件高級訂製禮服上繁複的刺繡，正由工匠們一絲不苟地手工製作」。使用了現在進行式的被動語態 (is being crafted)。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Have the preliminary negotiations regarding the intellectual property transfer been progressing smoothly?
options: A. The property is being sold to a private investor.
B. They must have canceled the negotiation without telling us.
C. Actually, they have been stalling over the valuation of the patents.
D. The intellectual progress must have been evaluated.
boss.explain: 原句：Have the preliminary negotiations regarding the intellectual property transfer been progressing smoothly?（關於智慧財產權轉讓的初步談判進展順利嗎？）回應「事實上，他們一直在專利估值上拖延」最符合商業情境。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The standardized testing protocols must have been compromised during the administrative transition.
options: A. 標準化測驗的程序一定在行政交接期間遭到了破壞。
B. 學校一直在過渡期間努力維持標準化測驗的公平性。
C. 測驗程序正被教育局重新評估其有效性。
D. 行政團隊必須在交接前確保測驗不會遭到外洩。
boss.explain: 原句：The standardized testing protocols must have been compromised during the administrative transition. 意思是「標準化測試規程一定在行政過渡/交接期間遭到妥協/破壞了」。compromised 在此指「遭受損害/破壞」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The prolonged exposure to blue light has been scientifically linked to retinal strain.
options: A. The blue paint is being applied to the walls.
B. Therefore, protective eyewear is highly recommended by optometrists.
C. They must have strained their muscles during the workout.
D. We have been staring at the beautiful blue ocean.
boss.explain: 原句：The prolonged exposure to blue light has been scientifically linked to retinal strain.（長時間暴露在藍光下已經在科學上被證實與視網膜疲勞有關。）回應「因此，驗光師強烈建議配戴防護眼鏡」最符合健康講座主題。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: Your roaming privileges are currently being suspended due to anomalous international activity.
options: A. 由於異常的國際活動，您的漫遊權限目前正被停用。
B. 我們一直懷疑您的帳號涉及異常的跨國詐騙活動。
C. 您的漫遊權限一定是因為出國太久而被取消了。
D. 您必須親自聯繫客服才能恢復國際漫遊服務。
boss.explain: 原句：Your roaming privileges are currently being suspended due to anomalous international activity. 意思是「您的漫遊特權/權限目前正因為異常的國際活動而被暫停」。(is being suspended)

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The controversial silhouette of the winter jacket must have provoked a strong reaction from critics.
options: A. The critics have been praising traditional styles lately.
B. Yes, it was widely debated, but it's being sold out everywhere.
C. You must have forgotten to wear a jacket today.
D. The winter collection has been delayed until next year.
boss.explain: 原句：The controversial silhouette of the winter jacket must have provoked a strong reaction from critics.（這款冬季外套備受爭議的輪廓/剪裁一定引起了評論家強烈的反應。）回應「是的，它引起了廣泛討論，但現在到處都賣光了」最合邏輯。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: A hostile bid has been secretly orchestrated by our biggest competitor to seize market dominance.
options: A. 我們最大的競爭對手一直秘密策劃惡意收購，以奪取市場主導權。
B. 競爭對手一定用非法的手段奪取了我們的市場份額。
C. 這個惡意出價正在被我們的董事會嚴厲拒絕。
D. 為了主導市場，我們必須秘密策劃收購對手。
boss.explain: 原句：A hostile bid has been secretly orchestrated by our biggest competitor to seize market dominance. 意思是「一個惡意出價（收購）已經被我們最大的競爭對手秘密策劃，以奪取市場主導地位」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The implementation of the inclusive pedagogy must have required extensive faculty retraining.
options: A. Faculty members have been complaining about the low salary.
B. Indeed, professional development sessions have been running for a whole semester.
C. The students are being retrained to pass the tests.
D. You must have implemented the wrong teaching method.
boss.explain: 原句：The implementation of the inclusive pedagogy must have required extensive faculty retraining.（實施包容性教學法一定需要教職員工進行廣泛的重新訓練。）回應「的確，專業發展課程已經進行了整整一個學期」最恰當。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The therapeutic benefits of this herbal remedy have been fiercely debated by medical professionals.
options: A. 這種草藥療法的治療效益一直受到醫療專業人員的激烈辯論。
B. 醫療專家一定早就知道這種草藥的潛在風險。
C. 這種草藥目前正被醫院廣泛用於治療重症病患。
D. 我們必須證明這種草藥具有醫學上的療效。
boss.explain: 原句：The therapeutic benefits of this herbal remedy have been fiercely debated by medical professionals. 意思是「這種草藥療法的療效一直被醫療專業人員激烈地爭論」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The encryption protocols on the legacy server are being systematically overhauled to prevent breaches.
options: A. The overhaul must have caused the data breach last week.
B. The legacy server has been completely shut down.
C. Good, we have been dealing with minor cyber threats recently.
D. You must have encrypted the password successfully.
boss.explain: 原句：The encryption protocols on the legacy server are being systematically overhauled to prevent breaches.（舊伺服器上的加密協定正被系統性地全面翻修以防止外洩。）回應「太好了，我們最近一直在處理輕微的網路威脅」最符合情境。

boss.desc:
【短文】Policy Update: We have been reviewing the impact of the new emission cap. The strict regulation is claimed to have spurred unprecedented innovation in battery storage. Startups that adapted quickly must have secured substantial government grants early on.
Q: What is the main outcome of the strict regulation?
options: A. Innovation in battery storage
B. Reduction of government grants
C. Collapse of the startup market
D. Increase in emission limits
boss.explain: 短文第二句提到「The strict regulation is claimed to have spurred unprecedented innovation in battery storage. (嚴格的法規被宣稱激發了電池儲能方面史無前例的創新。)」，故 A 為正確解答。

boss.desc:
【短文】Energy Critique: The utility provider has been raising tariffs without prior consultation. The sudden spike in electricity bills is projected to be challenged in court by consumer advocacy groups. The executives must have assumed the public would simply absorb the extra cost without resistance.
Q: What action will likely be taken against the tariff increase?
options: A. A new marketing campaign
B. A legal challenge in court
C. A public consultation event
D. A reduction in utility services
boss.explain: 文中指出「The sudden spike in electricity bills is projected to be challenged in court (預期將在法庭上受到挑戰)」，即訴諸法律行動。

boss.desc:
【短文】Academic Journal: Researchers have been tracking the long-term effects of bilingual education. Cognitive flexibility is proven to have been greatly enhanced in students who started early. Policymakers who cut funding for language programs must have disregarded these empirical findings.
Q: What is a proven benefit of bilingual education mentioned?
options: A. Cheaper program funding
B. Enhanced cognitive flexibility
C. More physical strength
D. Faster reading speed in one language
boss.explain: 文中的「Cognitive flexibility is proven to have been greatly enhanced」直接對應到選項 B。

boss.desc:
【短文】Reform Editorial: We have been witnessing a steady decline in vocational training enrollment. The societal obsession with university degrees is largely blamed for this trend. The Ministry of Education must have neglected to promote the lucrative career paths available in skilled trades.
Q: Why is vocational enrollment declining according to the editorial?
options: A. Society's focus on university degrees
B. The high cost of vocational training
C. The lack of skilled instructors
D. The low salary of trade jobs
boss.explain: 文章表示「The societal obsession with university degrees is largely blamed for this trend (社會對大學學歷的迷戀很大程度上是這個趨勢的原因)」。

boss.desc:
【短文】Quality Assurance Report: The front desk staff has been undergoing intensive conflict resolution training. A recent altercation in the lobby is confirmed to have been handled unprofessionally. The duty supervisor must have lacked the necessary experience to de-escalate the situation effectively.
Q: Why is the staff undergoing training?
options: A. To learn how to use the new software
B. Because a situation was handled poorly
C. To prepare for the tourist season
D. Because they requested a pay raise
boss.explain: 因為近期大廳的爭執 (altercation) 被證實處理得不專業 (handled unprofessionally)，所以人員正在接受衝突解決訓練。

boss.desc:
【短文】Hospitality Trends: Boutique hotels have been capitalizing on the demand for eco-friendly tourism. Their use of sustainable toiletries is widely praised by environmentally conscious travelers. Larger chains must have noticed this lucrative niche, as they are rapidly adopting similar practices.
Q: Why are larger chains adopting sustainable practices?
options: A. To tap into a profitable market niche
B. To reduce their cleaning staff
C. To comply with strict government laws
D. To avoid being sued by travelers
boss.explain: lucrative niche 意指「利潤豐厚的利基市場」，大型連鎖飯店必定是注意到了這個商機才會跟進採用永續做法。

boss.desc:
【短文】Court Document: The plaintiff has been attempting to secure an astronomical sum for damages. However, the patent in question is considered to have been too vague to enforce effectively. The original creators must have poorly defined the technical boundaries of their invention.
Q: Why is the patent difficult to enforce?
options: A. The damages requested are too high
B. Its technical boundaries were poorly defined
C. The plaintiff lost the original document
D. The judge refused to read it
boss.explain: 文中指出「The original creators must have poorly defined the technical boundaries (原創者必定是對技術邊界的定義太差)」，導致專利太模糊而難以執行。

boss.desc:
【短文】Arbitration Update: The mediation board has been striving to resolve the software copyright conflict peacefully. The proprietary code is verified to have been independently developed, not stolen. The accusing party must have jumped to conclusions based solely on the superficial similarities in the final product.
Q: What did the mediation board verify?
options: A. The software was stolen
B. The code was independently developed
C. The accusing party was correct
D. The final product was superficial
boss.explain: 短文第二句「The proprietary code is verified to have been independently developed (專有程式碼被驗證為獨立開發)」為解答依據。

boss.desc:
【短文】Urban Development Review: We have been assessing the social impact of the new luxury high-rises. The affordable housing quota is alleged to have been completely ignored by the developers. The oversight committee must have turned a blind eye to these egregious violations during the approval process.
Q: What are the developers accused of ignoring?
options: A. The structural safety codes
B. The affordable housing requirement
C. The approval process rules
D. The environmental guidelines
boss.explain: 文中提及「The affordable housing quota is alleged to have been completely ignored (據稱可負擔住宅的配額被完全忽視)」，對應選項 B。

boss.desc:
【短文】Public Transport Update: The transport authority has been extending the light rail network to the outer suburbs. The improved connectivity is projected to be a major catalyst for suburban economic growth. Residents who previously relied on cars must have welcomed the reduction in their daily commute times.
Q: What is expected to boost suburban economic growth?
options: A. More cars on the road
B. Better transport connectivity
C. A new shopping mall
D. The transport authority's headquarters
boss.explain: 「The improved connectivity is projected to be a major catalyst for suburban economic growth (改善的連結性預計將成為郊區經濟增長的主要催化劑)」，因此選 B。

boss.desc:
【短文】Heritage Newsletter: Activists have been campaigning to save the century-old library from demolition. The architectural integrity of the building is recognized to have been compromised by years of neglect. The city administration must have intentionally withheld maintenance funds to justify its eventual destruction.
Q: Why was the building neglected according to activists?
options: A. To provide an excuse for tearing it down
B. Because the city had no money at all
C. Because activists protested against maintenance
D. To preserve its original ancient look
boss.explain: 文中寫道市政府必定是「intentionally withheld maintenance funds to justify its eventual destruction (故意扣留維修資金以合理化其最終的拆毀)」，選 A。

boss.desc:
【短文】Market Watch: The petroleum giant has been shedding its less profitable assets. The recent divestment is widely believed to have been forced by aggressive shareholder activism. The board must have realized that fossil fuel investments are becoming a long-term liability.
Q: What forced the divestment?
options: A. A new energy law
B. Aggressive shareholder activism
C. High oil prices
D. A lack of fossil fuels
boss.explain: 由句子「The recent divestment is widely believed to have been forced by aggressive shareholder activism (最近的資產撤資普遍被認為是受到激進股東行動主義的逼迫)」可知答案為 B。

boss.desc:
【短文】Management Memo: We have been analyzing the recent wave of negative online reviews. The malfunctioning air conditioners are determined to have been the primary source of frustration. The maintenance crew must have skipped the annual servicing routine during the off-season.
Q: What was the main source of guest frustration?
options: A. Broken air conditioners
B. The online review system
C. The off-season rates
D. The front desk staff
boss.explain: 文中的「malfunctioning air conditioners (故障的冷氣機)」直接對應到選項 A (Broken air conditioners)。

boss.desc: 請唸出單字：闡明
boss.speak: elucidate
boss.explain: 口說表達「ELUCIDATE」(v.)：闡明。例句：Please elucidate your main points for the client.（請為客戶闡明您的主要觀點。）

boss.desc: 請唸出單字：證實
boss.speak: substantiate
boss.explain: 口說表達「SUBSTANTIATE」(v.)：證實。例句：You must substantiate your claims with solid data.（您必須用可靠的數據來證實您的主張。）

boss.desc: 請唸出單字：憂慮的
boss.speak: apprehensive
boss.explain: 口說表達「APPREHENSIVE」(adj.)：憂慮的。例句：Investors are apprehensive about the volatile market.（投資者對動盪的市場感到憂慮。）

boss.desc: 請唸出單字：財政的
boss.speak: fiscal
boss.explain: 口說表達「FISCAL」(adj.)：財政的。例句：The fiscal year ends in March.（財政年度於三月結束。）

boss.desc: 請唸出單字：爭議
boss.speak: controversy
boss.explain: 口說表達「CONTROVERSY」(n.)：爭議。例句：If we had handled it properly at the time, this controversy could have been avoided.（如果我們當時處理得當，這場爭議原本是可以避免的。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：一直在遊說
boss.speak: have been lobbying
boss.explain: 口說表達「HAVE BEEN LOBBYING」(phr.)：一直在遊說。

boss.desc: 請唸出：一定已經洩漏了
boss.speak: must have leaked
boss.explain: 口說表達「MUST HAVE LEAKED」(phr.)：一定已經洩漏了。

boss.desc: 請唸出：正在被展示
boss.speak: is being showcased
boss.explain: 口說表達「IS BEING SHOWCASED」(phr.)：正在被展示。

boss.desc: 請唸出：記者一定錯誤引用了我的聲明
boss.ans: THE REPORTER MUST HAVE MISQUOTED MY STATEMENT
boss.speak: the reporter must have misquoted my statement
boss.explain: 口說表達「THE REPORTER MUST HAVE MISQUOTED MY STATEMENT」(phr.)：記者一定錯誤引用了我的聲明。

boss.desc: 請唸出：這項提案正面臨著懷疑
boss.ans: THE PROPOSAL IS BEING MET WITH SKEPTICISM
boss.speak: the proposal is being met with skepticism
boss.explain: 口說表達「THE PROPOSAL IS BEING MET WITH SKEPTICISM」(phr.)：這項提案正面臨著懷疑。

boss.desc: 請唸出：他一定懷有一些嚴重的疑慮
boss.ans: HE MUST HAVE HARBORED SOME SERIOUS DOUBTS
boss.speak: he must have harbored some serious doubts
boss.explain: 口說表達「HE MUST HAVE HARBORED SOME SERIOUS DOUBTS」(phr.)：他一定懷有一些嚴重的疑慮。

boss.desc: 請唸出：我們最近一直在要求更多資源
boss.ans: WE HAVE BEEN REQUESTING MORE RESOURCES LATELY
boss.speak: we have been requesting more resources lately
boss.explain: 口說表達「WE HAVE BEEN REQUESTING MORE RESOURCES LATELY」(phr.)：我們最近一直在要求更多資源。

boss.desc: 填空題：M E T _ C U L _ U _ (一絲不苟的；嚴謹的)
boss.speak: meticulous
boss.explain: METICULOUS (n.)：一絲不苟的；嚴謹的。填空答案為「IOS」。

boss.desc: 填空題：A C K N _ W L _ D G _ (承認；告知收悉)
boss.speak: acknowledge
boss.explain: ACKNOWLEDGE (v.)：承認；告知收悉。填空答案為「OEE」。例句：If they had acknowledged the problem earlier, we wouldn't have lost the client.（如果他們早點承認這個問題，我們就不會失去那位客戶了。）

boss.desc: 填空題：T R _ N S P A R _ N C _ (透明度)
boss.speak: transparency
boss.explain: TRANSPARENCY (n.)：透明度。填空答案為「AEY」。例句：Greater transparency would help users make informed choices.（更高的透明度有助使用者作出知情選擇。）

boss.desc: 填空題：C O M M _ N D A T I _ _ (表揚；讚賞)
boss.speak: commendation
boss.explain: COMMENDATION (n.)：表揚；讚賞。填空答案為「EON」。例句：The employee is being given a commendation for his outstanding leadership.（這名員工正因為其優秀的領導能力而受到表揚。）

boss.desc: 填空題：R _ M U N _ R A T I _ N (報酬；酬勞)
boss.speak: remuneration
boss.explain: REMUNERATION (n.)：報酬；酬勞。填空答案為「EEO」。例句：Employees have been demanding higher remuneration for their extra hours.（員工們一直要求為他們的額外工時提供更高的報酬。）

boss.desc: 填空題：C O _ R D I N A T _ _ (協調員；統籌者)
boss.speak: coordinator
boss.explain: COORDINATOR (n.)：協調員；統籌者。填空答案為「OOR」。例句：The project coordinator must have forgotten to send out the meeting invites.（專案統籌者一定是忘記發送會議邀請了。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：一絲不苟的；嚴謹的
boss.speak: meticulous
boss.explain: METICULOUS (n.)：請拼出：一絲不苟的；嚴謹的。

boss.desc: 請拼出：承認；告知收悉
boss.speak: acknowledge
boss.explain: ACKNOWLEDGE (v.)：承認；告知收到。例句：If they had acknowledged the problem earlier, we wouldn't have lost the client.（如果他們早點承認這個問題，我們就不會失去那位客戶了。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：透明度
boss.speak: transparency
boss.explain: TRANSPARENCY (n.)：決策或程序可被清楚了解的透明程度。例句：Greater transparency would help users make informed choices.（更高的透明度有助使用者作出知情選擇。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：表揚；讚賞
boss.speak: commendation
boss.explain: COMMENDATION (n.)：表揚；讚賞。例句：The employee is being given a commendation for his outstanding leadership.（這名員工正因為其優秀的領導能力而受到表揚。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：報酬；酬勞
boss.speak: remuneration
boss.explain: REMUNERATION (n.)：報酬；酬勞。例句：Employees have been demanding higher remuneration for their extra hours.（員工們一直要求為他們的額外工時提供更高的報酬。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: All expired pharmaceutical products are legally required to be disposed of properly.
options: A. 法律規定所有過期的藥品都必須妥善處理。
B. 過期藥品一直被藥局合法地重新販售。
C. 法律規定過期藥品不能隨意販售給一般人。
D. 所有藥品都必須在過期前合法地丟棄。
boss.explain: 「All expired pharmaceutical products are legally required to be disposed of properly.」意思是「法律規定所有過期的藥品都必須妥善處理。」（重點文法：複雜被動）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The doctor must have adjusted the dosage without notifying the pharmacy.
options: A. The pharmacy has been relocating recently.
B. That explains why the prescription looks different.
C. The dosage is being measured accurately.
D. He must have forgotten to take his medicine.
boss.explain: 說話者推測：「The doctor must have adjusted the dosage without notifying the pharmacy.（醫生一定是沒有通知藥局就調整了劑量。）」最合理的回應是難怪處方箋看起來不一樣 (B)。（重點文法：must have done）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The compromised funds are anticipated to be fully refunded within ten business days.
options: A. 被盜用的資金一定已經在十個工作天內退還了。
B. 我們一直在努力確保被盜用的資金能全額退還。
C. 預計被盜用的資金將在十個工作天內全額退還。
D. 您必須在十個工作天內申請退還被盜用的資金。
boss.explain: 「The compromised funds are anticipated to be fully refunded within ten business days.」意思是「預計被盜用的資金將在十個工作天內全額退還。」（重點文法：複雜被動）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: He must have unknowingly provided his sensitive banking details to the imposter.
options: A. The bank has been freezing his account since Monday.
B. His details are expected to be verified soon.
C. I must have met the imposter before.
D. That's terrible; he probably thought it was a legitimate call.
boss.explain: 說話者推測：「He must have unknowingly provided his sensitive banking details to the imposter.（他一定是在不知情的情況下把敏感的銀行資料給了冒名頂替者。）」最合理的回應是感嘆並推測他以為那是合法電話 (D)。（重點文法：must have done）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The event organizers must have underestimated the sheer volume of international participants.
options: A. 活動主辦方一定低估了國際參與者的龐大數量。
B. 國際參與者的數量目前正被活動主辦方低估。
C. 活動主辦方一直無法估算國際參與者的數量。
D. 活動主辦方必須限制國際參與者的總數量。
boss.explain: 「The event organizers must have underestimated the sheer volume of international participants.」意思是「活動主辦方一定低估了國際參與者的龐大數量。」（重點文法：must have done）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: How long have your sales representatives been explaining the intricate features?
options: A. The intricate features are being redesigned.
B. For over forty minutes; the client is very curious.
C. They must have forgotten the product details.
D. The representatives have been to the exhibition twice.
boss.explain: 說話者詢問：「How long have your sales representatives been explaining the intricate features?（你們的業務代表解釋這些複雜功能多久了？）」最合理的回應是回答時間長度並解釋原因 (B)。（重點文法：現在完成進行式）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The primary investigator must have overlooked the subtle statistical anomaly.
options: A. The anomaly is being corrected by the software.
B. We have been gathering statistical data for a week.
C. He's usually very meticulous, so that's quite surprising.
D. You must have been the primary investigator.
boss.explain: 說話者推測：「The primary investigator must have overlooked the subtle statistical anomaly.（首席研究員一定忽略了那個細微的統計異常。）」最合理的回應是訝異於這個通常很細心的人會犯錯 (C)。（重點文法：must have done）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: We have been conducting longitudinal studies to assess the long-term cognitive impacts.
options: A. 為了評估長期認知影響，我們必須進行縱向研究。
B. 長期認知影響一定已經透過縱向研究被評估了。
C. 這些縱向研究預計將徹底改變長期認知影響。
D. 我們一直在進行縱向研究，以評估長期的認知影響。
boss.explain: 「We have been conducting longitudinal studies to assess the long-term cognitive impacts.」意思是「我們一直在進行縱向研究，以評估長期的認知影響。」（重點文法：現在完成進行式）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The emergency responders have been coordinating the rescue efforts via radio.
options: A. 緊急救援人員一定已經透過無線電完成了救援。
B. 透過無線電的救援行動目前正受到嚴格監控。
C. 緊急救援人員一直在透過無線電協調救援行動。
D. 緊急救援人員必須透過無線電來指揮所有人。
boss.explain: 「The emergency responders have been coordinating the rescue efforts via radio.」意思是「緊急救援人員一直在透過無線電協調救援行動。」（重點文法：現在完成進行式）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: These precautionary measures are being implemented to prevent future structural failures.
options: A. 未來的結構性損壞一定是因為這些預防措施而造成的。
B. 我們一直在研究如何防止未來的結構性損壞。
C. 為了防止未來的結構性損壞，必須停止這些措施。
D. 正在實施這些預防措施，以防止未來的結構性損壞。
boss.explain: 「These precautionary measures are being implemented to prevent future structural failures.」意思是「正在實施這些預防措施，以防止未來的結構性損壞。」（重點文法：複雜被動）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The occupants must have panicked and abandoned their personal belongings in the hallways.
options: A. 裡面的住戶一定是因為恐慌而把私人物品丟在走廊上。
B. 我們一直在走廊上尋找住戶遺留下來的私人物品。
C. 走廊上的私人物品預計將被歸還給恐慌的住戶。
D. 住戶們必須在恐慌中把私人物品留在走廊上。
boss.explain: 「The occupants must have panicked and abandoned their personal belongings in the hallways.」意思是「裡面的住戶一定是因為恐慌而把私人物品丟在走廊上。」（重點文法：must have done）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Have the floor wardens been instructing everyone to use the stairwells instead of elevators?
options: A. The elevators are expected to be fixed tomorrow.
B. Yes, they are standing by the lifts to redirect the crowd.
C. I must have taken the wrong stairwell earlier.
D. The floor wardens have been evacuated safely.
boss.explain: 說話者詢問：「Have the floor wardens been instructing everyone to use the stairwells instead of elevators?（樓層疏散員有一直指示大家走樓梯不要搭電梯嗎？）」最合理的回應是肯定並說明他們正在電梯旁引導人群 (B)。（重點文法：現在完成進行式）

boss.desc:
【對話】A: Are the regional managers still debating the budget cuts?
B: Yes, they ___ over the disproportionate funding allocated to the marketing team for hours.
options: A. argue
B. have been arguing
C. are argued
D. will have argued
boss.explain: for hours 表示動作從過去持續到現在，且雙方仍在爭論，應使用現在完成進行式 have been arguing。

boss.desc: 【句子】The CEO's abrupt resignation is widely alleged ___ by a severe disagreement with the board regarding the company's future direction.
options: A. to have been prompted
B. prompting
C. to prompt
D. prompt
boss.explain: is widely alleged to have been + p.p. 表示「被廣泛指稱已經被...引發」，符合複雜被動語態且表示對過去事件的描述。

boss.desc:
【對話】A: The competitor's new smartwatch is completely flawless!
B: I agree. Their R&D department ___ an unprecedented amount of resources into resolving the battery issues.
options: A. should pour
B. can pour
C. must have poured
D. will pour
boss.explain: 對手產品完美，推測其研發部門「必定投入了」空前資源，用 must have + p.p.。

boss.desc: 【句子】To survive in a highly competitive market, established corporations must continuously ___ their business models to adapt to changing consumer behaviors.
options: A. dismantle
B. fluctuate
C. obscure
D. revolutionize
boss.explain: revolutionize (徹底改變/革新) 商業模式以適應消費者行為。dismantle (拆除)、fluctuate (波動)、obscure (使模糊) 皆不合語意。

boss.desc:
【對話】A: Has the tourism committee finalized the new preservation guidelines?
B: Not yet. They ___ ways to alleviate the pressure on the historic sites without deterring visitors.
options: A. have been exploring
B. explored
C. are explored
D. will explore
boss.explain: Not yet 表示動作尚未完成且仍在進行，使用現在完成進行式 have been exploring 表示「一直都在探索」。

boss.desc:
【短文】Urban Tourism Report: We have been closely monitoring the socio-economic impacts of the short-term rental boom. The displacement of long-term residents is confirmed to have been exacerbated by unregulated platforms. The municipal authorities must have prioritized lucrative tax revenues over housing stability for local citizens. 
Q: What is a major criticism leveled against the municipal authorities?
options: A. They banned short-term rental platforms entirely.
B. They valued financial gains more than local housing stability.
C. They failed to collect taxes from tourists.
D. They forced long-term residents to rent out their homes.
boss.explain: 文中提到當局 must have prioritized lucrative tax revenues over housing stability (必定是將豐厚的稅收置於住房穩定之上)，即重視財務收益勝過居住穩定。

boss.desc:
【短文】NGO Strategic Review: The foundation has been channeling funds into renewable energy projects in developing nations. The reliance on fossil fuels is considered to have hindered economic resilience in these regions. The previous administration must have overlooked the vital importance of sustainable infrastructure when drafting their development plans. 
Q: According to the review, what hindered economic resilience?
options: A. The foundation's funding strategy.
B. The reliance on fossil fuels.
C. The new sustainable infrastructure.
D. The overpopulation in developing nations.
boss.explain: 文中明確寫出 The reliance on fossil fuels is considered to have hindered economic resilience (對化石燃料的依賴被認為阻礙了經濟韌性)。

boss.desc:
【短文】Market Trend Analysis: Analysts have been scrutinizing the sudden decline of prominent fast-fashion brands. The shift toward ethical consumption is shown to have dismantled their once-dominant market position. The brand executives must have been oblivious to the growing environmental concerns among younger demographics. 
Q: Why did the fast-fashion brands lose their dominant position?
options: A. A sudden increase in raw material costs.
B. Consumers shifting towards ethical consumption.
C. The executives launching too many new designs.
D. A lack of younger demographics in the market.
boss.explain: 文中提到 The shift toward ethical consumption is shown to have dismantled their once-dominant market position (向道德消費的轉變瓦解了他們的市場主導地位)。

boss.desc:
【短文】Employee Handbook Update: The HR team has been revising the clauses regarding intellectual property. Any software developed during company hours is stipulated to be the sole property of the corporation. Former employees who attempted to patent such software must have failed to read the explicit constraints in their original contracts. 
Q: What is true about software developed during company hours?
options: A. It belongs exclusively to the corporation.
B. It can be patented by the individual developer.
C. It is usually ignored by the HR team.
D. It must be shared with former employees.
boss.explain: 文中寫道 is stipulated to be the sole property of the corporation (規定為公司的唯一財產)。

boss.desc:
【短文】Medical Research News: Scientists have been conducting clinical trials on a new mRNA therapy. The experimental treatment is purported to have alleviated severe symptoms of autoimmune disorders. The pharmaceutical company must have bypassed some preliminary testing phases to fast-track its release. 
Q: What is the pharmaceutical company suspected of doing?
options: A. Fabricating the clinical trial results.
B. Skipping certain early testing stages to speed up the release.
C. Selling the therapy at an inflated price.
D. Ignoring the symptoms of autoimmune disorders.
boss.explain: 文中提到 must have bypassed some preliminary testing phases to fast-track its release (必定是跳過了一些初步測試階段以加快上市)。

boss.desc:
【短文】Policy Critique: The aviation authority has been attempting to reduce noise pollution around urban airports. The new flight path regulations are known to have disproportionately affected low-income neighborhoods. The planners must have intentionally routed the air traffic away from affluent areas to avoid political backlash. 
Q: What is the main criticism of the new flight path regulations?
options: A. They increased overall noise pollution in the city.
B. They unfairly impacted lower-income residential areas.
C. They caused multiple flights to be delayed.
D. They were rejected by the affluent neighborhoods.
boss.explain: 文中提到 disproportionately affected low-income neighborhoods (不成比例地影響了低收入社區)，因此選 B。

boss.desc:
【短文】NGO Impact Report: Our volunteers have been dispensing essential medicines in the conflict zones for months. The local healthcare system is widely acknowledged to have collapsed completely due to the ongoing embargo. The international mediators must have severely misjudged the devastating humanitarian toll when they imposed the sanctions. 
Q: What caused the local healthcare system to collapse?
options: A. The lack of volunteers.
B. The ongoing embargo.
C. The distribution of expired medicines.
D. A sudden outbreak of a new virus.
boss.explain: 文中明確寫出 to have collapsed completely due to the ongoing embargo (由於持續的禁運而完全崩潰)。

boss.desc: 請唸出：你的奉獻今天正在被表彰。
boss.ans: YOUR COMMITMENT IS BEING RECOGNIZED TODAY
boss.speak: your commitment is being recognized today
boss.explain: 口說表達「YOUR COMMITMENT IS BEING RECOGNIZED TODAY」(phr.)：你的奉獻今天正在被表彰。。

boss.desc: 請唸出：她一定是無意中聽到了我們的對話。
boss.ans: SHE MUST HAVE OVERHEARD OUR CONVERSATION
boss.speak: she must have overheard our conversation
boss.explain: 口說表達「SHE MUST HAVE OVERHEARD OUR CONVERSATION」(phr.)：她一定是無意中聽到了我們的對話。。

boss.desc: 請唸出：這項指令目前正在被修改。
boss.ans: THE DIRECTIVE IS BEING MODIFIED CURRENTLY
boss.speak: the directive is being modified currently
boss.explain: 口說表達「THE DIRECTIVE IS BEING MODIFIED CURRENTLY」(phr.)：這項指令目前正在被修改。。

boss.desc: 請唸出：他們一直在討論好幾個小時了。
boss.ans: THEY HAVE BEEN DELIBERATING FOR HOURS
boss.speak: they have been deliberating for hours
boss.explain: 口說表達「THEY HAVE BEEN DELIBERATING FOR HOURS」(phr.)：他們一直在討論好幾個小時了。。

boss.desc: 請唸出：他一定是打算幫忙。
boss.ans: HE MUST HAVE INTENDED TO HELP
boss.speak: he must have intended to help
boss.explain: 口說表達「HE MUST HAVE INTENDED TO HELP」(phr.)：他一定是打算幫忙。。

boss.desc: 請唸出：麥克風正在被遠端靜音。
boss.ans: THE MICROPHONE IS BEING MUTED REMOTELY
boss.speak: the microphone is being muted remotely
boss.explain: 口說表達「THE MICROPHONE IS BEING MUTED REMOTELY」(phr.)：麥克風正在被遠端靜音。。

boss.desc: 請唸出：我們一直在推測他的動機。
boss.ans: WE HAVE BEEN PRESUMING HIS MOTIVES
boss.speak: we have been presuming his motives
boss.explain: 口說表達「WE HAVE BEEN PRESUMING HIS MOTIVES」(phr.)：我們一直在推測他的動機。。

boss.desc: 請唸出：她一定是推斷出了真相。
boss.ans: SHE MUST HAVE DEDUCED THE TRUTH
boss.speak: she must have deduced the truth
boss.explain: 口說表達「SHE MUST HAVE DEDUCED THE TRUTH」(phr.)：她一定是推斷出了真相。。

boss.desc: 請唸出：這個環節今天正在被主持。
boss.ans: THE SESSION IS BEING MODERATED TODAY
boss.speak: the session is being moderated today
boss.explain: 口說表達「THE SESSION IS BEING MODERATED TODAY」(phr.)：這個環節今天正在被主持。。

boss.desc: 請唸出：他們一直表現出值得讚賞的行為。
boss.ans: THEY HAVE BEEN DISPLAYING COMMENDABLE BEHAVIOR
boss.speak: they have been displaying commendable behavior
boss.explain: 口說表達「THEY HAVE BEEN DISPLAYING COMMENDABLE BEHAVIOR」(phr.)：他們一直表現出值得讚賞的行為。。

boss.desc: 請唸出：規則正不經意地被違反。
boss.ans: THE RULES ARE BEING INADVERTENTLY VIOLATED
boss.speak: the rules are being inadvertently violated
boss.explain: 口說表達「THE RULES ARE BEING INADVERTENTLY VIOLATED」(phr.)：規則正不經意地被違反。。

boss.desc: 請唸出：你一定是故意隱瞞它的。
boss.ans: YOU MUST HAVE DELIBERATELY CONCEALED IT
boss.speak: you must have deliberately concealed it
boss.explain: 口說表達「YOU MUST HAVE DELIBERATELY CONCEALED IT」(phr.)：你一定是故意隱瞞它的。。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The cleanup crews have been working tirelessly to restore power to the grid.
options: A. 清潔人員已經完成了市區街道的垃圾清掃工作。
B. 發電廠正在努力增加電網系統的供電容量。
C. 清理小組一直不知疲倦地工作，以恢復電網的供電。
D. 由於持續的停電，工作人員被迫暫停所有的清理工作。
boss.explain: 正確答案是 C。句意：清理小組一直不知疲倦地工作，以恢復電網的供電。原句：The cleanup crews have been working tirelessly to restore power to the grid.

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The sudden flash flood must have caught many unaware drivers by surprise.
options: A. Flash photography is not allowed here.
B. He was caught stealing from the store.
C. Driving at night requires more attention.
D. Absolutely, the water level rose incredibly fast.
boss.explain: 正確答案是 D。句意：突如其來的山洪爆發一定讓許多毫無防備的駕駛措手不及。原句：The sudden flash flood must have caught many unaware drivers by surprise. 選項 D「絕對是，水位上升得快得難以置信」最適合。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: A strict curfew is highly likely to be imposed on the flooded regions.
options: A. 極大可能會對淹水地區實施嚴格的宵禁。
B. 淹水地區的居民已經被要求立即撤離。
C. 警察正在淹水災區實施嚴格的交通管制。
D. 政府決定取消災區原本實施的夜間宵禁。
boss.explain: 正確答案是 A。句意：極大可能會對淹水地區實施嚴格的宵禁。原句：A strict curfew is highly likely to be imposed on the flooded regions.

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: They have been striving to master the core concepts of the new marketing strategy.
options: A. The new market is located downtown.
B. It is a steep learning curve, but they will get there.
C. Mastering a musical instrument takes years.
D. The strategy was completely abandoned.
boss.explain: 正確答案是 B。句意：他們一直努力掌握新行銷策略的核心概念。原句：They have been striving to master the core concepts of the new marketing strategy. 選項 B「這是一段陡峭的學習曲線（學習難度高），但他們會達成的」最適合。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The attendees must have been overwhelmed by the vast amount of technical jargon.
options: A. 參加者抱怨會議中缺乏具體的技術細節。
B. 技術人員成功地向參加者解釋了複雜的術語。
C. 參加者一定是被大量專業的技術術語給壓垮（搞得不知所措）了。
D. 講者刻意減少了簡報中專業術語的使用量。
boss.explain: 正確答案是 C。句意：參加者一定是被大量專業的技術術語給壓垮（搞得不知所措）了。原句：The attendees must have been overwhelmed by the vast amount of technical jargon.

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The entire certification process is designed to be completed entirely online.
options: A. I need to print out the physical certificate.
B. Online gaming has become very popular.
C. The designer won an award for the website.
D. That will certainly make it convenient for remote employees.
boss.explain: 正確答案是 D。句意：整個認證流程被設計成完全在線上完成。原句：The entire certification process is designed to be completed entirely online. 選項 D「這肯定會為遠端員工帶來便利」最適合。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: Art historians have been disputing the true authenticity of this portrait.
options: A. 藝術史學家們一直在爭論這幅肖像畫的真實性（真偽）。
B. 歷史學家們已經證實這幅肖像畫是偽造的。
C. 這幅肖像畫背後的歷史故事讓許多學者感到著迷。
D. 博物館決定無限期展出這幅備受爭議的畫作。
boss.explain: 正確答案是 A。句意：藝術史學家們一直在爭論這幅肖像畫的真實性（真偽）。原句：Art historians have been disputing the true authenticity of this portrait.

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The original colors must have faded significantly due to prolonged sunlight exposure.
options: A. Sunlight is a great natural source of Vitamin D.
B. Yes, the ultraviolet rays can be incredibly damaging to pigments.
C. Colorful paintings are usually more expensive.
D. The gallery stays open until the sun goes down.
boss.explain: 正確答案是 B。句意：由於長時間的陽光照射，原本的顏色一定已經明顯褪色了。原句：The original colors must have faded significantly due to prolonged sunlight exposure. 選項 B「對，紫外線對顏料的破壞力極強」最適合。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The newly discovered relics are slated to be exhibited in the grand hall.
options: A. 新發現的遺跡將被永久保存在地下的儲藏室中。
B. 博物館大廳正在進行翻修以容納更多遊客。
C. 新發現的文物預計將在大廳進行展出。
D. 考古團隊在大廳底下發掘出了新的古物。
boss.explain: 正確答案是 C。句意：新發現的文物預計將在大廳展出。原句：The newly discovered relics are slated to be exhibited in the grand hall.

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The final draft of the contract is supposed to be signed before midnight.
options: A. I will draft a letter to the manager soon.
